   31: function createUploadError({
   32:   message,
   33:   code = "PROJECT_MEDIA_UPLOAD_FAILED",
   34:   status = 400,
   35: }) {
   36:   const error = new Error(message);
   37: 
   38:   error.name = "ProjectMediaUploadError";
   39:   error.code = code;
   40:   error.status = status;
   41:   error.publicMessage = message;
   42: 
   43:   return error;
   44: }
   45: 
   46: /*
   47:  * =========================================
   48:  * Authorized Project Context
   49:  * =========================================
   50:  */
   51: 
   52: function getAuthorizedUploadContext(request) {
   53:   const userId = String(request.auth?.userId ?? "").trim();
   54:   const projectId = String(request.params?.projectId ?? "").trim();
   55:   const authorizedProject = request.authorizedProject;
   56: 
   57:   if (!userId || !authorizedProject) {
   58:     throw createUploadError({
   59:       message: "Project media upload is not authorized.",
   60:       code: "PROJECT_MEDIA_UPLOAD_UNAUTHORIZED",
   61:       status: 403,
   62:     });
   63:   }
   64: 
   65:   if (
   66:     !projectId ||
   67:     String(authorizedProject.id ?? "").trim() !== projectId
   68:   ) {
   69:     throw createUploadError({
   70:       message: "Authorized Project does not match the upload destination.",
   71:       code: "PROJECT_MEDIA_UPLOAD_PROJECT_MISMATCH",
   72:       status: 403,
   73:     });
   74:   }
   75: 
   76:   return { userId, projectId };
   77: }
   78: 
   79: /*
   80:  * =========================================
   81:  * Storage Directory Safety
   82:  * =========================================
   83:  */
   84: 
   85: async function ensureSafeUploadDirectory(userId, projectId) {
   86:   const root = getProjectMediaStorageRoot();
   87:   const destination = getProjectMediaDirectory(userId, projectId);
   88: 
   89:   await fs.mkdir(root, { recursive: true });
   90: 
   91:   const relative = path.relative(root, destination);
   92: 
   93:   if (
   94:     !relative ||
   95:     relative === ".." ||
   96:     relative.startsWith(`..${path.sep}`) ||
   97:     path.isAbsolute(relative)
   98:   ) {
   99:     throw new Error("Project media upload destination is invalid.");
  100:   }
  101: 
  102:   const directories = [
  103:     root,
  104:     path.dirname(destination),
  105:     destination,
  106:   ];
  107: 
  108:   for (const directory of directories) {
  109:     try {
  110:       await fs.mkdir(directory);
  111:     } catch (error) {
  112:       if (error?.code !== "EEXIST") {
  113:         throw error;
  114:       }
  115:     }
  116: 
  117:     const stats = await fs.lstat(directory);
  118: 
  119:     if (stats.isSymbolicLink() || !stats.isDirectory()) {
  120:       throw new Error(
  121:         "Project media upload directory is not a regular directory.",
  122:       );
  123:     }
  124:   }
  125: 
  126:   const canonicalRoot = await fs.realpath(root);
  127:   const canonicalDestination = await fs.realpath(destination);
  128:   const canonicalRelative = path.relative(
  129:     canonicalRoot,
  130:     canonicalDestination,
  131:   );
  132: 
  133:   if (
  134:     !canonicalRelative ||
  135:     canonicalRelative === ".." ||
  136:     canonicalRelative.startsWith(`..${path.sep}`) ||
  137:     path.isAbsolute(canonicalRelative)
  138:   ) {
  139:     throw new Error("Project media upload destination escapes storage root.");
  140:   }
  141: 
  142:   return destination;
  143: }
  144: 
  145: /*
  146:  * =========================================
  147:  * Multer Storage
  148:  * =========================================
  149:  */
  150: 
  151: const storage = multer.diskStorage({
  152:   destination(request, file, callback) {
  153:     let context;
  154: 
  155:     try {
  156:       context = getAuthorizedUploadContext(request);
  157:     } catch (error) {
  158:       return callback(error);
  159:     }
  160: 
  161:     ensureSafeUploadDirectory(context.userId, context.projectId)
  162:       .then((directory) => callback(null, directory))
  163:       .catch((error) => callback(error));
  164:   },
  165: 
  166:   filename(request, file, callback) {
  167:     const configuration = ALLOWED_MEDIA_TYPES.get(file.mimetype);
  168: 
  169:     if (!configuration) {
  170:       return callback(
  171:         createUploadError({
  172:           message: "Unsupported Project media type.",
  173:           code: "PROJECT_MEDIA_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED",
  174:         }),
  175:       );
  176:     }
  177: 
  178:     const filename = `${crypto.randomUUID()}${configuration.extension}`;
  179: 
  180:     return callback(null, filename);
  181:   },
  182: });
  183: 
  184: /*
  185:  * =========================================
  186:  * Media Type Filter
  187:  * =========================================
  188:  */
  189: 
  190: function projectMediaFileFilter(request, file, callback) {
  191:   try {
  192:     getAuthorizedUploadContext(request);
  193: 
  194:     if (!ALLOWED_MEDIA_TYPES.has(file.mimetype)) {
  195:       throw createUploadError({
  196:         message: "Unsupported Project media type.",
  197:         code: "PROJECT_MEDIA_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED",
  198:       });
  199:     }
  200: 
  201:     return callback(null, true);
  202:   } catch (error) {
  203:     return callback(error);
  204:   }
  205: }
  206: 
  207: /*
  208:  * =========================================
  209:  * Multer Middleware
  210:  * =========================================
  211:  */
  212: 
  213: const projectMediaUpload = multer({
  214:   storage,
  215:   limits: {
  216:     fileSize: MAX_VIDEO_SIZE,
  217:     files: 1,
  218:   },
  219:   fileFilter: projectMediaFileFilter,
  220: }).single("media");
  221: 
  222: export function uploadProjectMedia(request, response, next) {
  223:   projectMediaUpload(request, response, (error) => {
  224:     if (!error) {
  225:       return next();
  226:     }
  227: 
  228:     if (error instanceof multer.MulterError) {
  229:       if (error.code === "LIMIT_FILE_SIZE") {
  230:         return next(
  231:           createUploadError({
  232:             message: "Project media exceeds the 100 MiB upload limit.",
  233:             code: "PROJECT_MEDIA_TOO_LARGE",
  234:             status: 413,
  235:           }),
  236:         );
  237:       }
  238: 
  239:       if (
  240:         error.code === "LIMIT_FILE_COUNT" ||
  241:         error.code === "LIMIT_UNEXPECTED_FILE"
  242:       ) {
  243:         return next(
  244:           createUploadError({
  245:             message: "Upload exactly one file using the media field.",
  246:             code: "PROJECT_MEDIA_INVALID_FILE_COUNT",
  247:           }),
  248:         );
  249:       }
  250: 
  251:       return next(
  252:         createUploadError({
  253:           message: "Project media upload could not be processed.",
  254:           code: "PROJECT_MEDIA_UPLOAD_INVALID",
  255:         }),
  256:       );
  257:     }
  258: 
  259:     return next(error);
  260:   });
  261: }

  101: export async function validateProjectMedia(request, response, next) {

  113:

  115:     const stats = await fs.lstat(uploadedPath);

  128:       !ALLOWED_MEDIA_TYPES.has(detectedType.mime)
  129:     ) {
  130:       throw createValidationError(
  131:         "The uploaded file does not contain a supported media signature.",
  132:         "PROJECT_MEDIA_CONTENT_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED",
  133:       );
  134:     }
  135: 
  136:     if (detectedType.mime !== uploadedFile.mimetype) {
  137:       throw createValidationError(
  138:         "The uploaded media type does not match its contents.",
  139:         "PROJECT_MEDIA_TYPE_MISMATCH",
  140:       );
  141:     }
  142: 
  143:     const maximumSize = detectedType.mime.startsWith("image/")
  144:       ? MAX_IMAGE_SIZE
  145:       : MAX_VIDEO_SIZE;
  146: 
  147: 
  148:     if (stats.size > maximumSize) {
  149:       throw createValidationError(
  150:         "The uploaded media exceeds its permitted size.",
  151:         "PROJECT_MEDIA_TOO_LARGE",
  152:         413,
  153:       );
  154:     }
  155: 
  156:     request.projectMediaFile = {
  157:       ...uploadedFile,
  158:       verifiedMimeType: detectedType.mime,
  159:       verifiedExtension: detectedType.ext,
  160:       verifiedSize: stats.size,
  161:     };
  162: 
  163:     return next();
  164:   } catch (error) {
  165:     if (uploadedPath) {
  166:       try {
  167:         await removeRejectedFile(
  168:           request.auth?.userId,
  169:           request.params?.projectId,
  170:           uploadedPath,
  171:         );
  172:       } catch (cleanupError) {
  173:         console.error(
  174:           "Failed to clean up rejected Project media:",
  175:           cleanupError,
  176:         );
  177: 
  178:         return next(
  179:           createValidationError(
  180:             "Project media cleanup failed.",
  181:             "PROJECT_MEDIA_CLEANUP_FAILED",
  182:             500,
  183:           ),
  184:         );
  185:       }
  186:     }
  187: 
  188:     return next(error);
  189:   }
  190: }

  370: /*
  371:  * =========================================
  372:  * Complete Registration
  373:  * =========================================
  374:  *
  375:  * The following operations occur in one
  376:  * serializable transaction:
  377:  *
  378:  * 1. Lock and verify the challenge
  379:  * 2. Ensure the email is not registered
  380:  * 3. Create the user
  381:  * 4. Create the default profile
  382:  * 5. Create the default settings
  383:  * 6. Assign the standard user role
  384:  * 7. Consume the registration challenge
  385:  * 8. Write the completion audit event
  386:  */
  387: 
  388: export async function completeRegistration({
  389:   challengeId,
  390:   continuationTokenHash,
  391:   passwordHash,
  392: }) {
  393:   const pool = await getDatabasePool();
  394: 
  395:   const transaction = new sql.Transaction(pool);
  396: 
  397:   await transaction.begin(sql.ISOLATION_LEVEL.SERIALIZABLE);
  398: 
  399:   try {
  400:     /*
  401:      * Lock Registration Challenge
  402:      */
  403: 
  404:     const challengeResult = await new sql.Request(transaction)
  405:       .input("challengeId", sql.UniqueIdentifier, challengeId)
  406:       .input("continuationTokenHash", sql.Char(64), continuationTokenHash)
  407:       .query(`
  408:         SELECT TOP (1) *
  409:         FROM dbo.auth_challenges WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
  410:         WHERE id = @challengeId
  411:           AND purpose = N'registration'
  412:           AND continuation_token_hash = @continuationTokenHash
  413:           AND verified_at IS NOT NULL
  414:           AND consumed_at IS NULL
  415:           AND expires_at > SYSUTCDATETIME();
  416:       `);
  417: 
  418:     const challenge = challengeResult.recordset[0];
  419: 
  420:     if (!challenge) {
  421:       throw createRepositoryError({
  422:         message: "The verified registration challenge is unavailable.",
  423: 
  424:         code: "REGISTRATION_CONTINUATION_INVALID",
  425: 
  426:         status: 400,
  427: 
  428:         publicMessage:
  429:           "The registration session is invalid or expired. Start registration again.",
  430:       });
  431:     }
  432: 
  433:     /*
  434:      * Prevent Duplicate Account
  435:      */
  436: 
  437:     const existingUserResult = await new sql.Request(transaction).input(
  438:       "normalizedEmail",
  439:       sql.NVarChar(320),
  440:       challenge.normalized_pending_email,
  441:     ).query(`
  442:         SELECT TOP (1) id
  443:         FROM dbo.users WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
  444:         WHERE normalized_email = @normalizedEmail;
  445:       `);
  446: 
  447:     if (existingUserResult.recordset[0]) {
  448:       throw createRepositoryError({
  449:         message: "A user already exists for the registration email.",
  450: 
  451:         code: "ACCOUNT_ALREADY_EXISTS",
  452: 
  453:         status: 409,
  454: 
  455:         publicMessage:
  456:           "This registration cannot be completed. Try signing in or resetting your password.",
  457:       });
  458:     }
  459: 
  460:     /*
  461:      * Create User
  462:      */
  463: 
  464:     const userResult = await new sql.Request(transaction)
  465:       .input("email", sql.NVarChar(320), challenge.pending_email)
  466:       .input(
  467:         "normalizedEmail",
  468:         sql.NVarChar(320),
  469:         challenge.normalized_pending_email,
  470:       )
  471:       .input("passwordHash", sql.NVarChar(500), passwordHash).query(`
  472:         INSERT INTO dbo.users
  473:         (
  474:           email,
  475:           normalized_email,
  476:           password_hash,
  477:           email_verified_at,
  478:           account_status
  479:         )
  480:         OUTPUT
  481:           inserted.id,
  482:           inserted.email,
  483:           inserted.normalized_email,
  484:           inserted.email_verified_at,
  485:           inserted.account_status,
  486:           inserted.failed_login_count,
  487:           inserted.locked_until,
  488:           inserted.last_login_at,
  489:           inserted.created_at,
  490:           inserted.updated_at
  491:         VALUES
  492:         (
  493:           @email,
  494:           @normalizedEmail,
  495:           @passwordHash,
  496:           SYSUTCDATETIME(),
  497:           N'active'
  498:         );
  499:       `);
  500: 
  501:     const user = userResult.recordset[0];
  502: 
  503:     /*
  504:      * Create Profile and Settings
  505:      */
  506: 
  507:     await new sql.Request(transaction).input(
  508:       "userId",
  509:       sql.UniqueIdentifier,
  510:       user.id,
  511:     ).query(`
  512:         INSERT INTO dbo.user_profiles (user_id)
  513:         VALUES (@userId);
  514: 
  515:         INSERT INTO dbo.user_settings (user_id)
  516:         VALUES (@userId);
  517:       `);
  518: 
  519:     /*
  520:      * Find Standard User Role
  521:      */
  522: 
  523:     const roleResult = await new sql.Request(transaction).query(`
  524:       SELECT TOP (1) id
  525:       FROM dbo.roles
  526:       WHERE name = N'user';
  527:     `);
  528: 
  529:     const role = roleResult.recordset[0];
  530: 
  531:     if (!role) {
  532:       throw createRepositoryError({
  533:         message: "The standard user role does not exist.",
  534: 
  535:         code: "STANDARD_USER_ROLE_MISSING",
  536: 
  537:         publicMessage: "The account could not be created.",
  538:       });
  539:     }
  540: 
  541:     /*
  542:      * Assign Role, Consume Challenge and Audit
  543:      */
  544: 
  545:     await new sql.Request(transaction)
  546:       .input("userId", sql.UniqueIdentifier, user.id)
  547:       .input("roleId", sql.UniqueIdentifier, role.id)
  548:       .input("challengeId", sql.UniqueIdentifier, challengeId).query(`
  549:         INSERT INTO dbo.user_roles
  550:         (
  551:           user_id,
  552:           role_id
  553:         )
  554:         VALUES
  555:         (
  556:           @userId,
  557:           @roleId
  558:         );
  559: 
  560:         UPDATE dbo.auth_challenges
  561:         SET consumed_at = SYSUTCDATETIME()
  562:         WHERE id = @challengeId;
  563: 
  564:         INSERT INTO dbo.login_audit_events
  565:         (
  566:           user_id,
  567:           email_attempted,
  568:           event_type,
  569:           was_successful,
  570:           ip_address_hash
  571:         )
  572:         SELECT
  573:           @userId,
  574:           pending_email,
  575:           N'registration_completed',
  576:           1,
  577:           request_ip_hash
  578:         FROM dbo.auth_challenges
  579:         WHERE id = @challengeId;
  580:       `);
  581: 
  582:     await transaction.commit();
  583: 
  584:     return {
  585:       user: mapUser(user),
  586:       roles: ["user"],
  587:     };
  588:   } catch (error) {
  589:     /*
  590:      * Roll Back Every Registration Change
  591:      */
  592: 
  593:     try {
  594:       await transaction.rollback();
  595:     } catch (rollbackError) {
  596:       console.error("Registration transaction rollback failed:", rollbackError);
  597:     }
  598: 
  599:     /*
  600:      * Normalize Unique Constraint Errors
  601:      */
  602: 
  603:     if (error.number === 2601 || error.number === 2627) {
  604:       throw createRepositoryError({
  605:         message: "A unique account value already exists.",
  606: 
  607:         code: "ACCOUNT_ALREADY_EXISTS",
  608: 
  609:         status: 409,
  610: 
  611:         publicMessage:
  612:           "This registration cannot be completed. Try signing in or resetting your password.",
  613:       });
  614:     }
  615: 
  616:     throw error;
  617:   }
  618: }

    3: const EXPERIENCE_COLUMNS = `
    4:   id,
    5:   user_id,
    6:   position_title,
    7:   organization_name,
    8:   category,
    9:   record_status,
   10:   experience_data,
   11:   created_at,
   12:   updated_at,
   13:   row_version
   14: `;
   15: 
   16: function mapExperienceRow(row) {
   17:   if (!row) {
   18:     return null;
   19:   }
   20: 
   21:   const experienceData =
   22:     typeof row.experience_data === "string"
   23:       ? JSON.parse(row.experience_data)
   24:       : row.experience_data;
   25: 
   26:   if (
   27:     !experienceData ||
   28:     typeof experienceData !== "object" ||
   29:     Array.isArray(experienceData)
   30:   ) {
   31:     throw new Error("Stored Experience data is invalid.");
   32:   }
   33: 
   34:   return {
   35:     ...experienceData,
   36: 
   37:     // Database columns are authoritative.
   38:     id: row.id,
   39:     position: {
   40:       ...(experienceData.position || {}),
   41:       title: row.position_title,
   42:     },
   43:     organization: {
   44:       ...(experienceData.organization || {}),
   45:       name: row.organization_name,
   46:     },
   47:     category: row.category,
   48:     status: row.record_status,
   49: 
   50:     createdAt: row.created_at,
   51:     updatedAt: row.updated_at,
   52:     rowVersion: Buffer.from(row.row_version).toString("base64"),
   53:   };
   54: }
   55: 
   56: function bindExperienceParameters(request, userId, experience) {
   57:   return request
   58:     .input("id", sql.NVarChar(200), experience.id)
   59:     .input("userId", sql.UniqueIdentifier, userId)
   60:     .input(
   61:       "positionTitle",
   62:       sql.NVarChar(200),
   63:       experience.position.title,
   64:     )
   65:     .input(
   66:       "organizationName",
   67:       sql.NVarChar(200),
   68:       experience.organization.name,
   69:     )
   70:     .input("category", sql.NVarChar(50), experience.category)
   71:     .input("recordStatus", sql.NVarChar(20), experience.status)
   72:     .input(
   73:       "experienceData",
   74:       sql.NVarChar(sql.MAX),
   75:       JSON.stringify(experience),
   76:     );
   77: }

  210: /*
  211:  * =========================================
  212:  * Known Account Password Failure
  213:  * =========================================
  214:  */
  215: 
  216: export async function recordPasswordLoginFailure({
  217:   userId,
  218:   email,
  219:   maximumFailures = 5,
  220:   lockMinutes = 15,
  221:   failureReason = "invalid_credentials",
  222:   ipAddressHash = null,
  223:   userAgent = null,
  224: }) {
  225:   const pool = await getDatabasePool();
  226: 
  227:   const transaction = new sql.Transaction(pool);
  228: 
  229:   await transaction.begin(sql.ISOLATION_LEVEL.SERIALIZABLE);
  230: 
  231:   try {
  232:     const result = await new sql.Request(transaction)
  233:       .input("userId", sql.UniqueIdentifier, userId)
  234:       .input("maximumFailures", sql.Int, maximumFailures)
  235:       .input("lockMinutes", sql.Int, lockMinutes).query(`
  236:           UPDATE dbo.users
  237:           SET
  238:             failed_login_count =
  239:               failed_login_count + 1,
  240: 
  241:             locked_until =
  242:               CASE
  243:                 WHEN failed_login_count + 1 >=
  244:                   @maximumFailures
  245:                 THEN DATEADD(
  246:                   MINUTE,
  247:                   @lockMinutes,
  248:                   SYSUTCDATETIME()
  249:                 )
  250:                 ELSE locked_until
  251:               END,
  252: 
  253:             updated_at =
  254:               SYSUTCDATETIME()
  255:           OUTPUT
  256:             inserted.failed_login_count,
  257:             inserted.locked_until
  258:           WHERE id = @userId;
  259:         `);
  260: 
  261:     const updated = result.recordset[0];
  262: 
  263:     if (!updated) {
  264:       throw createLoginRepositoryError({
  265:         message: "The user disappeared during failed-login processing.",
  266: 
  267:         code: "LOGIN_USER_NOT_FOUND",
  268: 
  269:         status: 404,
  270: 
  271:         publicMessage: "The email or password is incorrect.",
  272:       });
  273:     }
  274: 
  275:     const wasLocked =
  276:       updated.failed_login_count >= maximumFailures &&
  277:       Boolean(updated.locked_until);
  278: 
  279:     await new sql.Request(transaction)
  280:       .input("userId", sql.UniqueIdentifier, userId)
  281:       .input("email", sql.NVarChar(320), email)
  282:       .input("failureReason", sql.NVarChar(100), failureReason)
  283:       .input("ipAddressHash", sql.Char(64), ipAddressHash)
  284:       .input("userAgent", sql.NVarChar(1000), userAgent)
  285:       .input("wasLocked", sql.Bit, wasLocked).query(`
  286:         INSERT INTO dbo.login_audit_events
  287:         (
  288:           user_id,
  289:           email_attempted,
  290:           event_type,
  291:           was_successful,
  292:           failure_reason,
  293:           ip_address_hash,
  294:           user_agent
  295:         )
  296:         VALUES
  297:         (
  298:           @userId,
  299:           @email,
  300:           N'password_login_failed',
  301:           0,
  302:           @failureReason,
  303:           @ipAddressHash,
  304:           @userAgent
  305:         );
  306: 
  307:         IF @wasLocked = 1
  308:         BEGIN
  309:           INSERT INTO dbo.login_audit_events
  310:           (
  311:             user_id,
  312:             email_attempted,
  313:             event_type,
  314:             was_successful,
  315:             failure_reason,
  316:             ip_address_hash,
  317:             user_agent
  318:           )
  319:           VALUES
  320:           (
  321:             @userId,
  322:             @email,
  323:             N'account_locked',
  324:             0,
  325:             N'maximum_password_attempts',
  326:             @ipAddressHash,
  327:             @userAgent
  328:           );
  329:         END;
  330:       `);
  331: 
  332:     await transaction.commit();
  333: 
  334:     return {
  335:       failedLoginCount: updated.failed_login_count,
  336: 
  337:       lockedUntil: updated.locked_until,
  338: 
  339:       wasLocked,
  340:     };
  341:   } catch (error) {
  342:     try {
  343:       await transaction.rollback();
  344:     } catch (rollbackError) {
  345:       console.error(
  346:         "Password-failure transaction rollback failed:",
  347:         rollbackError,
  348:       );
  349:     }
  350: 
  351:     throw error;
  352:   }
  353: }
  354: 
  355: /*
  356:  * =========================================
  357:  * Successful Password Verification

  359:  */
  360: 
  361: export async function recordPasswordLoginSuccess({

  377:         failed_login_count = 0,

  379:         updated_at =
  380:           SYSUTCDATETIME()

  406: /*
  407:  * =========================================
  408:  * Create Login OTP Challenge
  409:  * =========================================
  410:  *
  411:  * Older incomplete login challenges for this
  412:  * user are deleted in the same transaction.
  413:  *
  414:  * OTP-delivery auditing is intentionally not
  415:  * performed here. The service records it only
  416:  * after the email provider succeeds or fails.
  417:  */
  418: 
  419: export async function replaceLoginChallenge({
  420:   id,
  421:   userId,
  422:   email,
  423:   normalizedEmail,
  424:   codeHash,
  425:   expiresAt,
  426:   lastSentAt,
  427:   maximumAttempts = 5,
  428:   requestIpHash = null,
  429: }) {
  430:   const pool = await getDatabasePool();
  431: 
  432:   const transaction = new sql.Transaction(pool);
  433: 
  434:   await transaction.begin(sql.ISOLATION_LEVEL.SERIALIZABLE);
  435: 
  436:   try {
  437:     await new sql.Request(transaction).input(
  438:       "userId",
  439:       sql.UniqueIdentifier,
  440:       userId,
  441:     ).query(`
  442:         DELETE FROM dbo.auth_challenges
  443:         WHERE user_id = @userId
  444:           AND purpose = N'login'
  445:           AND consumed_at IS NULL;
  446:       `);
  447: 
  448:     const result = await new sql.Request(transaction)
  449:       .input("id", sql.UniqueIdentifier, id)
  450:       .input("userId", sql.UniqueIdentifier, userId)
  451:       .input("email", sql.NVarChar(320), email)
  452:       .input("normalizedEmail", sql.NVarChar(320), normalizedEmail)
  453:       .input("codeHash", sql.Char(64), codeHash)
  454:       .input("expiresAt", sql.DateTime2(3), expiresAt)
  455:       .input("lastSentAt", sql.DateTime2(3), lastSentAt)
  456:       .input("maximumAttempts", sql.Int, maximumAttempts)
  457:       .input("requestIpHash", sql.Char(64), requestIpHash).query(`
  458:           INSERT INTO dbo.auth_challenges
  459:           (
  460:             id,
  461:             user_id,
  462:             pending_email,
  463:             normalized_pending_email,
  464:             purpose,
  465:             code_hash,
  466:             expires_at,
  467:             last_sent_at,
  468:             maximum_attempts,
  469:             request_ip_hash
  470:           )
  471:           OUTPUT inserted.*
  472:           VALUES
  473:           (
  474:             @id,
  475:             @userId,
  476:             @email,
  477:             @normalizedEmail,
  478:             N'login',
  479:             @codeHash,
  480:             @expiresAt,
  481:             @lastSentAt,
  482:             @maximumAttempts,
  483:             @requestIpHash
  484:           );
  485:         `);
  486: 
  487:     const challenge = result.recordset[0];
  488: 
  489:     await transaction.commit();
  490: 
  491:     return mapChallenge(challenge);
  492:   } catch (error) {
  493:     try {
  494:       await transaction.rollback();
  495:     } catch (rollbackError) {
  496:       console.error(
  497:         "Login-challenge transaction rollback failed:",
  498:         rollbackError,
  499:       );
  500:     }
  501: 
  502:     throw error;
  503:   }
  504: }
  505: 
  506: /*
  507:  * =========================================

  509:  * =========================================
  510:  *
  511:  * Used when OTP email delivery fails.
  512:  */
  513: 
  514: export async function deleteLoginChallengeById(challengeId) {
  515:   const pool = await getDatabasePool();
  516: 
  517:   const result = await pool
  518:     .request()
  519:     .input("challengeId", sql.UniqueIdentifier, challengeId).query(`
  520:       DELETE FROM dbo.auth_challenges
  521:       WHERE id = @challengeId
  522:         AND purpose = N'login'
  523:         AND consumed_at IS NULL;
  524: 
  525:       SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS deleted_count;
  526:     `);
  527: 
  528:   return Number(result.recordset[0]?.deleted_count || 0) > 0;
  529: }

  552: /*
  553:  * =========================================
  554:  * Refresh Login OTP Challenge
  555:  * =========================================
  556:  *
  557:  * Replaces the OTP hash and expiration while
  558:  * preserving the challenge identifier.
  559:  *
  560:  * The SQL condition also enforces the resend
  561:  * cooldown atomically, preventing concurrent
  562:  * requests from sending multiple codes.
  563:  */
  564: 
  565: export async function refreshLoginChallenge({
  566:   challengeId,
  567:   codeHash,
  568:   expiresAt,
  569:   lastSentAt,
  570:   cooldownSeconds = 60,
  571:   requestIpHash = null,
  572: }) {
  573:   const pool = await getDatabasePool();
  574: 
  575:   const result = await pool
  576:     .request()
  577:     .input("challengeId", sql.UniqueIdentifier, challengeId)
  578:     .input("codeHash", sql.Char(64), codeHash)
  579:     .input("expiresAt", sql.DateTime2(3), expiresAt)
  580:     .input("lastSentAt", sql.DateTime2(3), lastSentAt)
  581:     .input("cooldownSeconds", sql.Int, cooldownSeconds)
  582:     .input("requestIpHash", sql.Char(64), requestIpHash).query(`
  583:       UPDATE dbo.auth_challenges
  584:       SET
  585:         code_hash = @codeHash,
  586:         attempt_count = 0,
  587:         expires_at = @expiresAt,
  588:         last_sent_at = @lastSentAt,
  589:         request_ip_hash = @requestIpHash
  590:       OUTPUT inserted.*
  591:       WHERE id = @challengeId
  592:         AND purpose = N'login'
  593:         AND verified_at IS NULL
  594:         AND consumed_at IS NULL
  595:         AND
  596:         (
  597:           last_sent_at IS NULL
  598:           OR last_sent_at <=
  599:             DATEADD(
  600:               SECOND,
  601:               -@cooldownSeconds,
  602:               SYSUTCDATETIME()
  603:             )
  604:         );
  605:     `);
  606: 
  607:   return mapChallenge(result.recordset[0]);
  608: }

  610: /*
  611:  * =========================================
  612:  * Failed Login OTP Attempt
  613:  * =========================================
  614:  */
  615: 
  616: export async function recordFailedLoginOtpAttempt({
  617:   challengeId,
  618:   userId,
  619:   email,
  620:   ipAddressHash = null,
  621:   userAgent = null,
  622: }) {
  623:   const pool = await getDatabasePool();
  624: 
  625:   const transaction = new sql.Transaction(pool);
  626: 
  627:   await transaction.begin(sql.ISOLATION_LEVEL.SERIALIZABLE);
  628: 
  629:   try {
  630:     const result = await new sql.Request(transaction).input(
  631:       "challengeId",
  632:       sql.UniqueIdentifier,
  633:       challengeId,
  634:     ).query(`
  635:           UPDATE dbo.auth_challenges
  636:           SET
  637:             attempt_count =
  638:               attempt_count + 1
  639:           OUTPUT
  640:             inserted.attempt_count,
  641:             inserted.maximum_attempts
  642:           WHERE id = @challengeId
  643:             AND purpose = N'login'
  644:             AND verified_at IS NULL
  645:             AND consumed_at IS NULL
  646:             AND expires_at >
  647:               SYSUTCDATETIME()
  648:             AND attempt_count <
  649:               maximum_attempts;
  650:         `);
  651: 
  652:     const attempt = result.recordset[0];
  653: 
  654:     if (attempt) {
  655:       await new sql.Request(transaction)
  656:         .input("userId", sql.UniqueIdentifier, userId)
  657:         .input("email", sql.NVarChar(320), email)
  658:         .input("ipAddressHash", sql.Char(64), ipAddressHash)
  659:         .input("userAgent", sql.NVarChar(1000), userAgent).query(`
  660:           INSERT INTO dbo.login_audit_events
  661:           (
  662:             user_id,
  663:             email_attempted,
  664:             event_type,
  665:             was_successful,
  666:             failure_reason,
  667:             ip_address_hash,
  668:             user_agent
  669:           )
  670:           VALUES
  671:           (
  672:             @userId,
  673:             @email,
  674:             N'login_otp_failed',
  675:             0,
  676:             N'incorrect_otp',
  677:             @ipAddressHash,
  678:             @userAgent
  679:           );
  680:         `);
  681:     }
  682: 
  683:     await transaction.commit();
  684: 
  685:     return attempt
  686:       ? {
  687:           attemptCount: attempt.attempt_count,
  688: 
  689:           maximumAttempts: attempt.maximum_attempts,
  690:         }
  691:       : null;
  692:   } catch (error) {
  693:     try {
  694:       await transaction.rollback();
  695:     } catch (rollbackError) {
  696:       console.error(
  697:         "Login OTP failure transaction rollback failed:",
  698:         rollbackError,
  699:       );
  700:     }
  701: 
  702:     throw error;
  703:   }
  704: }

  794: /*
  795:  * =========================================
  796:  * Complete Login and Create Session
  797:  * =========================================
  798:  *
  799:  * Challenge consumption, session insertion,
  800:  * last-login update and login audit occur in
  801:  * one serializable transaction.
  802:  */
  803: 
  804: export async function completeLoginWithSession({
  805:   challengeId,
  806:   refreshTokenHash,
  807:   deviceName = null,
  808:   userAgent = null,
  809:   ipAddressHash = null,
  810:   expiresAt,
  811: }) {
  812:   const pool = await getDatabasePool();
  813: 
  814:   const transaction = new sql.Transaction(pool);
  815: 
  816:   await transaction.begin(sql.ISOLATION_LEVEL.SERIALIZABLE);
  817: 
  818:   try {
  819:     const challengeResult = await new sql.Request(transaction).input(
  820:       "challengeId",
  821:       sql.UniqueIdentifier,
  822:       challengeId,
  823:     ).query(`
  824:           SELECT TOP (1) *
  825:           FROM dbo.auth_challenges
  826:             WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
  827:           WHERE id = @challengeId
  828:             AND purpose = N'login'
  829:             AND verified_at IS NOT NULL
  830:             AND consumed_at IS NULL
  831:             AND expires_at >
  832:               SYSUTCDATETIME();
  833:         `);
  834: 
  835:     const challenge = challengeResult.recordset[0];
  836: 
  837:     if (!challenge) {
  838:       throw createLoginRepositoryError({
  839:         message: "The verified login challenge is unavailable.",
  840: 
  841:         code: "LOGIN_CHALLENGE_INVALID",
  842: 
  843:         status: 400,
  844: 
  845:         publicMessage: "The login verification request is invalid or expired.",
  846:       });
  847:     }
  848: 
  849:     const userResult = await new sql.Request(transaction).input(
  850:       "userId",
  851:       sql.UniqueIdentifier,
  852:       challenge.user_id,
  853:     ).query(`
  854:           SELECT TOP (1)
  855:             id,
  856:             email,
  857:             normalized_email,
  858:             password_hash,
  859:             email_verified_at,
  860:             account_status,
  861:             failed_login_count,
  862:             locked_until,
  863:             last_login_at,
  864:             created_at,
  865:             updated_at
  866:           FROM dbo.users
  867:             WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
  868:           WHERE id = @userId
  869:             AND account_status =
  870:               N'active'
  871:             AND email_verified_at
  872:               IS NOT NULL
  873:             AND
  874:             (
  875:               locked_until IS NULL
  876:               OR locked_until <=
  877:                 SYSUTCDATETIME()
  878:             );
  879:         `);
  880: 
  881:     const user = userResult.recordset[0];
  882: 
  883:     if (!user) {
  884:       throw createLoginRepositoryError({
  885:         message: "The login account is unavailable or locked.",
  886: 
  887:         code: "LOGIN_ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE",
  888: 
  889:         status: 403,
  890: 
  891:         publicMessage: "This account cannot sign in at this time.",
  892:       });
  893:     }
  894: 
  895:     const sessionResult = await new sql.Request(transaction)
  896:       .input("userId", sql.UniqueIdentifier, user.id)
  897:       .input("refreshTokenHash", sql.Char(64), refreshTokenHash)
  898:       .input("deviceName", sql.NVarChar(200), deviceName)
  899:       .input("userAgent", sql.NVarChar(1000), userAgent)
  900:       .input("ipAddressHash", sql.Char(64), ipAddressHash)
  901:       .input("expiresAt", sql.DateTime2(3), expiresAt).query(`
  902:           INSERT INTO dbo.sessions
  903:           (
  904:             user_id,
  905:             refresh_token_hash,
  906:             device_name,
  907:             user_agent,
  908:             ip_address_hash,
  909:             expires_at
  910:           )
  911:           OUTPUT inserted.*
  912:           VALUES
  913:           (
  914:             @userId,
  915:             @refreshTokenHash,
  916:             @deviceName,
  917:             @userAgent,
  918:             @ipAddressHash,
  919:             @expiresAt
  920:           );
  921:         `);
  922: 
  923:     const session = sessionResult.recordset[0];
  924: 
  925:     await new sql.Request(transaction)
  926:       .input("challengeId", sql.UniqueIdentifier, challengeId)
  927:       .input("userId", sql.UniqueIdentifier, user.id)
  928:       .input("email", sql.NVarChar(320), user.email)
  929:       .input("ipAddressHash", sql.Char(64), ipAddressHash)
  930:       .input("userAgent", sql.NVarChar(1000), userAgent).query(`
  931:         UPDATE dbo.auth_challenges
  932:         SET
  933:           consumed_at =
  934:             SYSUTCDATETIME()
  935:         WHERE id = @challengeId;
  936: 
  937:         UPDATE dbo.users
  938:         SET
  939:           last_login_at =
  940:             SYSUTCDATETIME(),
  941: 
  942:           failed_login_count = 0,
  943: 
  944:           locked_until = NULL,
  945: 
  946:           updated_at =
  947:             SYSUTCDATETIME()
  948:         WHERE id = @userId;
  949: 
  950:         INSERT INTO dbo.login_audit_events
  951:         (
  952:           user_id,
  953:           email_attempted,
  954:           event_type,
  955:           was_successful,
  956:           failure_reason,
  957:           ip_address_hash,
  958:           user_agent
  959:         )
  960:         VALUES
  961:         (
  962:           @userId,
  963:           @email,
  964:           N'login_completed',
  965:           1,
  966:           NULL,
  967:           @ipAddressHash,
  968:           @userAgent
  969:         );
  970:       `);
  971: 
  972:     const rolesResult = await new sql.Request(transaction).input(
  973:       "userId",
  974:       sql.UniqueIdentifier,
  975:       user.id,
  976:     ).query(`
  977:           SELECT role.name
  978:           FROM dbo.user_roles AS user_role
  979:           INNER JOIN dbo.roles AS role
  980:             ON role.id =
  981:               user_role.role_id
  982:           WHERE user_role.user_id =
  983:             @userId
  984:           ORDER BY role.name;
  985:         `);
  986: 
  987:     await transaction.commit();
  988: 
  989:     return {
  990:       user: mapUser(user),
  991: 
  992:       session: mapSession(session),
  993: 
  994:       roles: rolesResult.recordset.map((role) => role.name),
  995:     };
  996:   } catch (error) {
  997:     try {
  998:       await transaction.rollback();
  999:     } catch (rollbackError) {
 1000:       console.error(
 1001:         "Login-completion transaction rollback failed:",
 1002:         rollbackError,
 1003:       );
 1004:     }
 1005: 
 1006:     if (error.number === 2601 || error.number === 2627) {
 1007:       throw createLoginRepositoryError({
 1008:         message: "The generated session token already exists.",
 1009: 
 1010:         code: "SESSION_TOKEN_CONFLICT",
 1011: 
 1012:         status: 409,
 1013: 
 1014:         publicMessage:
 1015:           "The session could not be created. Please try signing in again.",
 1016:       });
 1017:     }
 1018: 
 1019:     throw error;
 1020:   }
 1021: }

  157:              file_type, file_size, use_default_avatar, image_width,
  158:              image_height, description, display_order, item_status,
  159:              created_at, updated_at
  160:       FROM dbo.user_profile_pictures
  161:       WHERE user_id = @userId
  162:       ORDER BY display_order, created_at;
  163:     `);
  164: 
  165:   return mapProfile({
  166:     profileRow,
  167:     titleRows: titleResult.recordset,
  168:     contactRows: contactResult.recordset,
  169:     pictureRows: pictureResult.recordset,
  170:   });

  256: export async function replaceProfileByUserId(userId, profile) {
  257:   const pool = await getDatabasePool();
  258:   const transaction = new sql.Transaction(pool);
  259:   await transaction.begin(sql.ISOLATION_LEVEL.SERIALIZABLE);
  260: 
  261:   try {
  262:     const updateResult = await new sql.Request(transaction)
  263:       .input("userId", sql.UniqueIdentifier, userId)
  264:       .input("firstName", sql.NVarChar(100), profile.firstName)
  265:       .input("middleName", sql.NVarChar(100), profile.middleName)
  266:       .input("lastName", sql.NVarChar(100), profile.lastName)
  267:       .input(
  268:         "visibility",
  269:         sql.NVarChar(20),
  270:         profile.visibility.isPublic ? "public" : "private",
  271:       )
  272:       .input("profileStatus", sql.NVarChar(20), profile.status)
  273:       .input(
  274:         "primaryTitle",
  275:         sql.NVarChar(200),
  276:         profile.preferences.primaryProfessionalTitleId || null,
  277:       )
  278:       .input(
  279:         "primaryEmail",
  280:         sql.NVarChar(200),
  281:         profile.preferences.primaryEmailId || null,
  282:       )
  283:       .input(
  284:         "primaryPhone",
  285:         sql.NVarChar(200),
  286:         profile.preferences.primaryPhoneId || null,
  287:       )
  288:       .input(
  289:         "primaryWebsite",
  290:         sql.NVarChar(200),
  291:         profile.preferences.primaryWebsiteId || null,
  292:       )
  293:       .input(
  294:         "primaryLocation",
  295:         sql.NVarChar(200),
  296:         profile.preferences.primaryLocationId || null,
  297:       )
  298:       .input(
  299:         "primarySocial",
  300:         sql.NVarChar(200),
  301:         profile.preferences.primarySocialLinkId || null,
  302:       )
  303:       .input(
  304:         "primaryPicture",
  305:         sql.NVarChar(200),
  306:         profile.preferences.primaryProfilePictureId || null,
  307:       ).query(`
  308:         UPDATE dbo.user_profiles
  309:         SET first_name = @firstName,
  310:             middle_name = @middleName,
  311:             last_name = @lastName,
  312:             display_name = LTRIM(RTRIM(CONCAT(@firstName, N' ', NULLIF(@middleName, N''), N' ', @lastName))),
  313:             profile_visibility = @visibility,
  314:             profile_status = @profileStatus,
  315:             primary_professional_title_id = @primaryTitle,
  316:             primary_email_id = @primaryEmail,
  317:             primary_phone_id = @primaryPhone,
  318:             primary_website_id = @primaryWebsite,
  319:             primary_location_id = @primaryLocation,
  320:             primary_social_link_id = @primarySocial,
  321:             primary_profile_picture_id = @primaryPicture,
  322:             updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME()
  323:         WHERE user_id = @userId;
  324:       `);
  325: 
  326:     if (!updateResult.rowsAffected[0]) {
  327:       await transaction.rollback();
  328:       return null;
  329:     }
  330: 
  331:     await new sql.Request(transaction).input(
  332:       "userId",
  333:       sql.UniqueIdentifier,
  334:       userId,
  335:     ).query(`
  336:         DELETE FROM dbo.user_profile_professional_titles WHERE user_id = @userId;
  337:         DELETE FROM dbo.user_profile_contacts WHERE user_id = @userId;
  338:         DELETE FROM dbo.user_profile_pictures WHERE user_id = @userId;
  339:       `);
  340: 
  341:     for (const item of profile.professionalTitles) {
  342:       await insertTitle(transaction, userId, item);
  343:     }
  344: 
  345:     for (const category of CONTACT_CATEGORIES) {
  346:       for (const item of profile[category]) {
  347:         await insertContact(transaction, userId, category, item);
  348:       }
  349:     }
  350: 
  351:     for (const item of profile.profilePictures) {
  352:       await insertPicture(transaction, userId, item);
  353:     }
  354: 
  355:     await transaction.commit();
  356:     return findProfileByUserId(userId);
  357:   } catch (error) {
  358:     try {
  359:       await transaction.rollback();
  360:     } catch (rollbackError) {
  361:       console.error("Profile transaction rollback failed:", rollbackError);
  362:     }
  363: 
  364:     throw error;
  365:   }
  366: }

   86:         @originalFileName,
   87:         @mimeType,

  106: /*
  107:  * =========================================
  108:  * Find Active Session by Refresh Token
  109:  * =========================================
  110:  *
  111:  * This lookup also confirms that the owning
  112:  * account remains active and unlocked.
  113:  */
  114: 
  115: export async function findActiveSessionByRefreshTokenHash(refreshTokenHash) {
  116:   const pool = await getDatabasePool();
  117: 
  118:   const result = await pool
  119:     .request()
  120:     .input("refreshTokenHash", sql.Char(64), refreshTokenHash).query(`
  121:       SELECT
  122:         session_record.id,
  123:         session_record.user_id,
  124:         session_record.refresh_token_hash,
  125:         session_record.device_name,
  126:         session_record.user_agent,
  127:         session_record.ip_address_hash,
  128:         session_record.created_at,
  129:         session_record.last_used_at,
  130:         session_record.expires_at,
  131:         session_record.revoked_at,
  132:         session_record.revocation_reason,
  133: 
  134:         app_user.email,
  135:         app_user.normalized_email,
  136:         app_user.email_verified_at,
  137:         app_user.account_status,
  138:         app_user.locked_until,
  139: 
  140:         role.name AS role_name
  141:       FROM dbo.sessions AS session_record
  142:       INNER JOIN dbo.users AS app_user
  143:         ON app_user.id =
  144:           session_record.user_id
  145:       LEFT JOIN dbo.user_roles AS user_role
  146:         ON user_role.user_id =
  147:           app_user.id
  148:       LEFT JOIN dbo.roles AS role
  149:         ON role.id =
  150:           user_role.role_id
  151:       WHERE session_record.refresh_token_hash =
  152:           @refreshTokenHash
  153:         AND session_record.revoked_at IS NULL
  154:         AND session_record.expires_at >
  155:           SYSUTCDATETIME()
  156:         AND app_user.account_status =
  157:           N'active'
  158:         AND
  159:         (
  160:           app_user.locked_until IS NULL
  161:           OR app_user.locked_until <=
  162:             SYSUTCDATETIME()
  163:         );
  164:     `);
  165: 
  166:   if (result.recordset.length === 0) {
  167:     return null;
  168:   }
  169: 
  170:   const firstRecord = result.recordset[0];
  171: 
  172:   const roles = [
  173:     ...new Set(
  174:       result.recordset.map((record) => record.role_name).filter(Boolean),
  175:     ),
  176:   ];
  177: 
  178:   return {
  179:     session: mapSession(firstRecord),
  180: 
  181:     user: mapSessionUser(firstRecord),
  182: 
  183:     roles,
  184:   };
  185: }

  193: export async function findSessionById({ sessionId, userId }) {
  194:   const pool = await getDatabasePool();
  195: 
  196:   const result = await pool
  197:     .request()
  198:     .input("sessionId", sql.UniqueIdentifier, sessionId)
  199:     .input("userId", sql.UniqueIdentifier, userId).query(`
  200:       SELECT TOP (1) *
  201:       FROM dbo.sessions
  202:       WHERE id = @sessionId
  203:         AND user_id = @userId;

  209: /*
  210:  * =========================================
  211:  * Rotate Refresh Token
  212:  * =========================================
  213:  *
  214:  * Rotation succeeds only when the supplied
  215:  * current hash still belongs to an active,
  216:  * unexpired session.
  217:  *
  218:  * If two requests attempt rotation using the
  219:  * same token, only the first one succeeds.
  220:  */
  221: 
  222: export async function rotateSessionRefreshToken({
  223:   sessionId,
  224:   currentRefreshTokenHash,
  225:   newRefreshTokenHash,
  226:   newExpiresAt,
  227:   ipAddressHash = null,
  228:   userAgent = null,
  229: }) {
  230:   const pool = await getDatabasePool();
  231: 
  232:   const result = await pool
  233:     .request()
  234:     .input("sessionId", sql.UniqueIdentifier, sessionId)
  235:     .input("currentRefreshTokenHash", sql.Char(64), currentRefreshTokenHash)
  236:     .input("newRefreshTokenHash", sql.Char(64), newRefreshTokenHash)
  237:     .input("newExpiresAt", sql.DateTime2(3), newExpiresAt)
  238:     .input("ipAddressHash", sql.Char(64), ipAddressHash)
  239:     .input("userAgent", sql.NVarChar(1000), userAgent).query(`
  240:       UPDATE dbo.sessions
  241:       SET
  242:         refresh_token_hash =
  243:           @newRefreshTokenHash,
  244: 
  245:         last_used_at =
  246:           SYSUTCDATETIME(),
  247: 
  248:         expires_at =
  249:           @newExpiresAt,
  250: 
  251:         ip_address_hash =
  252:           COALESCE(
  253:             @ipAddressHash,
  254:             ip_address_hash
  255:           ),
  256: 
  257:         user_agent =
  258:           COALESCE(
  259:             @userAgent,
  260:             user_agent
  261:           )
  262:       OUTPUT inserted.*
  263:       WHERE id = @sessionId
  264:         AND refresh_token_hash =
  265:           @currentRefreshTokenHash
  266:         AND revoked_at IS NULL
  267:         AND expires_at >
  268:           SYSUTCDATETIME();
  269:     `);
  270: 
  271:   return mapSession(result.recordset[0]);
  272: }

  102:   return mapSkillRow(result.recordset[0]);
  103: }
  104: 
  105: export async function findSkillByNormalizedName(
  106:   userId,
  107:   normalizedName,
  108: ) {
  109:   const pool = await getDatabasePool();
  110: 
  111:   const result = await pool
  112:     .request()
  113:     .input("userId", sql.UniqueIdentifier, userId)
  114:     .input("normalizedName", sql.NVarChar(150), normalizedName)
  115:     .query(`
  116:       SELECT ${SKILL_COLUMNS}
  117:       FROM dbo.skills
  118:       WHERE user_id = @userId
  119:         AND normalized_name = @normalizedName;
  120:     `);
  121: 
  122:   return mapSkillRow(result.recordset[0]);
  123: }

  148:       @category,

  158: export async function updateSkill(
  159:   userId,
  160:   skill,
  161:   expectedRowVersion,
  162: ) {
  163:   const pool = await getDatabasePool();
  164: 
  165:   const request = bindSkillParameters(
  166:     pool.request(),
  167:     userId,
  168:     skill,
  169:   ).input(
  170:     "expectedRowVersion",
  171:     sql.Binary(8),
  172:     Buffer.from(expectedRowVersion, "base64"),
  173:   );
  174: 
  175:   const result = await request.query(`
  176:     UPDATE dbo.skills
  177:     SET
  178:       name = @name,
  179:       normalized_name = @normalizedName,
  180:       category = @category,
  181:       skill_type = @skillType,
  182:       record_status = @recordStatus,
  183:       skill_data = @skillData,
  184:       updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME()
  185:     WHERE id = @id
  186:       AND user_id = @userId
  187:       AND row_version = @expectedRowVersion;
  188:   `);
  189: 
  190:   if (result.rowsAffected[0] === 0) {
  191:     return null;
  192:   }
  193: 
  194:   return findSkillById(userId, skill.id);
  195: }

  197: export async function deleteSkill(
  198:   userId,
  199:   skillId,
  200:   expectedRowVersion,
  201: ) {
  202:   const pool = await getDatabasePool();
  203: 
  204:   const result = await pool
  205:     .request()
  206:     .input("userId", sql.UniqueIdentifier, userId)
  207:     .input("id", sql.NVarChar(200), skillId)
  208:     .input(
  209:       "expectedRowVersion",
  210:       sql.Binary(8),
  211:       Buffer.from(expectedRowVersion, "base64"),
  212:     )
  213:     .query(`
  214:       DELETE FROM dbo.skills
  215:       WHERE id = @id
  216:         AND user_id = @userId
  217:         AND row_version = @expectedRowVersion;
  218:     `);
  219: 
  220:   return result.rowsAffected[0] > 0;
  221: }
  222: /*
  223:  * =========================================
  224:  * Transactional Legacy Skills Import
  225:  * =========================================
  226:  *
  227:  * The caller must validate the complete import
  228:  * payload before invoking this function.
  229:  *
  230:  * No existing Skill records are overwritten.
  231:  */
  232: 
  233: export async function importSkillsBatch(userId, skills) {
  234:   if (!Array.isArray(skills) || skills.length === 0) {
  235:     throw new Error("A nonempty Skills array is required.");
  236:   }
  237: 
  238:   const pool = await getDatabasePool();
  239:   const transaction = new sql.Transaction(pool);
  240: 
  241:   let transactionStarted = false;
  242: 
  243:   try {
  244:     await transaction.begin(sql.ISOLATION_LEVEL.SERIALIZABLE);
  245:     transactionStarted = true;
  246: 
  247:     const existingResult = await new sql.Request(transaction)
  248:       .input("userId", sql.UniqueIdentifier, userId)
  249:       .query(`
  250:         SELECT ${SKILL_COLUMNS}
  251:         FROM dbo.skills WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
  252:         WHERE user_id = @userId;
  253:       `);
  254: 
  255:     const existingSkills = existingResult.recordset.map(mapSkillRow);
  256: 
  257:     const importedIds = new Set();
  258:     const importedNames = new Set();
  259: 
  260:     const normalize = (value) =>
  261:       value
  262:         .normalize("NFKC")
  263:         .trim()
  264:         .toLocaleLowerCase()
  265:         .replace(/[._/\\-]+/g, " ")
  266:         .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
  267:         .trim();
  268: 
  269:     const namesOf = (skill) => [
  270:       skill.name,
  271:       ...(Array.isArray(skill.aliases) ? skill.aliases : []),
  272:     ];
  273: 
  274:     for (const existing of existingSkills) {
  275:       for (const name of namesOf(existing)) {
  276:         importedNames.add(normalize(name));
  277:       }
  278:     }
  279: 
  280:     const batchNames = new Set();
  281: 
  282:     for (const skill of skills) {
  283:       if (importedIds.has(skill.id)) {
  284:         throw new Error("Duplicate Skill identifier in import batch.");
  285:       }
  286: 
  287:       importedIds.add(skill.id);
  288: 
  289:       for (const name of namesOf(skill)) {
  290:         const normalized = normalize(name);
  291: 
  292:         if (importedNames.has(normalized) || batchNames.has(normalized)) {
  293:           const error = new Error(
  294:             "A Skill name or alias conflicts with an existing Skill.",
  295:           );
  296: 
  297:           error.code = "SKILL_NAME_CONFLICT";
  298:           error.status = 409;
  299:           error.publicMessage = error.message;
  300: 
  301:           throw error;
  302:         }
  303: 
  304:         batchNames.add(normalized);
  305:       }
  306:     }
  307: 
  308:     const imported = [];
  309: 
  310:     for (const skill of skills) {
  311:       const idCheck = await new sql.Request(transaction)
  312:         .input("id", sql.NVarChar(200), skill.id)
  313:         .query(`
  314:           SELECT id
  315:           FROM dbo.skills WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
  316:           WHERE id = @id;
  317:         `);
  318: 
  319:       if (idCheck.recordset.length > 0) {
  320:         const error = new Error(
  321:           "A Skill identifier is already registered.",
  322:         );
  323: 
  324:         error.code = "SKILL_ID_CONFLICT";
  325:         error.status = 409;
  326:         error.publicMessage = error.message;
  327: 
  328:         throw error;
  329:       }
  330: 
  331:       const request = bindSkillParameters(
  332:         new sql.Request(transaction),
  333:         userId,
  334:         skill,
  335:       )
  336:         .input(
  337:           "createdAt",
  338:           sql.DateTime2(3),
  339:           new Date(skill.createdAt),
  340:         )
  341:         .input(
  342:           "updatedAt",
  343:           sql.DateTime2(3),
  344:           new Date(skill.updatedAt),
  345:         );
  346: 
  347:       const result = await request.query(`
  348:         INSERT INTO dbo.skills (
  349:           id,
  350:           user_id,
  351:           name,
  352:           normalized_name,
  353:           category,
  354:           skill_type,
  355:           record_status,
  356:           skill_data,
  357:           created_at,
  358:           updated_at
  359:         )
  360:         OUTPUT
  361:           INSERTED.id,
  362:           INSERTED.user_id,
  363:           INSERTED.name,
  364:           INSERTED.normalized_name,
  365:           INSERTED.category,
  366:           INSERTED.skill_type,
  367:           INSERTED.record_status,
  368:           INSERTED.skill_data,
  369:           INSERTED.created_at,
  370:           INSERTED.updated_at,
  371:           INSERTED.row_version
  372:         VALUES (
  373:           @id,
  374:           @userId,
  375:           @name,
  376:           @normalizedName,
  377:           @category,
  378:           @skillType,
  379:           @recordStatus,
  380:           @skillData,
  381:           @createdAt,
  382:           @updatedAt
  383:         );
  384:       `);
  385: 
  386:       imported.push(mapSkillRow(result.recordset[0]));
  387:     }
  388: 
  389:     await transaction.commit();
  390:     transactionStarted = false;
  391: 
  392:     return imported;
  393:   } catch (error) {
  394:     if (transactionStarted) {
  395:       try {
  396:         await transaction.rollback();
  397:       } catch (rollbackError) {
  398:         error.rollbackError = rollbackError;
  399:       }
  400:     }
  401: 
  402:     const databaseErrorNumber =
  403:       error.number ??
  404:       error.originalError?.number ??
  405:       error.cause?.number;
  406: 
  407:     if (
  408:       databaseErrorNumber === 2601 ||
  409:       databaseErrorNumber === 2627
  410:     ) {
  411:       const conflict = new Error(
  412:         "A Skill identifier or name conflicts with an existing record.",
  413:       );
  414: 
  415:       conflict.name = "SkillImportConflictError";
  416:       conflict.code = "SKILL_IMPORT_DATABASE_CONFLICT";
  417:       conflict.status = 409;
  418:       conflict.publicMessage = conflict.message;
  419: 
  420:       throw conflict;
  421:     }
  422: 
  423:     throw error;
  424:   }
  425: }

   20:   refreshSession,

   22: 
   23: /*
   24:  * =========================================
   25:  * Authentication Router
   26:  * =========================================
   27:  */
   28: 
   29: const router = Router();
   30: 
   31: /*
   32:  * =========================================
   33:  * Rate-Limit Response
   34:  * =========================================
   35:  */
   36: 
   37: function createRateLimitHandler({ code, message }) {
   38:   return (request, response) => {
   39:     response.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");
   40: 
   41:     return response.status(429).json({
   42:       status: "error",
   43: 
   44:       code,
   45: 
   46:       message,
   47:     });
   48:   };
   49: }
   50: 
   51: /*
   52:  * =========================================
   53:  * Shared Rate-Limit Configuration
   54:  * =========================================
   55:  */
   56: 
   57: const sharedRateLimitOptions = {
   58:   standardHeaders: "draft-8",
   59: 
   60:   legacyHeaders: false,
   61: 
   62:   /*
   63:    * Do not count successful preflight
   64:    * requests against authentication limits.
   65:    */
   66: 
   67:   skip(request) {
   68:     return request.method === "OPTIONS";
   69:   },
   70: };
   71: 
   72: /*
   73:  * =========================================
   74:  * Registration Rate Limits
   75:  * =========================================
   76:  */
   77: 
   78: /*
   79:  * Limits email and OTP generation requests.
   80:  */
   81: 
   82: const registrationRequestLimiter = rateLimit({
   83:   ...sharedRateLimitOptions,
   84: 
   85:   windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000,
   86: 
   87:   limit: 10,
   88: 
   89:   handler: createRateLimitHandler({
   90:     code: "REGISTRATION_REQUEST_RATE_LIMITED",
   91: 
   92:     message:
   93:       "Too many registration requests were made. Please wait before trying again.",
   94:   }),
   95: });
   96: 
   97: /*
   98:  * Allows several OTP attempts while still
   99:  * protecting the endpoint from automation.
  100:  *
  101:  * The challenge itself also enforces its own
  102:  * maximum attempt count in the database.
  103:  */
  104: 
  105: const registrationVerificationLimiter = rateLimit({
  106:   ...sharedRateLimitOptions,
  107: 
  108:   windowMs: 10 * 60 * 1000,
  109: 
  110:   limit: 30,
  111: 
  112:   handler: createRateLimitHandler({
  113:     code: "REGISTRATION_VERIFICATION_RATE_LIMITED",
  114: 
  115:     message:
  116:       "Too many verification attempts were made. Please wait before trying again.",
  117:   }),
  118: });
  119: 
  120: /*
  121:  * Limits final account-creation requests.
  122:  */
  123: 
  124: const registrationCompletionLimiter = rateLimit({
  125:   ...sharedRateLimitOptions,
  126: 
  127:   windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000,
  128: 
  129:   limit: 10,
  130: 
  131:   handler: createRateLimitHandler({
  132:     code: "REGISTRATION_COMPLETION_RATE_LIMITED",
  133: 
  134:     message:
  135:       "Too many account-creation attempts were made. Please wait before trying again.",
  136:   }),
  137: });
  138: 
  139: /*
  140:  * =========================================
  141:  * Login Rate Limits
  142:  * =========================================
  143:  */
  144: 
  145: /*
  146:  * Password verification is intentionally
  147:  * restricted because password hashing is
  148:  * computationally expensive.
  149:  *
  150:  * The login service and database also track
  151:  * failures for known accounts.
  152:  */
  153: 
  154: const passwordLoginLimiter = rateLimit({
  155:   ...sharedRateLimitOptions,
  156: 
  157:   windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000,
  158: 
  159:   limit: 10,
  160: 
  161:   handler: createRateLimitHandler({
  162:     code: "LOGIN_PASSWORD_RATE_LIMITED",
  163: 
  164:     message:
  165:       "Too many sign-in attempts were made. Please wait before trying again.",
  166:   }),
  167: });
  168: 
  169: /*
  170:  * The database challenge applies its own OTP
  171:  * attempt limit. This IP-based limiter adds a
  172:  * second layer against automated requests.
  173:  */
  174: 
  175: const loginVerificationLimiter = rateLimit({
  176:   ...sharedRateLimitOptions,
  177: 
  178:   windowMs: 10 * 60 * 1000,
  179: 
  180:   limit: 30,
  181: 
  182:   handler: createRateLimitHandler({
  183:     code: "LOGIN_VERIFICATION_RATE_LIMITED",
  184: 
  185:     message:
  186:       "Too many login verification attempts were made. Please wait before trying again.",
  187:   }),
  188: });
  189: 
  190: /*
  191:  * Limits repeated OTP email delivery.
  192:  *
  193:  * The service also enforces a per-challenge
  194:  * cooldown in Azure SQL.
  195:  */
  196: 
  197: const loginResendLimiter = rateLimit({
  198:   ...sharedRateLimitOptions,
  199: 
  200:   windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000,
  201: 
  202:   limit: 5,
  203: 
  204:   handler: createRateLimitHandler({
  205:     code: "LOGIN_RESEND_RATE_LIMITED",
  206: 
  207:     message:
  208:       "Too many verification codes were requested. Please wait before trying again.",
  209:   }),
  210: });
  211: 
  212: /*
  213:  * =========================================
  214:  * Session Rate Limits
  215:  * =========================================
  216:  */
  217: 
  218: /*
  219:  * Refreshing a session performs a database
  220:  * lookup and rotates its refresh token.
  221:  */
  222:

  224:   ...sharedRateLimitOptions,

  227:

  231:     code: "SESSION_REFRESH_RATE_LIMITED",
  232: 
  233:     message:
  234:       "Too many session refresh requests were made. Please wait before trying again.",
  235:   }),
  236: });
  237: 
  238: /*
  239:  * Reading the current session does not rotate
  240:  * the token, so it can have a higher limit.
  241:  */
  242: 
  243: const sessionReadLimiter = rateLimit({
  244:   ...sharedRateLimitOptions,
  245: 
  246:   windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000,
  247: 
  248:   limit: 120,
  249: 
  250:   handler: createRateLimitHandler({
  251:     code: "SESSION_READ_RATE_LIMITED",
  252: 
  253:     message:
  254:       "Too many session requests were made. Please wait before trying again.",

  262:

  264:   ...sharedRateLimitOptions,
  265: 
  266:   windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000,
  267: 
  268:   limit: 30,
  269: 
  270:   handler: createRateLimitHandler({
  271:     code: "LOGOUT_RATE_LIMITED",
  272: 
  273:     message:
  274:       "Too many logout requests were made. Please wait before trying again.",
  275:   }),
  276: });

   28: function createRateLimitHandler({ code, message }) {
   29:   return (request, response) => {
   30:     response.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-store");
   31: 
   32:     return response.status(429).json({
   33:       status: "error",
   34:       code,
   35:       message,
   36:     });
   37:   };

   68:     code: "USER_SESSION_READ_RATE_LIMITED",

   72:   }),

   85:   limit: 30,
   86:

   88:     code: "USER_SESSION_REVOCATION_RATE_LIMITED",

    1: import { z } from "zod";
    2: 
    3: /*
    4:  * =========================================
    5:  * Limits
    6:  * =========================================
    7:  */
    8: 
    9: export const CONTACT_NAME_MAXIMUM_LENGTH = 120;
   10: export const CONTACT_EMAIL_MAXIMUM_LENGTH = 320;
   11: export const CONTACT_SUBJECT_MAXIMUM_LENGTH = 160;
   12: export const CONTACT_MESSAGE_MINIMUM_LENGTH = 20;
   13: export const CONTACT_MESSAGE_MAXIMUM_LENGTH = 5000;
   14: 
   15: /*
   16:  * =========================================
   17:  * Categories
   18:  * =========================================
   19:  */
   20: 
   21: export const CONTACT_CATEGORIES = Object.freeze([
   22:   "account_access",
   23:   "profile_records",
   24:   "ai_assistance",
   25:   "resume",
   26:   "portfolio",
   27:   "privacy_security",
   28:   "partnership",
   29:   "feedback",
   30:   "other",
   31: ]);
   32: 
   33: /*
   34:  * =========================================
   35:  * Contact Request Schema
   36:  * =========================================
   37:  */
   38: 
   39: export const contactRequestSchema = z
   40:   .object({
   41:     name: z
   42:       .string({
   43:         error: "Name is required.",
   44:       })
   45:       .trim()
   46:       .min(1, "Name is required.")
   47:       .max(
   48:         CONTACT_NAME_MAXIMUM_LENGTH,
   49:         `Name cannot contain more than ${CONTACT_NAME_MAXIMUM_LENGTH} characters.`,
   50:       ),
   51: 
   52:     email: z
   53:       .string({
   54:         error: "Email is required.",
   55:       })
   56:       .trim()
   57:       .min(1, "Email is required.")
   58:       .max(
   59:         CONTACT_EMAIL_MAXIMUM_LENGTH,
   60:         `Email cannot contain more than ${CONTACT_EMAIL_MAXIMUM_LENGTH} characters.`,
   61:       )
   62:       .email("Enter a valid email address.")
   63:       .transform((email) => email.toLowerCase()),
   64: 
   65:     category: z.enum(CONTACT_CATEGORIES, {
   66:       error: "Select a valid request category.",
   67:     }),
   68: 
   69:     subject: z
   70:       .string({
   71:         error: "Subject is required.",
   72:       })
   73:       .trim()
   74:       .min(1, "Subject is required.")
   75:       .max(
   76:         CONTACT_SUBJECT_MAXIMUM_LENGTH,
   77:         `Subject cannot contain more than ${CONTACT_SUBJECT_MAXIMUM_LENGTH} characters.`,
   78:       ),
   79: 
   80:     message: z
   81:       .string({
   82:         error: "Message is required.",
   83:       })
   84:       .trim()
   85:       .min(
   86:         CONTACT_MESSAGE_MINIMUM_LENGTH,
   87:         `Message must contain at least ${CONTACT_MESSAGE_MINIMUM_LENGTH} characters.`,
   88:       )
   89:       .max(
   90:         CONTACT_MESSAGE_MAXIMUM_LENGTH,
   91:         `Message cannot contain more than ${CONTACT_MESSAGE_MAXIMUM_LENGTH} characters.`,
   92:       ),
   93: 
   94:     replyConsent: z.literal(true, {
   95:       error: "Confirm that we may use your email address to respond.",
   96:     }),
   97:   })
   98:   .strict();
   99: 
  100: /*
  101:  * =========================================
  102:  * Field Error Mapping
  103:  * =========================================
  104:  */
  105: 
  106: function mapFieldErrors(issues) {
  107:   const fieldErrors = {};
  108: 
  109:   for (const issue of issues) {
  110:     const fieldName = issue.path.length > 0 ? issue.path.join(".") : "_form";
  111: 
  112:     if (!fieldErrors[fieldName]) {
  113:       fieldErrors[fieldName] = [];
  114:     }
  115: 
  116:     fieldErrors[fieldName].push(issue.message);
  117:   }
  118: 
  119:   return fieldErrors;
  120: }
  121: 
  122: /*
  123:  * =========================================
  124:  * Validation Error
  125:  * =========================================
  126:  */
  127: 
  128: function createContactValidationError(zodError) {
  129:   const error = new Error("Contact request validation failed.");
  130: 
  131:   error.name = "ContactValidationError";
  132:   error.code = "CONTACT_VALIDATION_FAILED";
  133:   error.status = 400;
  134:   error.publicMessage = "Review the contact information and try again.";
  135: 
  136:   error.errors = zodError.issues.map((issue) => ({
  137:     field: issue.path.length > 0 ? issue.path.join(".") : "",
  138:     code: issue.code,
  139:     message: issue.message,
  140:   }));
  141: 
  142:   error.fieldErrors = mapFieldErrors(zodError.issues);
  143: 
  144:   return error;
  145: }
  146: 
  147: /*
  148:  * =========================================
  149:  * Parse Contact Request
  150:  * =========================================
  151:  */
  152: 
  153: export function parseContactRequest(input) {
  154:   const result = contactRequestSchema.safeParse(input);
  155: 
  156:   if (!result.success) {
  157:     throw createContactValidationError(result.error);
  158:   }
  159: 
  160:   return result.data;
  161: }

  151: 
  152: export function normalizeExperienceOverviewResponse(value) {
  153:   const validationResult = experienceOverviewResponseSchema.safeParse(value);
  154: 
  155:   if (!validationResult.success) {
  156:     const error = new Error(
  157:       "The AI provider returned an invalid experience-overview structure.",
  158:     );
  159: 
  160:     error.status = 502;
  161:     error.publicMessage =
  162:       "The AI returned an invalid experience overview. Please try again.";
  163: 
  164:     error.validationIssues = validationResult.error.issues;
  165: 
  166:     throw error;
  167:   }
  168: 
  169:   const suggestions = validationResult.data.suggestions
  170:     .map((suggestion, index) => ({
  171:       id: suggestion.id.trim() || `experience-overview-${index + 1}`,
  172: 
  173:       label: suggestion.label.trim() || `Option ${index + 1}`,
  174: 
  175:       text: suggestion.text.trim(),
  176:     }))
  177:     .filter((suggestion) => suggestion.text.length > 0)
  178:     .slice(0, 3);
  179: 
  180:   if (suggestions.length !== 3) {
  181:     const error = new Error(
  182:       `Expected 3 valid experience-overview suggestions but received ${suggestions.length}.`,
  183:     );
  184: 
  185:     error.status = 502;
  186:     error.publicMessage =
  187:       "The AI did not return three valid experience overviews. Please regenerate them.";
  188: 
  189:     throw error;
  190:   }
  191: 
  192:   const warnings = validationResult.data.warnings
  193:     .map((warning) => warning.trim())
  194:     .filter(Boolean)
  195:     .slice(0, 5);
  196: 
  197:   return {
  198:     suggestions,
  199:     warnings,
  200:   };
  201: }

  140: function validDate(value) {
  141:   const match = typeof value === "string"
  142:     ? value.match(DATE_PATTERN)
  143:     : null;
  144: 
  145:   if (!match) return false;
  146:   if (!match[3]) return true;
  147: 
  148:   const year = Number(match[1]);
  149:   const month = Number(match[2]);
  150:   const day = Number(match[3]);
  151:   const date = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day));
  152: 
  153:   return date.getUTCFullYear() === year &&
  154:     date.getUTCMonth() === month - 1 &&
  155:     date.getUTCDate() === day;
  156: }

  158: function comparableDate(value, endOfMonth = false) {
  159:   const [year, month, suppliedDay] = value.split("-").map(Number);
  160:   const day = suppliedDay ||
  161:     (endOfMonth ? new Date(Date.UTC(year, month, 0)).getUTCDate() : 1);
  162: 
  163:   return Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day);
  164: }

  166: function checkDates(errors, dates) {

  171:   checkBoolean(errors, "dates.isCurrent", current);

  173:   if (!validDate(start)) {
  174:     addError(errors, "dates.startDate", "invalid_date",
  175:       "A valid start date is required.");

  179:     addError(errors, "dates.endDate", "current_position_has_end_date",
  180:       "A current position cannot have an end date.");

  182:

  184:     addError(errors, "dates.endDate", "required",
  185:       "An end date is required for a previous position.");

  194:       "End date cannot precede start date.");
