  291: export function parseExperienceInput(value) {
  292:   const errors = [];
  293: 
  294:   if (!isObject(value)) {
  295:     throw createValidationError([{
  296:       field: "experience",
  297:       code: "invalid_type",
  298:       message: "Experience must be an object.",
  299:     }]);
  300:   }
  301: 
  302:   for (const field of SERVER_FIELDS) {
  303:     if (Object.hasOwn(value, field)) {
  304:       addError(errors, field, "server_owned",
  305:         "This field is managed by the server.");
  306:     }
  307:   }
  308: 
  309:   if (typeof value.id !== "string" ||
  310:       value.id.length > 200 || !ID_PATTERN.test(value.id)) {
  311:     addError(errors, "id", "invalid_identifier",
  312:       "A valid Experience ID is required.");
  313:   }
  314: 
  315:   if (value.modelVersion !== undefined &&
  316:       value.modelVersion !== EXPERIENCE_MODEL_VERSION) {
  317:     addError(errors, "modelVersion", "invalid_version",
  318:       "Unsupported Experience model version.");
  319:   }
  320: 
  321:   checkOption(errors, "category", value.category, CATEGORIES);
  322:   checkOption(errors, "status", value.status, STATUSES);
  323: 
  324:   const position = checkObject(errors, value, "position");
  325:   const organization = checkObject(errors, value, "organization");
  326:   const dates = checkObject(errors, value, "dates");
  327: 
  328:   checkOption(errors, "position.employmentType",
  329:     position.employmentType, EMPLOYMENT_TYPES);
  330:   checkOption(errors, "position.workArrangement",
  331:     position.workArrangement, WORK_ARRANGEMENTS);
  332: 
  333:   for (const [field, max] of Object.entries(LIMITS)) {
  334:     const [section, property] = field.split(".");
  335:     const fieldValue = property ? value[section]?.[property] : value[field];
  336: 
  337:     checkText(errors, field, fieldValue, max,
  338:       field === "position.title" || field === "organization.name");
  339:   }
  340: 
  341:   if (value.organization?.website) {
  342:     const website = text(value.organization.website);
  343: 
  344:     try {
  345:       const normalized = /^https?:\/\//i.test(website)
  346:         ? website : `https://${website}`;
  347:       const url = new URL(normalized);
  348: 
  349:       if (!["http:", "https:"].includes(url.protocol) || !url.hostname) {
  350:         throw new Error("Invalid URL");
  351:       }
  352:     } catch {
  353:       addError(errors, "organization.website", "invalid_url",
  354:         "A valid website is required.");
  355:     }
  356:   }
  357: 
  358:   checkDates(errors, dates);
  359: 
  360:   for (const name of Object.keys(COLLECTION_LIMITS)) {
  361:     checkCollection(errors, value, name);
  362:   }
  363: 
  364:   for (const kind of ["responsibilities", "achievements"]) {
  365:     const values = value[kind];
  366:     if (!Array.isArray(values)) continue;
  367: 
  368:     values.forEach((item, index) => {
  369:       const itemText = typeof item === "string"
  370:         ? item : isObject(item) ? item.text : "";
  371: 
  372:       checkText(errors, `${kind}.${index}.text`, itemText,
  373:         kind === "responsibilities" ? 1500 : 1500, true);
  374: 
  375:       if (isObject(item)) {
  376:         checkText(errors, `${kind}.${index}.id`, item.id, 200);
  377: 
  378:         if (item.order !== undefined &&
  379:             (!Number.isInteger(item.order) || item.order < 0)) {
  380:           addError(errors, `${kind}.${index}.order`, "invalid_order",
  381:             "Order must be a nonnegative integer.");
  382:         }
  383: 
  384:         if (kind === "achievements") {
  385:           checkText(errors, `${kind}.${index}.metric`, item.metric, 300);
  386:         }
  387:       }
  388:     });
  389: 
  390:     checkUnique(errors, values, kind, (item) =>
  391:       typeof item === "string" ? item : text(item?.text));
  392:   }
  393: 
  394:   checkRelationships(errors, value.skills, "skills");
  395:   checkRelationships(errors, value.technologies, "technologies");
  396: 
  397:   if (Array.isArray(value.relatedProjectIds)) {
  398:     value.relatedProjectIds.forEach((id, index) => {
  399:       checkText(errors, `relatedProjectIds.${index}`, id, 200, true);
  400:     });
  401: 
  402:     checkUnique(errors, value.relatedProjectIds,
  403:       "relatedProjectIds", (id) => text(id));
  404:   }
  405: 
  406:   for (const name of ["location", "leadership",
  407:     "privateInformation", "visibility", "overviewMeta"]) {
  408:     if (value[name] !== undefined && !isObject(value[name])) {
  409:       addError(errors, name, "invalid_type", "Must be an object.");
  410:     }
  411:   }
  412: 
  413:   if (isObject(value.overviewMeta)) {
  414:     const meta = value.overviewMeta;
  415: 
  416:     if (meta.source !== undefined) {
  417:       checkOption(errors, "overviewMeta.source",
  418:         meta.source, OVERVIEW_SOURCES);
  419:     }
  420: 
  421:     checkText(errors, "overviewMeta.status", meta.status, 50);
  422: 
  423:     if (meta.generatedAt !== undefined &&
  424:         meta.generatedAt !== null) {
  425:       checkText(errors, "overviewMeta.generatedAt",
  426:         meta.generatedAt, 100);
  427:     }
  428: 
  429:     checkText(errors, "overviewMeta.contextFingerprint",
  430:       meta.contextFingerprint, 300);
  431: 
  432:     checkBoolean(errors, "overviewMeta.isStale", meta.isStale);
  433:   }
  434: 
  435:   const leadership = isObject(value.leadership) ? value.leadership : {};
  436:   checkBoolean(errors, "leadership.hasLeadershipResponsibilities",
  437:     leadership.hasLeadershipResponsibilities);
  438: 
  439:   const people = leadership.peopleManaged;
  440:   if (people !== undefined && people !== null && people !== "") {
  441:     const number = Number(people);
  442: 
  443:     if (!Number.isInteger(number) || number < 0 || number > 100000) {
  444:       addError(errors, "leadership.peopleManaged", "invalid_number",
  445:         "People managed must be between 0 and 100000.");
  446:     }
  447:   }
  448: 
  449:   if (isObject(value.visibility)) {
  450:     for (const [key, enabled] of Object.entries(value.visibility)) {
  451:       if (!VISIBILITY_FIELDS.has(key)) {
  452:         addError(errors, `visibility.${key}`, "unsupported_field",
  453:           "Unsupported visibility setting.");
  454:         continue;
  455:       }
  456: 
  457:       checkBoolean(errors, `visibility.${key}`, enabled);
  458:     }
  459:   }
  460: 
  461:   const hasOverview = Boolean(text(value.overview));
  462:   const hasResponsibility = Array.isArray(value.responsibilities) &&
  463:     value.responsibilities.some((item) =>
  464:       Boolean(text(typeof item === "string" ? item : item?.text)));
  465:   const hasAchievement = Array.isArray(value.achievements) &&
  466:     value.achievements.some((item) =>
  467:       Boolean(text(typeof item === "string" ? item : item?.text)));
  468: 
  469:   if (!hasOverview && !hasResponsibility && !hasAchievement) {
  470:     addError(errors, "overview", "insufficient_content",
  471:       "Provide an overview, responsibility, or achievement.");
  472:   }
  473: 
  474:   if (errors.length) {
  475:     throw createValidationError(errors);
  476:   }
  477: 
  478:   return structuredClone(value);
  479: }
  480: 
  481: export function parseExperienceRowVersion(value) {
  482:   if (typeof value !== "string" ||
  483:       !/^[A-Za-z0-9+/]{10}[AEIMQUYcgkosw048]=$/.test(value) ||
  484:       Buffer.from(value, "base64").length !== 8) {
  485:     throw createValidationError([{
  486:       field: "rowVersion",
  487:       code: "EXPERIENCE_VERSION_INVALID",
  488:       message: "A valid Experience version is required.",
  489:     }]);
  490:   }
  491: 
  492:   return value;
  493: }

  125:   existingSkills: z.array(skillName).max(100).default([]),
  126: 
  127:   technologies: z.array(skillName).max(100).default([]),
  128: 
  129:   generationRules: z
  130:     .object({
  131:       maximumSuggestions: z.number().int().min(3).max(12).default(8),
  132: 
  133:       excludeExistingSkills: z.boolean().default(true),
  134: 
  135:       useOnlySupportedEvidence: z.boolean().default(true),
  136:     })
  137:     .default({
  138:       maximumSuggestions: 8,
  139:       excludeExistingSkills: true,
  140:       useOnlySupportedEvidence: true,
  141:     }),
  142: });
  143: 
  144: /*
  145:  * =========================================
  146:  * AI Response Schema
  147:  * =========================================
  148:  */
  149: 
  150: export const experienceSkillResponseSchema = z.object({
  151:   suggestions: z.array(
  152:     z.object({
  153:       name: z.string(),
  154:       category: z.enum(SKILL_CATEGORY_VALUES),
  155:       type: z.enum(SKILL_TYPE_VALUES),
  156:       reason: z.string(),
  157:     }),
  158:   ),
  159: 
  160:   warnings: z.array(z.string()),
  161: });
  162: 
  163: /*
  164:  * =========================================
  165:  * Normalization Helpers
  166:  * =========================================
  167:  */
  168: 
  169: function normalizeComparisonValue(value) {
  170:   return String(value || "")
  171:     .normalize("NFKC")
  172:     .trim()
  173:     .toLowerCase()
  174:     .replace(/[._/\\-]+/g, " ")
  175:     .replace(/\s+/g, " ");
  176: }
  177: 
  178: function normalizeWarnings(value) {
  179:   const warnings = Array.isArray(value?.warnings) ? value.warnings : [];
  180: 
  181:   return warnings
  182:     .map((warning) => String(warning || "").trim())
  183:     .filter(Boolean)
  184:     .slice(0, 5);
  185: }
  186: 
  187: /*
  188:  * =========================================
  189:  * Normalize AI Response
  190:  * =========================================
  191:  */
  192: 
  193: export function normalizeExperienceSkillResponse(value, context = {}) {
  194:   const validationResult = experienceSkillResponseSchema.safeParse(value);
  195: 
  196:   if (!validationResult.success) {
  197:     const error = new Error(
  198:       "The AI provider returned an invalid experience-skill structure.",
  199:     );
  200: 
  201:     error.status = 502;
  202:     error.publicMessage =
  203:       "The AI returned invalid skill suggestions. Please try again.";
  204: 
  205:     error.validationIssues = validationResult.error.issues;
  206: 
  207:     throw error;
  208:   }
  209: 
  210:   const maximumSuggestions = context.generationRules?.maximumSuggestions || 8;
  211: 
  212:   const existingSkillNames = new Set(
  213:     (context.existingSkills || []).map(normalizeComparisonValue),
  214:   );
  215: 
  216:   const seenNames = new Set();
  217: 
  218:   const suggestions = validationResult.data.suggestions
  219:     .map((suggestion) => ({
  220:       name: suggestion.name.trim().slice(0, 150),
  221: 
  222:       category: suggestion.category,
  223: 
  224:       type: suggestion.type,
  225: 
  226:       reason: suggestion.reason.trim().slice(0, 1000),
  227:     }))
  228:     .filter((suggestion) => {
  229:       const normalizedName = normalizeComparisonValue(suggestion.name);
  230: 
  231:       if (!normalizedName || !suggestion.reason) {
  232:         return false;
  233:       }
  234: 
  235:       if (seenNames.has(normalizedName)) {
  236:         return false;
  237:       }
  238: 
  239:       if (
  240:         context.generationRules?.excludeExistingSkills !== false &&
  241:         existingSkillNames.has(normalizedName)
  242:       ) {
  243:         return false;
  244:       }
  245: 
  246:       seenNames.add(normalizedName);
  247: 
  248:       return true;
  249:     })
  250:     .slice(0, maximumSuggestions);
  251: 
  252:   if (suggestions.length === 0) {
  253:     const error = new Error(
  254:       "The AI provider did not return any usable experience-skill suggestions.",
  255:     );
  256: 
  257:     error.status = 502;
  258:     error.publicMessage =
  259:       "The AI could not identify any supported skills from this experience.";
  260: 
  261:     throw error;
  262:   }
  263: 
  264:   return {
  265:     suggestions,
  266:     warnings: normalizeWarnings(validationResult.data),
  267:   };
  268: }

   65: function object(value) {

   67:     typeof value === "object" &&

   71: function fieldValue(source, path) {

   73:     (current, key) => object(current) ? current[key] : undefined,
   74:     source,

   78: function error(errors, field, code, message) {

   82: function checkText(errors, field, value, maximum) {

   86:     error(
   87:       errors, field, "PROJECT_FIELD_INVALID",
   88:       `This field must be text with at most ${maximum} characters.`,
   89:     );
   90:   }

   93: function checkOption(errors, field, value, options) {
   94:   if (value === undefined) return;
   95: 
   96:   if (!options.includes(value)) {
   97:     error(errors, field, "PROJECT_OPTION_INVALID", "Invalid option.");
   98:   }
   99: }

  101: function checkUrl(errors, field, value, maximum = 2000) {
  102:   if (value === undefined) return;
  103: 
  104:   checkText(errors, field, value, maximum);
  105: 
  106:   if (typeof value !== "string" || !value.trim()) return;
  107: 
  108:   try {
  109:     const url = new URL(value);
  110:     if (!["http:", "https:"].includes(url.protocol)) throw new Error();
  111:   } catch {
  112:     error(errors, field, "PROJECT_URL_INVALID", "Invalid HTTP or HTTPS URL.");
  113:   }
  114: }

  116: function checkItems(errors, source, path, callback) {
  117:   const items = fieldValue(source, path);
  118:   if (items === undefined || !Array.isArray(items)) return;
  119: 
  120:   items.forEach((item, index) => {
  121:     const base = `${path}.${index}`;
  122: 
  123:     if (!object(item)) {
  124:       error(errors, base, "PROJECT_ITEM_INVALID", "Expected an object.");
  125:       return;
  126:     }
  127: 
  128:     callback(item, base);
  129:   });
  130: }

  132: function checkOrderedItems(errors, source, path, maximum) {
  133:   checkItems(errors, source, path, (item, base) => {
  134:     checkText(errors, `${base}.id`, item.id, 200);
  135:     checkText(errors, `${base}.text`, item.text, maximum);

   46: function createValidationError(errors) {
   47:   const error = new Error("Project validation failed.");
   48: 
   49:   error.name = "ProjectValidationError";
   50:   error.code = "PROJECT_VALIDATION_FAILED";
   51:   error.status = 400;
   52:   error.publicMessage = "Please correct the Project information.";
   53:   error.errors = errors;
   54: 
   55:   error.fieldErrors = {};
   56: 
   57:   for (const item of errors) {
   58:     if (!error.fieldErrors[item.field]) {
   59:       error.fieldErrors[item.field] = item.message;
   60:     }
   61:   }
   62: 
   63:   return error;
   64: }

   66: function addError(errors, field, code, message) {
   67:   errors.push({ field, code, message });

   70: function isPlainObject(value) {
   71:   return value !== null && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value);
   72: }
   73: 
   74: function isValidProjectDate(value) {
   75:   if (typeof value !== "string") {
   76:     return false;
   77:   }
   78: 
   79:   const match = value.match(
   80:     /^(\d{4})-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])(?:-(0[1-9]|[12]\d|3[01]))?$/,
   81:   );
   82: 
   83:   if (!match) {
   84:     return false;
   85:   }
   86: 
   87:   const year = Number(match[1]);
   88:   const month = Number(match[2]);
   89:   const day = match[3] ? Number(match[3]) : 1;
   90: 
   91:   const date = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day));
   92: 
   93:   return (
   94:     date.getUTCFullYear() === year &&
   95:     date.getUTCMonth() === month - 1 &&
   96:     date.getUTCDate() === day
   97:   );
   98: }

  100: export function parseProjectInput(value) {

  129:       "A valid Project identifier is required.",

  131:   }

  144:   }
  145:

  172:       "PROJECT_LIFECYCLE_INVALID",
  173:       "Select a valid lifecycle status.",
  174:     );
  175:   }
  176: 
  177:   if (!RECORD_STATUSES.has(value.recordStatus)) {
  178:     addError(
  179:       errors,
  180:       "recordStatus",
  181:       "PROJECT_RECORD_STATUS_INVALID",
  182:       "Select a valid record status.",
  183:     );
  184:   }
  185: 
  186:   if (!isPlainObject(value.dates)) {
  187:     addError(
  188:       errors,
  189:       "dates",
  190:       "PROJECT_DATES_INVALID",
  191:       "Project dates must be an object.",

  194:     if (!isValidProjectDate(value.dates.startDate)) {
  195:       addError(
  196:         errors,
  197:         "dates.startDate",
  198:         "PROJECT_START_DATE_INVALID",
  199:         "A valid Project start date is required.",
  200:       );
  201:     }

  204:       addError(
  205:         errors,

  207:         "PROJECT_END_DATE_INVALID",
  208:         "Enter a valid Project end date.",
  209:       );
  210:     }
  211:

  213:       addError(
  214:         errors,
  215:         "dates.endDate",

  217:         "An ongoing Project cannot have an end date.",

  226:         errors,

  230:       );
  231:     }

  235:       value.dates.isCurrent !== true &&

  113: function mapFieldErrors(issues) {

  115: 
  116:   for (const issue of issues) {
  117:     const fieldName = issue.path.length > 0 ? issue.path.join(".") : "_form";
  118: 
  119:     if (!fieldErrors[fieldName]) {
  120:       fieldErrors[fieldName] = [];
  121:     }
  122: 
  123:     fieldErrors[fieldName].push(issue.message);
  124:   }
  125: 
  126:   return fieldErrors;
  127: }
  128: 
  129: /*
  130:  * =========================================
  131:  * Validation Error Creation
  132:  * =========================================
  133:  */
  134: 
  135: function createValidationError(zodError) {
  136:   const errors = zodError.issues.map((issue) => ({
  137:     field: issue.path.length > 0 ? issue.path.join(".") : "",
  138: 
  139:     code: issue.code,
  140: 
  141:     message: issue.message,
  142:   }));
  143: 
  144:   const error = new Error("Registration request validation failed.");
  145: 
  146:   error.name = "RegistrationValidationError";
  147: 
  148:   error.code = "REGISTRATION_VALIDATION_FAILED";
  149: 
  150:   error.status = 400;
  151: 
  152:   error.publicMessage = "Review the registration information and try again.";
  153: 
  154:   error.errors = errors;
  155: 
  156:   error.fieldErrors = mapFieldErrors(zodError.issues);
  157: 
  158:   return error;
  159: }
  160: 
  161: /*
  162:  * =========================================
  163:  * Parse Registration Input
  164:  * =========================================
  165:  *
  166:  * This helper keeps Zod-specific logic out
  167:  * of the Express controllers.
  168:  */
  169: 
  170: export function parseRegistrationInput(schema, input) {
  171:   const result = schema.safeParse(input);
  172: 
  173:   if (!result.success) {
  174:     throw createValidationError(result.error);
  175:   }
  176: 
  177:   return result.data;
  178: }
  179: 
  180: /*
  181:  * =========================================
  182:  * Individual Parsing Helpers
  183:  * =========================================
  184:  */
  185: 
  186: export function parseRegistrationRequest(input) {
  187:   return parseRegistrationInput(registrationRequestSchema, input);
  188: }

  191:   return parseRegistrationInput(registrationVerificationSchema, input);
  192: }
  193:

  195:   return parseRegistrationInput(registrationCompletionSchema, input);

  107:  * =========================================
  108:  *
  109:  * Avoid .min(), .max(), and .length() here.
  110:  * OpenAI Structured Outputs does not support
  111:  * every JSON Schema array constraint.
  112:  */
  113: 
  114: export const resumeSummaryResponseSchema = z.object({
  115:   suggestions: z.array(
  116:     z.object({
  117:       id: z.string(),
  118:       label: z.string(),
  119:       text: z.string(),
  120:     }),
  121:   ),
  122: 
  123:   warnings: z.array(z.string()),
  124: });

  126: /*
  127:  * =========================================
  128:  * Validate and Normalize AI Response
  129:  * =========================================
  130:  */
  131: 
  132: export function normalizeResumeSummaryResponse(value) {
  133:   /*
  134:    * Some providers may return the suggestions array
  135:    * directly instead of wrapping it in an object.
  136:    */
  137: 
  138:   const rawSuggestions = Array.isArray(value) ? value : value?.suggestions;
  139: 
  140:   if (!Array.isArray(rawSuggestions)) {
  141:     const error = new Error(
  142:       "The AI response does not contain a suggestions array.",
  143:     );
  144: 
  145:     error.status = 502;
  146:     error.publicMessage =
  147:       "The AI returned an invalid response. Please try again.";
  148: 
  149:     throw error;
  150:   }
  151: 
  152:   /*
  153:    * Normalize small provider differences.
  154:    *
  155:    * Supported suggestion formats:
  156:    *
  157:    * { id, label, text }
  158:    * { id, label, summary }
  159:    * "Summary text"
  160:    */
  161: 
  162:   const suggestions = rawSuggestions
  163:     .map((suggestion, index) => {
  164:       if (typeof suggestion === "string") {
  165:         return {
  166:           id: `summary-suggestion-${index + 1}`,
  167:           label: `Option ${index + 1}`,
  168:           text: suggestion.trim(),
  169:         };
  170:       }
  171: 
  172:       if (!suggestion || typeof suggestion !== "object") {
  173:         return null;
  174:       }
  175: 
  176:       const text = String(
  177:         suggestion.text || suggestion.summary || suggestion.content || "",
  178:       ).trim();
  179: 
  180:       if (!text) {
  181:         return null;
  182:       }
  183: 
  184:       return {
  185:         id: String(suggestion.id || `summary-suggestion-${index + 1}`).trim(),
  186: 
  187:         label: String(
  188:           suggestion.label || suggestion.title || `Option ${index + 1}`,
  189:         ).trim(),
  190: 
  191:         text,
  192:       };
  193:     })
  194:     .filter(Boolean)
  195:     .slice(0, 3);
  196: 
  197:   if (suggestions.length !== 3) {
  198:     const error = new Error(
  199:       `Expected 3 valid suggestions but received ${suggestions.length}.`,
  200:     );
  201: 
  202:     error.status = 502;
  203:     error.publicMessage =
  204:       "The AI did not return three valid suggestions. Please regenerate them.";
  205: 
  206:     throw error;
  207:   }
  208: 
  209:   /*
  210:    * Warnings are useful but should not cause the
  211:    * entire request to fail if Groq omits them.
  212:    */
  213: 
  214:   const rawWarnings = Array.isArray(value?.warnings) ? value.warnings : [];
  215: 
  216:   const warnings = rawWarnings
  217:     .map((warning) => {
  218:       if (typeof warning === "string") {
  219:         return warning.trim();
  220:       }
  221: 
  222:       if (warning && typeof warning === "object") {
  223:         return String(warning.message || warning.text || "").trim();
  224:       }
  225: 
  226:       return "";
  227:     })
  228:     .filter(Boolean)
  229:     .slice(0, 5);
  230: 
  231:   return {
  232:     suggestions,
  233:     warnings,
  234:   };
  235: }

    1: import { z } from "zod";
    2: 
    3: /*
    4:  * =========================================
    5:  * SQL Server Unique Identifier
    6:  * =========================================
    7:  *
    8:  * SQL Server UNIQUEIDENTIFIER values use the
    9:  * familiar 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal structure.
   10:  *
   11:  * Azure SQL may generate identifiers that do
   12:  * not satisfy Zod's stricter RFC UUID version
   13:  * validation. Therefore, validate the SQL
   14:  * identifier structure without restricting
   15:  * its version or variant bits.
   16:  */
   17: 
   18: const SQL_UNIQUE_IDENTIFIER_PATTERN =
   19:   /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
   20: 
   21: /*
   22:  * =========================================
   23:  * Session Management Fields
   24:  * =========================================
   25:  */
   26: 
   27: const sessionIdSchema = z
   28:   .string({
   29:     error: "Session ID is required.",
   30:   })
   31:   .trim()
   32:   .min(1, "Session ID is required.")
   33:   .regex(
   34:     SQL_UNIQUE_IDENTIFIER_PATTERN,
   35: 
   36:     "Session ID must be a valid unique identifier.",
   37:   )
   38:   .transform((sessionId) => sessionId.toLowerCase());
   39: 
   40: /*
   41:  * =========================================
   42:  * Revoke Session
   43:  * =========================================
   44:  */
   45: 
   46: const revokeSessionSchema = z
   47:   .object({
   48:     sessionId: sessionIdSchema,
   49:   })
   50:   .strict();
   51: 
   52: /*
   53:  * =========================================
   54:  * Field Error Mapping
   55:  * =========================================
   56:  */
   57: 
   58: function mapFieldErrors(issues) {
   59:   const fieldErrors = {};
   60: 
   61:   for (const issue of issues) {
   62:     const fieldName = issue.path.length > 0 ? issue.path.join(".") : "_form";
   63: 
   64:     if (!fieldErrors[fieldName]) {
   65:       fieldErrors[fieldName] = [];
   66:     }
   67: 
   68:     fieldErrors[fieldName].push(issue.message);
   69:   }
   70: 
   71:   return fieldErrors;
   72: }
   73: 
   74: /*
   75:  * =========================================
   76:  * Validation Error
   77:  * =========================================
   78:  */
   79: 
   80: function createValidationError(zodError) {
   81:   const error = new Error("Session-management validation failed.");
   82:

   84: 
   85:   error.code = "SESSION_MANAGEMENT_VALIDATION_FAILED";
   86: 
   87:   error.status = 400;
   88:

   90:

   93:

   95:

  100:

  198: function validateSkillRelationships(skill, context) {
  199:   const isLanguageType = skill.type === "language";
  200: 
  201:   const isLanguageCategory = skill.category === "language";
  202: 
  203:   const languageProficiency = skill.language?.proficiency || "";
  204: 
  205:   if (isLanguageType && !isLanguageCategory) {
  206:     context.addIssue({
  207:       code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
  208:       path: ["category"],
  209:       message: 'A language skill must use the "Languages" category.',
  210:     });
  211:   }
  212: 
  213:   if (isLanguageCategory && !isLanguageType) {
  214:     context.addIssue({
  215:       code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
  216:       path: ["type"],
  217:       message:
  218:         'A skill in the "Languages" category must use the "Language Skill" type.',
  219:     });
  220:   }
  221: 
  222:   if (!isLanguageType && languageProficiency) {
  223:     context.addIssue({
  224:       code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
  225:       path: ["language", "proficiency"],
  226:       message: "Language proficiency can only be assigned to a language skill.",
  227:     });
  228:   }
  229: 
  230:   const normalizedName = skill.name
  231:     .normalize("NFKC")
  232:     .trim()
  233:     .toLocaleLowerCase()
  234:     .replace(/[._/\\-]+/g, " ")
  235:     .replace(/\s+/g, " ");
  236: 
  237:   const seenAliases = new Set();
  238: 
  239:   skill.aliases.forEach((alias, index) => {
  240:     const normalizedAlias = alias
  241:       .normalize("NFKC")
  242:       .trim()
  243:       .toLocaleLowerCase()
  244:       .replace(/[._/\\-]+/g, " ")
  245:       .replace(/\s+/g, " ");
  246: 
  247:     if (normalizedAlias === normalizedName) {
  248:       context.addIssue({
  249:         code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
  250:         path: ["aliases", index],
  251:         message: "An alias cannot be the same as the primary skill name.",
  252:       });
  253:     }
  254: 
  255:     if (seenAliases.has(normalizedAlias)) {
  256:       context.addIssue({
  257:         code: z.ZodIssueCode.custom,
  258:         path: ["aliases", index],
  259:         message: "This skill alias has already been added.",
  260:       });
  261:     }
  262: 
  263:     seenAliases.add(normalizedAlias);
  264:   });
  265: }

FILE: D:\Documents\Project\Portfolio\portfolio-plateform\backend\src\security\emailSecurity.js

    1: /*
    2:  * =========================================
    3:  * Email Configuration
    4:  * =========================================
    5:  */
    6: 
    7: const MAXIMUM_EMAIL_LENGTH = 320;
    8: 
    9: const EMAIL_PATTERN = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
   10: 
   11: /*
   12:  * =========================================
   13:  * Email Normalization
   14:  * =========================================
   15:  */
   16: 
   17: export function normalizeEmail(value) {
   18:   return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim().toLowerCase() : "";
   19: }
   20: 
   21: /*
   22:  * =========================================
   23:  * Email Validation
   24:  * =========================================
   25:  */
   26: 
   27: export function isValidEmail(value) {
   28:   const email = normalizeEmail(value);
   29: 
   30:   return (
   31:     email.length >= 3 &&
   32:     email.length <= MAXIMUM_EMAIL_LENGTH &&
   33:     EMAIL_PATTERN.test(email)
   34:   );
   35: }
   36: 
   37: /*
   38:  * =========================================
   39:  * Assert Valid Email
   40:  * =========================================
   41:  */
   42: 
   43: export function assertValidEmail(value) {
   44:   const email = normalizeEmail(value);
   45: 
   46:   if (!isValidEmail(email)) {
   47:     const error = new Error("A valid email address is required.");
   48: 
   49:     error.name = "EmailValidationError";
   50: 
   51:     error.code = "INVALID_EMAIL";
   52: 
   53:     error.status = 400;
   54: 
   55:     error.publicMessage = "Enter a valid email address.";
   56: 
   57:     throw error;
   58:   }
   59: 
   60:   return email;
   61: }
   62: 
   63: /*
   64:  * =========================================
   65:  * Mask Email
   66:  * =========================================
   67:  *
   68:  * Example:
   69:  *
   70:  * jean@example.com
   71:  * je**@example.com
   72:  */
   73: 
   74: export function maskEmail(value) {
   75:   const email = normalizeEmail(value);
   76: 
   77:   const separatorIndex = email.lastIndexOf("@");
   78: 
   79:   if (separatorIndex <= 0) {
   80:     return "***";
   81:   }
   82: 
   83:   const localPart = email.slice(0, separatorIndex);
   84: 
   85:   const domain = email.slice(separatorIndex + 1);
   86: 
   87:   const visibleLocal = localPart.slice(0, Math.min(2, localPart.length));
   88: 
   89:   const maskedCharacters = "*".repeat(
   90:     Math.max(3, localPart.length - visibleLocal.length),
   91:   );
   92: 
   93:   return `${visibleLocal}${maskedCharacters}@${domain}`;
   94: }

FILE: D:\Documents\Project\Portfolio\portfolio-plateform\backend\src\security\otpSecurity.js
--------------------------------------------------
    1: import { createHmac, randomInt, timingSafeEqual } from "node:crypto";
    2: 
    3: import { getAuthenticationSecrets } from "../config/environment.js";
    4: 
    5: /*
    6:  * =========================================
    7:  * OTP Configuration
    8:  * =========================================
    9:  */
   10: 
   11: export const OTP_LENGTH = 6;
   12: 
   13: const OTP_PATTERN = /^\d{6}$/;
   14: 
   15: /*
   16:  * =========================================
   17:  * OTP Normalization
   18:  * =========================================
   19:  */
   20: 
   21: export function normalizeOtp(value) {
   22:   return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
   23: }
   24: 
   25: /*
   26:  * =========================================
   27:  * OTP Generation
   28:  * =========================================
   29:  */
   30: 
   31: export function generateOtp() {
   32:   const upperLimit = 10 ** OTP_LENGTH;
   33: 
   34:   return String(randomInt(0, upperLimit)).padStart(OTP_LENGTH, "0");
   35: }
   36: 
   37: /*
   38:  * =========================================
   39:  * OTP Format Validation
   40:  * =========================================
   41:  */
   42: 
   43: export function isValidOtpFormat(value) {
   44:   return OTP_PATTERN.test(normalizeOtp(value));
   45: }
   46: 
   47: /*
   48:  * =========================================
   49:  * OTP Hash
   50:  * =========================================
   51:  *
   52:  * The OTP is bound to its challenge and
   53:  * purpose. The database never receives the
   54:  * plaintext OTP.
   55:  */
   56: 
   57: export function hashOtp({ challengeId, purpose, otp }) {
   58:   const normalizedChallengeId =
   59:     typeof challengeId === "string" ? challengeId.trim().toLowerCase() : "";
   60: 
   61:   const normalizedPurpose =
   62:     typeof purpose === "string" ? purpose.trim().toLowerCase() : "";
   63: 
   64:   const normalizedOtp = normalizeOtp(otp);
   65: 
   66:   if (
   67:     !normalizedChallengeId ||
   68:     !normalizedPurpose ||
   69:     !isValidOtpFormat(normalizedOtp)
   70:   ) {
   71:     throw new TypeError(
   72:       "A challenge ID, purpose, and six-digit OTP are required.",
   73:     );
   74:   }
   75: 
   76:   const { otp: secret } = getAuthenticationSecrets();
   77: 
   78:   return createHmac("sha256", secret)
   79:     .update(
   80:       `${normalizedChallengeId}:${normalizedPurpose}:${normalizedOtp}`,
   81:       "utf8",
   82:     )
   83:     .digest("hex");
   84: }
   85: 
   86: /*
   87:  * =========================================
   88:  * OTP Verification
   89:  * =========================================
   90:  */
   91: 
   92: export function verifyOtp({ challengeId, purpose, otp, expectedHash }) {
   93:   if (!isValidOtpFormat(otp) || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(expectedHash || "")) {
   94:     return false;
   95:   }
   96: 
   97:   const actualHash = hashOtp({
   98:     challengeId,
   99:     purpose,
  100:     otp,
  101:   });
  102: 
  103:   const actualBuffer = Buffer.from(actualHash, "hex");
  104: 
  105:   const expectedBuffer = Buffer.from(expectedHash, "hex");
  106: 
  107:   return (
  108:     actualBuffer.length === expectedBuffer.length &&
  109:     timingSafeEqual(actualBuffer, expectedBuffer)
  110:   );
  111: }

    1: import argon2 from "argon2";
    2: 
    3: /*
    4:  * =========================================
    5:  * Password Configuration
    6:  * =========================================
    7:  */
    8: 
    9: export const MINIMUM_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 12;
   10: 
   11: export const MAXIMUM_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 256;
   12: 
   13: /*
   14:  * OWASP minimum Argon2id configuration:
   15:  *
   16:  * Memory: 19 MiB
   17:  * Iterations: 2
   18:  * Parallelism: 1
   19:  */
   20: 
   21: const ARGON2_OPTIONS = Object.freeze({
   22:   type: argon2.argon2id,
   23: 
   24:   memoryCost: 19456,
   25: 
   26:   timeCost: 2,
   27: 
   28:   parallelism: 1,
   29: 
   30:   hashLength: 32,
   31: });
   32: 
   33: /*
   34:  * =========================================
   35:  * Password Validation
   36:  * =========================================
   37:  */
   38: 
   39: export function validatePassword(password) {
   40:   const errors = [];
   41: 
   42:   if (typeof password !== "string") {
   43:     errors.push("Password is required.");
   44: 
   45:     return {
   46:       isValid: false,
   47:       errors,
   48:     };
   49:   }
   50: 
   51:   if (password.length < MINIMUM_PASSWORD_LENGTH) {
   52:     errors.push(
   53:       `Password must contain at least ${MINIMUM_PASSWORD_LENGTH} characters.`,
   54:     );
   55:   }
   56: 
   57:   if (password.length > MAXIMUM_PASSWORD_LENGTH) {
   58:     errors.push(
   59:       `Password cannot contain more than ${MAXIMUM_PASSWORD_LENGTH} characters.`,
   60:     );
   61:   }
   62: 
   63:   return {
   64:     isValid: errors.length === 0,
   65: 
   66:     errors,
   67:   };
   68: }
   69: 
   70: /*
   71:  * =========================================
   72:  * Password Hash
   73:  * =========================================
   74:  */
   75: 
   76: export async function hashPassword(password) {
   77:   const validation = validatePassword(password);
   78: 
   79:   if (!validation.isValid) {
   80:     const error = new Error(validation.errors.join(" "));
   81: 
   82:     error.name = "PasswordValidationError";
   83: 
   84:     error.code = "INVALID_PASSWORD";
   85: 
   86:     error.status = 400;
   87: 
   88:     error.publicMessage = validation.errors[0];
   89: 
   90:     error.validationErrors = validation.errors;
   91: 
   92:     throw error;
   93:   }
   94: 
   95:   return argon2.hash(password, ARGON2_OPTIONS);
   96: }
   97: 
   98: /*
   99:  * =========================================
  100:  * Password Verification
  101:  * =========================================
  102:  */
  103: 
  104: export async function verifyPassword(passwordHash, password) {
  105:   if (typeof passwordHash !== "string" || typeof password !== "string") {
  106:     return false;
  107:   }
  108: 
  109:   try {
  110:     return await argon2.verify(passwordHash, password);
  111:   } catch {
  112:     return false;
  113:   }
  114: }
  115: 
  116: /*
  117:  * =========================================
  118:  * Rehash Detection
  119:  * =========================================
  120:  *
  121:  * This allows stronger Argon2 parameters to
  122:  * be introduced later without resetting all
  123:  * user passwords.
  124:  */
  125: 
  126: export function passwordNeedsRehash(passwordHash) {
  127:   if (typeof passwordHash !== "string") {
  128:     return true;
  129:   }
  130: 
  131:   try {
  132:     return argon2.needsRehash(passwordHash, ARGON2_OPTIONS);
  133:   } catch {
  134:     return true;
  135:   }
  136: }

    1: import { createHmac } from "node:crypto";
    2: 
    3: import { isIP } from "node:net";
    4: 
    5: import { getAuthenticationSecrets } from "../config/environment.js";
    6: 
    7: /*
    8:  * =========================================
    9:  * Request Configuration
   10:  * =========================================
   11:  */
   12: 
   13: const MAXIMUM_USER_AGENT_LENGTH = 1000;
   14: 
   15: /*
   16:  * =========================================
   17:  * IP Normalization
   18:  * =========================================
   19:  */
   20: 
   21: function normalizeIpAddress(value) {
   22:   if (typeof value !== "string") {
   23:     return "";
   24:   }
   25: 
   26:   let ipAddress = value.trim();
   27: 
   28:   /*
   29:    * Convert IPv4-mapped IPv6 values:
   30:    *
   31:    * ::ffff:192.168.1.10
   32:    * becomes:
   33:    * 192.168.1.10
   34:    */
   35: 
   36:   if (ipAddress.startsWith("::ffff:")) {
   37:     ipAddress = ipAddress.slice(7);
   38:   }
   39: 
   40:   /*
   41:    * Remove IPv6 interface zone identifiers.
   42:    */
   43: 
   44:   const zoneIndex = ipAddress.indexOf("%");
   45: 
   46:   if (zoneIndex >= 0) {
   47:     ipAddress = ipAddress.slice(0, zoneIndex);
   48:   }
   49: 
   50:   return isIP(ipAddress) ? ipAddress.toLowerCase() : "";
   51: }
   52: 
   53: /*
   54:  * =========================================
   55:  * Get Request IP
   56:  * =========================================
   57:  *
   58:  * This uses Express req.ip. Proxy trust will
   59:  * be configured carefully when the backend is
   60:  * deployed to Azure.
   61:  */
   62: 
   63: export function getRequestIp(request) {
   64:   return normalizeIpAddress(
   65:     request?.ip || request?.socket?.remoteAddress || "",
   66:   );
   67: }
   68: 
   69: /*
   70:  * =========================================
   71:  * IP Hash
   72:  * =========================================
   73:  */
   74: 
   75: export function hashIpAddress(ipAddress) {
   76:   const normalizedIpAddress = normalizeIpAddress(ipAddress);
   77: 
   78:   if (!normalizedIpAddress) {
   79:     return null;
   80:   }
   81: 
   82:   const { ip: secret } = getAuthenticationSecrets();
   83: 
   84:   return createHmac("sha256", secret)
   85:     .update(`ip:${normalizedIpAddress}`, "utf8")
   86:     .digest("hex");
   87: }
   88: 
   89: /*
   90:  * =========================================
   91:  * Request IP Hash
   92:  * =========================================
   93:  */
   94: 
   95: export function getRequestIpHash(request) {
   96:   return hashIpAddress(getRequestIp(request));
   97: }
   98: 
   99: /*
  100:  * =========================================
  101:  * User Agent
  102:  * =========================================
  103:  */
  104: 
  105: export function getRequestUserAgent(request) {
  106:   const value =
  107:     request?.get?.("user-agent") || request?.headers?.["user-agent"];
  108: 
  109:   return typeof value === "string"
  110:     ? value.trim().slice(0, MAXIMUM_USER_AGENT_LENGTH)
  111:     : "";
  112: }

   75:   }
   76: 
   77:   response.cookie(name, refreshToken, {
   78:     ...options,
   79: 
   80:     expires: expirationDate,
   81: 
   82:     maxAge: Math.max(0, expirationDate.getTime() - Date.now()),
   83:   });
   84: }
   85: 
   86: /*
   87:  * =========================================
   88:  * Clear Refresh-Token Cookie
   89:  * =========================================
   90:  */
   91: 
   92: export function clearRefreshTokenCookie(response) {
   93:   const { name, options } = getCookieConfiguration();
   94: 
   95:   response.clearCookie(name, options);
   96: }
   97: 
   98: /*
   99:  * =========================================
  100:  * Parse Cookie Header
  101:  * =========================================
  102:  */
  103: 
  104: function parseCookieHeader(headerValue) {
  105:   if (typeof headerValue !== "string" || !headerValue.trim()) {
  106:     return {};
  107:   }
  108: 
  109:   const cookies = {};
  110: 
  111:   for (const cookiePart of headerValue.split(";")) {
  112:     const separatorIndex = cookiePart.indexOf("=");
  113: 
  114:     if (separatorIndex <= 0) {
  115:       continue;
  116:     }
  117: 
  118:     const name = cookiePart.slice(0, separatorIndex).trim();
  119: 
  120:     const rawValue = cookiePart.slice(separatorIndex + 1).trim();
  121: 
  122:     if (!name) {
  123:       continue;
  124:     }
  125: 
  126:     try {
  127:       cookies[name] = decodeURIComponent(rawValue);
  128:     } catch {
  129:       cookies[name] = rawValue;
  130:     }
  131:   }
  132: 
  133:   return cookies;
  134: }
  135: 
  136: /*
  137:  * =========================================
  138:  * Read Refresh Token
  139:  * =========================================
  140:  *
  141:  * cookie-parser is not required.
  142:  */
  143: 
  144: export function getRefreshTokenFromRequest(request) {
  145:   const { name } = getCookieConfiguration();
  146: 
  147:   /*
  148:    * Support cookie-parser if it is installed
  149:    * later.
  150:    */
  151: 
  152:   const parsedCookieValue = request?.cookies?.[name];
  153: 
  154:   if (typeof parsedCookieValue === "string" && parsedCookieValue) {
  155:     return parsedCookieValue;
  156:   }
  157: 
  158:   const cookieHeader = request?.headers?.cookie;
  159: 
  160:   const cookies = parseCookieHeader(cookieHeader);
  161: 
  162:   const token = cookies[name];
  163: 
  164:   return typeof token === "string" ? token : "";
  165: }

FILE: D:\Documents\Project\Portfolio\portfolio-plateform\backend\src\security\tokenSecurity.js
--------------------------------------------------
    1: import { createHmac, randomBytes, timingSafeEqual } from "node:crypto";
    2: 
    3: import { getAuthenticationSecrets } from "../config/environment.js";
    4: 
    5: /*
    6:  * =========================================
    7:  * Token Configuration
    8:  * =========================================
    9:  */
   10: 
   11: const TOKEN_BYTES = 32;
   12: 
   13: const HASH_PATTERN = /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i;
   14: 
   15: /*
   16:  * =========================================
   17:  * Opaque Token Generation
   18:  * =========================================
   19:  */
   20: 
   21: export function generateOpaqueToken() {
   22:   return randomBytes(TOKEN_BYTES).toString("base64url");
   23: }
   24: 
   25: /*
   26:  * =========================================
   27:  * Token Hashing
   28:  * =========================================
   29:  *
   30:  * Purpose examples:
   31:  *
   32:  * registration-continuation
   33:  * password-reset-continuation
   34:  * session-refresh
   35:  */
   36: 
   37: export function hashToken(token, purpose = "generic") {
   38:   if (
   39:     typeof token !== "string" ||
   40:     !token ||
   41:     typeof purpose !== "string" ||
   42:     !purpose
   43:   ) {
   44:     throw new TypeError("A token and token purpose are required.");
   45:   }
   46: 
   47:   const { token: secret } = getAuthenticationSecrets();
   48: 
   49:   return createHmac("sha256", secret)
   50:     .update(`${purpose}:${token}`, "utf8")
   51:     .digest("hex");
   52: }
   53: 
   54: /*
   55:  * =========================================
   56:  * Create Token and Hash
   57:  * =========================================
   58:  *
   59:  * Return token to the authorized client.
   60:  * Store only hash in the database.
   61:  */
   62: 
   63: export function createOpaqueTokenRecord(purpose) {
   64:   const token = generateOpaqueToken();
   65: 
   66:   return {
   67:     token,
   68: 
   69:     hash: hashToken(token, purpose),
   70:   };
   71: }
   72: 
   73: /*
   74:  * =========================================
   75:  * Token Verification
   76:  * =========================================
   77:  */
   78: 
   79: export function verifyToken({ token, purpose, expectedHash }) {
   80:   if (
   81:     typeof token !== "string" ||
   82:     !token ||
   83:     typeof purpose !== "string" ||
   84:     !purpose ||
   85:     !HASH_PATTERN.test(expectedHash || "")
   86:   ) {
   87:     return false;
   88:   }
   89: 
   90:   const actualBuffer = Buffer.from(hashToken(token, purpose), "hex");
   91: 
   92:   const expectedBuffer = Buffer.from(expectedHash, "hex");
   93: 
   94:   return (
   95:     actualBuffer.length === expectedBuffer.length &&
   96:     timingSafeEqual(actualBuffer, expectedBuffer)
   97:   );
   98: }

   70:  * =========================================
   71:  */
   72: 
   73: async function shutdown(signal, exitCode = 0) {
   74:   if (isShuttingDown) {
   75:     return;
   76:   }
   77: 
   78:   isShuttingDown = true;
   79: 
   80:   console.log(`${signal} received. Closing API server.`);
   81: 
   82:   /*
   83:    * Stop accepting new HTTP requests.
   84:    */
   85:

   89:     });
   90:

   92:   }

  101:     console.error("Unable to close the database pool cleanly:", error);
  102: 
  103:     exitCode = 1;
  104:   }

  107: }

   65: 
   66: function createProviderError(message, publicMessage, status = 502) {
   67:   const error = new Error(message);
   68: 
   69:   error.status = status;
   70:   error.publicMessage = publicMessage;
   71:   error.provider = "groq";
   72: 
   73:   return error;
   74: }
   75: 
   76: function getGroqErrorCode(error) {
   77:   return (
   78:     error?.error?.code ||
   79:     error?.response?.data?.error?.code ||
   80:     error?.code ||
   81:     ""
   82:   );
   83: }

   85: /*
   86:  * =========================================
   87:  * Generate Experience Overview
   88:  * =========================================
   89:  */
   90: 
   91: export async function generateExperienceOverviewWithGroq(context = {}) {
   92:   const groq = getGroqClient();
   93: 
   94:   const model =
   95:     process.env.GROQ_EXPERIENCE_OVERVIEW_MODEL?.trim() ||
   96:     process.env.GROQ_SUMMARY_MODEL?.trim() ||
   97:     "openai/gpt-oss-20b";
   98: 
   99:   try {
  100:     const completion = await groq.chat.completions.create({
  101:       model,
  102: 
  103:       temperature: 0.4,
  104: 
  105:       max_completion_tokens: 1800,
  106: 
  107:       response_format: {
  108:         type: "json_schema",
  109: 
  110:         json_schema: {
  111:           name: "experience_overview_suggestions",
  112: 
  113:           strict: true,
  114: 
  115:           schema: EXPERIENCE_OVERVIEW_JSON_SCHEMA,
  116:         },
  117:       },
  118: 
  119:       messages: [
  120:         {
  121:           role: "system",
  122: 
  123:           content: [
  124:             createExperienceOverviewSystemInstructions(context),
  125: 
  126:             "",
  127:             "Structured response requirements:",
  128:             "- Return exactly three suggestions.",
  129:             "- Every suggestion must contain a non-empty id, label, and text.",
  130:             "- Never return placeholder text.",
  131:             "- Use only the experience information provided by the user.",
  132:             "- Put information limitations in the warnings array.",
  133:             "- The response must follow the supplied JSON schema exactly.",
  134:           ].join("\n"),
  135:         },
  136: 
  137:         {
  138:           role: "user",
  139:           content: createExperienceOverviewPrompt(context),
  140:         },
  141:       ],
  142:     });
  143: 
  144:     const content = completion.choices?.[0]?.message?.content;
  145: 
  146:     if (!content) {
  147:       throw createProviderError(
  148:         "Groq returned an empty Experience Overview response.",
  149:         "Groq returned an empty response. Please try again.",
  150:       );
  151:     }
  152: 
  153:     let parsedContent;
  154: 
  155:     try {
  156:       parsedContent = JSON.parse(content);
  157:     } catch (parseError) {
  158:       throw createProviderError(
  159:         `Unable to parse the Groq Experience Overview response: ${parseError.message}`,
  160:         "Groq returned an invalid Experience Overview response. Please try again.",
  161:       );
  162:     }
  163: 
  164:     if (process.env.NODE_ENV === "development") {
  165:       console.log(
  166:         "Groq Experience Overview response:",
  167:         JSON.stringify(parsedContent, null, 2),
  168:       );
  169:     }
  170: 
  171:     const normalizedResult = normalizeExperienceOverviewResponse(parsedContent);
  172: 
  173:     return {
  174:       ...normalizedResult,
  175: 
  176:       provider: "groq",
  177: 
  178:       model: completion.model || model,
  179:     };

  100: 
  101: export async function generateExperienceSkillsWithGroq(context = {}) {
  102:   const groq = getGroqClient();
  103: 
  104:   const model =
  105:     process.env.GROQ_SKILL_MODEL?.trim() ||
  106:     process.env.GROQ_SUMMARY_MODEL?.trim() ||
  107:     "openai/gpt-oss-20b";
  108: 
  109:   try {
  110:     const completion = await groq.chat.completions.create({
  111:       model,
  112: 
  113:       temperature: 0.2,
  114: 
  115:       max_completion_tokens: 1600,
  116: 
  117:       response_format: {
  118:         type: "json_schema",
  119: 
  120:         json_schema: {
  121:           name: "experience_skill_suggestions",
  122: 
  123:           strict: true,
  124: 
  125:           schema: EXPERIENCE_SKILL_JSON_SCHEMA,
  126:         },
  127:       },
  128: 
  129:       messages: [
  130:         {
  131:           role: "system",
  132: 
  133:           content: createExperienceSkillSystemInstructions(context),
  134:         },
  135:         {
  136:           role: "user",
  137: 
  138:           content: createExperienceSkillPrompt(context),
  139:         },
  140:       ],
  141:     });
  142: 
  143:     const content = completion.choices?.[0]?.message?.content;
  144: 
  145:     if (!content) {
  146:       throw createProviderError(
  147:         "Groq returned an empty experience-skill response.",

  149:       );
  150:     }
  151:

  153: 
  154:     try {
  155:       parsedContent = JSON.parse(content);
  156:     } catch (parseError) {
  157:       throw createProviderError(
  158:         `Unable to parse Groq experience-skill response: ${parseError.message}`,
  159:         "Groq returned invalid skill suggestions. Please try again.",
  160:       );
  161:     }
  162: 
  163:     if (process.env.NODE_ENV === "development") {
  164:       console.log(
  165:         "Groq experience skill response:",
  166:         JSON.stringify(parsedContent, null, 2),
  167:       );
  168:     }
  169: 
  170:     const normalizedResult = normalizeExperienceSkillResponse(
  171:       parsedContent,
  172:       context,
  173:     );
  174: 
  175:     return {
  176:       ...normalizedResult,
  177:       provider: "groq",
  178:       model: completion.model || model,
  179:     };
  180:   } catch (error) {
  181:     if (!error.provider) {
  182:       error.provider = "groq";
  183:     }
  184: 
  185:     const errorCode = getGroqErrorCode(error);
  186: 
  187:     if (error?.status === 404 || errorCode === "model_not_found") {
  188:       error.status = 503;
  189: 
  190:       error.publicMessage = `The Groq model "${model}" is unavailable or not enabled for this project.`;
  191:     }
  192:

   93:

   95: 
   96:   /*
   97:    * Portfolio About suggestions are longer than

  100:    */
  101:

  103:

  105:

  107: 
  108:   try {
  109:     const completion = await groq.chat.completions.create({
  110:       model,
  111: 
  112:       temperature: isTagline ? 0.65 : isPortfolio ? 0.55 : 0.4,
  113: 
  114:       max_completion_tokens: maxCompletionTokens,
  115: 
  116:       response_format: {
  117:         type: "json_schema",
  118:

  120:           name: "resume_summary_suggestions",
  121: 
  122:           strict: true,
  123: 
  124:           schema: RESUME_SUMMARY_JSON_SCHEMA,
  125:         },
  126:       },
  127: 
  128:       messages: [

  130:           role: "system",
  131:

  138:             "- Never return placeholder text.",

  143:           ].join("\n"),

  145:

  148:           content: createResumeSummaryPrompt(context),
  149:         },
  150:       ],
  151:     });
  152: 
  153:     const content = completion.choices?.[0]?.message?.content;
  154: 
  155:     if (!content) {
  156:       throw createProviderError(
  157:         "Groq returned an empty response.",

  159:       );
  160:     }

  165:       parsedContent = JSON.parse(content);
  166:     } catch (parseError) {
  167:       throw createProviderError(

  182:     return {

  189:   } catch (error) {

    2: 
    3: import { getOpenAIClient } from "../../config/openaiClient.js";
    4: 
    5: import {
    6:   normalizeResumeSummaryResponse,
    7:   resumeSummaryResponseSchema,
    8: } from "../../schemas/resumeSummarySchemas.js";
    9: 
   10: import {
   11:   createResumeSummaryPrompt,
   12:   createResumeSummarySystemInstructions,
   13: } from "../Prompt/resumeSummaryPrompt.js";
   14: 
   15: /*
   16:  * =========================================
   17:  * Generate With OpenAI
   18:  * =========================================
   19:  */
   20: 
   21: export async function generateResumeSummaryWithOpenAI(context = {}) {
   22:   const openai = getOpenAIClient();
   23: 
   24:   const model = process.env.OPENAI_SUMMARY_MODEL || "gpt-5.6-luna";
   25: 
   26:   let response;
   27: 
   28:   try {
   29:     response = await openai.responses.parse({
   30:       model,
   31: 
   32:       reasoning: {
   33:         effort: "low",
   34:       },
   35: 
   36:       input: [
   37:         {
   38:           role: "system",

   46:       ],
   47: 
   48:       text: {
   49:         format: zodTextFormat(
   50:           resumeSummaryResponseSchema,
   51:           "resume_summary_suggestions",
   52:         ),
   53:       },
   54: 
   55:       max_output_tokens: 1400,
   56:     });
   57:   } catch (error) {
   58:     error.provider = "openai";
   59: 
   60:     throw error;
   61:   }
   62: 
   63:   if (!response.output_parsed) {
   64:     const error = new Error("OpenAI did not return valid structured output.");
   65: 
   66:     error.status = 502;
   67:     error.provider = "openai";
   68:     error.publicMessage =
   69:       "OpenAI returned an invalid response. Please try again.";
   70: 
   71:     throw error;
   72:   }
   73: 
   74:   const normalizedResult = normalizeResumeSummaryResponse(
   75:     response.output_parsed,
   76:   );
   77: 
   78:   return {
   79:     ...normalizedResult,
   80: 
   81:     provider: "openai",
   82: 
   83:     model: response.model || model,
   84:   };
   85: }

   13: 
   14: function createContactError({ message, code, status = 503, publicMessage }) {
   15:   const error = new Error(message);
   16: 
   17:   error.name = "ContactServiceError";
   18:   error.code = code;
   19:   error.status = status;
   20:   error.publicMessage = publicMessage;
   21: 
   22:   return error;
   23: }
   24: 
   25: /*
   26:  * =========================================
   27:  * Create Contact Request
   28:  * =========================================
   29:  */
   30: 
   31: export async function submitContactRequest({
   32:   name,
   33:   email,
   34:   category,
   35:   subject,
   36:   message,
   37:   replyConsent,
   38:   request,
   39: }) {
   40:   /*
   41:    * The route is public. Never trust a user ID
   42:    * sent in the request body.
   43:    *
   44:    * A future optional-authentication middleware
   45:    * may safely supply request.auth.user.id.
   46:    */
   47: 
   48:   const authenticatedUserId =
   49:     typeof request?.auth?.user?.id === "string" ? request.auth.user.id : null;
   50: 
   51:   try {
   52:     const contactRequest = await createContactRequestRepository({
   53:       userId: authenticatedUserId,
   54: 
   55:       name,
   56: 
   57:       email,
   58: 
   59:       normalizedEmail: email.toLowerCase(),
   60: 
   61:       category,
   62: 
   63:       subject,
   64: 
   65:       message,
   66: 
   67:       replyConsent,
   68: 
   69:       ipAddressHash: getRequestIpHash(request),
   70: 
   71:       userAgent: getRequestUserAgent(request),
   72:     });
   73: 
   74:     if (!contactRequest?.id) {
   75:       throw new Error(
   76:         "The repository did not return the created contact request.",
   77:       );
   78:     }
   79: 
   80:     return {
   81:       message: "Your support request was submitted successfully.",
   82: 
   83:       request: {
   84:         id: contactRequest.id,
   85: 
   86:         category: contactRequest.category,
   87: 
   88:         status: contactRequest.status,
   89: 
   90:         createdAt: contactRequest.createdAt,
   91:       },
   92:     };
   93:   } catch (error) {
   94:     if (error?.name === "ContactServiceError") {
   95:       throw error;
   96:     }
   97: 
   98:     /*
   99:      * Database messages, table names and SQL
  100:      * details must not reach the client.
  101:      */
  102: 
  103:     throw createContactError({
  104:       message: `Unable to store contact request: ${error.message}`,
  105: 
  106:       code: "CONTACT_SUBMISSION_UNAVAILABLE",
  107: 
  108:       status: 503,
  109: 
  110:       publicMessage:
  111:         "Contact submission is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.",
  112:     });
  113:   }
  114: }

  181:     authenticatedUserId,

  186:     throw experienceNotFound();

  188: 
  189:   const updatedExperience = await updateExperience(
  190:     authenticatedUserId,
  191:     validatedExperience,

  193:   );
  194: 
  195:   if (!updatedExperience) {
  196:     throw experienceVersionConflict();
  197:   }

  192: export async function requestPasswordLogin({

  199:

  210:   }
  211: 
  212:   if (typeof sendLoginOtp !== "function") {
  213:     throw createLoginError({

  221:     });

  227:

  229: 
  230:   /*
  231:    * Always perform Argon2 verification,
  232:    * including unknown email addresses.
  233:    */
  234: 
  235:   const passwordHash = user?.passwordHash || (await getDummyPasswordHash());
  236: 
  237:   const passwordMatches = await verifyPassword(passwordHash, password);

  239:   if (!user || !passwordMatches) {

  262:         ipAddressHash,
  263: 
  264:         userAgent,

  438: /*
  439:  * =========================================
  440:  * Resend Login OTP
  441:  * =========================================
  442:  *
  443:  * The user has already passed password
  444:  * verification. The existing challenge ID is
  445:  * sufficient to request another email.
  446:  *
  447:  * The old OTP becomes invalid as soon as its
  448:  * stored hash is replaced.
  449:  */
  450: 
  451: export async function resendLoginOtp({ challengeId, request, sendLoginOtp }) {
  452:   const normalizedChallengeId = assertChallengeId(challengeId);
  453: 
  454:   if (typeof sendLoginOtp !== "function") {
  455:     throw createLoginError({
  456:       message: "A login OTP email sender was not provided.",
  457: 
  458:       code: "LOGIN_EMAIL_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE",
  459: 
  460:       status: 503,
  461: 
  462:       publicMessage: "Email verification is temporarily unavailable.",
  463:     });
  464:   }
  465: 
  466:   const existingChallenge = await getLoginChallengeById(normalizedChallengeId);
  467: 
  468:   if (!existingChallenge) {
  469:     throw createLoginError({
  470:       message: "The login challenge does not exist.",
  471: 
  472:       code: "LOGIN_CHALLENGE_NOT_FOUND",
  473: 
  474:       publicMessage: INVALID_CHALLENGE_MESSAGE,
  475:     });
  476:   }
  477: 
  478:   if (existingChallenge.consumedAt) {
  479:     throw createLoginError({
  480:       message: "The login challenge was already consumed.",
  481: 
  482:       code: "LOGIN_CHALLENGE_CONSUMED",
  483: 
  484:       publicMessage: INVALID_CHALLENGE_MESSAGE,
  485:     });
  486:   }
  487: 
  488:   if (existingChallenge.verifiedAt) {
  489:     throw createLoginError({
  490:       message: "The login challenge was already verified.",
  491: 
  492:       code: "LOGIN_CHALLENGE_ALREADY_VERIFIED",
  493: 
  494:       publicMessage: "This verification request has already been used.",
  495:     });
  496:   }
  497: 
  498:   const now = new Date();
  499: 
  500:   const lastSentAt = existingChallenge.lastSentAt
  501:     ? new Date(existingChallenge.lastSentAt)
  502:     : null;
  503: 
  504:   if (lastSentAt && !Number.isNaN(lastSentAt.getTime())) {
  505:     const availableAt =
  506:       lastSentAt.getTime() + LOGIN_OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS * 1000;
  507: 
  508:     const retryAfterSeconds = Math.max(
  509:       0,
  510: 
  511:       Math.ceil((availableAt - now.getTime()) / 1000),
  512:     );
  513: 
  514:     if (retryAfterSeconds > 0) {
  515:       throw createLoginError({
  516:         message: "The login OTP resend cooldown is still active.",
  517: 
  518:         code: "LOGIN_OTP_RESEND_TOO_SOON",
  519: 
  520:         status: 429,
  521: 
  522:         publicMessage: `Wait ${retryAfterSeconds} second${
  523:           retryAfterSeconds === 1 ? "" : "s"
  524:         } before requesting another code.`,
  525: 
  526:         details: {
  527:           retryAfterSeconds,
  528:         },
  529:       });
  530:     }
  531:   }
  532: 
  533:   const otp = generateOtp();
  534: 
  535:   const expiresAt = addMinutes(
  536:     now,
  537: 
  538:     LOGIN_OTP_EXPIRATION_MINUTES,
  539:   );
  540: 
  541:   const codeHash = hashOtp({
  542:     challengeId: normalizedChallengeId,
  543: 
  544:     purpose: LOGIN_PURPOSE,
  545: 
  546:     otp,
  547:   });
  548: 
  549:   const ipAddressHash = getRequestIpHash(request);
  550: 
  551:   const userAgent = getRequestUserAgent(request);
  552: 
  553:   const refreshedChallenge = await refreshLoginChallenge({
  554:     challengeId: normalizedChallengeId,
  555: 
  556:     codeHash,
  557: 
  558:     expiresAt,
  559: 
  560:     lastSentAt: now,
  561: 
  562:     cooldownSeconds: LOGIN_OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS,
  563: 
  564:     requestIpHash: ipAddressHash,
  565:   });
  566: 
  567:   /*
  568:    * Another request may have refreshed the
  569:    * challenge after our initial read.
  570:    */
  571: 
  572:   if (!refreshedChallenge) {
  573:     throw createLoginError({
  574:       message: "The login challenge changed or the resend cooldown is active.",
  575: 
  576:       code: "LOGIN_OTP_RESEND_CONFLICT",
  577: 
  578:       status: 429,
  579: 
  580:       publicMessage:
  581:         "A new code was recently requested. Wait before trying again.",
  582: 
  583:       details: {
  584:         retryAfterSeconds: LOGIN_OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS,
  585:       },
  586:     });
  587:   }
  588: 
  589:   try {
  590:     await sendLoginOtp({
  591:       email: refreshedChallenge.pendingEmail,
  592: 
  593:       otp,
  594: 
  595:       expiresInMinutes: LOGIN_OTP_EXPIRATION_MINUTES,
  596:     });
  597:   } catch (emailError) {
  598:     /*
  599:      * The old OTP is already invalid. Remove
  600:      * the challenge so an undelivered new OTP
  601:      * cannot leave an unusable active flow.
  602:      */
  603: 
  604:     await deleteLoginChallengeById(refreshedChallenge.id).catch(
  605:       (cleanupError) => {
  606:         console.error(
  607:           "Unable to remove an undelivered resent login challenge:",
  608: 
  609:           cleanupError,
  610:         );
  611:       },
  612:     );
  613: 
  614:     await recordLoginAudit({
  615:       userId: refreshedChallenge.userId,
  616: 
  617:       emailAttempted: refreshedChallenge.normalizedPendingEmail,
  618: 
  619:       eventType: "login_otp_sent",
  620: 
  621:       wasSuccessful: false,
  622: 
  623:       failureReason: "resend_email_delivery_failed",
  624: 
  625:       ipAddressHash,
  626: 
  627:       userAgent,
  628:     });
  629: 
  630:     throw createLoginError({
  631:       message: "The replacement login OTP email could not be delivered.",
  632: 
  633:       code: "LOGIN_EMAIL_DELIVERY_FAILED",
  634: 
  635:       status: 503,
  636: 
  637:       publicMessage:
  638:         "The new verification email could not be sent. Return to sign in and try again.",
  639:     });
  640:   }
  641: 
  642:   await recordLoginAudit({
  643:     userId: refreshedChallenge.userId,
  644: 
  645:     emailAttempted: refreshedChallenge.normalizedPendingEmail,
  646: 
  647:     eventType: "login_otp_sent",
  648: 
  649:     wasSuccessful: true,
  650: 
  651:     failureReason: "resend_requested",
  652: 
  653:     ipAddressHash,
  654: 
  655:     userAgent,
  656:   });
  657: 
  658:   return {
  659:     challengeId: refreshedChallenge.id,
  660: 
  661:     email: maskEmail(refreshedChallenge.pendingEmail),
  662: 
  663:     expiresAt: refreshedChallenge.expiresAt,
  664: 
  665:     maximumAttempts: refreshedChallenge.maximumAttempts,
  666: 
  667:     resendAvailableAt: new Date(
  668:       now.getTime() + LOGIN_OTP_RESEND_COOLDOWN_SECONDS * 1000,
  669:     ),
  670: 
  671:     message: "A new verification code was sent to your email.",
  672:   };
  673: }
  674: 
  675: /*
  676:  * =========================================
  677:  * Verify Login OTP
  678:  * =========================================
  679:  *
  680:  * Stage 2:
  681:  *
  682:  * Challenge + OTP
  683:  *       â†“
  684:  * OTP verification
  685:  *       â†“
  686:  * Session transaction
  687:  *       â†“
  688:  * Raw token returned only to controller
  689:  */
  690: 
  691: export async function verifyLoginOtp({ challengeId, otp, request }) {
  692:   const normalizedChallengeId = assertChallengeId(challengeId);
  693: 
  694:   if (!isValidOtpFormat(otp)) {
  695:     throw createLoginError({
  696:       message: "The login OTP format is invalid.",
  697: 
  698:       code: "LOGIN_OTP_INVALID",
  699: 
  700:       publicMessage: INVALID_OTP_MESSAGE,
  701:     });
  702:   }
  703: 
  704:   const challenge = await getLoginChallengeById(normalizedChallengeId);
  705: 
  706:   if (!challenge) {
  707:     throw createLoginError({
  708:       message: "The login challenge does not exist.",
  709: 
  710:       code: "LOGIN_CHALLENGE_NOT_FOUND",
  711: 
  712:       publicMessage: INVALID_CHALLENGE_MESSAGE,
  713:     });
  714:   }
  715: 
  716:   if (challenge.consumedAt) {
  717:     throw createLoginError({
  718:       message: "The login challenge was already consumed.",
  719: 
  720:       code: "LOGIN_CHALLENGE_CONSUMED",
  721: 
  722:       publicMessage: INVALID_CHALLENGE_MESSAGE,
  723:     });
  724:   }
  725: 
  726:   if (challenge.verifiedAt) {
  727:     throw createLoginError({
  728:       message: "The login challenge was already verified.",
  729: 
  730:       code: "LOGIN_CHALLENGE_ALREADY_VERIFIED",
  731: 
  732:       publicMessage: "This verification code has already been used.",
  733:     });
  734:   }
  735: 
  736:   if (!challenge.expiresAt || new Date(challenge.expiresAt) <= new Date()) {
  737:     throw createLoginError({
  738:       message: "The login challenge has expired.",
  739: 
  740:       code: "LOGIN_CHALLENGE_EXPIRED",
  741: 
  742:       publicMessage: INVALID_OTP_MESSAGE,
  743:     });
  744:   }
  745: 
  746:   if (challenge.attemptCount >= challenge.maximumAttempts) {
  747:     throw createLoginError({
  748:       message: "The login challenge reached its maximum attempts.",
  749: 
  750:       code: "LOGIN_MAXIMUM_ATTEMPTS_REACHED",
  751: 
  752:       status: 429,
  753: 
  754:       publicMessage:
  755:         "Too many incorrect verification attempts were submitted. Start signing in again.",
  756:     });
  757:   }
  758: 
  759:   const ipAddressHash = getRequestIpHash(request);
  760: 
  761:   const userAgent = getRequestUserAgent(request);
  762: 
  763:   const otpMatches = verifyOtp({
  764:     challengeId: normalizedChallengeId,
  765: 
  766:     purpose: LOGIN_PURPOSE,
  767: 
  768:     otp,
  769: 
  770:     expectedHash: challenge.codeHash,
  771:   });
  772: 
  773:   if (!otpMatches) {
  774:     const attempt = await recordFailedLoginOtpAttempt({
  775:       challengeId: normalizedChallengeId,
  776: 
  777:       userId: challenge.userId,
  778: 
  779:       email: challenge.normalizedPendingEmail,
  780: 
  781:       ipAddressHash,
  782: 
  783:       userAgent,
  784:     });
  785: 
  786:     const attemptsRemaining = attempt
  787:       ? Math.max(0, attempt.maximumAttempts - attempt.attemptCount)
  788:       : 0;
  789: 
  790:     if (attemptsRemaining === 0) {
  791:       throw createLoginError({
  792:         message: "The login challenge reached its maximum attempts.",
  793: 
  794:         code: "LOGIN_MAXIMUM_ATTEMPTS_REACHED",
  795: 
  796:         status: 429,
  797: 
  798:         publicMessage:
  799:           "Too many incorrect verification attempts were submitted. Start signing in again.",
  800:       });
  801:     }
  802: 
  803:     throw createLoginError({
  804:       message: "The submitted login OTP is incorrect.",
  805: 
  806:       code: "LOGIN_OTP_INCORRECT",
  807: 
  808:       publicMessage: INVALID_OTP_MESSAGE,
  809: 
  810:       details: {
  811:         attemptsRemaining,
  812:       },
  813:     });
  814:   }
  815: 
  816:   const verifiedChallenge = await markLoginChallengeVerified({
  817:     challengeId: normalizedChallengeId,
  818: 
  819:     userId: challenge.userId,
  820: 
  821:     email: challenge.normalizedPendingEmail,
  822: 
  823:     ipAddressHash,
  824: 
  825:     userAgent,
  826:   });
  827: 
  828:   if (!verifiedChallenge) {
  829:     throw createLoginError({
  830:       message: "The login challenge changed before verification completed.",
  831: 
  832:       code: "LOGIN_CHALLENGE_STATE_CHANGED",
  833: 
  834:       status: 409,
  835: 
  836:       publicMessage:
  837:         "This verification request is no longer available. Start signing in again.",
  838:     });
  839:   }
  840: 
  841:   const refreshToken = createOpaqueTokenRecord(SESSION_REFRESH_PURPOSE);
  842: 
  843:   const refreshTokenExpiresAt = getRefreshTokenExpiration();
  844: 
  845:   const loginResult = await completeLoginWithSession({
  846:     challengeId: normalizedChallengeId,
  847: 
  848:     refreshTokenHash: refreshToken.hash,
  849: 
  850:     deviceName: detectDeviceName(userAgent),
  851: 
  852:     userAgent,
  853: 
  854:     ipAddressHash,
  855: 
  856:     expiresAt: refreshTokenExpiresAt,
  857:   });
  858: 
  859:   return {
  860:     refreshToken: refreshToken.token,
  861: 
  862:     refreshTokenExpiresAt: loginResult.session.expiresAt,
  863: 
  864:     session: createPublicSession(loginResult.session, loginResult.session.id),
  865: 
  866:     user: {
  867:       id: loginResult.user.id,
  868: 
  869:       email: loginResult.user.email,
  870: 
  871:       emailVerifiedAt: loginResult.user.emailVerifiedAt,
  872: 
  873:       accountStatus: loginResult.user.accountStatus,
  874:     },
  875: 
  876:     roles: loginResult.roles,
  877: 
  878:     message: "Sign in completed successfully.",
  879:   };
  880: }

    8: function createProfileError({ message, code, status, publicMessage }) {
    9:   const error = new Error(message);
   10:   error.name = "ProfileServiceError";

   13:   error.publicMessage = publicMessage;

   17: function assertUserId(userId) {
   18:   if (typeof userId !== "string" || !userId.trim()) {
   19:     throw createProfileError({
   20:       message: "An authenticated user ID is required.",
   21:       code: "PROFILE_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED",
   22:       status: 401,
   23:       publicMessage: "You must sign in to access your Profile.",
   24:     });
   25:   }
   26: 
   27:   return userId.trim();

   30: export async function getAuthenticatedProfile({ userId }) {
   31:   const profile = await findProfileByUserId(assertUserId(userId));
   32: 
   33:   if (!profile) {
   34:     throw createProfileError({
   35:       message: "The authenticated user does not have a Profile row.",
   36:       code: "PROFILE_NOT_FOUND",
   37:       status: 404,
   38:       publicMessage: "Your Profile could not be found.",
   39:     });
   40:   }
   41: 
   42:   return profile;
   43: }
   44: 
   45: export async function updateAuthenticatedProfile({ userId, profile }) {
   46:   const authenticatedUserId = assertUserId(userId);
   47: 
   48:   /*
   49:    * Read the currently persisted Profile before replacing it.
   50:    *
   51:    * We need this snapshot so that, after a successful database save,
   52:    * we can determine which previously committed picture files are no
   53:    * longer referenced by the Profile.
   54:    */
   55:   const previousProfile = await findProfileByUserId(authenticatedUserId);
   56: 
   57:   const updatedProfile = await replaceProfileByUserId(
   58:     authenticatedUserId,
   59:     profile,
   60:   );
   61: 
   62:   if (!updatedProfile) {
   63:     throw createProfileError({
   64:       message: "The authenticated user Profile could not be updated.",
   65:       code: "PROFILE_NOT_FOUND",
   66:       status: 404,
   67:       publicMessage: "Your Profile could not be found.",
   68:     });
   69:   }
   70: 
   71:   /*
   72:    * Build the set of picture storage keys that are still referenced
   73:    * after the successful database update.
   74:    */
   75:   const updatedStorageKeys = new Set(
   76:     updatedProfile.profilePictures
   77:       .map((picture) => String(picture.storageKey || "").trim())
   78:       .filter(Boolean),
   79:   );
   80: 
   81:   /*
   82:    * A previously committed picture becomes orphaned when its storage
   83:    * key existed before the save but is no longer referenced afterward.
   84:    */
   85:   const orphanedStorageKeys = (previousProfile?.profilePictures || [])
   86:     .map((picture) => String(picture.storageKey || "").trim())
   87:     .filter((storageKey) => storageKey && !updatedStorageKeys.has(storageKey));
   88: 
   89:   /*
   90:    * The database update has already succeeded at this point.
   91:    *
   92:    * Filesystem cleanup is therefore best-effort. A cleanup failure must
   93:    * not make the API report that the Profile save failed when the
   94:    * database has already committed successfully.
   95:    */
   96:   const cleanupResults = await Promise.allSettled(
   97:     orphanedStorageKeys.map((storageKey) =>
   98:       deleteOwnedProfilePicture(authenticatedUserId, storageKey),
   99:     ),
  100:   );
  101: 
  102:   for (const cleanupResult of cleanupResults) {
  103:     if (cleanupResult.status === "rejected") {
  104:       console.error(
  105:         "Failed to clean up an orphaned profile picture after Profile save:",
  106:         cleanupResult.reason,
  107:       );
  108:     }
  109:   }
  110: 
  111:   return updatedProfile;
  112: }
  113: 
  114: export async function deleteUncommittedProfilePicture({ userId, storageKey }) {
  115:   const authenticatedUserId = assertUserId(userId);
  116: 
  117:   const normalizedStorageKey = String(storageKey || "").trim();
  118: 
  119:   if (!normalizedStorageKey) {
  120:     throw createProfileError({
  121:       message: "A profile-picture storage key is required for cleanup.",
  122:       code: "PROFILE_PICTURE_STORAGE_KEY_REQUIRED",
  123:       status: 400,
  124:       publicMessage: "The profile picture could not be removed.",
  125:     });
  126:   }
  127: 
  128:   /*
  129:    * Load the currently committed profile before touching
  130:    * the filesystem.
  131:    */
  132: 
  133:   const currentProfile = await findProfileByUserId(authenticatedUserId);
  134: 
  135:   if (!currentProfile) {
  136:     throw createProfileError({
  137:       message: "The authenticated user does not have a Profile row.",
  138:       code: "PROFILE_NOT_FOUND",
  139:       status: 404,
  140:       publicMessage: "Your Profile could not be found.",
  141:     });
  142:   }
  143: 
  144:   /*
  145:    * Never allow this cleanup operation to delete a file
  146:    * that is currently referenced by the persisted profile.
  147:    */
  148: 
  149:   const isCommitted = currentProfile.profilePictures.some(
  150:     (picture) =>
  151:       String(picture.storageKey || "").trim() === normalizedStorageKey,
  152:   );
  153: 
  154:   if (isCommitted) {
  155:     throw createProfileError({
  156:       message:
  157:         "The requested profile picture is currently referenced by the persisted Profile.",
  158:       code: "PROFILE_PICTURE_IS_COMMITTED",
  159:       status: 409,
  160:       publicMessage:
  161:         "A saved profile picture cannot be removed as a temporary upload.",
  162:     });
  163:   }
  164: 
  165:   return deleteOwnedProfilePicture(authenticatedUserId, normalizedStorageKey);
  166: }
