   75:  * =========================================
   76:  * Role Normalization
   77:  * =========================================
   78:  */
   79: 
   80: function normalizeRoles(roles) {
   81:   if (!Array.isArray(roles)) {
   82:     return [];
   83:   }
   84: 
   85:   return [
   86:     ...new Set(
   87:       roles
   88:         .map((role) =>
   89:           typeof role === "string" ? role.trim().toLowerCase() : "",
   90:         )
   91:         .filter(Boolean),
   92:     ),
   93:   ];
   94: }
   95: 
   96: /*
   97:  * =========================================
   98:  * Authentication Data
   99:  * =========================================
  100:  */
  101: 
  102: function normalizeAuthentication(result) {
  103:   if (!result?.user?.id || !result?.session?.id) {
  104:     return null;
  105:   }
  106: 
  107:   return {
  108:     user: result.user,
  109: 
  110:     roles: normalizeRoles(result.roles),
  111: 
  112:     session: result.session,
  113:   };
  114: }
  115: 
  116: /*
  117:  * =========================================
  118:  * Expected Unauthenticated Errors
  119:  * =========================================
  120:  */
  121: 
  122: function isUnauthenticatedError(error) {
  123:   return (
  124:     Number(error?.status) === 401 ||
  125:     [
  126:       "AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED",
  127:       "SESSION_REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID",
  128:       "SESSION_NOT_FOUND",
  129:     ].includes(error?.code)
  130:   );
  131: }
  132: 
  133: /*
  134:  * =========================================
  135:  * Provider
  136:  * =========================================
  137:  */
  138: 
  139: export function AuthProvider({ children }) {
  140:   const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  141: 
  142:   const [roles, setRoles] = useState([]);
  143: 
  144:   const [session, setSession] = useState(null);
  145: 
  146:   const [status, setStatus] = useState(AUTH_STATUS.INITIALIZING);
  147: 
  148:   const [operation, setOperation] = useState(AUTH_OPERATION.IDLE);
  149: 
  150:   const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  151: 
  152:   /*
  153:    * Prevent state updates after an actual
  154:    * provider unmount.
  155:    */
  156: 
  157:   const isMountedRef = useRef(false);
  158: 
  159:   /*
  160:    * Prevent duplicate restoration and token
  161:    * rotation requests.
  162:    */
  163: 
  164:   const restorationPromiseRef = useRef(null);
  165: 
  166:   const refreshPromiseRef = useRef(null);
  167: 
  168:   /*
  169:    * =========================================
  170:    * Safe State Helpers
  171:    * =========================================
  172:    */
  173: 
  174:   const clearAuthentication = useCallback(() => {
  175:     if (!isMountedRef.current) {
  176:       return;
  177:     }
  178: 
  179:     setUser(null);
  180: 
  181:     setRoles([]);
  182: 
  183:     setSession(null);
  184: 
  185:     setStatus(AUTH_STATUS.UNAUTHENTICATED);
  186:   }, []);
  187: 
  188:   const applyAuthentication = useCallback((result) => {
  189:     const authentication = normalizeAuthentication(result);
  190: 
  191:     if (!authentication) {
  192:       const authenticationError = new Error(
  193:         "The server returned an incomplete authentication response.",
  194:       );
  195: 
  196:       authenticationError.name = "AuthenticationResponseError";
  197: 
  198:       authenticationError.code = "AUTHENTICATION_RESPONSE_INVALID";
  199: 
  200:       throw authenticationError;
  201:     }
  202: 
  203:     if (!isMountedRef.current) {
  204:       return authentication;
  205:     }
  206: 
  207:     setUser(authentication.user);
  208: 
  209:     setRoles(authentication.roles);
  210: 
  211:     setSession(authentication.session);
  212: 
  213:     setStatus(AUTH_STATUS.AUTHENTICATED);
  214: 
  215:     setError(null);
  216: 
  217:     return authentication;
  218:   }, []);
  219: 
  220:   const clearError = useCallback(() => {
  221:     if (isMountedRef.current) {
  222:       setError(null);
  223:     }
  224:   }, []);
  225: 
  226:   /*
  227:    * =========================================
  228:    * Invalid Session Events
  229:    * =========================================
  230:    *
  231:    * Protected API requests dispatch this event
  232:    * when the server reports that the current
  233:    * session was revoked, expired, or invalid.
  234:    */
  235: 
  236:   useEffect(() => {
  237:     function handleInvalidSession() {
  238:       clearAuthentication();
  239: 
  240:       if (isMountedRef.current) {
  241:         setError(null);
  242: 
  243:         setOperation(AUTH_OPERATION.IDLE);
  244:       }
  245:     }
  246: 
  247:     window.addEventListener(
  248:       AUTH_SESSION_INVALID_EVENT,
  249: 
  250:       handleInvalidSession,
  251:     );
  252: 
  253:     return () => {
  254:       window.removeEventListener(
  255:         AUTH_SESSION_INVALID_EVENT,
  256: 
  257:         handleInvalidSession,
  258:       );
  259:     };
  260:   }, [clearAuthentication]);
  261: 
  262:   /*
  263:    * =========================================
  264:    * Restore Existing Session
  265:    * =========================================
  266:    *
  267:    * A missing or expired cookie is an ordinary
  268:    * unauthenticated state, not an application
  269:    * failure.
  270:    */
  271: 
  272:   const restoreAuthentication = useCallback(async () => {
  273:     if (restorationPromiseRef.current) {
  274:       return restorationPromiseRef.current;
  275:     }
  276: 
  277:     const restorationPromise = (async () => {
  278:       if (isMountedRef.current) {
  279:         setOperation(AUTH_OPERATION.RESTORING);
  280: 
  281:         setError(null);
  282:       }
  283: 
  284:       try {
  285:         const result = await getCurrentSession();
  286: 
  287:         return applyAuthentication(result);
  288:       } catch (restorationError) {
  289:         if (isUnauthenticatedError(restorationError)) {
  290:           clearAuthentication();
  291: 
  292:           return null;
  293:         }
  294: 
  295:         if (isMountedRef.current) {
  296:           setUser(null);
  297: 
  298:           setRoles([]);
  299: 
  300:           setSession(null);
  301: 
  302:           setStatus(AUTH_STATUS.ERROR);
  303: 
  304:           setError(restorationError);
  305:         }
  306: 
  307:         return null;
  308:       } finally {
  309:         if (isMountedRef.current) {
  310:           setOperation(AUTH_OPERATION.IDLE);
  311:         }
  312:       }
  313:     })();
  314: 
  315:     restorationPromiseRef.current = restorationPromise;
  316: 
  317:     try {
  318:       return await restorationPromise;
  319:     } finally {
  320:       if (restorationPromiseRef.current === restorationPromise) {
  321:         restorationPromiseRef.current = null;
  322:       }
  323:     }
  324:   }, [applyAuthentication, clearAuthentication]);
  325: 
  326:   /*
  327:    * =========================================
  328:    * Revalidate Returning Browsers
  329:    * =========================================
  330:    *
  331:    * If another device revoked this browser's
  332:    * session, returning to this tab triggers a
  333:    * server validation before continued use.
  334:    */
  335: 
  336:   useEffect(() => {
  337:     function revalidateAuthentication() {
  338:       if (!isMountedRef.current || status !== AUTH_STATUS.AUTHENTICATED) {
  339:         return;
  340:       }
  341: 
  342:       void restoreAuthentication();
  343:     }
  344: 
  345:     function handleVisibilityChange() {
  346:       if (document.visibilityState === "visible") {
  347:         revalidateAuthentication();
  348:       }
  349:     }
  350: 
  351:     window.addEventListener("focus", revalidateAuthentication);
  352: 
  353:     document.addEventListener(
  354:       "visibilitychange",
  355: 
  356:       handleVisibilityChange,
  357:     );
  358: 
  359:     return () => {
  360:       window.removeEventListener(
  361:         "focus",
  362: 
  363:         revalidateAuthentication,
  364:       );
  365: 
  366:       document.removeEventListener(
  367:         "visibilitychange",
  368: 
  369:         handleVisibilityChange,
  370:       );
  371:     };
  372:   }, [status, restoreAuthentication]);
  373: 
  374:   /*
  375:    * =========================================
  376:    * Begin Registration
  377:    * =========================================
  378:    *
  379:    * This creates a registration challenge and
  380:    * requests delivery of the registration OTP.
  381:    * It does not authenticate the browser.
  382:    */
  383: 
  384:   const beginRegistration = useCallback(async ({ email }) => {
  385:     if (isMountedRef.current) {
  386:       setOperation(AUTH_OPERATION.REQUESTING_REGISTRATION);
  387: 
  388:       setError(null);
  389:     }
  390: 
  391:     try {
  392:       return await requestRegistrationOtp({
  393:         email,
  394:       });
  395:     } catch (registrationError) {
  396:       if (isMountedRef.current) {
  397:         setError(registrationError);
  398:       }
  399: 
  400:       throw registrationError;
  401:     } finally {
  402:       if (isMountedRef.current) {
  403:         setOperation(AUTH_OPERATION.IDLE);
  404:       }
  405:     }
  406:   }, []);
  407: 
  408:   /*
  409:    * =========================================
  410:    * Verify Registration OTP
  411:    * =========================================
  412:    *
  413:    * Successful verification returns a
  414:    * short-lived continuation token. It does
  415:    * not create the account or session yet.
  416:    */
  417: 
  418:   const verifyRegistration = useCallback(async ({ challengeId, otp }) => {
  419:     if (isMountedRef.current) {
  420:       setOperation(AUTH_OPERATION.VERIFYING_REGISTRATION);
  421: 
  422:       setError(null);
  423:     }
  424: 
  425:     try {
  426:       return await verifyRegistrationOtp({
  427:         challengeId,
  428: 
  429:         otp,
  430:       });
  431:     } catch (verificationError) {
  432:       if (isMountedRef.current) {
  433:         setError(verificationError);
  434:       }
  435: 
  436:       throw verificationError;
  437:     } finally {
  438:       if (isMountedRef.current) {
  439:         setOperation(AUTH_OPERATION.IDLE);
  440:       }
  441:     }
  442:   }, []);
  443: 
  444:   /*
  445:    * =========================================
  446:    * Complete Registration
  447:    * =========================================
  448:    *
  449:    * This creates the user, initial profile,
  450:    * settings and standard user role. It does
  451:    * not create an authenticated session.
  452:    */
  453: 
  454:   const finishRegistration = useCallback(
  455:     async ({ challengeId, continuationToken, password }) => {
  456:       if (isMountedRef.current) {
  457:         setOperation(AUTH_OPERATION.COMPLETING_REGISTRATION);
  458: 
  459:         setError(null);
  460:       }
  461: 
  462:       try {
  463:         return await completeRegistrationService({
  464:           challengeId,
  465: 
  466:           continuationToken,
  467: 
  468:           password,
  469:         });
  470:       } catch (registrationError) {
  471:         if (isMountedRef.current) {
  472:           setError(registrationError);
  473:         }
  474: 
  475:         throw registrationError;
  476:       } finally {
  477:         if (isMountedRef.current) {
  478:           setOperation(AUTH_OPERATION.IDLE);
  479:         }
  480:       }
  481:     },
  482:     [],
  483:   );
  484: 
  485:   /*
  486:    * =========================================
  487:    * Begin Password Login
  488:    * =========================================
  489:    *
  490:    * This validates the password and requests
  491:    * an OTP. It does not authenticate the
  492:    * browser yet.
  493:    */
  494: 
  495:   const beginPasswordLogin = useCallback(async ({ email, password }) => {
  496:     if (isMountedRef.current) {
  497:       setOperation(AUTH_OPERATION.REQUESTING_LOGIN);
  498: 
  499:       setError(null);
  500:     }
  501: 
  502:     try {
  503:       return await requestPasswordLogin({
  504:         email,
  505: 
  506:         password,
  507:       });
  508:     } catch (loginError) {
  509:       if (isMountedRef.current) {
  510:         setError(loginError);
  511:       }
  512: 
  513:       throw loginError;
  514:     } finally {
  515:       if (isMountedRef.current) {
  516:         setOperation(AUTH_OPERATION.IDLE);
  517:       }
  518:     }
  519:   }, []);
  520: 
  521:   /*
  522:    * =========================================
  523:    * Complete Login OTP
  524:    * =========================================
  525:    *
  526:    * Successful verification creates the
  527:    * server session and HttpOnly cookie.
  528:    */
  529: 
  530:   const completeLogin = useCallback(
  531:     async ({ challengeId, otp }) => {
  532:       if (isMountedRef.current) {
  533:         setOperation(AUTH_OPERATION.VERIFYING_LOGIN);
  534: 
  535:         setError(null);
  536:       }
  537: 
  538:       try {
  539:         const result = await verifyLoginOtp({
  540:           challengeId,
  541: 
  542:           otp,
  543:         });
  544: 
  545:         applyAuthentication(result);
  546: 
  547:         return result;
  548:       } catch (verificationError) {
  549:         if (isMountedRef.current) {
  550:           setError(verificationError);
  551:         }
  552: 
  553:         throw verificationError;
  554:       } finally {
  555:         if (isMountedRef.current) {
  556:           setOperation(AUTH_OPERATION.IDLE);
  557:         }
  558:       }
  559:     },
  560:     [applyAuthentication],
  561:   );
  562: 
  563:   /*
  564:    * =========================================
  565:    * Refresh Session
  566:    * =========================================
  567:    *
  568:    * Only one refresh may run at a time because
  569:    * every successful refresh invalidates the
  570:    * previous refresh token.
  571:    */
  572: 
  573:   const refreshAuthentication = useCallback(async () => {
  574:     if (refreshPromiseRef.current) {
  575:       return refreshPromiseRef.current;
  576:     }
  577: 
  578:     const refreshPromise = (async () => {
  579:       if (isMountedRef.current) {
  580:         setOperation(AUTH_OPERATION.REFRESHING);
  581: 
  582:         setError(null);
  583:       }
  584: 
  585:       try {
  586:         const result = await refreshSession();
  587: 
  588:         applyAuthentication(result);
  589: 
  590:         return result;
  591:       } catch (refreshError) {
  592:         if (
  593:           isUnauthenticatedError(refreshError) ||
  594:           refreshError?.code === "SESSION_REFRESH_CONFLICT"
  595:         ) {
  596:           clearAuthentication();
  597:         }
  598: 
  599:         if (isMountedRef.current) {
  600:           setError(refreshError);
  601:         }
  602: 
  603:         throw refreshError;
  604:       } finally {
  605:         if (isMountedRef.current) {
  606:           setOperation(AUTH_OPERATION.IDLE);
  607:         }
  608:       }
  609:     })();
  610: 
  611:     refreshPromiseRef.current = refreshPromise;
  612: 
  613:     try {
  614:       return await refreshPromise;
  615:     } finally {
  616:       if (refreshPromiseRef.current === refreshPromise) {
  617:         refreshPromiseRef.current = null;
  618:       }
  619:     }
  620:   }, [applyAuthentication, clearAuthentication]);
  621: 
  622:   /*
  623:    * =========================================
  624:    * Logout
  625:    * =========================================
  626:    */
  627: 
  628:   const logout = useCallback(async () => {
  629:     if (isMountedRef.current) {
  630:       setOperation(AUTH_OPERATION.LOGGING_OUT);
  631: 
  632:       setError(null);
  633:     }
  634: 
  635:     try {
  636:       const result = await logoutService();
  637: 
  638:       clearAuthentication();
  639: 
  640:       return result;
  641:     } catch (logoutError) {
  642:       /*
  643:        * The backend intentionally preserves
  644:        * the cookie when database revocation
  645:        * fails, so keep the local identity
  646:        * until logout actually succeeds.
  647:        */
  648: 
  649:       if (isMountedRef.current) {
  650:         setError(logoutError);
  651:       }
  652: 
  653:       throw logoutError;
  654:     } finally {
  655:       if (isMountedRef.current) {
  656:         setOperation(AUTH_OPERATION.IDLE);
  657:       }
  658:     }
  659:   }, [clearAuthentication]);
  660: 
  661:   /*
  662:    * =========================================
  663:    * Role Lookup
  664:    * =========================================
  665:    */
  666: 
  667:   const hasRole = useCallback(
  668:     (roleName) => {
  669:       const normalizedRole =
  670:         typeof roleName === "string" ? roleName.trim().toLowerCase() : "";
  671: 
  672:       return Boolean(normalizedRole && roles.includes(normalizedRole));
  673:     },
  674:     [roles],
  675:   );
  676: 
  677:   /*
  678:    * =========================================
  679:    * Initial Session Restoration
  680:    * =========================================
  681:    */
  682: 
  683:   useEffect(() => {
  684:     isMountedRef.current = true;
  685: 
  686:     void restoreAuthentication();
  687: 
  688:     return () => {
  689:       isMountedRef.current = false;
  690:     };
  691:   }, [restoreAuthentication]);
  692: 
  693:   /*
  694:    * =========================================
  695:    * Derived State
  696:    * =========================================
  697:    */
  698: 
  699:   const isAuthenticated = status === AUTH_STATUS.AUTHENTICATED;
  700: 
  701:   const isInitializing = status === AUTH_STATUS.INITIALIZING;
  702: 
  703:   const isBusy = operation !== AUTH_OPERATION.IDLE;
  704: 
  705:   /*
  706:    * =========================================
  707:    * Context Value
  708:    * =========================================
  709:    */
  710: 
  711:   const contextValue = useMemo(
  712:     () => ({
  713:       /*
  714:        * Identity
  715:        */
  716: 
  717:       user,
  718: 
  719:       roles,
  720: 
  721:       session,
  722: 
  723:       /*
  724:        * Status
  725:        */
  726: 
  727:       status,
  728: 
  729:       operation,
  730: 
  731:       error,
  732: 
  733:       isAuthenticated,
  734: 
  735:       isInitializing,
  736: 
  737:       isBusy,
  738: 
  739:       /*
  740:        * Authentication Actions
  741:        */
  742: 
  743:       restoreAuthentication,
  744: 
  745:       beginRegistration,
  746: 
  747:       verifyRegistration,
  748: 
  749:       finishRegistration,
  750: 
  751:       beginPasswordLogin,
  752: 
  753:       completeLogin,
  754: 
  755:       refreshAuthentication,
  756: 
  757:       logout,
  758: 
  759:       /*
  760:        * Utilities
  761:        */
  762: 
  763:       hasRole,
  764: 
  765:       clearError,
  766:     }),
  767:     [
  768:       user,
  769: 
  770:       roles,
  771: 
  772:       session,
  773: 
  774:       status,
  775: 
  776:       operation,
  777: 
  778:       error,
  779: 
  780:       isAuthenticated,
  781: 
  782:       isInitializing,
  783: 
  784:       isBusy,
  785: 
  786:       restoreAuthentication,
  787: 
  788:       beginRegistration,
  789: 
  790:       verifyRegistration,
  791: 
  792:       finishRegistration,
  793: 
  794:       beginPasswordLogin,
  795: 
  796:       completeLogin,
  797: 
  798:       refreshAuthentication,
  799: 
  800:       logout,
  801: 
  802:       hasRole,
  803: 
  804:       clearError,
  805:     ],
  806:   );
  807: 
  808:   return (
  809:     <AuthContext.Provider value={contextValue}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>
  810:   );
  811: }
  812: 
  813: /*
  814:  * =========================================
  815:  * Authentication Hook
  816:  * =========================================
  817:  */
  818: 
  819: export function useAuth() {
  820:   const context = useContext(AuthContext);
  821: 
  822:   if (!context) {
  823:     throw new Error("useAuth must be used inside AuthProvider.");
  824:   }
  825: 
  826:   return context;
  827: }

  120:     },
  121:     [],
  122:   );
  123: 
  124:   /*
  125:    * =========================================
  126:    * Synchronize After Changes
  127:    * =========================================
  128:    */
  129: 
  130:   const synchronizeCertifications = useCallback(() => {
  131:     const records = getCertifications({
  132:       includeArchived: true,
  133:     });
  134: 
  135:     setCertifications(records);
  136:     setLoadStatus("success");
  137: 
  138:     return records;
  139:   }, []);
  140: 
  141:   /*
  142:    * =========================================
  143:    * Initial Loading
  144:    * =========================================
  145:    */
  146: 
  147:   useEffect(() => {
  148:     refreshCertifications({
  149:       includeArchived: true,
  150: 
  151:       /*
  152:        * The migration service uses its version marker,
  153:        * so this is safe to request during every initial
  154:        * Certification context load.
  155:        */
  156: 
  157:       runLegacyMigration: true,
  158:     }).catch(() => {
  159:       /*
  160:        * The loading or migration error is already
  161:        * saved in the context.
  162:        */
  163:     });
  164:   }, [refreshCertifications]);
  165: 
  166:   /*
  167:    * =========================================
  168:    * Browser Tab Synchronization
  169:    * =========================================
  170:    */
  171: 
  172:   useEffect(() => {
  173:     if (typeof window === "undefined") {
  174:       return undefined;
  175:     }
  176: 
  177:     const handleStorageChange = (event) => {
  178:       if (
  179:         event.storageArea !== window.localStorage ||
  180:         event.key !== CERTIFICATION_STORAGE_KEY
  181:       ) {
  182:         return;
  183:       }
  184: 
  185:       refreshCertifications({
  186:         includeArchived: true,
  187:         runLegacyMigration: false,
  188:       }).catch(() => {
  189:         /*
  190:          * The loading error is already saved
  191:          * in the context.
  192:          */
  193:       });
  194:     };
  195: 
  196:     window.addEventListener("storage", handleStorageChange);
  197: 
  198:     return () => {
  199:       window.removeEventListener("storage", handleStorageChange);
  200:     };
  201:   }, [refreshCertifications]);
  202: 
  203:   /*
  204:    * =========================================
  205:    * Mutation Runner
  206:    * =========================================
  207:    */
  208: 
  209:   const runMutation = useCallback(
  210:     async (operationInformation, mutation) => {
  211:       setOperation(operationInformation);
  212:       setSaveStatus("saving");
  213:       setError(null);
  214:       setWarnings([]);
  215: 
  216:       try {
  217:         const result = await mutation();
  218: 
  219:         synchronizeCertifications();
  220: 
  221:         const resultWarnings = Array.isArray(result?.warnings)
  222:           ? result.warnings
  223:           : [];
  224: 
  225:         setWarnings(resultWarnings);
  226:         setSaveStatus("success");
  227: 
  228:         return result?.certification || result;
  229:       } catch (caughtError) {
  230:         const normalizedError = normalizeContextError(caughtError);
  231: 
  232:         setError(normalizedError);
  233: 
  234:         setWarnings(normalizedError.warnings);
  235: 
  236:         setSaveStatus("error");
  237: 
  238:         throw caughtError;
  239:       } finally {
  240:         setOperation(null);
  241:       }
  242:     },
  243:     [synchronizeCertifications],
  244:   );
  245: 
  246:   /*
  247:    * =========================================
  248:    * Create Certification

  253:     (certificationData, options = {}) =>

  256:           type: "create",

  259:         },

  261:       ),
  262:     [runMutation],
  263:   );

  279:       ),

  281:   );

   52: function normalizeEducationContextError(error) {
   53:   return {
   54:     message:
   55:       error?.publicMessage ||
   56:       error?.message ||
   57:       "An unexpected education-management error occurred.",
   58: 
   59:     code: error?.code || "EDUCATION_OPERATION_FAILED",
   60: 
   61:     status: Number(error?.status) || 500,
   62: 
   63:     errors: Array.isArray(error?.errors) ? error.errors : [],
   64: 
   65:     warnings: Array.isArray(error?.warnings) ? error.warnings : [],
   66: 
   67:     conflicts: Array.isArray(error?.conflicts) ? error.conflicts : [],
   68: 
   69:     fieldErrors:
   70:       error?.fieldErrors && typeof error.fieldErrors === "object"
   71:         ? error.fieldErrors
   72:         : {},
   73: 
   74:     validation: error?.validation || null,
   75: 
   76:     details:
   77:       error?.details && typeof error.details === "object"
   78:         ? error.details
   79:         : null,
   80: 
   81:     originalError: error,

  675:         }

  678:

  780:       resetOperation,

  782:   );

  784:   return (

   83: function loadStoredDraft() {

  136: function resolveStateValue(valueOrUpdater, currentValue) {
  137:   return typeof valueOrUpdater === "function"
  138:     ? valueOrUpdater(currentValue)
  139:     : valueOrUpdater;
  140: }

  142: export function PortfolioDraftProvider({ children }) {
  143:   const [portfolioDraft, setPortfolioDraft] = useState(loadStoredDraft);
  144: 
  145:   const [saveStatus, setSaveStatus] = useState("idle");

  147:   useEffect(() => {
  148:     try {
  149:       sessionStorage.setItem(
  150:         EDITOR_STORAGE_KEY,

  153:     } catch (error) {
  154:       console.error("Unable to store the portfolio editor draft:", error);
  155:     }
  156:   }, [portfolioDraft]);

  159:     setPortfolioDraft((currentDraft) => ({
  160:       ...currentDraft,
  161: 
  162:       [fieldName]: resolveStateValue(valueOrUpdater, currentDraft[fieldName]),
  163:     }));
  164:   };
  165: 
  166:   const updateSectionVisibility = (sectionName, isVisible) => {
  167:     setPortfolioDraft((currentDraft) => ({
  168:       ...currentDraft,
  169: 
  170:       sectionVisibility: {
  171:         ...currentDraft.sectionVisibility,
  172:         [sectionName]: isVisible,
  173:       },
  174:     }));
  175:   };
  176: 
  177:   const resetPortfolioDraft = () => {
  178:     setPortfolioDraft(INITIAL_PORTFOLIO_DRAFT);

  180:

  182:     sessionStorage.removeItem("portfolio-preview");

  227:     addProfileItem, updateProfileItem, replaceProfileCollection,
  228:     reorderProfileCollection, setPrimaryProfileItem, archiveProfileItem,
  229:     restoreProfileItem, deleteProfileItem, validateProfileDraft,
  230:     clearError, resetSaveStatus, resetOperation,
  231:   }), [
  232:     profile, setProfile, activeCollections, archivedCollections, statistics,
  233:     isLoading, loadStatus, saveStatus, operation, error, refreshProfile,
  234:     getProfileCollection, getProfileItem, updateProfile, updateProfileIdentity,
  235:     updateProfileVisibility, archiveProfile, restoreProfile, resetProfile,
  236:     deleteProfile, addProfileItem, updateProfileItem, replaceProfileCollection,
  237:     reorderProfileCollection, setPrimaryProfileItem, archiveProfileItem,
  238:     restoreProfileItem, deleteProfileItem, validateProfileDraft,
  239:     clearError, resetSaveStatus, resetOperation,
  240:   ]);
  241: 
  242:   return <ProfileDataContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</ProfileDataContext.Provider>;
  243: }
  244: 
  245: export function useProfileData() {
  246:   const context = useContext(ProfileDataContext);
  247:   if (!context) throw new Error("useProfileData must be used inside ProfileDataProvider.");
  248:   return context;
  249: }

  169: function normalizeProfileContextError(error) {
  170:   return {
  171:     message:
  172:       error?.publicMessage ||
  173:       error?.message ||
  174:       "An unexpected Profile error occurred.",
  175: 
  176:     code: error?.code || "PROFILE_OPERATION_FAILED",
  177: 
  178:     status: Number(error?.status) || 500,
  179: 
  180:     errors: Array.isArray(error?.errors) ? error.errors : [],
  181: 
  182:     warnings: Array.isArray(error?.warnings) ? error.warnings : [],
  183: 
  184:     conflicts: Array.isArray(error?.conflicts) ? error.conflicts : [],
  185: 
  186:     fieldErrors:
  187:       error?.fieldErrors && typeof error.fieldErrors === "object"
  188:         ? error.fieldErrors
  189:         : {},
  190: 
  191:     validation: error?.validation || null,
  192: 
  193:     details: error?.details || null,
  194: 
  195:     originalError: error,
  196:   };
  197: }

   38: function normalizeContextError(error) {
   39:   return {
   40:     name: error?.name || "ProjectError",
   41: 
   42:     code: error?.code || "PROJECT_OPERATION_ERROR",
   43: 
   44:     message:
   45:       error?.publicMessage ||
   46:       error?.message ||
   47:       "The Project Library operation could not be completed.",
   48: 
   49:     fieldErrors: error?.fieldErrors || error?.validation?.fieldErrors || {},
   50: 
   51:     errors: error?.errors || error?.validation?.errors || [],
   52: 
   53:     warnings: error?.warnings || error?.validation?.warnings || [],
   54: 
   55:     projectId: error?.projectId || error?.details?.projectId || "",
   56:   };
   57: }

   59: /*
   60:  * =========================================
   61:  * Warning Normalization
   62:  * =========================================
   63:  */
   64: 
   65: function normalizeOperationWarnings(result) {
   66:   const operationWarnings = Array.isArray(result?.warnings)
   67:     ? result.warnings
   68:     : [];
   69: 
   70:   const assetCleanupWarning = result?.assetCleanupWarning;
   71: 
   72:   if (!assetCleanupWarning) {
   73:     return operationWarnings;
   74:   }
   75: 
   76:   const cleanupMessage =
   77:     typeof assetCleanupWarning === "string"
   78:       ? assetCleanupWarning
   79:       : assetCleanupWarning?.publicMessage ||
   80:         assetCleanupWarning?.message ||
   81:         "The Project was saved, but one or more unused files could not be removed.";
   82: 
   83:   return [
   84:     ...operationWarnings,
   85: 
   86:     {
   87:       code: "PROJECT_ASSET_CLEANUP_WARNING",
   88:       field: "media",
   89:       message: cleanupMessage,
   90:     },
   91:   ];
   92: }

  101:   const [projects, setProjects] = useState([]);
  102:

  108:

  110: 
  111:   const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  112: 
  113:   const [warnings, setWarnings] = useState([]);
  114:

  116: 
  117:   const [backendError, setBackendError] = useState(null);
  118: 
  119:   /*
  120:    * =========================================
  121:    * Load Project Records
  122:    * =========================================
  123:    */
  124: 
  125:   const refreshBackendProjects = useCallback(async (options = {}) => {
  126:   setBackendStatus("loading");
  127:   setBackendError(null);
  128: 
  129:   try {
  130:     const records = await fetchProjects(options);
  131: 
  132:     if (!Array.isArray(records)) {
  133:       throw new TypeError("The Project API did not return a Project array.");
  134:     }
  135: 
  136:     setBackendStatus("success");
  137: 
  138:     // Do not replace browser-local Project records.
  139:     return records;
  140:   } catch (caughtError) {
  141:     setBackendStatus("error");
  142:     setBackendError(normalizeContextError(caughtError));
  143:     throw caughtError;
  144:   }
  145: }, []);
  146:   const refreshProjects = useCallback(
  147:     async ({ includeArchived = true, preserveCurrentRecords = false } = {}) => {
  148:       setIsLoading(true);
  149:       setLoadStatus("loading");
  150: 
  151:       try {
  152:         const records = await fetchProjects();
  153: 
  154:         if (!Array.isArray(records)) {
  155:           throw new TypeError(
  156:             "The Project API did not return a Project array."
  157:           );
  158:         }
  159: 
  160:         const filteredRecords = includeArchived
  161:           ? records
  162:           : records.filter(
  163:               (project) => project.recordStatus !== "archived"
  164:             );
  165: 
  166:         setProjects(filteredRecords);
  167:         setLoadStatus("success");
  168:         setError(null);
  169: 
  170:         return filteredRecords;
  171:       } catch (caughtError) {
  172:         const normalizedError = normalizeContextError(caughtError);
  173: 
  174:         if (!preserveCurrentRecords) {
  175:           setProjects([]);
  176:         }
  177: 
  178:         setLoadStatus("error");
  179:         setError(normalizedError);
  180: 
  181:         throw caughtError;
  182:       } finally {
  183:         setIsLoading(false);
  184:       }
  185:     },
  186:     [],
  187:   );
  188: 
  189:   /*
  190:    * =========================================
  191:    * Silent Local Synchronization
  192:    * =========================================
  193:    *
  194:    * Used after a successful mutation. This
  195:    * avoids showing the full loading state
  196:    * every time a Project is saved.
  197:    */
  198: 
  199:   const synchronizeProjects = useCallback(async () => {
  200:     const records = await fetchProjects();
  201: 
  202:     if (!Array.isArray(records)) {
  203:       throw new TypeError(
  204:         "The Project API did not return a Project array."
  205:       );
  206:     }
  207: 
  208:     setProjects(records);
  209:     setLoadStatus("success");
  210: 
  211:     return records;
  212:   }, []);

  219:

  221:     refreshProjects().catch(() => {
  222:       /*
  223:        * The normalized loading error is already
  224:        * stored in the Context.

  227:   }, [refreshProjects]);

  231:    * Cross-Tab Synchronization
  232:    * =========================================
  233:    */

  235:   useEffect(() => {
  236:     if (typeof window === "undefined") {
  237:       return undefined;
  238:     }
  239: 
  240:     const handleStorageChange = (event) => {
  241:       if (
  242:         event.storageArea !== window.localStorage ||
  243:         event.key !== PROJECT_STORAGE_KEY

  245:         return;

  248:       refreshProjects({
  249:         includeArchived: true,
  250:         preserveCurrentRecords: true,
  251:       }).catch(() => {
  252:         /*
  253:          * Keep the current in-memory collection
  254:          * when another tab writes invalid data.
  255:          */
  256:       });
  257:     };

  260: 
  261:     return () => {
  262:       window.removeEventListener("storage", handleStorageChange);
  263:     };

  301:           status: "success",

  303:

   14: function createId() {
   15:   if (typeof crypto !== "undefined" && crypto.randomUUID) {
   16:     return crypto.randomUUID();
   17:   }
   18: 
   19:   return `resume-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`;

   22: function createSlug(value) {
   23:   const slug = String(value || "")
   24:     .trim()
   25:     .toLowerCase()
   26:     .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
   27:     .replace(/^-|-$/g, "");
   28: 
   29:   return slug || "resume";
   30: }
   31: 
   32: function createUniqueSlug(resumeName, resumes, currentResumeId = null) {
   33:   const baseSlug = createSlug(resumeName);
   34: 
   35:   const usedSlugs = new Set(
   36:     resumes
   37:       .filter((resume) => resume.id !== currentResumeId)
   38:       .map((resume) => resume.publicSlug)
   39:       .filter(Boolean),
   40:   );
   41: 
   42:   if (!usedSlugs.has(baseSlug)) {
   43:     return baseSlug;
   44:   }
   45: 
   46:   let suffix = 2;
   47:   let nextSlug = `${baseSlug}-${suffix}`;
   48: 
   49:   while (usedSlugs.has(nextSlug)) {
   50:     suffix += 1;
   51:     nextSlug = `${baseSlug}-${suffix}`;
   52:   }
   53: 
   54:   return nextSlug;
   55: }

   71: function createSkillDeletionConflict(skillId, usage) {
   72:   const experienceCount = Number(usage?.experienceCount) || 0;
   73: 
   74:   const error = new Error(`Skill "${skillId}" is still referenced.`);
   75: 
   76:   error.name = "SkillUsageConflictError";
   77:   error.code = "SKILL_IN_USE";
   78:   error.status = 409;
   79: 
   80:   error.publicMessage =
   81:     experienceCount === 1
   82:       ? "This skill cannot be permanently deleted because it is used by an experience. Archive it instead."
   83:       : `This skill cannot be permanently deleted because it is used by ${experienceCount} experiences. Archive it instead.`;
   84: 
   85:   error.usage = usage;
   86: 
   87:   error.conflicts = [
   88:     {
   89:       field: "skillId",
   90:       code: "skill_in_use",
   91:       message: error.publicMessage,
   92:       skillId,
   93:       experienceCount,
   94: 
   95:       experienceSkillCount: Number(usage?.experienceSkillCount) || 0,
   96:

  100:         ? usage.experiences.map((item) => item.id).filter(Boolean)
  101:         : [],
  102:     },

  106: }

  108: function sortSkillLibrary(skills) {

  116: export function SkillDataProvider({ children }) {
  117:   const { user, session, isAuthenticated, isInitializing } = useAuth();
  118: 
  119:   const userId = isAuthenticated ? user?.id || null : null;
  120: 
  121:   const sessionKey =
  122:     isAuthenticated && user?.id && session?.id
  123:       ? JSON.stringify([user.id, session.id])
  124:       : null;
  125: 
  126:   const activeSessionRef = useRef(sessionKey);
  127:   const requestGenerationRef = useRef(0);
  128:   const refreshGenerationRef = useRef(0);
  129: 
  130:   if (activeSessionRef.current !== sessionKey) {
  131:     activeSessionRef.current = sessionKey;
  132:     requestGenerationRef.current += 1;
  133:     refreshGenerationRef.current += 1;
  134:   }
  135: 
  136:   const captureRequest = useCallback(() => {
  137:     if (!activeSessionRef.current) {
  138:       const error = new Error("An authenticated session is required.");
  139:       error.code = "AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED";
  140:       error.status = 401;
  141:       throw error;
  142:     }
  143: 
  144:     return {
  145:       sessionKey: activeSessionRef.current,
  146:       generation: requestGenerationRef.current,
  147:     };
  148:   }, []);
  149: 
  150:   const isRequestCurrent = useCallback(
  151:     (request) =>
  152:       request.sessionKey === activeSessionRef.current &&
  153:       request.generation === requestGenerationRef.current,
  154:     [],
  155:   );
  156:   const [skills, setSkills] = useState([]);
  157:   const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  158:   const [loadStatus, setLoadStatus] = useState("idle");
  159:   const [saveStatus, setSaveStatus] = useState("idle");
  160:   const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  161:   const [operation, setOperation] = useState(INITIAL_OPERATION);
  162: 
  163:   const clearError = useCallback(() => {
  164:     setError(null);
  165:   }, []);
  166: 
  167:   const resetSaveStatus = useCallback(() => {
  168:     setSaveStatus("idle");
  169:   }, []);
  170: 
  171:   const resetOperation = useCallback(() => {
  172:     setOperation(INITIAL_OPERATION);
  173:   }, []);
  174: 
  175: 
  176:   const refreshSkills = useCallback(
  177:     async ({ includeArchived = true, showLoading = true } = {}) => {
  178:       const request = captureRequest();
  179:       const refreshGeneration = ++refreshGenerationRef.current;
  180: 
  181:       const isCurrentRefresh = () =>
  182:         isRequestCurrent(request) &&
  183:         refreshGeneration === refreshGenerationRef.current;
  184: 
  185:       try {
  186:         if (showLoading && isCurrentRefresh()) {
  187:           setIsLoading(true);
  188:           setLoadStatus("loading");
  189:         }
  190: 
  191:         if (isCurrentRefresh()) {
  192:           setError(null);
  193:         }
  194: 
  195:         const loadedSkills = await getSkillsService({
  196:           includeArchived,
  197:         });
  198: 
  199:         const nextSkills = sortSkillLibrary(
  200:           Array.isArray(loadedSkills) ? loadedSkills : [],
  201:         );
  202: 
  203:         if (isCurrentRefresh()) {
  204:           setSkills(nextSkills);
  205:           setLoadStatus("success");
  206:         }
  207: 
  208:         return nextSkills;
  209:       } catch (loadError) {
  210:         if (isCurrentRefresh()) {
  211:           console.error("Unable to load skills:", loadError);
  212:           setLoadStatus("error");
  213:           setError(normalizeSkillContextError(loadError));
  214:         }
  215: 
  216:         throw loadError;
  217:       } finally {
  218:         if (showLoading && isCurrentRefresh()) {
  219:           setIsLoading(false);
  220:         }
  221:       }
  222:     },
  223:     [captureRequest, isRequestCurrent],
  224:   );
  225: 
  226:   useEffect(() => {
  227:     const generation = ++requestGenerationRef.current;
  228:     const refreshGeneration = ++refreshGenerationRef.current;
  229: 
  230:     if (!sessionKey) {
  231:       setSkills([]);
  232:       setIsLoading(false);
  233:       setLoadStatus(isInitializing ? "idle" : "idle");
  234:       setSaveStatus("idle");
  235:       setError(null);
  236:       setOperation(INITIAL_OPERATION);
  237:       return;
  238:     }
  239: 
  240:     setSkills([]);
  241:     setIsLoading(true);
  242:     setLoadStatus("loading");
  243:     setError(null);
  244: 
  245:     getSkillsService({ includeArchived: true })
  246:       .then((loadedSkills) => {
  247:         if ((generation !== requestGenerationRef.current || refreshGeneration !== refreshGenerationRef.current)) return;
  248: 
  249:         setSkills(sortSkillLibrary(loadedSkills));
  250:         setLoadStatus("success");
  251:       })
  252:       .catch((loadError) => {
  253:         if ((generation !== requestGenerationRef.current || refreshGeneration !== refreshGenerationRef.current)) return;
  254: 
  255:         console.error("Unable to load skills:", loadError);
  256:         setSkills([]);
  257:         setLoadStatus("error");
  258:         setError(normalizeSkillContextError(loadError));
  259:       })
  260:       .finally(() => {
  261:         if ((generation === requestGenerationRef.current && refreshGeneration === refreshGenerationRef.current)) {
  262:           setIsLoading(false);
  263:         }
  264:       });
  265: 
  266:     return () => {
  267:       requestGenerationRef.current += 1;
  268:     };
  269:   }, [sessionKey, isInitializing]);
  270:   const getSkillById = useCallback(
  271:     async (skillId) => {
  272:       const request = captureRequest();
  273: 
  274:       const existingSkill = skills.find((skill) => skill.id === skillId);
  275: 
  276:       if (existingSkill) {
  277:         return existingSkill;
  278:       }
  279:

   50: function normalizeTrainingContextError(error) {
   51:   return {
   52:     message:
   53:       error?.publicMessage ||
   54:       error?.message ||
   55:       "An unexpected Training Library error occurred.",
   56: 
   57:     code: error?.code || "TRAINING_OPERATION_FAILED",
   58: 
   59:     status: Number(error?.status) || 500,
   60: 
   61:     errors: Array.isArray(error?.errors) ? error.errors : [],
   62: 
   63:     warnings: Array.isArray(error?.warnings) ? error.warnings : [],
   64: 
   65:     fieldErrors:
   66:       error?.fieldErrors && typeof error.fieldErrors === "object"
   67:         ? error.fieldErrors
   68:         : {},
   69: 
   70:     validation:
   71:       error?.validation && typeof error.validation === "object"
   72:         ? error.validation
   73:         : null,
   74: 
   75:     details:
   76:       error?.details && typeof error.details === "object"
   77:         ? error.details
   78:         : null,
   79: 
   80:     originalError: error,
   81:   };

   90: function getTrainingDateValue(training) {
   91:   const value =
   92:     training?.dates?.endDate ||
   93:     training?.dates?.startDate ||
   94:     training?.updatedAt ||
   95:     "";
   96: 
   97:   const timestamp = new Date(value).getTime();
   98: 
   99:   return Number.isFinite(timestamp) ? timestamp : 0;
  100: }
  101: 
  102: function sortTrainingLibrary(trainingRecords = []) {
  103:   return [...trainingRecords].sort((firstTraining, secondTraining) => {
  104:     const firstCurrent =
  105:       firstTraining?.dates?.isCurrent === true ||
  106:       firstTraining?.completion?.status === "in-progress";
  107: 
  108:     const secondCurrent =
  109:       secondTraining?.dates?.isCurrent === true ||
  110:       secondTraining?.completion?.status === "in-progress";
  111: 
  112:     if (firstCurrent !== secondCurrent) {
  113:       return firstCurrent ? -1 : 1;
  114:     }
  115: 
  116:     const dateDifference =
  117:       getTrainingDateValue(secondTraining) -
  118:       getTrainingDateValue(firstTraining);
  119: 
  120:     if (dateDifference !== 0) {
  121:       return dateDifference;
  122:     }
  123: 
  124:     return String(firstTraining?.title || "").localeCompare(
  125:       String(secondTraining?.title || ""),
  126:       undefined,
  127:       {
  128:         sensitivity: "base",
  129:       },
  130:     );
  131:   });
  132: }

  238:         setTrainingRecords(
  239:           sortTrainingLibrary(
  240:             Array.isArray(loadedRecords) ? loadedRecords : [],
  241:           ),
  242:         );
  243: 
  244:         setLoadStatus("success");
  245:       } catch (loadError) {
  246:         if (!isActive) {
  247:           return;
  248:         }
  249: 
  250:         console.error("Unable to load training records:", loadError);
  251: 
  252:         setTrainingRecords([]);
  253:         setLoadStatus("error");
  254:         setError(normalizeTrainingContextError(loadError));
  255:       } finally {
  256:         if (isActive) {
  257:           setIsLoading(false);
  258:         }
  259:       }
  260:     };
  261: 
  262:     loadInitialTraining();
  263: 
  264:     return () => {
  265:       isActive = false;
  266:     };
  267:   }, []);
  268: 
  269:   /*
  270:    * =========================================
  271:    * Cross-Tab Synchronization
  272:    * =========================================
  273:    */
  274: 
  275:   useEffect(() => {

  277:       if (
  278:         event.storageArea !== window.localStorage ||
  279:         event.key !== TRAINING_STORAGE_KEY
  280:       ) {
  281:         return;

  285:         includeArchived: true,
  286:         showLoading: false,

  289:          * The context already records the error.
  290:          */
  291:       });

  295: 
  296:     return () => {
  297:       window.removeEventListener("storage", handleStorageChange);
  298:     };

  669:   /*
  670:    * =========================================
  671:    * Derived Collections
  672:    * =========================================
  673:    */
  674: 
  675:   const activeTrainingRecords = useMemo(
  676:     () => trainingRecords.filter((training) => training.status !== "archived"),
  677:     [trainingRecords],
  678:   );
  679: 
  680:   const archivedTrainingRecords = useMemo(
  681:     () => trainingRecords.filter((training) => training.status === "archived"),
  682:     [trainingRecords],
  683:   );
  684: 
  685:   const plannedTrainingRecords = useMemo(
  686:     () =>
  687:       activeTrainingRecords.filter(
  688:         (training) => training.completion?.status === "planned",
  689:       ),
  690:     [activeTrainingRecords],
  691:   );
  692: 
  693:   const inProgressTrainingRecords = useMemo(
  694:     () =>
  695:       activeTrainingRecords.filter(
  696:         (training) =>
  697:           training.completion?.status === "in-progress" ||
  698:           training.dates?.isCurrent === true,
  699:       ),
  700:     [activeTrainingRecords],
  701:   );
  702: 
  703:   const completedTrainingRecords = useMemo(
  704:     () =>
  705:       activeTrainingRecords.filter(
  706:         (training) => training.completion?.status === "completed",
  707:       ),
  708:     [activeTrainingRecords],
  709:   );
  710: 
  711:   const pausedTrainingRecords = useMemo(
  712:     () =>
  713:       activeTrainingRecords.filter(
  714:         (training) => training.completion?.status === "paused",
  715:       ),
  716:     [activeTrainingRecords],
  717:   );
  718: 
  719:   const withdrawnTrainingRecords = useMemo(
  720:     () =>
  721:       activeTrainingRecords.filter(
  722:         (training) => training.completion?.status === "withdrawn",
  723:       ),
  724:     [activeTrainingRecords],
  725:   );
  726: 
  727:   const trainingById = useMemo(
  728:     () => new Map(trainingRecords.map((training) => [training.id, training])),
  729:     [trainingRecords],
  730:   );
  731: 
  732:   const trainingByType = useMemo(
  733:     () =>
  734:       activeTrainingRecords.reduce((groups, training) => {
  735:         const trainingType = training.trainingType || "other";
  736: 
  737:         if (!groups[trainingType]) {
  738:           groups[trainingType] = [];
  739:         }
  740: 
  741:         groups[trainingType].push(training);
  742: 
  743:         return groups;
  744:       }, {}),
  745:     [activeTrainingRecords],
  746:   );
  747: 
  748:   const statistics = useMemo(
  749:     () => ({
  750:       total: trainingRecords.length,
  751: 
  752:       active: activeTrainingRecords.length,
  753: 
  754:       archived: archivedTrainingRecords.length,
  755: 
  756:       planned: plannedTrainingRecords.length,
  757: 
  758:       inProgress: inProgressTrainingRecords.length,
  759: 
  760:       completed: completedTrainingRecords.length,
  761: 
  762:       paused: pausedTrainingRecords.length,
  763: 
  764:       withdrawn: withdrawnTrainingRecords.length,
  765: 
  766:       withCredentials: activeTrainingRecords.filter(
  767:         (training) =>
  768:           training.completion?.certificateEarned === true ||
  769:           Boolean(training.completion?.credentialId) ||
  770:           Boolean(training.completion?.credentialUrl) ||
  771:           (Array.isArray(training.certificationRelationships) &&
  772:             training.certificationRelationships.length > 0),
  773:       ).length,
  774: 
  775:       withSkills: activeTrainingRecords.filter(
  776:         (training) =>
  777:           Array.isArray(training.skillRelationships) &&
  778:           training.skillRelationships.length > 0,
  779:       ).length,
  780: 
  781:       withDocuments: activeTrainingRecords.filter(
  782:         (training) =>
  783:           Array.isArray(training.supportingDocuments) &&
  784:           training.supportingDocuments.length > 0,
  785:       ).length,
  786:     }),
  787:     [
  788:       trainingRecords,
  789:       activeTrainingRecords,
  790:       archivedTrainingRecords,
  791:       plannedTrainingRecords,
  792:       inProgressTrainingRecords,
  793:       completedTrainingRecords,
  794:       pausedTrainingRecords,
  795:       withdrawnTrainingRecords,
  796:     ],
  797:   );
  798: 
  799:   /*
  800:    * =========================================
  801:    * Context Value
  802:    * =========================================
  803:    */
  804: 
  805:   const contextValue = useMemo(
  806:     () => ({
  807:       /*
  808:        * Collections
  809:        */
  810: 
  811:       trainingRecords,
  812: 
  813:       activeTrainingRecords,
  814:       archivedTrainingRecords,
  815: 
  816:       plannedTrainingRecords,
  817:       inProgressTrainingRecords,
  818:       completedTrainingRecords,
  819:       pausedTrainingRecords,
  820:       withdrawnTrainingRecords,
  821: 
  822:       trainingById,
  823:       trainingByType,
  824: 
  825:       statistics,
  826: 
  827:       /*
  828:        * Status
  829:        */
  830: 
  831:       isLoading,
  832:       loadStatus,
  833:       saveStatus,
  834:       operation,
  835:       error,
  836: 
  837:       /*
  838:        * Read Operations
  839:        */
  840: 
  841:       refreshTraining,
  842:       getTrainingById,
  843: 
  844:       /*
  845:        * Write Operations
  846:        */
  847: 
  848:       createTraining,
  849:       updateTraining,
  850:       archiveTraining,
  851:       restoreTraining,

  853:       replaceTrainingRecords,
  854: 
  855:       /*
  856:        * Validation
  857:        */
  858: 
  859:       validateTrainingDraft,
  860: 
  861:       /*
  862:        * Status Management
  863:        */
  864: 
  865:       clearError,
  866:       resetSaveStatus,
  867:       resetOperation,
  868:     }),
  869:     [
  870:       trainingRecords,
  871:       activeTrainingRecords,
  872:       archivedTrainingRecords,
  873:       plannedTrainingRecords,
  874:       inProgressTrainingRecords,
  875:       completedTrainingRecords,
  876:       pausedTrainingRecords,
  877:       withdrawnTrainingRecords,
  878:       trainingById,
  879:       trainingByType,
  880:       statistics,
  881:       isLoading,
  882:       loadStatus,
  883:       saveStatus,
  884:       operation,
  885:       error,
  886:       refreshTraining,
  887:       getTrainingById,
  888:       createTraining,

  890:       archiveTraining,

  892:       deleteTraining,
  893:       replaceTrainingRecords,

  899:   );
  900: 
  901:   return (

  904:     </TrainingDataContext.Provider>
  905:   );
  906: }
  907: 
  908: /*
  909:  * =========================================
  910:  * Context Hook
  911:  * =========================================
  912:  */
  913: 
  914: export function useTrainingData() {
  915:   const context = useContext(TrainingDataContext);
  916: 
  917:   if (!context) {
  918:     throw new Error(
  919:       "useTrainingData must be used inside TrainingDataProvider.",
  920:     );
  921:   }
  922: 
  923:   return context;
  924: }

    1: import {
    2:   CERTIFICATION_CREDENTIAL_STATE_OPTIONS,
    3:   CERTIFICATION_DOCUMENT_TYPE_OPTIONS,
    4:   CERTIFICATION_ISSUER_TYPE_OPTIONS,

    6:   CERTIFICATION_STATUS_OPTIONS,

   10: 
   11: export const CERTIFICATION_MODEL_VERSION = 1;
   12: 
   13: const MONTH_PATTERN = /^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/;
   14: 
   15: /*
   16:  * =========================================
   17:  * Primitive Helpers
   18:  * =========================================
   19:  */
   20: 
   21: function createId(prefix = "certification") {
   22:   if (
   23:     typeof crypto !== "undefined" &&
   24:     typeof crypto.randomUUID === "function"
   25:   ) {
   26:     return `${prefix}-${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
   27:   }
   28: 
   29:   return `${prefix}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`;
   30: }
   31: 
   32: function getText(value) {
   33:   return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
   34: }
   35: 
   36: function getBoolean(value, fallback = false) {
   37:   return typeof value === "boolean" ? value : fallback;
   38: }
   39: 
   40: function getArray(value) {
   41:   return Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
   42: }
   43: 
   44: function getMonth(value) {
   45:   const month = getText(value);
   46: 
   47:   return MONTH_PATTERN.test(month) ? month : "";
   48: }
   49: 
   50: function getTimestamp(value, fallback) {
   51:   const timestamp = getText(value);
   52: 
   53:   return timestamp && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(timestamp))
   54:     ? timestamp
   55:     : fallback;
   56: }
   57: 
   58: function getFileExtension(fileName) {
   59:   const normalizedName = getText(fileName).toLocaleLowerCase();
   60: 
   61:   const extensionIndex = normalizedName.lastIndexOf(".");
   62: 
   63:   return extensionIndex >= 0 ? normalizedName.slice(extensionIndex) : "";
   64: }
   65: 
   66: function getOptionValue(options, value, fallback) {
   67:   const normalizedValue = getText(value);
   68: 
   69:   return options.some((option) => option.value === normalizedValue)
   70:     ? normalizedValue
   71:     : fallback;
   72: }
   73: 
   74: function uniqueTextValues(values) {
   75:   const usedValues = new Set();
   76: 
   77:   return getArray(values).reduce((result, value) => {
   78:     const text = getText(value);
   79: 
   80:     if (!text || usedValues.has(text)) {
   81:       return result;
   82:     }
   83: 
   84:     usedValues.add(text);
   85:     result.push(text);
   86: 
   87:     return result;
   88:   }, []);
   89: }

   92:  * =========================================
   93:  * Skill Relationships

   96: 
   97: export function createCertificationSkillRelationship(skill = {}, order = 0) {
   98:   const skillId = getText(skill.skillId || skill.profileSkillId || skill.id);
   99: 
  100:   return {
  101:     id: getText(skill.relationshipId) || createId("certification-skill"),
  102: 
  103:     skillId,
  104: 
  105:     order: Number.isInteger(skill.order) ? skill.order : order,
  106: 
  107:     snapshot: {
  108:       name: getText(skill.snapshot?.name || skill.skillName || skill.name),
  109: 
  110:       category: getText(skill.snapshot?.category || skill.category),
  111: 
  112:       type: getText(skill.snapshot?.type || skill.type),
  113: 
  114:       proficiency: getText(
  115:         skill.snapshot?.proficiency ||
  116:           skill.proficiency?.level ||
  117:           skill.proficiency,
  118:       ),
  119:     },
  120:   };
  121: }
  122: 
  123: function normalizeSkillRelationships(value) {
  124:   const usedSkillIds = new Set();
  125: 
  126:   return getArray(value).reduce((relationships, relationship, index) => {
  127:     const normalized = createCertificationSkillRelationship(
  128:       relationship,
  129:       index,
  130:     );
  131: 
  132:     if (!normalized.skillId || usedSkillIds.has(normalized.skillId)) {
  133:       return relationships;
  134:     }
  135: 
  136:     usedSkillIds.add(normalized.skillId);
  137: 
  138:     relationships.push({
  139:       ...normalized,
  140:       order: relationships.length,
  141:     });
  142: 
  143:     return relationships;
  144:   }, []);
  145: }

  216: /*
  217:  * =========================================
  218:  * Supporting Documents
  219:  * =========================================
  220:  */
  221: 
  222: export function createCertificationDocument(document = {}, order = 0) {
  223:   const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
  224: 
  225:   const fileName = getText(document.fileName || document.originalName);
  226: 
  227:   return {
  228:     id: getText(document.id) || createId("certification-document"),
  229: 
  230:     documentType: getOptionValue(
  231:       CERTIFICATION_DOCUMENT_TYPE_OPTIONS,
  232:       document.documentType || document.type,
  233:       "certificate",
  234:     ),
  235: 
  236:     name: getText(document.name || document.displayName || document.fileName),
  237: 
  238:     description: getText(document.description),
  239: 
  240:     fileName,
  241: 
  242:     extension:
  243:       getText(document.extension).toLocaleLowerCase() ||
  244:       getFileExtension(fileName),
  245: 
  246:     mimeType: getText(document.mimeType || document.fileType),
  247: 
  248:     size: Math.max(0, Number(document.size ?? document.fileSize) || 0),
  249: 
  250:     /*
  251:      * The actual Blob is stored in IndexedDB.
  252:      * Only the IndexedDB reference is stored here.
  253:      */
  254: 
  255:     storageKey: getText(document.storageKey || document.documentKey),
  256: 
  257:     checksum: getText(document.checksum),
  258: 
  259:     /*
  260:      * The primary document is used for the preview
  261:      * shown on the Certification item.
  262:      */
  263: 
  264:     isPrimary: getBoolean(document.isPrimary, false),
  265: 
  266:     previewMode: getCertificationDocumentPreviewMode({
  267:       mimeType: document.mimeType || document.fileType,
  268: 
  269:       fileName,
  270:     }),
  271: 
  272:     order: Number.isInteger(document.order) ? document.order : order,
  273: 
  274:     status: document.status === "archived" ? "archived" : "active",
  275: 
  276:     uploadedAt: getTimestamp(document.uploadedAt, timestamp),
  277: 
  278:     createdAt: getTimestamp(document.createdAt, timestamp),
  279: 
  280:     updatedAt: getTimestamp(document.updatedAt, timestamp),
  281:   };
  282: }
  283: 
  284: function normalizeDocuments(value) {
  285:   const usedIds = new Set();
  286: 
  287:   const documents = getArray(value).reduce((result, document, index) => {
  288:     if (!document || typeof document !== "object") {
  289:       return result;
  290:     }
  291: 
  292:     const normalized = createCertificationDocument(document, index);
  293: 
  294:     if (usedIds.has(normalized.id)) {
  295:       return result;
  296:     }
  297: 
  298:     usedIds.add(normalized.id);
  299: 
  300:     result.push({
  301:       ...normalized,
  302:       order: result.length,
  303:     });
  304: 
  305:     return result;
  306:   }, []);
  307: 
  308:   /*
  309:    * Only one active document can be the primary
  310:    * document used for the Certification item preview.
  311:    */
  312: 
  313:   const requestedPrimaryIndex = documents.findIndex(
  314:     (document) => document.isPrimary && document.status !== "archived",
  315:   );
  316: 
  317:   const primaryIndex =
  318:     requestedPrimaryIndex >= 0
  319:       ? requestedPrimaryIndex
  320:       : documents.findIndex((document) => document.status !== "archived");
  321: 
  322:   return documents.map((document, index) => ({
  323:     ...document,
  324:     isPrimary: index === primaryIndex,
  325:   }));
  326: }

  572: 
  573: export function normalizeCertificationCollection(values = []) {
  574:   const usedIds = new Set();
  575: 
  576:   return getArray(values).reduce((certifications, value) => {
  577:     const certification = normalizeCertification(value);
  578: 
  579:     if (usedIds.has(certification.id)) {
  580:       return certifications;
  581:     }
  582: 
  583:     usedIds.add(certification.id);
  584: 
  585:     certifications.push(certification);
  586: 
  587:     return certifications;
  588:   }, []);
  589: }

  675: 
  676: export function getEffectiveCredentialState(certification, today = new Date()) {
  677:   const normalized = normalizeCertification(certification);
  678: 
  679:   const todayMonth = today.toISOString().slice(0, 7);
  680: 
  681:   if (
  682:     normalized.credential.state === "planned" ||
  683:     (normalized.dates.issueDate && normalized.dates.issueDate > todayMonth)
  684:   ) {
  685:     return "planned";
  686:   }
  687: 
  688:   if (
  689:     !normalized.dates.doesNotExpire &&
  690:     normalized.dates.expirationDate &&
  691:     normalized.dates.expirationDate < todayMonth
  692:   ) {
  693:     return "expired";
  694:   }
  695: 
  696:   return normalized.credential.state;
  697: }

   47: function normalizeText(value, maximumLength = Infinity) {
   48:   if (typeof value !== "string") {
   49:     return "";
   50:   }
   51: 
   52:   return value.trim().slice(0, maximumLength);
   53: }
   54: 
   55: function normalizeBoolean(value, defaultValue = false) {
   56:   return typeof value === "boolean" ? value : defaultValue;
   57: }
   58: 
   59: function normalizeNullableNumber(value) {
   60:   if (value === "" || value === null || value === undefined) {
   61:     return null;
   62:   }
   63: 
   64:   const numberValue = Number(value);
   65: 
   66:   if (!Number.isFinite(numberValue)) {
   67:     return null;
   68:   }
   69: 
   70:   return Number(Math.max(0, numberValue).toFixed(2));
   71: }
   72: 
   73: function normalizeDate(value) {
   74:   const text = normalizeText(value, 10);
   75: 
   76:   if (!text) {
   77:     return "";
   78:   }
   79: 
   80:   if (!/^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])(?:-(0[1-9]|[12]\d|3[01]))?$/.test(text)) {
   81:     return "";
   82:   }
   83: 
   84:   return text;
   85: }

   87: function normalizeIdentifierList(values, maximumItems) {
   88:   if (!Array.isArray(values)) {
   89:     return [];
   90:   }
   91: 
   92:   return [
   93:     ...new Set(
   94:       values
   95:         .map((value) => {
   96:           if (typeof value === "string") {
   97:             return value.trim();
   98:           }
   99: 
  100:           return String(value?.id || "").trim();
  101:         })
  102:         .filter(Boolean),
  103:     ),
  104:   ].slice(0, maximumItems);

  404:   };

   26: export function createExperienceId(prefix = "experience") {
   27:   if (
   28:     typeof crypto !== "undefined" &&
   29:     typeof crypto.randomUUID === "function"
   30:   ) {
   31:     return `${prefix}-${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
   32:   }
   33: 
   34:   return `${prefix}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`;
   35: }

   37: /*
   38:  * =========================================
   39:  * Primitive Normalization

   42: 
   43: function normalizeText(value, maximumLength = Infinity) {
   44:   if (typeof value !== "string") {
   45:     return "";
   46:   }
   47: 
   48:   return value.trim().slice(0, maximumLength);
   49: }
   50: 
   51: function normalizeBoolean(value, defaultValue = false) {
   52:   return typeof value === "boolean" ? value : defaultValue;
   53: }
   54: 
   55: function normalizeNullableNumber(value) {
   56:   if (value === "" || value === null || value === undefined) {
   57:     return null;
   58:   }
   59: 
   60:   const numberValue = Number(value);
   61: 
   62:   if (!Number.isFinite(numberValue)) {
   63:     return null;
   64:   }
   65: 
   66:   return Math.max(0, Math.trunc(numberValue));
   67: }
   68: 
   69: function normalizeDate(value) {
   70:   if (typeof value !== "string") {
   71:     return "";
   72:   }
   73: 
   74:   const trimmedValue = value.trim();
   75: 
   76:   if (!trimmedValue) {
   77:     return "";
   78:   }
   79: 
   80:   /*
   81:    * The form uses YYYY-MM values, but this also
   82:    * permits YYYY-MM-DD records imported later.
   83:    */
   84: 
   85:   if (
   86:     !/^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])(?:-(0[1-9]|[12]\d|3[01]))?$/.test(trimmedValue)
   87:   ) {
   88:     return "";
   89:   }
   90: 
   91:   return trimmedValue;
   92: }

   94: function normalizeIdentifierList(values, maximumItems) {
   95:   if (!Array.isArray(values)) {
   96:     return [];
   97:   }
   98: 
   99:   return [
  100:     ...new Set(
  101:       values
  102:         .map((value) => {
  103:           if (typeof value === "string") {
  104:             return value.trim();
  105:           }
  106: 
  107:           return String(value?.id || "").trim();
  108:         })
  109:         .filter(Boolean),
  110:     ),
  111:   ].slice(0, maximumItems);
  112: }

  291: 
  292:   const normalizedSkills = values
  293:     .map(createExperienceSkill)
  294:     .filter((skill) => skill.skillId || skill.nameSnapshot);
  295: 
  296:   const seenIdentities = new Set();
  297: 
  298:   return normalizedSkills
  299:     .filter((skill) => {
  300:       const identity = skill.skillId
  301:         ? `id:${skill.skillId}`
  302:         : `name:${skill.nameSnapshot
  303:             .normalize("NFKC")
  304:             .toLocaleLowerCase()
  305:             .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
  306:             .trim()}`;
  307: 
  308:       if (seenIdentities.has(identity)) {
  309:         return false;
  310:       }
  311: 
  312:       seenIdentities.add(identity);
  313: 
  314:       return true;
  315:     })
  316:     .slice(0, EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumSkills)
  317:     .map((skill, index) => ({
  318:       ...skill,
  319:       order: index,
  320:     }));
  321: }

  335:       : value && typeof value === "object"

  346:     EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS.technologyName,

  351:       normalizeText(source.id, 200) ||

  373:

  375:      * Technology-specific relationship metadata.

  377:

  380:       EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS.technologyCategory,
  381:     ),

  544: 
  545: export function normalizeExperience(value = {}) {
  546:   const defaults = createEmptyExperience();
  547:   const source = value && typeof value === "object" ? value : {};
  548: 
  549:   const position =
  550:     source.position && typeof source.position === "object"
  551:       ? source.position
  552:       : {};
  553: 
  554:   const organization =
  555:     source.organization && typeof source.organization === "object"
  556:       ? source.organization
  557:       : {};
  558: 
  559:   const location =
  560:     source.location && typeof source.location === "object"
  561:       ? source.location
  562:       : {};
  563: 
  564:   const dates =
  565:     source.dates && typeof source.dates === "object" ? source.dates : {};
  566: 
  567:   const leadership =
  568:     source.leadership && typeof source.leadership === "object"
  569:       ? source.leadership
  570:       : {};
  571: 
  572:   const privateInformation =
  573:     source.privateInformation && typeof source.privateInformation === "object"
  574:       ? source.privateInformation
  575:       : {};
  576: 
  577:   const visibility =
  578:     source.visibility && typeof source.visibility === "object"
  579:       ? source.visibility
  580:       : {};
  581: 
  582:   const category = isValidExperienceCategory(source.category)
  583:     ? source.category
  584:     : defaults.category;
  585: 
  586:   const employmentType = isValidEmploymentType(position.employmentType)
  587:     ? position.employmentType
  588:     : defaults.position.employmentType;
  589: 
  590:   const workArrangement = isValidWorkArrangement(position.workArrangement)
  591:     ? position.workArrangement
  592:     : defaults.position.workArrangement;
  593: 
  594:   const status = isValidExperienceStatus(source.status)
  595:     ? source.status
  596:     : defaults.status;
  597: 
  598:   const isCurrent = normalizeBoolean(dates.isCurrent, false);
  599: 
  600:   const overviewMeta =
  601:     source.overviewMeta && typeof source.overviewMeta === "object"
  602:       ? source.overviewMeta
  603:       : {};
  604: 
  605:   return {
  606:     modelVersion: EXPERIENCE_MODEL_VERSION,
  607:

  615:         EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS.positionTitle,
  616:       ),
  617: 
  618:       employmentType,
  619: 
  620:       workArrangement,
  621:     },
  622: 
  623:     organization: {
  624:       name: normalizeText(
  625:         organization.name ||
  626:           source.organizationName ||
  627:           source.company ||
  628:           source.employer,
  629:         EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS.organizationName,
  630:       ),
  631: 
  632:       website: normalizeText(
  633:         organization.website || source.organizationWebsite,
  634:         EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS.organizationWebsite,
  635:       ),
  636: 
  637:       industry: normalizeText(
  638:         organization.industry || source.industry,
  639:         EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS.industry,
  640:       ),
  641:     },
  642: 
  643:     location: {
  644:       city: normalizeText(location.city, EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS.city),
  645: 
  646:       stateRegion: normalizeText(
  647:         location.stateRegion || location.state,
  648:         EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS.stateRegion,
  649:       ),
  650: 
  651:       country: normalizeText(location.country, EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS.country),
  652: 
  653:       displayValue: normalizeText(
  654:         location.displayValue ||
  655:           source.locationValue ||
  656:           (typeof source.location === "string" ? source.location : ""),
  657:         EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS.locationDisplayValue,
  658:       ),
  659:     },
  660: 
  661:     dates: {
  662:       startDate: normalizeDate(dates.startDate || source.startDate),
  663: 
  664:       endDate: isCurrent ? "" : normalizeDate(dates.endDate || source.endDate),
  665: 
  666:       isCurrent,
  667:     },
  668: 
  669:     overview: normalizeText(
  670:       source.overview || source.description,
  671:       EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS.overview,
  672:     ),
  673:

  686:     },

  692:     ),

  695:

  697:

  700:       EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumRelatedProjects,

  702:

  705:         leadership.hasLeadershipResponsibilities,
  706:         false,
  707:       ),
  708:

  710: 
  711:       description: normalizeText(
  712:         leadership.description,
  713:         EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS.leadershipDescription,
  714:       ),
  715:     },
  716: 
  717:     privateInformation: {
  718:       reasonForLeaving: normalizeText(
  719:         privateInformation.reasonForLeaving || source.reasonForLeaving,
  720:         EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS.reasonForLeaving,
  721:       ),
  722:

  724:         privateInformation.notes || source.privateNotes,
  725:         EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS.privateNotes,

  727:     },
  728:

  731:         visibility.showOrganizationWebsite,
  732:         defaults.visibility.showOrganizationWebsite,
  733:       ),
  734: 
  735:       showLocation: normalizeBoolean(
  736:         visibility.showLocation,
  737:         defaults.visibility.showLocation,
  738:       ),
  739:

  741:         visibility.showEmploymentType,
  742:         defaults.visibility.showEmploymentType,
  743:       ),
  744:

  746:         visibility.showWorkArrangement,
  747:         defaults.visibility.showWorkArrangement,

  869: export function normalizeExperienceCollection(values) {

  871:     return [];

  875:

  877:     (experience, index, collection) =>
  878:       collection.findIndex((candidate) => candidate.id === experience.id) ===
  879:       index,
  880:   );
  881: }

   17: export function createProfileId(prefix = "profile") {
   18:   if (
   19:     typeof crypto !== "undefined" &&
   20:     typeof crypto.randomUUID === "function"
   21:   ) {
   22:     return `${prefix}-${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
   23:   }
   24: 
   25:   return `${prefix}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`;
   26: }

   28: /*
   29:  * =========================================
   30:  * Primitive Normalization

   32:  */
   33: 
   34: function normalizeText(value, maximumLength = Infinity) {
   35:   if (typeof value !== "string") {
   36:     return "";
   37:   }
   38: 
   39:   return value.trim().slice(0, maximumLength);
   40: }
   41: 
   42: function normalizeBoolean(value, defaultValue = false) {
   43:   return typeof value === "boolean" ? value : defaultValue;
   44: }
   45: 
   46: function normalizeNonNegativeNumber(value) {
   47:   const numericValue = Number(value);
   48: 
   49:   if (!Number.isFinite(numericValue) || numericValue < 0) {
   50:     return 0;
   51:   }
   52: 
   53:   return numericValue;
   54: }
   55: 
   56: function normalizeNullableDimension(value) {
   57:   if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") {
   58:     return null;
   59:   }
   60: 
   61:   const numericValue = Number(value);
   62: 
   63:   if (!Number.isFinite(numericValue) || numericValue <= 0) {
   64:     return null;
   65:   }
   66: 
   67:   return Math.round(numericValue);
   68: }
   69: 
   70: function normalizeOrder(value, fallbackOrder = 0) {
   71:   const numericOrder = Number(value);
   72: 
   73:   if (!Number.isInteger(numericOrder) || numericOrder < 0) {
   74:     return fallbackOrder;
   75:   }
   76: 
   77:   return numericOrder;
   78: }

  174:

  411: /*
  412:  * =========================================
  413:  * Collection Normalization
  414:  * =========================================
  415:  */
  416: 
  417: function normalizeCollection(values, normalizer, maximumItems) {
  418:   if (!Array.isArray(values)) {
  419:     return [];
  420:   }
  421: 
  422:   const normalizedItems = values
  423:     .slice(0, maximumItems)
  424:     .map((value, index) => normalizer(value, index))
  425:     .filter(Boolean);
  426: 
  427:   const usedIds = new Set();
  428: 
  429:   return normalizedItems
  430:     .filter((item) => {
  431:       if (usedIds.has(item.id)) {
  432:         return false;
  433:       }
  434: 
  435:       usedIds.add(item.id);
  436: 
  437:       return true;
  438:     })
  439:     .sort((firstItem, secondItem) => {
  440:       if (firstItem.order !== secondItem.order) {
  441:         return firstItem.order - secondItem.order;
  442:       }
  443: 
  444:       return firstItem.createdAt.localeCompare(secondItem.createdAt);
  445:     })
  446:     .map((item, index) => ({
  447:       ...item,
  448:       order: index,
  449:     }));
  450: }
  451: 
  452: /*
  453:  * =========================================
  454:  * Primary Preference
  455:  * =========================================
  456:  */
  457: 
  458: function resolvePrimaryId(requestedId, collection) {
  459:   const activeItems = collection.filter((item) => item.status !== "archived");
  460: 
  461:   /*
  462:    * An archived record cannot remain the primary item.
  463:    */
  464: 
  465:   if (requestedId && activeItems.some((item) => item.id === requestedId)) {
  466:     return requestedId;
  467:   }
  468: 
  469:   /*
  470:    * Support older records that stored isPrimary
  471:    * directly on the child item.
  472:    */
  473: 
  474:   const legacyPrimaryItem = activeItems.find((item) => item.isPrimary === true);
  475: 
  476:   return legacyPrimaryItem?.id || activeItems[0]?.id || "";
  477: }
