  479: /*
  480:  * =========================================
  481:  * Profile Normalization
  482:  * =========================================
  483:  */
  484: 
  485: export function normalizeProfile(value = {}) {
  486:   const defaults = createEmptyProfile();
  487: 
  488:   const source = value && typeof value === "object" ? value : {};
  489: 
  490:   const professionalTitles = normalizeCollection(
  491:     source.professionalTitles,
  492:     normalizeProfessionalTitle,
  493:     PROFILE_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumProfessionalTitles,
  494:   );
  495: 
  496:   const emails = normalizeCollection(
  497:     source.emails,
  498:     (item, index) => normalizeContactItem(item, "emails", index),
  499:     PROFILE_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumEmails,
  500:   );
  501: 
  502:   const phones = normalizeCollection(
  503:     source.phones,
  504:     (item, index) => normalizeContactItem(item, "phones", index),
  505:     PROFILE_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumPhones,
  506:   );
  507: 
  508:   const websites = normalizeCollection(
  509:     source.websites,
  510:     (item, index) => normalizeContactItem(item, "websites", index),
  511:     PROFILE_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumWebsites,
  512:   );
  513: 
  514:   const locations = normalizeCollection(
  515:     source.locations,
  516:     (item, index) => normalizeContactItem(item, "locations", index),
  517:     PROFILE_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumLocations,
  518:   );
  519: 
  520:   const socialLinks = normalizeCollection(
  521:     source.socialLinks,
  522:     (item, index) => normalizeContactItem(item, "socialLinks", index),
  523:     PROFILE_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumSocialLinks,
  524:   );
  525: 
  526:   const profilePictures = normalizeCollection(
  527:     source.profilePictures,
  528:     normalizeProfilePicture,
  529:     PROFILE_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumProfilePictures,
  530:   );
  531: 
  532:   const requestedPreferences =
  533:     source.preferences && typeof source.preferences === "object"
  534:       ? source.preferences
  535:       : {};
  536: 
  537:   return {
  538:     modelVersion: PROFILE_MODEL_VERSION,
  539: 
  540:     id: normalizeText(source.id, 200) || defaults.id,
  541: 
  542:     userId: normalizeText(source.userId, 200),
  543: 
  544:     firstName: normalizeText(source.firstName, PROFILE_FIELD_LIMITS.firstName),
  545: 
  546:     middleName: normalizeText(
  547:       source.middleName,
  548:       PROFILE_FIELD_LIMITS.middleName,
  549:     ),
  550: 
  551:     lastName: normalizeText(source.lastName, PROFILE_FIELD_LIMITS.lastName),
  552: 
  553:     professionalTitles,
  554: 
  555:     emails,
  556:     phones,
  557:     websites,
  558:     locations,
  559:     socialLinks,
  560:     profilePictures,
  561: 
  562:     preferences: {
  563:       primaryProfessionalTitleId: resolvePrimaryId(
  564:         requestedPreferences.primaryProfessionalTitleId,
  565:         professionalTitles,
  566:       ),
  567: 
  568:       primaryEmailId: resolvePrimaryId(
  569:         requestedPreferences.primaryEmailId,
  570:         emails,
  571:       ),
  572: 
  573:       primaryPhoneId: resolvePrimaryId(
  574:         requestedPreferences.primaryPhoneId,
  575:         phones,
  576:       ),
  577: 
  578:       primaryWebsiteId: resolvePrimaryId(
  579:         requestedPreferences.primaryWebsiteId,
  580:         websites,
  581:       ),
  582: 
  583:       primaryLocationId: resolvePrimaryId(
  584:         requestedPreferences.primaryLocationId,
  585:         locations,
  586:       ),
  587: 
  588:       primarySocialLinkId: resolvePrimaryId(
  589:         requestedPreferences.primarySocialLinkId,

  606:

   62: function normalizeNullableFileSize(value) {
   63:   if (value === "" || value === null || value === undefined) {
   64:     return null;

   67:   const numberValue = Number(value);
   68: 
   69:   if (!Number.isFinite(numberValue)) {
   70:     return null;
   71:   }

  234:           100,
  235:         ),
  236:       },
  237:     });
  238: 
  239:     return relationships;
  240:   }, []);
  241: }

  243: /*
  244:  * =========================================
  245:  * Skill Relationship
  246:  * =========================================
  247:  */
  248: 
  249: export function createProjectSkillRelationship(value = {}, order = 0) {
  250:   const source =
  251:     typeof value === "string"
  252:       ? {
  253:           nameSnapshot: value,
  254:         }
  255:       : value && typeof value === "object"
  256:         ? value
  257:         : {};
  258: 
  259:   const proficiency =
  260:     source.demonstratedProficiency || source.proficiency || source.level || "";
  261: 
  262:   return {
  263:     id:
  264:       normalizeText(
  265:         source.relationshipId || (source.skillId ? source.id : ""),
  266:         200,
  267:       ) || createProjectId("project-skill"),
  268: 
  269:     skillId: normalizeText(
  270:       source.skillId ||
  271:         source.profileSkillId ||
  272:         (!source.skillId ? source.id : ""),
  273:       200,
  274:     ),
  275: 
  276:     nameSnapshot: normalizeText(
  277:       source.nameSnapshot || source.name || source.label || source.value,
  278:       PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.relationshipName,
  279:     ),
  280: 
  281:     categorySnapshot: normalizeText(
  282:       source.categorySnapshot || source.category,
  283:       100,
  284:     ),
  285: 
  286:     demonstratedProficiency: isValidProjectSkillProficiency(proficiency)
  287:       ? proficiency
  288:       : "",
  289: 
  290:     usageDescription: normalizeText(
  291:       source.usageDescription || source.description,
  292:       PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.relationshipDescription,
  293:     ),
  294: 
  295:     order:
  296:       Number.isInteger(Number(order)) && Number(order) >= 0 ? Number(order) : 0,
  297:   };
  298: }

  305: 
  306: export function createProjectMedia(value = {}, order = 0) {
  307:   const source = value && typeof value === "object" ? value : {};
  308:

  310:     ? source.type
  311:     : source.mimeType?.startsWith("video/")
  312:       ? "video"
  313:       : "image";
  314: 
  315:   return {
  316:     id: normalizeText(source.id, 200) || createProjectId("project-media"),
  317: 
  318:     type,
  319: 
  320:     name: normalizeText(
  321:       source.name || source.fileName,
  322:       PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.mediaName,
  323:     ),
  324: 
  325:     caption: normalizeText(source.caption, PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.mediaCaption),
  326: 
  327:     altText: normalizeText(
  328:       source.altText || source.alternativeText || source.imageDescription,
  329:       PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.mediaAltText,
  330:     ),
  331: 
  332:     fileName: normalizeText(source.fileName, 500),
  333: 
  334:     mimeType: normalizeText(source.mimeType || source.fileType, 200),
  335:

  337: 
  338:     storageProvider:
  339:       normalizeText(source.storageProvider, 100) ||
  340:       (source.storageKey ? "indexed-db" : ""),
  341:

  343: 
  344:     storageKey: normalizeText(source.storageKey, 500),
  345: 
  346:     externalUrl: normalizeText(

  348:       PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.url,
  349:     ),
  350:

  352:

  355:     visibility: source.visibility === "private" ? "private" : "public",
  356: 
  357:     status: source.status === "archived" ? "archived" : "active",
  358: 
  359:     uploadedAt: normalizeText(source.uploadedAt, 100),
  360: 
  361:     order:
  362:       Number.isInteger(Number(order)) && Number(order) >= 0 ? Number(order) : 0,
  363:   };
  364: }

  676: /*
  677:  * =========================================
  678:  * Featured Media Eligibility
  679:  * =========================================
  680:  */
  681: 
  682: function isEligibleFeaturedMedia(mediaItem) {
  683:   return Boolean(
  684:     mediaItem &&
  685:     mediaItem.status !== "archived" &&
  686:     mediaItem.visibility !== "private" &&
  687:     (normalizeText(mediaItem.storageKey, 500) ||
  688:       normalizeText(mediaItem.externalUrl, PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.url)),
  689:   );
  690: }
  691: 
  692: /*
  693:  * =========================================
  694:  * Project Normalization
  695:  * =========================================
  696:  */
  697: 
  698: export function normalizeProject(value = {}) {
  699:   const defaults = createEmptyProject();
  700: 
  701:   const source =
  702:     value && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value) ? value : {};
  703: 
  704:   const getObject = (fieldName) =>
  705:     source[fieldName] &&
  706:     typeof source[fieldName] === "object" &&
  707:     !Array.isArray(source[fieldName])
  708:       ? source[fieldName]
  709:       : {};
  710: 
  711:   const organization = getObject("organization");
  712:   const dates = getObject("dates");
  713:   const location = getObject("location");
  714:   const links = getObject("links");
  715:   const problem = getObject("problem");
  716:   const solution = getObject("solution");
  717:   const results = getObject("results");
  718:   const relatedRecords = getObject("relatedRecords");
  719:   const presentation = getObject("presentation");
  720:   const visibility = getObject("visibility");
  721:   const privateInformation = getObject("privateInformation");
  722: 
  723:   const lifecycleStatus = isValidProjectLifecycleStatus(
  724:     source.lifecycleStatus || source.projectStatus,
  725:   )
  726:     ? source.lifecycleStatus || source.projectStatus
  727:     : defaults.lifecycleStatus;
  728: 
  729:   const isCurrent = normalizeBoolean(
  730:     dates.isCurrent,
  731:     ["in-progress", "maintained"].includes(lifecycleStatus),
  732:   );
  733: 
  734:   /*
  735:    * =========================================
  736:    * Media Normalization
  737:    * =========================================
  738:    */
  739: 
  740:   const media = normalizeArray(source.media)
  741:     .map((item, order) => createProjectMedia(item, order))
  742:     .filter((item) => item.name || item.storageKey || item.externalUrl)
  743:     .slice(0, PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumMedia)
  744:     .map((item, order) => ({
  745:       ...item,
  746:       order,
  747:     }));
  748: 
  749:   const requestedFeaturedMediaId = normalizeText(
  750:     presentation.featuredMediaId,
  751:     200,
  752:   );
  753: 
  754:   const featuredMedia =
  755:     media.find(
  756:       (item) =>
  757:         item.id === requestedFeaturedMediaId && isEligibleFeaturedMedia(item),
  758:     ) ||
  759:     media.find((item) => item.isFeatured && isEligibleFeaturedMedia(item)) ||
  760:     media.find(isEligibleFeaturedMedia) ||
  761:     null;
  762: 
  763:   /*
  764:    * =========================================
  765:    * Skill Relationship Normalization
  766:    * =========================================
  767:    */
  768: 
  769:   const seenSkills = new Set();
  770: 
  771:   const skillRelationships = normalizeArray(source.skillRelationships)
  772:     .map((relationship, order) =>
  773:       createProjectSkillRelationship(relationship, order),
  774:     )
  775:     .filter((relationship) => {
  776:       const identity = (relationship.skillId || relationship.nameSnapshot)
  777:         .normalize("NFKC")
  778:         .toLocaleLowerCase();
  779: 
  780:       if (!identity || seenSkills.has(identity)) {
  781:         return false;
  782:       }
  783: 
  784:       seenSkills.add(identity);
  785: 
  786:       return true;
  787:     })
  788:     .slice(0, PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumSkills)
  789:     .map((relationship, order) => ({
  790:       ...relationship,
  791:       order,
  792:     }));
  793: 
  794:   /*
  795:    * =========================================
  796:    * Supporting Documents
  797:    * =========================================
  798:    */
  799: 
  800:   const supportingDocuments = normalizeArray(source.supportingDocuments)
  801:     .map((documentRecord, order) =>
  802:       createProjectDocument(documentRecord, order),
  803:     )
  804:     .filter(
  805:       (documentRecord) =>
  806:         documentRecord.name ||
  807:         documentRecord.storageKey ||
  808:         documentRecord.externalUrl,
  809:     )
  810:     .slice(0, PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumDocuments)
  811:     .map((documentRecord, order) => ({
  812:       ...documentRecord,
  813:       order,
  814:     }));
  815: 
  816:   const validDocumentIds = new Set(
  817:     supportingDocuments.map((documentRecord) => documentRecord.id),
  818:   );
  819: 
  820:   /*
  821:    * =========================================
  822:    * Normalized Project
  823:    * =========================================
  824:    */
  825: 
  826:   return {
  827:     modelVersion: PROJECT_MODEL_VERSION,
  828: 
  829:     ...(typeof source.rowVersion === "string" &&
  830:     /^[A-Za-z0-9+/]{11}=$/.test(source.rowVersion)
  831:       ? { rowVersion: source.rowVersion }
  832:       : {}),
  833:     id: normalizeText(source.id, 200) || defaults.id,
  834: 
  835:     title: normalizeText(
  836:       source.title || source.name,
  837:       PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.title,
  838:     ),
  839: 
  840:     category: isValidProjectCategory(source.category)
  841:       ? source.category
  842:       : defaults.category,
  843: 
  844:     lifecycleStatus,
  845: 
  846:     role: normalizeText(source.role, PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.role),
  847: 
  848:     ownership: isValidProjectOwnership(source.ownership)
  849:       ? source.ownership
  850:       : defaults.ownership,
  851: 
  852:     organization: {
  853:       name: normalizeText(
  854:         organization.name,
  855:         PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.organizationName,
  856:       ),
  857: 
  858:       clientName: normalizeText(
  859:         organization.clientName,
  860:         PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.clientName,
  861:       ),
  862: 
  863:       website: normalizeText(
  864:         organization.website,
  865:         PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.website,
  866:       ),
  867:     },
  868: 
  869:     dates: {
  870:       startDate: normalizeDate(dates.startDate || source.startDate),
  871: 
  872:       endDate: isCurrent ? "" : normalizeDate(dates.endDate || source.endDate),
  873: 
  874:       isCurrent,
  875:     },
  876: 
  877:     location: {
  878:       displayValue: normalizeText(
  879:         location.displayValue ||
  880:           source.locationValue ||
  881:           (typeof source.location === "string" ? source.location : ""),
  882:         PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.locationDisplayValue,
  883:       ),
  884:     },
  885: 
  886:     links: {
  887:       liveUrl: normalizeText(links.liveUrl, PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.url),
  888: 
  889:       repositoryUrl: normalizeText(
  890:         links.repositoryUrl,
  891:         PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.url,
  892:       ),
  893: 
  894:       documentationUrl: normalizeText(
  895:         links.documentationUrl,
  896:         PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.url,
  897:       ),
  898: 
  899:       caseStudyUrl: normalizeText(links.caseStudyUrl, PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.url),
  900: 
  901:       videoUrl: normalizeText(links.videoUrl, PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.url),
  902:     },
  903: 
  904:     problem: {
  905:       statement: normalizeText(
  906:         problem.statement,
  907:         PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.problemStatement,
  908:       ),
  909: 
  910:       targetAudience: normalizeText(
  911:         problem.targetAudience,
  912:         PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.targetAudience,
  913:       ),
  914: 
  915:       context: normalizeText(problem.context, PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.context),
  916: 
  917:       importance: normalizeText(
  918:         problem.importance || problem.whyImportant,
  919:         PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.importance,
  920:       ),
  921: 
  922:       constraints: normalizeOrderedTextItems(
  923:         problem.constraints,
  924:         "project-constraint",
  925:         PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumConstraints,
  926:       ),
  927: 
  928:       objectives: normalizeOrderedTextItems(
  929:         problem.objectives,
  930:         "project-objective",
  931:         PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumObjectives,
  932:       ),
  933:     },
  934: 
  935:     solution: {
  936:       overview: normalizeText(
  937:         solution.overview || source.description,
  938:         PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.overview,
  939:       ),
  940: 
  941:       approach: normalizeText(
  942:         solution.approach || solution.proposedSolution,
  943:         PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.approach,
  944:       ),
  945: 
  946:       architecture: normalizeText(
  947:         solution.architecture || solution.implementationSummary,
  948:         PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.architecture,
  949:       ),
  950: 
  951:       features: normalizeOrderedTextItems(
  952:         solution.features,
  953:         "project-feature",
  954:         PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumFeatures,
  955:       ),
  956: 
  957:       contributions: normalizeOrderedTextItems(
  958:         solution.contributions,
  959:         "project-contribution",
  960:         PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumContributions,
  961:       ),
  962:     },
  963: 
  964:     results: {
  965:       outcome: normalizeText(results.outcome, PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.outcome),
  966: 
  967:       problemsSolved: normalizeText(
  968:         results.problemsSolved || results.solutionImpact,
  969:         PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.problemsSolved,
  970:       ),
  971: 
  972:       impact: normalizeText(results.impact, PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.impact),
  973: 
  974:       beneficiariesAffected: normalizeText(
  975:         results.beneficiariesAffected ||
  976:           results.peopleAffected ||
  977:           results.organizationsAffected,

   26: export function createSkillId(prefix = "skill") {
   27:   if (
   28:     typeof crypto !== "undefined" &&
   29:     typeof crypto.randomUUID === "function"
   30:   ) {
   31:     return `${prefix}-${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
   32:   }
   33: 
   34:   return `${prefix}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)}`;
   35: }

   37: /*
   38:  * =========================================
   39:  * Primitive Normalization
   40:  * =========================================
   41:  */
   42: 
   43: function normalizeText(value, maximumLength = Infinity) {
   44:   if (typeof value !== "string") {
   45:     return "";
   46:   }
   47: 
   48:   return value.trim().slice(0, maximumLength);
   49: }
   50: 
   51: function normalizeNullableNumber(value) {
   52:   if (value === "" || value === null || value === undefined) {
   53:     return null;
   54:   }
   55: 
   56:   const numberValue = Number(value);
   57: 
   58:   if (!Number.isFinite(numberValue) || numberValue < 0) {
   59:     return null;
   60:   }
   61: 
   62:   return Number(numberValue.toFixed(1));
   63: }
   64: 
   65: function normalizeYearMonth(value) {
   66:   const text = normalizeText(value, 10);
   67: 
   68:   if (!text) {
   69:     return "";
   70:   }
   71: 
   72:   if (!/^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/.test(text)) {
   73:     return "";
   74:   }
   75: 
   76:   return text;
   77: }

   79: /*
   80:  * =========================================
   81:  * Search Name Normalization
   82:  * =========================================
   83:  *
   84:  * normalizedName is used for searching and
   85:  * duplicate prevention. It is not intended as
   86:  * the user-facing display name.
   87:  */
   88: 
   89: export function normalizeSkillNameForComparison(value) {
   90:   return normalizeText(value)
   91:     .normalize("NFKC")
   92:     .toLocaleLowerCase()
   93:     .replace(/[._/\\-]+/g, " ")
   94:     .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
   95:     .trim();
   96: }

   98: /*
   99:  * =========================================
  100:  * Alias Normalization
  101:  * =========================================
  102:  */
  103: 
  104: function normalizeAliases(aliases, skillName = "") {
  105:   if (!Array.isArray(aliases)) {
  106:     return [];
  107:   }
  108: 
  109:   const normalizedSkillName = normalizeSkillNameForComparison(skillName);
  110: 
  111:   const normalizedAliases = aliases
  112:     .map((alias) => {
  113:       if (typeof alias === "string") {
  114:         return normalizeText(alias, SKILL_FIELD_LIMITS.alias);
  115:       }
  116: 
  117:       return normalizeText(
  118:         alias?.name || alias?.value || alias?.label,
  119:         SKILL_FIELD_LIMITS.alias,
  120:       );
  121:     })
  122:     .filter(Boolean);
  123: 
  124:   return normalizedAliases
  125:     .filter((alias, index, collection) => {
  126:       const comparisonName = normalizeSkillNameForComparison(alias);
  127: 
  128:       if (comparisonName === normalizedSkillName) {
  129:         return false;
  130:       }
  131: 
  132:       return (
  133:         collection.findIndex(
  134:           (candidate) =>
  135:             normalizeSkillNameForComparison(candidate) === comparisonName,
  136:         ) === index
  137:       );
  138:     })
  139:     .slice(0, SKILL_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumAliases);
  140: }

  364:  * Normalize Skill Collection
  365:  * =========================================
  366:  */
  367: 
  368: export function normalizeSkillCollection(values) {
  369:   if (!Array.isArray(values)) {
  370:     return [];
  371:   }
  372: 
  373:   const normalizedSkills = values.map(normalizeSkill);
  374: 
  375:   /*
  376:    * Remove duplicate IDs and duplicate skill names.
  377:    */
  378: 
  379:   return normalizedSkills.filter((skill, index, collection) => {
  380:     const duplicateIdIndex = collection.findIndex(
  381:       (candidate) => candidate.id === skill.id,
  382:     );
  383: 
  384:     const duplicateNameIndex = collection.findIndex(
  385:       (candidate) =>
  386:         candidate.normalizedName &&
  387:         candidate.normalizedName === skill.normalizedName,
  388:     );
  389: 
  390:     return (
  391:       duplicateIdIndex === index &&
  392:       (!skill.normalizedName || duplicateNameIndex === index)
  393:     );
  394:   });
  395: }

  398:  * =========================================
  399:  * Find Matching Skill
  400:  * =========================================
  401:  */
  402: 
  403: export function findMatchingSkill(skills, name) {
  404:   if (!Array.isArray(skills)) {
  405:     return null;
  406:   }
  407: 
  408:   const normalizedName = normalizeSkillNameForComparison(name);
  409: 
  410:   if (!normalizedName) {
  411:     return null;
  412:   }
  413: 
  414:   return (
  415:     skills.find((skill) => {
  416:       if (normalizeSkillNameForComparison(skill.name) === normalizedName) {
  417:         return true;
  418:       }
  419: 
  420:       return (skill.aliases || []).some(
  421:         (alias) => normalizeSkillNameForComparison(alias) === normalizedName,
  422:       );
  423:     }) || null
  424:   );
  425: }
  426: 
  427: /*
  428:  * =========================================
  429:  * Skill Display Information
  430:  * =========================================
  431:  */
  432: 
  433: export function getSkillDisplayName(skill) {
  434:   return normalizeText(skill?.name) || "Unnamed Skill";
  435: }
  436: 
  437: /*
  438:  * =========================================
  439:  * Public Skill
  440:  * =========================================
  441:  *
  442:  * Private notes and internal source context are
  443:  * excluded before public presentation.
  444:  */
  445: 
  446: export function createPublicSkill(value) {
  447:   const skill = normalizeSkill(value);
  448: 
  449:   const { notes, sourceContext, ...publicSkill } = skill;
  450: 
  451:   return publicSkill;
  452: }

   46:   if (typeof value !== "string") {

   48:   }

   53: function normalizeBoolean(value, defaultValue = false) {
   54:   return typeof value === "boolean" ? value : defaultValue;
   55: }
   56: 
   57: function normalizeNullableNumber(value, maximumValue = Infinity) {
   58:   if (value === "" || value === null || value === undefined) {
   59:     return null;
   60:   }
   61: 
   62:   const numberValue = Number(value);
   63: 
   64:   if (!Number.isFinite(numberValue)) {
   65:     return null;
   66:   }
   67: 
   68:   return Math.min(maximumValue, Math.max(0, numberValue));
   69: }

   71: function normalizeDate(value) {

   73:     return "";
   74:   }

   76:   const text = value.trim();

  431: function normalizeTrainingCertificationRelationships(values) {
  432:   if (!Array.isArray(values)) {
  433:     return [];
  434:   }
  435: 
  436:   const usedCertificationIds = new Set();
  437: 
  438:   return values.reduce((relationships, value) => {
  439:     const relationship = createTrainingCertificationRelationship(
  440:       value,
  441:       relationships.length,
  442:     );
  443: 
  444:     if (!relationship.certificationId) {
  445:       return relationships;
  446:     }
  447: 
  448:     const comparisonId = relationship.certificationId.toLocaleLowerCase();
  449: 
  450:     if (usedCertificationIds.has(comparisonId)) {
  451:       return relationships;
  452:     }
  453: 
  454:     if (
  455:       relationships.length >= TRAINING_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumRelatedCertifications
  456:     ) {
  457:       return relationships;
  458:     }
  459: 
  460:     usedCertificationIds.add(comparisonId);
  461: 
  462:     relationships.push({
  463:       ...relationship,
  464:       order: relationships.length,
  465:     });
  466: 
  467:     return relationships;
  468:   }, []);
  469: }

  745:

  224:               (educationId) => educationId !== education.id,
  225:             ),
  226:       },
  227:     }));
  228: 
  229:     clearFieldError("relatedRecords.educationIds");
  230:   };
  231: 
  232:   /*
  233:    * =========================================
  234:    * Document Uploads
  235:    * =========================================
  236:    */
  237: 
  238:   const handleDocumentSelection = (event) => {
  239:     const selectedFiles = Array.from(event.target.files || []);
  240: 
  241:     const availableDocumentSlots =
  242:       CERTIFICATION_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumSupportingDocuments -
  243:       formData.supportingDocuments.length -
  244:       documentUploads.length;
  245: 
  246:     setDocumentError("");
  247: 
  248:     if (availableDocumentSlots <= 0) {
  249:       setDocumentError(
  250:         `Add no more than ${CERTIFICATION_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumSupportingDocuments} documents.`,
  251:       );
  252: 
  253:       event.target.value = "";
  254: 
  255:       return;
  256:     }
  257: 
  258:     const acceptedUploads = [];
  259: 
  260:     let latestError = "";
  261: 
  262:     selectedFiles.slice(0, availableDocumentSlots).forEach((file) => {
  263:       if (!isSupportedCertificationDocument(file)) {
  264:         latestError = "Upload only PDF, Word, JPG, JPEG, PNG, or WebP files.";
  265: 
  266:         return;
  267:       }
  268: 
  269:       if (!isCertificationDocumentWithinSizeLimit(file)) {
  270:         latestError = "Each certificate document must be 10 MB or smaller.";
  271: 
  272:         return;
  273:       }
  274: 
  275:       const duplicateDocument = [
  276:         ...formData.supportingDocuments.map((document) => document.fileName),
  277:         ...documentUploads.map((upload) => upload.file.name),
  278:         ...acceptedUploads.map((upload) => upload.file.name),
  279:       ].some(
  280:         (fileName) =>
  281:           fileName?.trim().toLocaleLowerCase() ===
  282:           file.name.trim().toLocaleLowerCase(),
  283:       );
  284: 
  285:       if (duplicateDocument) {
  286:         latestError = `"${file.name}" has already been added.`;
  287: 
  288:         return;
  289:       }
  290: 
  291:       const hasPrimaryDocument =
  292:         formData.supportingDocuments.some(
  293:           (document) => document.status !== "archived" && document.isPrimary,
  294:         ) ||
  295:         documentUploads.some((upload) => upload.isPrimary) ||
  296:         acceptedUploads.some((upload) => upload.isPrimary);
  297: 
  298:       acceptedUploads.push({
  299:         file,
  300:         name: file.name,
  301:         documentType: "certificate",
  302:         description: "",
  303:         isPrimary: !hasPrimaryDocument,
  304:       });
  305:     });
  306: 
  307:     if (selectedFiles.length > availableDocumentSlots) {
  308:       latestError = `Only ${availableDocumentSlots} additional ${
  309:         availableDocumentSlots === 1 ? "document" : "documents"
  310:       } can be added.`;
  311:     }
  312: 
  313:     if (latestError) {
  314:       setDocumentError(latestError);
  315:     }
  316: 
  317:     if (acceptedUploads.length > 0) {
  318:       setDocumentUploads((currentUploads) => [
  319:         ...currentUploads,
  320:         ...acceptedUploads,
  321:       ]);
  322:     }
  323: 
  324:     event.target.value = "";
  325:   };
  326: 
  327:   const removeStagedDocument = (selectedIndex) => {
  328:     setDocumentUploads((currentUploads) => {
  329:       const removedUpload = currentUploads[selectedIndex];
  330: 
  331:       const nextUploads = currentUploads.filter(
  332:         (_, index) => index !== selectedIndex,
  333:       );
  334: 
  335:       const existingPrimaryExists = formData.supportingDocuments.some(
  336:         (document) => document.status !== "archived" && document.isPrimary,
  337:       );
  338: 
  339:       if (
  340:         removedUpload?.isPrimary &&
  341:         !existingPrimaryExists &&
  342:         nextUploads.length > 0
  343:       ) {
  344:         return nextUploads.map((upload, index) => ({
  345:           ...upload,
  346:           isPrimary: index === 0,
  347:         }));
  348:       }
  349: 
  350:       return nextUploads;
  351:     });
  352: 
  353:     setDocumentError("");
  354:   };
  355: 
  356:   const removeExistingDocument = (documentId) => {
  357:     setFormData((currentData) =>
  358:       normalizeCertification({
  359:         ...currentData,
  360: 
  361:         supportingDocuments: currentData.supportingDocuments.filter(
  362:           (document) => document.id !== documentId,
  363:         ),
  364:       }),
  365:     );
  366: 
  367:     setDocumentError("");
  368:   };
  369: 
  370:   const setExistingPrimaryDocument = (documentId) => {
  371:     setFormData((currentData) => ({
  372:       ...currentData,
  373: 
  374:       supportingDocuments: currentData.supportingDocuments.map((document) => ({
  375:         ...document,
  376: 
  377:         isPrimary: document.id === documentId && document.status !== "archived",
  378:       })),
  379:     }));
  380: 
  381:     setDocumentUploads((currentUploads) =>
  382:       currentUploads.map((upload) => ({
  383:         ...upload,
  384:         isPrimary: false,
  385:       })),
  386:     );
  387:   };
  388: 
  389:   const setStagedPrimaryDocument = (selectedIndex) => {
  390:     setDocumentUploads((currentUploads) =>
  391:       currentUploads.map((upload, index) => ({
  392:         ...upload,
  393:         isPrimary: index === selectedIndex,
  394:       })),
  395:     );
  396: 
  397:     setFormData((currentData) => ({
  398:       ...currentData,
  399: 
  400:       supportingDocuments: currentData.supportingDocuments.map((document) => ({
  401:         ...document,
  402:         isPrimary: false,
  403:       })),
  404:     }));
  405:   };
  406: 
  407:   /*
  408:    * =========================================
  409:    * Submission
  410:    * =========================================
  411:    */
  412: 
  413:   const handleSubmit = async (event) => {
  414:     event.preventDefault();
  415: 
  416:     setSubmitError("");
  417: 
  418:     const validation = validateCertification(formData, {
  419:       skills,
  420:       trainingRecords,
  421:       educationRecords,
  422:     });
  423: 
  424:     setFieldErrors(validation.fieldErrors || {});
  425: 
  426:     setWarnings(
  427:       documentUploads.length > 0
  428:         ? (validation.warnings || []).filter(
  429:             (warning) => warning.code !== "CERTIFICATION_DOCUMENT_RECOMMENDED",
  430:           )
  431:         : validation.warnings || [],
  432:     );
  433: 
  434:     if (!validation.isValid) {
  435:       const errors = validation.errors || [];
  436: 
  437:       setSubmitError(
  438:         `${errors.length} ${
  439:           errors.length === 1 ? "problem must" : "problems must"
  440:         } be corrected before saving.`,
  441:       );
  442: 
  443:       const firstError = errors[0];
  444: 
  445:       if (firstError?.field) {
  446:         window.document
  447:           .querySelector(`[data-field="${firstError.field}"]`)
  448:           ?.scrollIntoView({
  449:             behavior: "smooth",
  450:             block: "center",
  451:           });
  452:       }
  453: 
  454:       return;
  455:     }
  456: 
  457:     const normalizedName = formData.name.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
  458: 
  459:     const normalizedIssuer = formData.issuingOrganization.name
  460:       .trim()
  461:       .toLocaleLowerCase();
  462: 
  463:     const duplicateCertification = existingCertifications.find(
  464:       (certification) => {
  465:         const existingName =
  466:           typeof certification?.name === "string"
  467:             ? certification.name.trim().toLocaleLowerCase()
  468:             : "";
  469: 
  470:         const existingIssuer =
  471:           typeof certification?.issuingOrganization?.name === "string"
  472:             ? certification.issuingOrganization.name.trim().toLocaleLowerCase()
  473:             : "";
  474: 
  475:         return (
  476:           certification?.id !== initialCertification?.id &&
  477:           existingName === normalizedName &&
  478:           existingIssuer === normalizedIssuer
  479:         );
  480:       },
  481:     );
  482: 
  483:     if (duplicateCertification) {
  484:       setFieldErrors({
  485:         name: "A matching certification already exists.",
  486:       });
  487: 
  488:       setSubmitError(
  489:         "A Certification with this name and issuing organization already exists.",
  490:       );
  491: 
  492:       return;
  493:     }
  494: 
  495:     try {
  496:       await onSubmit?.(formData, documentUploads);
  497:     } catch (error) {
  498:       setFieldErrors(
  499:         error?.fieldErrors || error?.validation?.fieldErrors || {},
  500:       );
  501: 
  502:       setWarnings(error?.warnings || error?.validation?.warnings || []);
  503: 
  504:       setSubmitError(
  505:         error?.publicMessage ||
  506:           error?.message ||
  507:           "The certification could not be saved.",
  508:       );
  509:     }
  510:   };
  511: 
  512:   return (
  513:     <form className="certification-form" onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate>
  514:       <FormSection
  515:         label="Credential"
  516:         title="Certification Information"
  517:         description="Identify the credential and issuing organization."
  518:       >
  519:         <div className="certification-form-grid">
  520:           <FormField
  521:             label="Certification Name"
  522:             field="name"
  523:             error={fieldErrors.name}
  524:             required
  525:             wide
  526:           >
  527:             <input
  528:               type="text"
  529:               value={formData.name}
  530:               onChange={(event) => updateTopLevel("name", event.target.value)}
  531:               maxLength={CERTIFICATION_FIELD_LIMITS.name}
  532:               placeholder="Example: CompTIA A+"
  533:               disabled={isSaving}
  534:             />
  535:           </FormField>
  536: 
  537:           <FormField
  538:             label="Certification Type"
  539:             field="certificationType"
  540:             error={fieldErrors.certificationType}
  541:             required
  542:           >
  543:             <select
  544:               value={formData.certificationType}
  545:               onChange={(event) =>
  546:                 updateTopLevel("certificationType", event.target.value)
  547:               }
  548:               disabled={isSaving}
  549:             >
  550:               {CERTIFICATION_TYPE_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
  551:                 <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>
  552:                   {option.label}
  553:                 </option>
  554:               ))}
  555:             </select>
  556:           </FormField>
  557: 
  558:           <FormField
  559:             label="Credential State"
  560:             field="credential.state"
  561:             error={fieldErrors["credential.state"]}
  562:             required
  563:           >
  564:             <select
  565:               value={formData.credential.state}
  566:               onChange={(event) =>
  567:                 updateNested("credential", "state", event.target.value)
  568:               }
  569:               disabled={isSaving}
  570:             >
  571:               {CERTIFICATION_CREDENTIAL_STATE_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
  572:                 <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>
  573:                   {option.label}
  574:                 </option>
  575:               ))}
  576:             </select>
  577:           </FormField>
  578: 
  579:           <FormField
  580:             label="Issuing Organization"
  581:             field="issuingOrganization.name"
  582:             error={fieldErrors["issuingOrganization.name"]}
  583:             required
  584:           >
  585:             <input
  586:               type="text"
  587:               value={formData.issuingOrganization.name}
  588:               onChange={(event) =>
  589:                 updateNested("issuingOrganization", "name", event.target.value)
  590:               }
  591:               maxLength={CERTIFICATION_FIELD_LIMITS.issuerName}
  592:               placeholder="Example: CompTIA"
  593:               disabled={isSaving}
  594:             />
  595:           </FormField>
  596: 
  597:           <FormField
  598:             label="Issuer Type"
  599:             field="issuingOrganization.type"
  600:             error={fieldErrors["issuingOrganization.type"]}
  601:           >
  602:             <select
  603:               value={formData.issuingOrganization.type}
  604:               onChange={(event) =>
  605:                 updateNested("issuingOrganization", "type", event.target.value)
  606:               }
  607:               disabled={isSaving}
  608:             >
  609:               {CERTIFICATION_ISSUER_TYPE_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
  610:                 <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>
  611:                   {option.label}
  612:                 </option>
  613:               ))}
  614:             </select>
  615:           </FormField>
  616: 
  617:           <FormField
  618:             label="Issuer Website"
  619:             field="issuingOrganization.website"
  620:             error={fieldErrors["issuingOrganization.website"]}
  621:             wide
  622:           >
  623:             <input
  624:               type="url"
  625:               value={formData.issuingOrganization.website}
  626:               onChange={(event) =>
  627:                 updateNested(
  628:                   "issuingOrganization",
  629:                   "website",
  630:                   event.target.value,
  631:                 )
  632:               }
  633:               maxLength={CERTIFICATION_FIELD_LIMITS.issuerWebsite}
  634:               placeholder="https://www.example.com"
  635:               disabled={isSaving}
  636:             />
  637:           </FormField>
  638:         </div>
  639:       </FormSection>
  640: 
  641:       <FormSection
  642:         label="Timeline"
  643:         title="Issue, Expiration, and Renewal"
  644:         description="Record the credential lifecycle and renewal schedule."
  645:       >
  646:         <div className="certification-form-grid">
  647:           <FormField
  648:             label="Issue Date"
  649:             field="dates.issueDate"
  650:             error={fieldErrors["dates.issueDate"]}
  651:           >
  652:             <input
  653:               type="month"
  654:               value={formData.dates.issueDate}
  655:               onChange={(event) =>
  656:                 updateNested("dates", "issueDate", event.target.value)
  657:               }
  658:               disabled={isSaving}
  659:             />
  660:           </FormField>
  661: 
  662:           <FormField
  663:             label="Expiration Date"
  664:             field="dates.expirationDate"
  665:             error={fieldErrors["dates.expirationDate"]}
  666:           >
  667:             <input
  668:               type="month"
  669:               value={formData.dates.expirationDate}
  670:               onChange={(event) =>
  671:                 updateNested("dates", "expirationDate", event.target.value)
  672:               }
  673:               disabled={isSaving || formData.dates.doesNotExpire}
  674:             />
  675:           </FormField>
  676: 
  677:           <FormField
  678:             label="Last Renewed"
  679:             field="dates.lastRenewedDate"
  680:             error={fieldErrors["dates.lastRenewedDate"]}
  681:           >
  682:             <input
  683:               type="month"
  684:               value={formData.dates.lastRenewedDate}
  685:               onChange={(event) =>
  686:                 updateNested("dates", "lastRenewedDate", event.target.value)
  687:               }
  688:               disabled={isSaving}
  689:             />
  690:           </FormField>
  691: 
  692:           <FormField
  693:             label="Next Renewal"
  694:             field="dates.nextRenewalDate"
  695:             error={fieldErrors["dates.nextRenewalDate"]}
  696:           >
  697:             <input
  698:               type="month"
  699:               value={formData.dates.nextRenewalDate}
  700:               onChange={(event) =>
  701:                 updateNested("dates", "nextRenewalDate", event.target.value)
  702:               }
  703:               disabled={isSaving || formData.dates.doesNotExpire}
  704:             />
  705:           </FormField>
  706: 
  707:           <label
  708:             className="certification-form-checkbox certification-form-wide"
  709:             data-field="dates.doesNotExpire"
  710:           >
  711:             <input
  712:               type="checkbox"
  713:               checked={formData.dates.doesNotExpire}
  714:               onChange={(event) =>
  715:                 handleDoesNotExpireChange(event.target.checked)
  716:               }
  717:               disabled={isSaving}
  718:             />
  719: 
  720:             <span>This Certification does not expire</span>
  721:           </label>
  722:         </div>
  723:       </FormSection>
  724: 
  725:       <FormSection
  726:         label="Verification"
  727:         title="Credential Verification"
  728:         description="Save the credential number and public verification address."
  729:       >
  730:         <div className="certification-form-grid">
  731:           <FormField
  732:             label="Credential ID"
  733:             field="credential.credentialId"
  734:             error={fieldErrors["credential.credentialId"]}
  735:           >
  736:             <input
  737:               type="text"
  738:               value={formData.credential.credentialId}
  739:               onChange={(event) =>
  740:                 updateNested("credential", "credentialId", event.target.value)
  741:               }
  742:               maxLength={CERTIFICATION_FIELD_LIMITS.credentialId}
  743:               disabled={isSaving}
  744:             />
  745:           </FormField>
  746: 
  747:           <FormField
  748:             label="Verification URL"
  749:             field="credential.verificationUrl"
  750:             error={fieldErrors["credential.verificationUrl"]}
  751:           >
  752:             <input
  753:               type="url"
  754:               value={formData.credential.verificationUrl}
  755:               onChange={(event) =>
  756:                 updateNested(
  757:                   "credential",
  758:                   "verificationUrl",
  759:                   event.target.value,
  760:                 )
  761:               }
  762:               maxLength={CERTIFICATION_FIELD_LIMITS.verificationUrl}
  763:               placeholder="https://www.example.com/verify"
  764:               disabled={isSaving}
  765:             />
  766:           </FormField>
  767: 
  768:           <FormField
  769:             label="Description"
  770:             field="description"
  771:             error={fieldErrors.description}
  772:             wide
  773:           >
  774:             <textarea
  775:               rows={5}
  776:               value={formData.description}
  777:               onChange={(event) =>
  778:                 updateTopLevel("description", event.target.value)
  779:               }
  780:               maxLength={CERTIFICATION_FIELD_LIMITS.description}
  781:               placeholder="Describe the credential and its professional relevance."
  782:               disabled={isSaving}
  783:             />
  784:           </FormField>
  785:         </div>
  786:       </FormSection>
  787: 
  788:       <RelationshipSection
  789:         label="Training"
  790:         title="Related Training"
  791:         description="Connect Training that prepared you for or awarded this Certification."
  792:         loading={isRelationshipDataLoading}
  793:         emptyMessage="No Training records are available."
  794:       >
  795:         {trainingRecords.map((training) => {
  796:           const checked = formData.relatedRecords.trainingRelationships.some(
  797:             (relationship) => relationship.trainingId === training.id,
  798:           );
  799: 
  800:           return (
  801:             <label key={training.id} className="certification-form-option">
  802:               <input
  803:                 type="checkbox"
  804:                 checked={checked}
  805:                 onChange={(event) =>
  806:                   handleTrainingToggle(training, event.target.checked)
  807:                 }
  808:                 disabled={isSaving}
  809:               />
  810: 
  811:               <span>
  812:                 <strong>{training.title || "Untitled Training"}</strong>
  813: 
  814:                 <small>
  815:                   {training.provider?.name || "Provider not specified"}
  816:                 </small>
  817:               </span>
  818:             </label>
  819:           );
  820:         })}
  821:       </RelationshipSection>
  822: 
  823:       <RelationshipSection
  824:         label="Skills"
  825:         title="Related Skills"
  826:         description="Connect skills demonstrated or validated by this Certification."
  827:         loading={isRelationshipDataLoading}
  828:         emptyMessage="No Skill Library records are available."
  829:       >
  830:         {skills.map((skill) => {
  831:           const checked = formData.skillRelationships.some(
  832:             (relationship) => relationship.skillId === skill.id,
  833:           );
  834: 
  835:           return (
  836:             <label key={skill.id} className="certification-form-option">
  837:               <input
  838:                 type="checkbox"
  839:                 checked={checked}
  840:                 onChange={(event) =>
  841:                   handleSkillToggle(skill, event.target.checked)
  842:                 }
  843:                 disabled={isSaving}
  844:               />
  845: 
  846:               <span>
  847:                 <strong>{skill.name || "Unnamed Skill"}</strong>
  848: 
  849:                 <small>{skill.category || "Other"}</small>
  850:               </span>
  851:             </label>
  852:           );
  853:         })}
  854:       </RelationshipSection>
  855: 
  856:       <RelationshipSection
  857:         label="Education"
  858:         title="Related Education"
  859:         description="Connect Education records associated with this Certification."
  860:         loading={isRelationshipDataLoading}
  861:         emptyMessage="No Education records are available."
  862:       >
  863:         {educationRecords.map((education) => {
  864:           const checked = formData.relatedRecords.educationIds.includes(
  865:             education.id,
  866:           );
  867: 
  868:           return (
  869:             <label key={education.id} className="certification-form-option">
  870:               <input
  871:                 type="checkbox"
  872:                 checked={checked}
  873:                 onChange={(event) =>
  874:                   handleEducationToggle(education, event.target.checked)
  875:                 }
  876:                 disabled={isSaving}
  877:               />
  878: 
  879:               <span>
  880:                 <strong>
  881:                   {education.credential?.name || "Unnamed Credential"}
  882:                 </strong>
  883: 
  884:                 <small>
  885:                   {education.institution?.name || "Institution not specified"}
  886:                 </small>
  887:               </span>
  888:             </label>
  889:           );
  890:         })}
  891:       </RelationshipSection>
  892: 
  893:       <FormSection
  894:         label="Documents"
  895:         title="Certificate Documents"
  896:         description="Upload PDF, Word, JPG, JPEG, PNG, or WebP files. The primary document appears on the Certification item."
  897:       >
  898:         <label className="certification-form-upload">
  899:           <input
  900:             type="file"
  901:             multiple
  902:             accept={CERTIFICATION_DOCUMENT_ACCEPT}
  903:             onChange={handleDocumentSelection}
  904:             disabled={isSaving}
  905:           />
  906: 
  907:           <span>
  908:             <strong>Select certificate documents</strong>
  909: 
  910:             <small>
  911:               Maximum 10 MB per file and{" "}
  912:               {CERTIFICATION_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumSupportingDocuments} documents
  913:               per Certification
  914:             </small>
  915:           </span>
  916:         </label>
  917: 
  918:         {documentError && (
  919:           <p className="certification-form-document-error" role="alert">
  920:             {documentError}
  921:           </p>
  922:         )}
  923: 
  924:         {(formData.supportingDocuments.length > 0 ||
  925:           documentUploads.length > 0) && (
  926:           <div className="certification-form-document-list">
  927:             {formData.supportingDocuments.map((certificationDocument) => (
  928:               <div key={certificationDocument.id}>
  929:                 <label>
  930:                   <input
  931:                     type="radio"
  932:                     name="primary-certificate-document"

   17:       label: item,

   28:

   30:       typeof source.label === "string" && source.label.trim()
   31:         ? source.label.trim()
   32:         : "Professional information",

   35:       typeof source.description === "string" ? source.description.trim() : "",
   36:

   43: function clampPercentage(value) {
   44:   const numericValue = Number(value);
   45: 
   46:   if (!Number.isFinite(numericValue)) {
   47:     return 0;
   48:   }
   49: 
   50:   return Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Math.round(numericValue)));
   51: }

   59: function ProfileCompletion({
   60:   percentage,
   61:   completedItems = [],
   62:   remainingItems = [],
   63:   isLoading = false,
   64: }) {

   66:     Array.isArray(completedItems) ? completedItems : []

   68:

   70:     Array.isArray(remainingItems) ? remainingItems : []
   71:   ).map((item, index) => normalizeCompletionItem(item, index, false));

   73:   const completedCount = normalizedCompletedItems.length;
   74: 
   75:   const remainingCount = normalizedRemainingItems.length;
   76: 
   77:   const totalItems = completedCount + remainingCount;
   78: 
   79:   const calculatedPercentage =
   80:     totalItems > 0 ? Math.round((completedCount / totalItems) * 100) : 0;
   81: 
   82:   const completionPercentage = clampPercentage(
   83:     typeof percentage === "number" ? percentage : calculatedPercentage,
   84:   );
   85: 
   86:   const isComplete =
   87:     totalItems > 0 && remainingCount === 0 && completionPercentage === 100;
   88: 
   89:   const nextRecommendedItem =
   90:     normalizedRemainingItems.find((item) => item.href) ||
   91:     normalizedRemainingItems[0] ||
   92:     null;
   93: 
   94:   const allItems = [...normalizedRemainingItems, ...normalizedCompletedItems];
   95: 
   96:   return (
   97:     <article className="profile-completion dashboard-card">
   98:       <header className="dashboard-card-header">

  100:           <span className="dashboard-card-eyebrow">Professional Readiness</span>

  102:           <h3>Profile Completion</h3>
  103:         </div>

  107:             isComplete ? "completion-percentage--complete" : ""

  111:         </span>

  124:             isComplete ? "completion-progress-bar--complete" : ""
  125:           }`}

  127:             width: `${completionPercentage}%`,
  128:           }}
  129:         />
  130:       </div>
  131:

  133:         <p className="dashboard-card-description">

  136:             : "Complete the remaining professional records to strengthen your portfolio and rÃ©sumÃ© content."}

   12: function getText(value) {
   13:   return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
   14: }
   15: 
   16: function formatUpdatedDate(value) {
   17:   const timestamp = new Date(value || "").getTime();
   18: 
   19:   if (!Number.isFinite(timestamp)) {
   20:     return "Not published yet";
   21:   }
   22: 
   23:   try {
   24:     return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, {
   25:       month: "short",
   26:       day: "numeric",
   27:       year: "numeric",
   28:     }).format(new Date(timestamp));
   29:   } catch {
   30:     return "Recently updated";
   31:   }
   32: }
   33: 
   34: function getPlatformOrigin(platformUrl) {
   35:   const suppliedUrl = getText(platformUrl);
   36: 
   37:   if (suppliedUrl) {
   38:     return suppliedUrl.startsWith("http://") ||
   39:       suppliedUrl.startsWith("https://")
   40:       ? suppliedUrl.replace(/\/+$/, "")
   41:       : `https://${suppliedUrl.replace(/\/+$/, "")}`;
   42:   }
   43: 
   44:   if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
   45:     return window.location.origin;
   46:   }
   47: 
   48:   return "";
   49: }

   56: 
   57: function PublicPortfolioCard({
   58:   username = "",
   59:   portfolioSlug = "",
   60:   portfolioName = "Professional Portfolio",
   61:   isLive = false,
   62:   updatedAt = "",
   63:   projectCount = 0,
   64:   resumeCount = 0,
   65:   platformUrl = "",
   66:   isLoading = false,
   67: }) {
   68:   const [copyStatus, setCopyStatus] = useState("idle");
   69: 
   70:   const copyTimeoutRef = useRef(null);
   71: 
   72:   const normalizedUsername = getText(username);
   73: 
   74:   const normalizedSlug = getText(portfolioSlug);
   75: 
   76:   const hasPortfolioIdentity = Boolean(normalizedUsername && normalizedSlug);
   77: 
   78:   const portfolioPath = hasPortfolioIdentity
   79:     ? `/portfolio/${encodeURIComponent(
   80:         normalizedUsername,
   81:       )}/${encodeURIComponent(normalizedSlug)}`
   82:     : "";
   83: 
   84:   const portfolioUrl = useMemo(() => {
   85:     if (!portfolioPath) {
   86:       return "";
   87:     }
   88: 
   89:     const origin = getPlatformOrigin(platformUrl);
   90: 
   91:     return origin ? `${origin}${portfolioPath}` : portfolioPath;
   92:   }, [platformUrl, portfolioPath]);
   93: 
   94:   const canOpenPortfolio = isLive && hasPortfolioIdentity && !isLoading;
   95: 
   96:   const publishedDate = formatUpdatedDate(updatedAt);
   97: 
   98:   /*
   99:    * =========================================
  100:    * Clear Copy Timer
  101:    * =========================================
  102:    */
  103: 
  104:   useEffect(
  105:     () => () => {
  106:       if (copyTimeoutRef.current) {
  107:         window.clearTimeout(copyTimeoutRef.current);
  108:       }
  109:     },
  110:     [],
  111:   );
  112: 
  113:   /*
  114:    * =========================================
  115:    * Copy Portfolio URL
  116:    * =========================================
  117:    */
  118: 
  119:   const handleCopy = async () => {
  120:     if (!portfolioUrl || !canOpenPortfolio) {
  121:       return;
  122:     }
  123: 
  124:     try {
  125:       if (typeof navigator === "undefined" || !navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
  126:         throw new Error("Clipboard access is unavailable.");
  127:       }
  128: 
  129:       await navigator.clipboard.writeText(portfolioUrl);
  130: 
  131:       setCopyStatus("copied");
  132: 
  133:       if (copyTimeoutRef.current) {
  134:         window.clearTimeout(copyTimeoutRef.current);
  135:       }
  136: 
  137:       copyTimeoutRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
  138:         setCopyStatus("idle");
  139:       }, 2000);
  140:     } catch (error) {
  141:       console.error("Unable to copy portfolio URL:", error);
  142: 
  143:       setCopyStatus("error");
  144: 
  145:       if (copyTimeoutRef.current) {
  146:         window.clearTimeout(copyTimeoutRef.current);
  147:       }
  148: 
  149:       copyTimeoutRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
  150:         setCopyStatus("idle");
  151:       }, 2500);
  152:     }
  153:   };
  154: 
  155:   /*
  156:    * =========================================
  157:    * Render
  158:    * =========================================
  159:    */
  160: 
  161:   return (
  162:     <article className="public-portfolio-card dashboard-card">
  163:       <header className="dashboard-card-header">
  164:         <div>
  165:           <span className="dashboard-card-eyebrow">Public Presence</span>
  166: 
  167:           <h3>Your Portfolio</h3>
  168:         </div>
  169: 
  170:         <span
  171:           className={`portfolio-status ${
  172:             isLive ? "portfolio-status--live" : "portfolio-status--offline"
  173:           }`}
  174:         >
  175:           <span className="portfolio-status-dot" aria-hidden="true" />
  176: 
  177:           {isLoading ? "Loading" : isLive ? "Published" : "Draft"}
  178:         </span>
  179:       </header>
  180: 
  181:       <p className="dashboard-card-description">
  182:         {isLive

  184:           : "Complete and publish your portfolio to create a shareable professional presence."}
  185:       </p>

   10: 
   11: function getTimestamp(value) {
   12:   const timestamp = new Date(value || "").getTime();
   13: 
   14:   return Number.isFinite(timestamp) ? timestamp : 0;
   15: }
   16: 
   17: function formatRelativeTime(value) {
   18:   const timestamp = getTimestamp(value);
   19: 
   20:   if (!timestamp) {
   21:     return "Date unavailable";
   22:   }
   23: 
   24:   const difference = Date.now() - timestamp;
   25: 
   26:   if (difference < 0) {
   27:     return "Recently";
   28:   }
   29: 
   30:   const minute = 60 * 1000;
   31:   const hour = 60 * minute;
   32:   const day = 24 * hour;
   33:   const week = 7 * day;
   34: 
   35:   if (difference < minute) {
   36:     return "Just now";
   37:   }
   38: 
   39:   if (difference < hour) {
   40:     const minutes = Math.floor(difference / minute);
   41: 
   42:     return `${minutes} ${minutes === 1 ? "minute" : "minutes"} ago`;
   43:   }
   44: 
   45:   if (difference < day) {
   46:     const hours = Math.floor(difference / hour);
   47: 
   48:     return `${hours} ${hours === 1 ? "hour" : "hours"} ago`;
   49:   }
   50: 
   51:   if (difference < week) {
   52:     const days = Math.floor(difference / day);
   53: 
   54:     return `${days} ${days === 1 ? "day" : "days"} ago`;
   55:   }
   56: 
   57:   try {
   58:     return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, {
   59:       month: "short",
   60:       day: "numeric",
   61:       year: "numeric",
   62:     }).format(new Date(timestamp));
   63:   } catch {
   64:     return "Recently";
   65:   }
   66: }
   67: 
   68: function formatExactDate(value) {
   69:   const timestamp = getTimestamp(value);
   70: 
   71:   if (!timestamp) {
   72:     return "";
   73:   }
   74: 
   75:   try {
   76:     return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, {
   77:       dateStyle: "medium",
   78:       timeStyle: "short",
   79:     }).format(new Date(timestamp));
   80:   } catch {
   81:     return "";
   82:   }
   83: }
   84:

  104:

  106:     time || formatRelativeTime(activityDate);

  109:

   37:   return documents.map((document, index) => ({
   38:     ...document,
   39:     order: index,
   40:   }));
   41: }
   42: 
   43: /*
   44:  * =========================================
   45:  * Education Document Editor

   49: function EducationDocumentEditor({
   50:   educationId,

   52:   fieldErrors = {},
   53:   disabled = false,
   54:   onChange,

   56:   const sectionTitleId = useId();
   57:   const fileInputId = useId();

   60:   const visibilitySelectId = useId();

   81:   const orderedDocuments = useMemo(

   85:       ),

   88: 
   89:   const maximumDocuments = DOCUMENT_FILE_LIMITS.maximumDocumentsPerRecord;
   90:

   92:

  129:       );

  132:

  134:     }

  139:       const nameWithoutExtension = file.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "");
  140:

  142:     }
  143:   };
  144: 
  145:   /*
  146:    * =========================================
  147:    * Upload
  148:    * =========================================
  149:    */
  150: 
  151:   const handleAddDocument = async () => {
  152:     setEditorError("");
  153: 
  154:     if (hasReachedMaximum) {
  155:       setEditorError(
  156:         `Add no more than ${maximumDocuments} supporting documents.`,
  157:       );
  158: 
  159:       return;
  160:     }

  163:       setEditorError("Select a document to upload.");
  164: 
  165:       return;
  166:     }

  172:

  177:       setEditorError(
  178:         `Document name cannot exceed ${DOCUMENT_FILE_LIMITS.documentName} characters.`,
  179:       );
  180: 
  181:       return;
  182:     }
  183:

  185:       setEditorError(
  186:         `Document description cannot exceed ${DOCUMENT_FILE_LIMITS.description} characters.`,
  187:       );
  188: 
  189:       return;

  193:       (document) =>
  194:         document.fileName?.trim().toLocaleLowerCase() ===
  195:         selectedFile.name.trim().toLocaleLowerCase(),
  196:     );
  197: 
  198:     if (duplicateFile) {
  199:       setEditorError("A document with this file name has already been added.");
  200:

  260:     if (document.fileUrl) {
  261:       return {
  262:         url: document.fileUrl,
  263:         temporary: false,
  264:       };

   90:         return current;

  117:   };

  108:           (relationship) => relationship.id !== relationshipId,

   15: function normalizeAchievementOrder(achievements) {
   16:   return achievements.map((achievement, index) => ({
   17:     ...achievement,
   18:     order: index,
   19:   }));
   20: }
   21: 
   22: function getAchievementText(achievement) {
   23:   if (typeof achievement === "string") {
   24:     return achievement.trim();
   25:   }
   26: 
   27:   return achievement?.text?.trim() || "";
   28: }
   29: 
   30: /*
   31:  * =========================================
   32:  * Achievement Editor
   33:  * =========================================
   34:  */
   35: 
   36: function AchievementEditor({
   37:   achievements = [],
   38:   fieldErrors = {},
   39:   disabled = false,
   40:   onChange,
   41: }) {
   42:   const sectionTitleId = useId();
   43:   const textId = useId();
   44:   const metricId = useId();
   45: 
   46:   const [draftText, setDraftText] = useState("");
   47: 
   48:   const [draftMetric, setDraftMetric] = useState("");
   49: 
   50:   const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState(null);
   51: 
   52:   const [editorError, setEditorError] = useState("");
   53: 
   54:   const isEditing = Boolean(editingId);
   55: 
   56:   const maximumItems = EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumAchievements;
   57: 
   58:   const maximumTextLength = EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS.achievementText;
   59: 
   60:   const maximumMetricLength = EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS.achievementMetric;
   61: 
   62:   const hasReachedMaximum = achievements.length >= maximumItems;
   63: 
   64:   /*
   65:    * =========================================
   66:    * Ordered Achievements
   67:    * =========================================
   68:    */
   69: 
   70:   const orderedAchievements = useMemo(
   71:     () =>
   72:       [...achievements].sort(
   73:         (first, second) => (first.order ?? 0) - (second.order ?? 0),
   74:       ),
   75:     [achievements],
   76:   );
   77: 
   78:   /*
   79:    * =========================================
   80:    * Reset Editor
   81:    * =========================================
   82:    */
   83: 
   84:   const resetEditor = () => {
   85:     setDraftText("");
   86:     setDraftMetric("");
   87:     setEditingId(null);
   88:     setEditorError("");
   89:   };
   90: 
   91:   /*
   92:    * =========================================
   93:    * Duplicate Check
   94:    * =========================================
   95:    */
   96: 
   97:   const isDuplicateAchievement = (text) => {
   98:     const normalizedText = text.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
   99: 
  100:     return achievements.some((achievement) => {
  101:       if (achievement.id === editingId) {
  102:         return false;
  103:       }
  104: 
  105:       return (
  106:         getAchievementText(achievement).toLocaleLowerCase() === normalizedText
  107:       );
  108:     });
  109:   };
  110: 
  111:   /*
  112:    * =========================================
  113:    * Add or Update
  114:    * =========================================
  115:    */
  116: 
  117:   const handleSaveAchievement = () => {
  118:     const normalizedText = draftText.trim();
  119: 
  120:     const normalizedMetric = draftMetric.trim();
  121: 
  122:     if (!normalizedText) {
  123:       setEditorError("Enter an achievement before adding it.");
  124: 
  125:       return;
  126:     }
  127: 
  128:     if (normalizedText.length > maximumTextLength) {
  129:       setEditorError(
  130:         `An achievement cannot exceed ${maximumTextLength} characters.`,
  131:       );
  132: 
  133:       return;
  134:     }
  135: 
  136:     if (normalizedMetric.length > maximumMetricLength) {
  137:       setEditorError(
  138:         `The measurable result cannot exceed ${maximumMetricLength} characters.`,
  139:       );
  140: 
  141:       return;
  142:     }
  143: 
  144:     if (!isEditing && hasReachedMaximum) {
  145:       setEditorError(`You can add no more than ${maximumItems} achievements.`);
  146: 
  147:       return;
  148:     }
  149: 
  150:     if (isDuplicateAchievement(normalizedText)) {
  151:       setEditorError("This achievement has already been added.");
  152: 
  153:       return;
  154:     }
  155: 
  156:     if (isEditing) {
  157:       const updatedAchievements = achievements.map((achievement) =>
  158:         achievement.id === editingId
  159:           ? {
  160:               ...achievement,
  161:               text: normalizedText,
  162:               metric: normalizedMetric,
  163:             }
  164:           : achievement,
  165:       );
  166: 
  167:       onChange?.(normalizeAchievementOrder(updatedAchievements));
  168:     } else {
  169:       const newAchievement = createAchievement({
  170:         text: normalizedText,
  171:         metric: normalizedMetric,
  172:         order: achievements.length,
  173:       });
  174: 
  175:       onChange?.(normalizeAchievementOrder([...achievements, newAchievement]));
  176:     }
  177: 
  178:     resetEditor();
  179:   };
  180: 
  181:   /*
  182:    * =========================================
  183:    * Edit
  184:    * =========================================
  185:    */
  186: 
  187:   const handleEdit = (achievement) => {
  188:     setEditingId(achievement.id);
  189:     setDraftText(achievement.text || "");
  190:     setDraftMetric(achievement.metric || "");
  191:     setEditorError("");
  192:   };
  193: 
  194:   /*
  195:    * =========================================
  196:    * Remove
  197:    * =========================================
  198:    */
  199: 
  200:   const handleRemove = (achievementId) => {
  201:     const remainingAchievements = achievements.filter(
  202:       (achievement) => achievement.id !== achievementId,
  203:     );
  204: 
  205:     onChange?.(normalizeAchievementOrder(remainingAchievements));
  206: 
  207:     if (editingId === achievementId) {

  218:   const handleMove = (achievementId, direction) => {
  219:     const currentIndex = orderedAchievements.findIndex(
  220:       (achievement) => achievement.id === achievementId,
  221:     );
  222: 
  223:     if (currentIndex === -1) {
  224:       return;
  225:     }
  226: 
  227:     const targetIndex =
  228:       direction === "up" ? currentIndex - 1 : currentIndex + 1;
  229: 
  230:     if (targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex >= orderedAchievements.length) {
  231:       return;
  232:     }
  233: 
  234:     const reorderedAchievements = [...orderedAchievements];
  235: 
  236:     const [movedAchievement] = reorderedAchievements.splice(currentIndex, 1);
  237: 
  238:     reorderedAchievements.splice(targetIndex, 0, movedAchievement);
  239: 
  240:     onChange?.(normalizeAchievementOrder(reorderedAchievements));
  241:   };

    9: function getText(value) {
   10:   return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
   11: }

   13: function formatOptionValue(value) {
   14:   return getText(value)
   15:     .split("-")
   16:     .filter(Boolean)
   17:     .map((part) => part.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + part.slice(1))
   18:     .join(" ");

   20: 
   21: function formatMonthYear(value) {
   22:   if (!value || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}$/.test(value)) {
   23:     return "";
   24:   }
   25: 
   26:   const [year, month] = value.split("-").map(Number);
   27: 
   28:   const date = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, 1));
   29: 
   30:   return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, {
   31:     month: "short",
   32:     year: "numeric",
   33:     timeZone: "UTC",
   34:   }).format(date);
   35: }
   36:

   49: }

    1: import { useEffect, useId, useState } from "react";
    2: 
    3: import {
    4:   EMPLOYMENT_TYPE_OPTIONS,
    5:   EXPERIENCE_CATEGORY_OPTIONS,
    6:   EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS,

    8:   WORK_ARRANGEMENT_OPTIONS,
    9: } from "../../../../config/experienceConfig.js";
   10: 
   11: import {
   12:   createEmptyExperience,
   13:   normalizeExperience,
   14: } from "../../../../models/experienceModel.js";
   15: 
   16: import { validateExperience } from "../../../../services/Experience/experienceValidation.js";
   17: 
   18: import ResponsibilityEditor from "../ResponsibilityEditor/ResponsibilityEditor.jsx";
   19: import AchievementEditor from "../AchievementEditor/AchievementEditor.jsx";

   25: 
   26: /*
   27:  * =========================================
   28:  * Form Data Creation
   29:  * =========================================
   30:  */
   31: 
   32: function createFormData(initialExperience) {
   33:   return initialExperience
   34:     ? normalizeExperience(initialExperience)
   35:     : createEmptyExperience();
   36: }
   37: 
   38: /*
   39:  * =========================================
   40:  * Experience Form
   41:  * =========================================
   42:  */
   43: 
   44: function ExperienceForm({
   45:   initialExperience = null,
   46:   isSaving = false,
   47:   onSubmit,
   48:   onCancel,
   49: }) {
   50:   const formId = useId();
   51: 
   52:   const [formData, setFormData] = useState(() =>
   53:     createFormData(initialExperience),
   54:   );
   55: 
   56:   const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState({});
   57: 
   58:   const [warnings, setWarnings] = useState([]);
   59: 
   60:   const [submissionError, setSubmissionError] = useState("");
   61: 
   62:   const isEditing = Boolean(initialExperience?.id);
   63: 
   64:   /*
   65:    * =========================================
   66:    * Synchronize Editing Record
   67:    * =========================================
   68:    */
   69: 
   70:   useEffect(() => {
   71:     setFormData(createFormData(initialExperience));
   72: 
   73:     setFieldErrors({});
   74:     setWarnings([]);
   75:     setSubmissionError("");
   76:   }, [initialExperience]);
   77: 
   78:   /*
   79:    * =========================================
   80:    * Error Management
   81:    * =========================================
   82:    */
   83: 
   84:   const clearFieldError = (fieldName) => {
   85:     setFieldErrors((currentErrors) => {
   86:       if (!currentErrors[fieldName]) {
   87:         return currentErrors;
   88:       }
   89: 
   90:       const nextErrors = {
   91:         ...currentErrors,
   92:       };
   93: 
   94:       delete nextErrors[fieldName];
   95: 
   96:       return nextErrors;
   97:     });
   98: 
   99:     setSubmissionError("");
  100:   };
  101: 
  102:   /*
  103:    * =========================================
  104:    * Top-Level Field Update
  105:    * =========================================
  106:    */
  107: 
  108:   const updateTopLevelField = (fieldName, value) => {
  109:     setFormData((currentData) => ({
  110:       ...currentData,
  111:       [fieldName]: value,
  112:     }));
  113: 
  114:     clearFieldError(fieldName);
  115:   };
  116: 
  117:   /*
  118:    * =========================================
  119:    * Nested Field Update
  120:    * =========================================
  121:    */
  122: 
  123:   const updateNestedField = (sectionName, fieldName, value) => {
  124:     setFormData((currentData) => ({
  125:       ...currentData,
  126: 
  127:       [sectionName]: {
  128:         ...currentData[sectionName],
  129:         [fieldName]: value,
  130:       },
  131:     }));
  132: 
  133:     clearFieldError(`${sectionName}.${fieldName}`);
  134:   };
  135: 
  136:   /*
  137:    * =========================================
  138:    * Current Position
  139:    * =========================================
  140:    */
  141: 
  142:   const handleCurrentPositionChange = (event) => {
  143:     const { checked } = event.target;
  144: 
  145:     setFormData((currentData) => ({
  146:       ...currentData,
  147: 
  148:       dates: {
  149:         ...currentData.dates,
  150:         isCurrent: checked,
  151: 
  152:         /*
  153:          * A current position cannot have an
  154:          * end date.
  155:          */
  156: 
  157:         endDate: checked ? "" : currentData.dates.endDate,
  158:       },
  159:     }));
  160: 
  161:     clearFieldError("dates.isCurrent");
  162:     clearFieldError("dates.endDate");
  163:   };
  164: 
  165:   /*
  166:    * =========================================
  167:    * Leadership Toggle
  168:    * =========================================
  169:    */
  170: 
  171:   const handleLeadershipChange = (event) => {
  172:     const { checked } = event.target;
  173: 
  174:     setFormData((currentData) => ({
  175:       ...currentData,
  176: 
  177:       leadership: {
  178:         ...currentData.leadership,
  179: 
  180:         hasLeadershipResponsibilities: checked,
  181:       },
  182:     }));
  183: 
  184:     clearFieldError("leadership.hasLeadershipResponsibilities");
  185:   };
  186: 
  187:   /*
  188:    * =========================================
  189:    * Collection Update
  190:    * =========================================
  191:    */
  192: 
  193:   const updateCollectionField = (fieldName, values) => {
  194:     setFormData((currentData) => ({
  195:       ...currentData,
  196:       [fieldName]: values,
  197:     }));
  198: 
  199:     setFieldErrors((currentErrors) => {
  200:       const nextErrors = {};
  201: 
  202:       Object.entries(currentErrors).forEach(([errorField, message]) => {
  203:         if (
  204:           errorField !== fieldName &&
  205:           !errorField.startsWith(`${fieldName}.`)
  206:         ) {
  207:           nextErrors[errorField] = message;
  208:         }
  209:       });
  210: 
  211:       return nextErrors;
  212:     });
  213: 
  214:     setSubmissionError("");
  215:   };
  216: 
  217:   /*
  218:    * =========================================
  219:    * Form Submission
  220:    * =========================================
  221:    */
  222: 
  223:   const handleSubmit = async (event) => {
  224:     event.preventDefault();
  225: 
  226:     setSubmissionError("");
  227: 
  228:     const validationResult = validateExperience(formData);
  229: 
  230:     setFieldErrors(validationResult.fieldErrors);
  231: 
  232:     setWarnings(validationResult.warnings);
  233: 
  234:     if (!validationResult.isValid) {
  235:       setSubmissionError(
  236:         `${validationResult.errors.length} ${
  237:           validationResult.errors.length === 1
  238:             ? "problem must"
  239:             : "problems must"
  240:         } be corrected before saving.`,
  241:       );
  242: 
  243:       return;
  244:     }
  245: 
  246:     try {
  247:       await onSubmit?.(formData);
  248:     } catch (error) {
  249:       const serviceFieldErrors =
  250:         error?.fieldErrors || error?.validation?.fieldErrors || {};
  251: 
  252:       setFieldErrors(serviceFieldErrors);
  253: 
  254:       setSubmissionError(
  255:         error?.publicMessage ||
  256:           error?.message ||
  257:           "The experience could not be saved.",
  258:       );
  259:     }
  260:   };
  261: 
  262:   /*
  263:    * =========================================
  264:    * Form IDs
  265:    * =========================================
  266:    */
  267: 
  268:   const getFieldId = (fieldName) => `${formId}-${fieldName}`;
  269: 
  270:   const handleOverviewUpdate = ({ overview, overviewMeta }) => {
  271:     setFormData((currentData) => ({
  272:       ...currentData,
  273:       overview,
  274:       overviewMeta,

  295:     setSubmissionError("");
  296:   };
  297: 
  298:   return (
  299:     <form className="experience-form" onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate>
  300:       {/* =====================================
  301:           Role and Organization

  332:           >

  338:                 updateNestedField("position", "title", event.target.value)
