 1054:  * =========================================
 1055:  * Form Field
 1056:  * =========================================
 1057:  */
 1058: 
 1059: function FormField({
 1060:   id,
 1061:   label,
 1062:   required = false,
 1063:   error = "",
 1064:   help = "",
 1065:   count = "",
 1066:   className = "",
 1067:   children,
 1068: }) {
 1069:   return (
 1070:     <div
 1071:       className={`experience-form-field ${className} ${
 1072:         error ? "experience-form-field--error" : ""
 1073:       }`}
 1074:     >
 1075:       <div className="experience-form-label-row">
 1076:         <label htmlFor={id}>
 1077:           {label}
 1078: 
 1079:           {required && <span aria-hidden="true">*</span>}
 1080:         </label>
 1081: 
 1082:         {count && <small>{count}</small>}
 1083:       </div>
 1084: 
 1085:       {children}
 1086: 
 1087:       {help && !error && <small className="experience-form-help">{help}</small>}
 1088: 
 1089:       {error && (
 1090:         <p className="experience-form-field-error" role="alert">
 1091:           {error}
 1092:         </p>
 1093:       )}
 1094:     </div>
 1095:   );
 1096: }

 1114:         <strong>{label}</strong>
 1115: 
 1116:         <small>{description}</small>
 1117:       </span>

   50: function getTechnologyName(technology) {
   51:   if (typeof technology === "string") {
   52:     return technology.trim();
   53:   }
   54: 
   55:   return String(
   56:     technology?.nameSnapshot ||
   57:       technology?.name ||
   58:       technology?.label ||
   59:       technology?.value ||
   60:       "",
   61:   ).trim();
   62: }
   63: 
   64: function normalizeTechnologyRelationship(technology, index) {
   65:   if (typeof technology === "string") {
   66:     return {
   67:       id: `legacy-technology-${index}`,
   68:       skillId: "",
   69:       nameSnapshot: technology.trim(),
   70:       name: technology.trim(),
   71:       category: "",
   72:       proficiency: "",
   73:       usageDescription: "",
   74:       order: index,
   75:     };
   76:   }
   77: 
   78:   const name = getTechnologyName(technology);
   79: 
   80:   return {
   81:     id: technology?.id || `technology-${index}`,
   82:     skillId: technology?.skillId || technology?.profileSkillId || "",
   83:     nameSnapshot: technology?.nameSnapshot || name,
   84:     name,
   85:     category: technology?.category || "",
   86:     proficiency: technology?.proficiency || technology?.level || "",
   87:     usageDescription:
   88:       technology?.usageDescription || technology?.description || "",
   89:     order: Number.isFinite(Number(technology?.order))
   90:       ? Number(technology.order)
   91:       : index,
   92:   };
   93: }
   94: 
   95: function getLibrarySkillCategory(skill) {
   96:   return skill?.category || skill?.type || "";
   97: }
   98: 
   99: /*
  100:  * =========================================
  101:  * Technology Editor
  102:  * =========================================
  103:  */
  104: 
  105: function ExperienceTechnologyEditor({
  106:   technologies = [],
  107:   fieldError = "",
  108:   disabled = false,
  109:   onChange,
  110: }) {
  111:   const { activeSkills = [], findOrCreateSkill } = useSkillData();
  112: 
  113:   const [editor, setEditor] = useState(EMPTY_EDITOR);
  114:   const [editingRelationshipId, setEditingRelationshipId] = useState("");
  115:   const [searchValue, setSearchValue] = useState("");
  116:   const [editorError, setEditorError] = useState("");
  117:   const [isSavingTechnology, setIsSavingTechnology] = useState(false);
  118: 
  119:   /*
  120:    * =========================================
  121:    * Normalized Relationships
  122:    * =========================================
  123:    */
  124: 
  125:   const normalizedTechnologies = useMemo(
  126:     () =>
  127:       (technologies || [])
  128:         .map(normalizeTechnologyRelationship)
  129:         .filter((technology) => technology.nameSnapshot)
  130:         .sort((first, second) => first.order - second.order),
  131:     [technologies],
  132:   );
  133: 
  134:   const selectedNames = useMemo(
  135:     () =>
  136:       new Set(
  137:         normalizedTechnologies.map((technology) =>
  138:           normalizeName(technology.nameSnapshot),
  139:         ),
  140:       ),
  141:     [normalizedTechnologies],
  142:   );
  143: 
  144:   /*
  145:    * =========================================
  146:    * Library Search
  147:    * =========================================
  148:    */
  149: 
  150:   const matchingLibrarySkills = useMemo(() => {
  151:     const normalizedSearch = normalizeName(searchValue);
  152: 
  153:     return activeSkills
  154:       .filter((skill) => {
  155:         if (!skill?.name) {
  156:           return false;
  157:         }
  158: 
  159:         if (!normalizedSearch) {
  160:           return true;
  161:         }
  162: 
  163:         const searchableValue = [
  164:           skill.name,
  165:           skill.category,
  166:           skill.type,
  167:           ...(skill.aliases || []),
  168:         ]
  169:           .filter(Boolean)
  170:           .join(" ")
  171:           .toLocaleLowerCase();
  172: 
  173:         return searchableValue.includes(normalizedSearch);
  174:       })
  175:       .sort((first, second) => first.name.localeCompare(second.name))
  176:       .slice(0, 25);
  177:   }, [activeSkills, searchValue]);
  178: 
  179:   /*
  180:    * =========================================
  181:    * Editor State
  182:    * =========================================
  183:    */
  184: 
  185:   const updateEditor = (updates) => {
  186:     setEditor((currentEditor) => ({
  187:       ...currentEditor,
  188:       ...updates,
  189:     }));
  190: 
  191:     setEditorError("");
  192:   };
  193: 
  194:   const resetEditor = () => {
  195:     setEditor(EMPTY_EDITOR);
  196:     setEditingRelationshipId("");
  197:     setSearchValue("");
  198:     setEditorError("");
  199:   };
  200: 
  201:   /*
  202:    * =========================================
  203:    * Select Library Skill
  204:    * =========================================
  205:    */
  206: 
  207:   const handleLibrarySelection = (event) => {
  208:     const skillId = event.target.value;
  209: 
  210:     if (!skillId) {
  211:       updateEditor({
  212:         selectedSkillId: "",
  213:         name: "",
  214:         category: "",
  215:       });
  216: 
  217:       return;
  218:     }
  219: 
  220:     const selectedSkill = activeSkills.find((skill) => skill.id === skillId);
  221: 
  222:     if (!selectedSkill) {
  223:       setEditorError("The selected Skill Library item could not be found.");
  224: 
  225:       return;
  226:     }
  227: 
  228:     updateEditor({
  229:       selectedSkillId: selectedSkill.id,
  230:       name: selectedSkill.name,
  231:       category: getLibrarySkillCategory(selectedSkill),
  232:     });
  233:   };
  234: 
  235:   /*
  236:    * =========================================
  237:    * Duplicate Detection
  238:    * =========================================
  239:    */
  240: 
  241:   const isDuplicateTechnology = (name, skillId = "") => {
  242:     const normalizedCandidateName = normalizeName(name);
  243: 
  244:     return normalizedTechnologies.some((technology) => {
  245:       if (technology.id === editingRelationshipId) {
  246:         return false;
  247:       }
  248: 
  249:       if (skillId && technology.skillId && technology.skillId === skillId) {
  250:         return true;
  251:       }
  252: 
  253:       return normalizeName(technology.nameSnapshot) === normalizedCandidateName;
  254:     });
  255:   };
  256: 
  257:   /*
  258:    * =========================================
  259:    * Add or Update Technology
  260:    * =========================================
  261:    */
  262: 
  263:   const handleSaveTechnology = async () => {
  264:     if (disabled || isSavingTechnology) {
  265:       return;
  266:     }
  267: 
  268:     const technologyName = editor.name.trim();
  269: 
  270:     if (!technologyName) {
  271:       setEditorError("Select a Skill Library item or enter a technology name.");
  272: 
  273:       return;
  274:     }
  275: 
  276:     if (isDuplicateTechnology(technologyName, editor.selectedSkillId)) {
  277:       setEditorError(
  278:         "This technology has already been added to the experience.",
  279:       );
  280: 
  281:       return;
  282:     }
  283: 
  284:     try {
  285:       setIsSavingTechnology(true);
  286:       setEditorError("");
  287: 
  288:       let librarySkill = activeSkills.find(
  289:         (skill) => skill.id === editor.selectedSkillId,
  290:       );
  291: 
  292:       /*
  293:        * A manually entered technology is saved in the
  294:        * central Skill Library before being attached to
  295:        * this experience.
  296:        */
  297: 
  298:       if (!librarySkill) {
  299:         const skillResult = await findOrCreateSkill({
  300:           name: technologyName,
  301: 
  302:           category: editor.category || "tools-platforms",
  303: 
  304:           type: "tool",
  305: 
  306:           proficiency: {
  307:             level: editor.proficiency || "",
  308:             yearsOfExperience: null,
  309:             lastUsedDate: "",
  310:           },
  311: 
  312:           language: {
  313:             proficiency: "",
  314:           },
  315: 
  316:           description: editor.usageDescription.trim(),
  317: 
  318:           aliases: [],
  319: 
  320:           source: "manual",
  321: 
  322:           sourceContext: "experience-technology-editor",
  323: 
  324:           notes: "",
  325: 
  326:           status: "active",
  327:         });
  328: 
  329:         librarySkill = skillResult?.skill || skillResult;
  330:       }
  331: 
  332:       const savedSkill = librarySkill;
  333: 
  334:       if (!savedSkill?.id) {
  335:         throw new Error(
  336:           "The technology could not be saved in the Skill Library.",
  337:         );
  338:       }
  339: 
  340:       const relationship = {
  341:         id: editingRelationshipId || createRelationshipId(),
  342: 
  343:         skillId: savedSkill.id,
  344: 
  345:         /*
  346:          * The snapshot keeps the experience readable
  347:          * if the library item is renamed or unavailable.
  348:          */
  349: 
  350:         nameSnapshot: savedSkill.name || technologyName,
  351: 
  352:         name: savedSkill.name || technologyName,
  353: 
  354:         category: editor.category || getLibrarySkillCategory(savedSkill) || "",
  355: 
  356:         proficiency: editor.proficiency,
  357: 
  358:         usageDescription: editor.usageDescription.trim(),
  359: 
  360:         order: editingRelationshipId
  361:           ? (normalizedTechnologies.find(
  362:               (technology) => technology.id === editingRelationshipId,
  363:             )?.order ?? normalizedTechnologies.length)
  364:           : normalizedTechnologies.length,
  365:       };
  366: 
  367:       const nextTechnologies = editingRelationshipId
  368:         ? normalizedTechnologies.map((technology) =>
  369:             technology.id === editingRelationshipId ? relationship : technology,
  370:           )
  371:         : [...normalizedTechnologies, relationship];
  372: 
  373:       onChange?.(
  374:         nextTechnologies.map((technology, index) => ({
  375:           ...technology,
  376:           order: index,
  377:         })),
  378:       );
  379: 
  380:       resetEditor();
  381:     } catch (saveError) {
  382:       console.error("Unable to save experience technology:", {
  383:         error: saveError,
  384:         errors: saveError?.errors,
  385:         fieldErrors: saveError?.fieldErrors,
  386:         validation: saveError?.validation,
  387:       });
  388: 
  389:       const firstValidationMessage =
  390:         saveError?.errors?.[0]?.message ||
  391:         Object.values(saveError?.fieldErrors || {})[0];
  392: 
  393:       setEditorError(
  394:         firstValidationMessage ||
  395:           saveError?.publicMessage ||
  396:           saveError?.message ||
  397:           "The technology could not be saved.",
  398:       );
  399:     } finally {
  400:       setIsSavingTechnology(false);
  401:     }
  402:   };
  403: 
  404:   /*
  405:    * =========================================
  406:    * Edit
  407:    * =========================================
  408:    */
  409: 
  410:   const handleEdit = (technology) => {
  411:     setEditingRelationshipId(technology.id);
  412: 
  413:     setEditor({
  414:       selectedSkillId: technology.skillId || "",
  415:       name: technology.nameSnapshot,
  416:       category: technology.category || "",
  417:       proficiency: technology.proficiency || "",
  418:       usageDescription: technology.usageDescription || "",
  419:     });
  420: 
  421:     setSearchValue(technology.nameSnapshot);
  422:     setEditorError("");
  423:   };
  424: 
  425:   /*
  426:    * =========================================
  427:    * Remove
  428:    * =========================================
  429:    */
  430: 
  431:   const handleRemove = (relationshipId) => {
  432:     const nextTechnologies = normalizedTechnologies
  433:       .filter((technology) => technology.id !== relationshipId)
  434:       .map((technology, index) => ({
  435:         ...technology,
  436:         order: index,
  437:       }));
  438: 
  439:     onChange?.(nextTechnologies);
  440: 
  441:     if (editingRelationshipId === relationshipId) {
  442:       resetEditor();
  443:     }
  444:   };
  445: 
  446:   /*
  447:    * =========================================
  448:    * Reorder
  449:    * =========================================
  450:    */
  451: 
  452:   const handleMove = (relationshipId, direction) => {
  453:     const currentIndex = normalizedTechnologies.findIndex(
  454:       (technology) => technology.id === relationshipId,
  455:     );
  456: 
  457:     const nextIndex = currentIndex + direction;
  458: 
  459:     if (
  460:       currentIndex < 0 ||
  461:       nextIndex < 0 ||
  462:       nextIndex >= normalizedTechnologies.length
  463:     ) {
  464:       return;
  465:     }
  466: 
  467:     const reorderedTechnologies = [...normalizedTechnologies];
  468: 
  469:     const [movedTechnology] = reorderedTechnologies.splice(currentIndex, 1);
  470: 
  471:     reorderedTechnologies.splice(nextIndex, 0, movedTechnology);
  472: 
  473:     onChange?.(
  474:       reorderedTechnologies.map((technology, index) => ({
  475:         ...technology,
  476:         order: index,
  477:       })),
  478:     );
  479:   };
  480: 
  481:   return (
  482:     <section className="experience-form-section experience-technology-editor">
  483:       <header className="experience-form-section-header">
  484:         <span aria-hidden="true" />
  485: 
  486:         <div>
  487:           <small>Tools and Technology</small>
  488: 
  489:           <h3>Technologies and Tools</h3>
  490: 
  491:           <p>
  492:             Add the software, platforms, frameworks, tools, systems, hardware,
  493:             or equipment used in this experience.
  494:           </p>
  495:         </div>
  496:       </header>
  497: 
  498:       <div className="experience-technology-editor-workspace">
  499:         <section className="experience-technology-editor-panel">
  500:           <header>
  501:             <div>
  502:               <span>
  503:                 {editingRelationshipId ? "Edit Technology" : "Add Technology"}
  504:               </span>
  505: 
  506:               <h4>Select or Create a Library Item</h4>
  507:             </div>
  508: 
  509:             {editingRelationshipId && (
  510:               <button type="button" onClick={resetEditor} disabled={disabled}>
  511:                 Cancel Edit
  512:               </button>
  513:             )}
  514:           </header>
  515: 
  516:           <div className="experience-technology-editor-fields">
  517:             <div className="experience-technology-editor-field experience-technology-editor-field--full">
  518:               <label htmlFor="experience-technology-search">
  519:                 Search Skill Library
  520:               </label>
  521: 
  522:               <input
  523:                 id="experience-technology-search"
  524:                 type="search"
  525:                 value={searchValue}
  526:                 onChange={(event) => setSearchValue(event.target.value)}
  527:                 disabled={disabled}
  528:                 placeholder="Search React, Azure, SQL Server, AutoCAD..."
  529:               />
  530:             </div>
  531: 
  532:             <div className="experience-technology-editor-field experience-technology-editor-field--full">
  533:               <label htmlFor="experience-technology-library">
  534:                 Existing Library Item
  535:               </label>
  536: 
  537:               <select
  538:                 id="experience-technology-library"
  539:                 value={editor.selectedSkillId}
  540:                 onChange={handleLibrarySelection}
  541:                 disabled={disabled}
  542:               >
  543:                 <option value="">Create or enter a different technology</option>
  544: 
  545:                 {matchingLibrarySkills.map((skill) => {
  546:                   const alreadySelected = selectedNames.has(
  547:                     normalizeName(skill.name),
  548:                   );
  549: 
  550:                   return (
  551:                     <option
  552:                       key={skill.id}
  553:                       value={skill.id}
  554:                       disabled={
  555:                         alreadySelected && skill.id !== editor.selectedSkillId
  556:                       }
  557:                     >
  558:                       {skill.name}
  559:                       {skill.category ? ` â€” ${skill.category}` : ""}
  560:                       {alreadySelected && skill.id !== editor.selectedSkillId
  561:                         ? " â€” Already added"
  562:                         : ""}
  563:                     </option>
  564:                   );
  565:                 })}
  566:               </select>
  567: 
  568:               <small>
  569:                 Selecting a library item does not create a duplicate Skill
  570:                 record.
  571:               </small>
  572:             </div>
  573: 
  574:             <div className="experience-technology-editor-field">
  575:               <label htmlFor="experience-technology-name">
  576:                 Technology Name
  577:               </label>
  578: 
  579:               <input
  580:                 id="experience-technology-name"
  581:                 type="text"
  582:                 value={editor.name}
  583:                 onChange={(event) =>
  584:                   updateEditor({
  585:                     name: event.target.value,
  586:                     selectedSkillId: "",
  587:                   })
  588:                 }
  589:                 disabled={disabled}
  590:                 maxLength={150}
  591:                 placeholder="Example: Microsoft Azure"
  592:               />
  593:             </div>
  594: 
  595:             <div className="experience-technology-editor-field">
  596:               <label htmlFor="experience-technology-category">Category</label>
  597: 
  598:               <select
  599:                 id="experience-technology-category"
  600:                 value={editor.category}
  601:                 onChange={(event) =>
  602:                   updateEditor({
  603:                     category: event.target.value,
  604:                   })
  605:                 }
  606:                 disabled={disabled}
  607:               >
  608:                 <option value="">Choose a category</option>
  609: 
  610:                 {SKILL_CATEGORY_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
  611:                   <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>
  612:                     {option.label}
  613:                   </option>
  614:                 ))}
  615:               </select>
  616:             </div>
  617: 
  618:             <div className="experience-technology-editor-field">
  619:               <label htmlFor="experience-technology-proficiency">
  620:                 Experience-Specific Proficiency
  621:               </label>
  622: 
  623:               <select
  624:                 id="experience-technology-proficiency"
  625:                 value={editor.proficiency}
  626:                 onChange={(event) =>
  627:                   updateEditor({
  628:                     proficiency: event.target.value,
  629:                   })
  630:                 }
  631:                 disabled={disabled}
  632:               >
  633:                 {SKILL_PROFICIENCY_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
  634:                   <option
  635:                     key={option.value || "not-specified"}
  636:                     value={option.value}
  637:                   >
  638:                     {option.label}
  639:                   </option>
  640:                 ))}
  641:               </select>
  642: 
  643:               <small>Optional. This applies only to this experience.</small>
  644:             </div>
  645: 
  646:             <div className="experience-technology-editor-field experience-technology-editor-field--full">
  647:               <label htmlFor="experience-technology-usage">
  648:                 How It Was Used
  649:               </label>
  650: 
  651:               <textarea
  652:                 id="experience-technology-usage"
  653:                 value={editor.usageDescription}
  654:                 onChange={(event) =>
  655:                   updateEditor({
  656:                     usageDescription: event.target.value,
  657:                   })
  658:                 }
  659:                 disabled={disabled}
  660:                 rows={3}
  661:                 maxLength={500}
  662:                 placeholder="Example: Used Azure App Service to deploy and manage the backend API."
  663:               />
  664: 
  665:               <small>
  666:                 Optional context for rÃ©sumÃ©s, portfolios, and AI-generated
  667:                 content.
  668:               </small>
  669:             </div>
  670:           </div>
  671: 
  672:           {editorError && (
  673:             <p className="experience-technology-editor-error" role="alert">
  674:               {editorError}
  675:             </p>
  676:           )}
  677: 
  678:           <footer>
  679:             {editingRelationshipId && (
  680:               <button
  681:                 type="button"
  682:                 onClick={resetEditor}
  683:                 disabled={disabled || isSavingTechnology}
  684:               >
  685:                 Cancel
  686:               </button>
  687:             )}
  688: 
  689:             <button
  690:               type="button"
  691:               className="experience-technology-editor-save"
  692:               onClick={handleSaveTechnology}
  693:               disabled={disabled || isSavingTechnology}
  694:             >
  695:               {isSavingTechnology
  696:                 ? "Saving..."
  697:                 : editingRelationshipId
  698:                   ? "Save Technology"
  699:                   : "+ Add Technology"}
  700:             </button>
  701:           </footer>
  702:         </section>
  703: 
  704:         <section className="experience-technology-editor-selected">
  705:           <header>
  706:             <div>
  707:               <span>Experience Technologies</span>
  708: 
  709:               <h4>Selected Technologies</h4>
  710:             </div>
  711: 
  712:             <span>
  713:               {normalizedTechnologies.length}{" "}
  714:               {normalizedTechnologies.length === 1 ? "item" : "items"}
  715:             </span>
  716:           </header>
  717: 
  718:           {normalizedTechnologies.length > 0 ? (
  719:             <div className="experience-technology-editor-list">
  720:               {normalizedTechnologies.map((technology, index) => (
  721:                 <article
  722:                   key={technology.id}
  723:                   className="experience-technology-editor-item"
  724:                 >
  725:                   <div className="experience-technology-editor-item-number">
  726:                     {String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}
  727:                   </div>
  728: 
  729:                   <div className="experience-technology-editor-item-content">
  730:                     <div>
  731:                       <span>{getSkillCategoryLabel(technology.category)}</span>
  732: 
  733:                       {technology.proficiency && (
  734:                         <span>
  735:                           {getSkillProficiencyLabel(technology.proficiency)}
  736:                         </span>
  737:                       )}
  738:                     </div>
  739: 
  740:                     <h5>{technology.nameSnapshot}</h5>
  741: 
  742:                     {technology.usageDescription && (
  743:                       <p>{technology.usageDescription}</p>
  744:                     )}
  745: 
  746:                     <small>
  747:                       {technology.skillId
  748:                         ? "Connected to Skill Library"
  749:                         : "Legacy technology"}
  750:                     </small>
  751:                   </div>
  752: 
  753:                   <div className="experience-technology-editor-item-actions">
  754:                     <button
  755:                       type="button"
  756:                       onClick={() => handleMove(technology.id, -1)}
  757:                       disabled={disabled || index === 0}
  758:                       aria-label={`Move ${technology.nameSnapshot} up`}
  759:                     >
  760:                       â†‘
  761:                     </button>
  762: 
  763:                     <button
  764:                       type="button"
  765:                       onClick={() => handleMove(technology.id, 1)}
  766:                       disabled={
  767:                         disabled || index === normalizedTechnologies.length - 1
  768:                       }
  769:                       aria-label={`Move ${technology.nameSnapshot} down`}
  770:                     >
  771:                       â†“
  772:                     </button>
  773: 
  774:                     <button
  775:                       type="button"
  776:                       onClick={() => handleEdit(technology)}
  777:                       disabled={disabled}
  778:                     >
  779:                       Edit
  780:                     </button>
  781: 
  782:                     <button
  783:                       type="button"
  784:                       className="experience-technology-editor-remove"
  785:                       onClick={() => handleRemove(technology.id)}
  786:                       disabled={disabled}
  787:                       aria-label={`Remove ${technology.nameSnapshot}`}
  788:                     >
  789:                       Remove
  790:                     </button>
  791:                   </div>
  792:                 </article>
  793:               ))}
  794:             </div>
  795:           ) : (
  796:             <div className="experience-technology-editor-empty">
  797:               <span aria-hidden="true">âŒ˜</span>
  798: 
  799:               <h5>No technologies added</h5>

   20:   experiences = [],

   25:   onDelete,

   30:

   32: 
   33:   /*
   34:    * Current positions appear first. Previous
   35:    * positions follow from most recently ended
   36:    * to oldest.

   57:     filters.timeline !== "all" ||

   74:   };

   79:   };
   80:

   84:   };
   85:

   81: function createContextFingerprint(context) {
   82:   const fingerprintValue = JSON.stringify({
   83:     positionTitle: context.positionTitle,
   84:     organizationIndustry: context.organizationIndustry,
   85:     employmentType: context.employmentType,
   86:     workArrangement: context.workArrangement,
   87:     responsibilities: context.responsibilities,
   88:     achievements: context.achievements,
   89:     skills: context.skills,
   90:     technologies: context.technologies,
   91:     leadership: context.leadership,
   92:   });
   93: 
   94:   let hash = 0;
   95: 
   96:   for (let index = 0; index < fingerprintValue.length; index += 1) {
   97:     hash = (hash << 5) - hash + fingerprintValue.charCodeAt(index);
   98: 
   99:     hash |= 0;
  100:   }
  101: 
  102:   return `experience-overview-${Math.abs(hash).toString(36)}`;
  103: }

  111: function getOverviewReadiness(context) {
  112:   const details = [
  113:     {
  114:       id: "position",
  115:       label: "Position",
  116:       complete: Boolean(context.positionTitle),
  117:       weight: 2,
  118:       value: context.positionTitle || "Not provided",
  119:     },
  120:     {
  121:       id: "responsibilities",
  122:       label: "Responsibilities",
  123:       complete: context.responsibilities.length > 0,
  124:       weight: 3,
  125:       value: `${context.responsibilities.length} added`,
  126:     },
  127:     {
  128:       id: "achievements",
  129:       label: "Achievements",
  130:       complete: context.achievements.length > 0,
  131:       weight: 3,
  132:       value: `${context.achievements.length} added`,
  133:     },
  134:     {
  135:       id: "skills",
  136:       label: "Skills",
  137:       complete: context.skills.length > 0,
  138:       weight: 2,
  139:       value: `${context.skills.length} selected`,
  140:     },
  141:     {
  142:       id: "technologies",
  143:       label: "Technologies",
  144:       complete: context.technologies.length > 0,
  145:       weight: 2,
  146:       value: `${context.technologies.length} selected`,
  147:     },
  148:     {
  149:       id: "leadership",
  150:       label: "Leadership",
  151:       complete: Boolean(
  152:         context.leadership.description ||
  153:         context.leadership.hasLeadershipResponsibilities,
  154:       ),
  155:       weight: 1,
  156:       value:
  157:         context.leadership.description ||
  158:         context.leadership.hasLeadershipResponsibilities
  159:           ? "Provided"
  160:           : "Not provided",
  161:     },
  162:   ];
  163: 
  164:   const maximumScore = details.reduce(
  165:     (total, detail) => total + detail.weight,
  166:     0,
  167:   );
  168:

  170:     (total, detail) => total + (detail.complete ? detail.weight : 0),
  171:     0,
  172:   );
  173:

  175:     return {
  176:       level: "excellent",

  179:         "All major context areas are available for a detailed and accurate overview.",
  180:       score,
  181:       maximumScore,
  182:       details,
  183:     };
  184:   }
  185: 
  186:   if (score >= 9) {
  187:     return {
  188:       level: "strong",
  189:       label: "Strong",
  190:       description:
  191:         "The available information provides strong context for an accurate overview.",
  192:       score,
  193:       maximumScore,
  194:       details,
  195:     };
  196:   }
  197: 
  198:   if (score >= 4) {
  199:     return {
  200:       level: "developing",
  201:       label: "Developing",
  202:       description:
  203:         "The AI can generate an overview, but more responsibilities, achievements, or skills would improve it.",
  204:       score,
  205:       maximumScore,
  206:       details,
  207:     };
  208:   }
  209: 
  210:   return {
  211:     level: "basic",
  212:     label: "Basic",
  213:     description:
  214:       "Add more professional context for a specific and meaningful overview.",
  215:     score,
  216:     maximumScore,
  217:     details,
  218:   };
  219: }

  227: function ExperienceOverviewBuilder({
  228:   experience = {},
  229:   fieldError = "",
  230:   disabled = false,
  231:   onChange,

  233:   const sectionTitleId = useId();
  234:   const textareaId = useId();

  240:   const [suggestions, setSuggestions] = useState([]);
  241: 
  242:   const [warnings, setWarnings] = useState([]);
  243: 
  244:   const [status, setStatus] = useState("idle");
  245: 
  246:   const [error, setError] = useState("");
  247: 
  248:   const overview = experience.overview || "";
  249: 
  250:   const overviewMeta = {
  251:     ...EMPTY_OVERVIEW_META,
  252:     ...experience.overviewMeta,
  253:   };
  254: 
  255:   /*
  256:    * =========================================
  257:    * Generation Context
  258:    * =========================================
  259:    */
  260: 
  261:   const generationContext = useMemo(
  262:     () => ({
  263:       positionTitle: experience.position?.title || "",
  264: 
  265:       organizationName: experience.organization?.name || "",
  266: 
  267:       organizationIndustry: experience.organization?.industry || "",
  268: 
  269:       experienceCategory: experience.category || "",
  270: 
  271:       employmentType: experience.position?.employmentType || "",
  272: 
  273:       workArrangement: experience.position?.workArrangement || "",
  274: 
  275:       responsibilities: (experience.responsibilities || [])
  276:         .map(getResponsibilityText)
  277:         .filter(Boolean),
  278: 
  279:       achievements: (experience.achievements || [])
  280:         .map(normalizeAchievement)
  281:         .filter((achievement) => achievement.text),
  282: 
  283:       skills: (experience.skills || [])
  284:         .map((relationship) => ({
  285:           name:
  286:             skillsById.get(relationship.skillId)?.name ||
  287:             relationship.nameSnapshot ||
  288:             "",
  289: 
  290:           nameSnapshot: relationship.nameSnapshot || "",
  291: 
  292:           level: relationship.level || "",
  293:         }))
  294:         .filter((skill) => skill.name || skill.nameSnapshot),
  295: 
  296:       technologies: (experience.technologies || [])
  297:         .map(normalizeTechnology)
  298:         .filter((technology) => technology.name),
  299: 
  300:       leadership: {
  301:         hasLeadershipResponsibilities:
  302:           experience.leadership?.hasLeadershipResponsibilities === true,
  303: 
  304:         peopleManaged:
  305:           experience.leadership?.peopleManaged === "" ||
  306:           experience.leadership?.peopleManaged === null ||
  307:           experience.leadership?.peopleManaged === undefined
  308:             ? null
  309:             : Number(experience.leadership.peopleManaged),
  310: 
  311:         description: experience.leadership?.description || "",
  312:       },
  313: 
  314:       existingOverview: overview,
  315: 
  316:       generationRules: {
  317:         numberOfSuggestions: 3,
  318:         recommendedWords: "50â€“120 words",
  319:         useOnlyProvidedFacts: true,
  320:         doNotInventMetrics: true,
  321:       },
  322:     }),
  323:     [experience, overview, skillsById],
  324:   );
  325: 
  326:   const contextFingerprint = useMemo(
  327:     () => createContextFingerprint(generationContext),
  328:     [generationContext],
  329:   );
  330: 
  331:   const readiness = useMemo(
  332:     () => getOverviewReadiness(generationContext),
  333:     [generationContext],
  334:   );
  335: 
  336:   const canGenerate = readiness.score > 0;
  337: 
  338:   const isGenerating = status === "loading";
  339: 
  340:   const isStale =
  341:     overviewMeta.source === "ai" &&
  342:     Boolean(overviewMeta.contextFingerprint) &&
  343:     overviewMeta.contextFingerprint !== contextFingerprint;
  344: 
  345:   /*
  346:    * =========================================
  347:    * Request Cleanup
  348:    * =========================================
  349:    */
  350: 
  351:   useEffect(() => {
  352:     return () => {
  353:       abortControllerRef.current?.abort();
  354:     };
  355:   }, []);
  356: 
  357:   /*
  358:    * =========================================
  359:    * Manual Editing
  360:    * =========================================
  361:    */
  362: 
  363:   const handleOverviewChange = (event) => {
  364:     const nextOverview = event.target.value;
  365: 
  366:     onChange?.({
  367:       overview: nextOverview,

  393:

  395:

  397:

  399:       setStatus("loading");
  400:       setError("");
  401:       setWarnings([]);

  403:       const response = await fetch(API_ENDPOINTS.generateExperienceOverview, {
  404:         method: "POST",
  405: 
  406:         headers: {
  407:           "Content-Type": "application/json",
  408:         },
  409: 
  410:         body: JSON.stringify(generationContext),
  411: 
  412:         signal: controller.signal,
  413:       });
  414: 
  415:       const responseData = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
  416:

  418:         throw new Error(

  420:         );

  425:             suggestion?.text?.trim(),

  427:         : [];
  428: 
  429:       if (generatedSuggestions.length !== 3) {
  430:         throw new Error(
  431:           "The AI did not return three usable Experience Overview suggestions.",
  432:         );
  433:       }
  434: 
  435:       setSuggestions(generatedSuggestions);
  436: 
  437:       setWarnings(
  438:         Array.isArray(responseData.warnings) ? responseData.warnings : [],
  439:       );
  440: 
  441:       setStatus("success");
  442:     } catch (generationError) {
  443:       if (generationError.name === "AbortError") {
  444:         return;
  445:       }
  446: 
  447:       console.error("Unable to generate Experience Overview:", generationError);
  448: 
  449:       setSuggestions([]);
  450:       setStatus("error");
  451: 
  452:       setError(
  453:         generationError.message ||
  454:           "The Experience Overview could not be generated.",
  455:       );
  456:     } finally {
  457:       if (abortControllerRef.current === controller) {
  458:         abortControllerRef.current = null;
  459:       }
  460:     }
  461:   };
  462: 
  463:   /*
  464:    * =========================================

  471:       overview: suggestion.text,
  472: 
  473:       overviewMeta: {
  474:         source: "ai",
  475:         status: "accepted",

  477:         contextFingerprint,

  479:       },

  486:   };

  488:   /*

  493:

  500:

  502:     onChange?.({

  504:       overviewMeta: {

  507:     });
  508: 
  509:     handleDismiss();
  510:   };
  511: 
  512:   return (
  513:     <section
  514:       className="experience-form-section experience-overview-builder"
  515:       aria-labelledby={sectionTitleId}
  516:     >
  517:       <header className="experience-form-section-header">

  519: 
  520:         <div>
  521:           <small>Overview</small>
  522: 
  523:           <h3 id={sectionTitleId}>Experience Overview</h3>
  524: 
  525:           <p>Explain the purpose, scope, and professional focus of the role.</p>
  526:         </div>
  527:       </header>
  528: 
  529:       <ExperienceOverviewReadiness readiness={readiness} />
  530:

  539:             </p>

  541:

  551:

  558:           <label htmlFor={textareaId}>Professional Overview</label>

  588:           </div>

  649:         </div>

  651:

  653:         suggestions={suggestions}
  654:         disabled={disabled || isGenerating}

FILE: D:\Documents\Project\Portfolio\portfolio-plateform\frontend\src\pages\Experience\components\ExperienceSkillsEditor\ExperienceSkillsEditor.jsx

    1: import { useId, useMemo } from "react";
    2: 
    3: import {
    4:   SKILL_PROFICIENCY_OPTIONS,
    5:   getSkillCategoryLabel,
    6:   getSkillTypeLabel,
    7: } from "../../../../config/skillConfig.js";
    8: 
    9: import { EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS } from "../../../../config/experienceConfig.js";
   10: 
   11: import { useSkillData } from "../../../../context/SkillDataContext.jsx";
   12: 
   13: import { createExperienceSkill } from "../../../../models/experienceModel.js";
   14: 
   15: import SkillSelector from "../../../skills/components/SkillSelector/SkillSelector.jsx";
   16: 
   17: import ExperienceSkillSuggestions from "./ExperienceSkillSuggestions/ExperienceSkillSuggestions.jsx";
   18: 
   19: import "./ExperienceSkillsEditor.css";
   20: 
   21: /*
   22:  * =========================================
   23:  * Relationship Ordering
   24:  * =========================================
   25:  */
   26: 
   27: function normalizeSkillOrder(skills = []) {
   28:   return skills.map((skill, index) => ({
   29:     ...skill,
   30:     order: index,
   31:   }));
   32: }
   33: 
   34: /*
   35:  * =========================================
   36:  * Relationship Display
   37:  * =========================================
   38:  */
   39: 
   40: function getRelationshipInformation(relationship, skillsById) {
   41:   const librarySkill = skillsById.get(relationship.skillId);
   42: 
   43:   return {
   44:     librarySkill,
   45: 
   46:     name:
   47:       librarySkill?.name || relationship.nameSnapshot || "Unavailable Skill",
   48: 
   49:     category:
   50:       librarySkill?.category || relationship.categorySnapshot || "other",
   51: 
   52:     type: librarySkill?.type || relationship.typeSnapshot || "professional",
   53: 
   54:     isConnected: Boolean(librarySkill),
   55: 
   56:     isArchived: librarySkill?.status === "archived",
   57:   };
   58: }
   59: 
   60: /*
   61:  * =========================================
   62:  * Experience Skills Editor
   63:  * =========================================
   64:  */
   65: 
   66: function ExperienceSkillsEditor({
   67:   experience = {},
   68:   experienceSkills = [],
   69:   fieldErrors = {},
   70:   disabled = false,
   71:   onChange,
   72: }) {
   73:   const sectionTitleId = useId();
   74: 
   75:   const { activeSkills, skillsById, findOrCreateSkill, isLoading } =
   76:     useSkillData();
   77: 
   78:   const maximumSkills = EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumSkills;
   79: 
   80:   const orderedExperienceSkills = useMemo(
   81:     () =>
   82:       [...experienceSkills].sort(
   83:         (first, second) => (first.order ?? 0) - (second.order ?? 0),
   84:       ),
   85:     [experienceSkills],
   86:   );
   87: 
   88:   const selectedSkillIds = useMemo(
   89:     () =>
   90:       orderedExperienceSkills
   91:         .map((relationship) => relationship.skillId)
   92:         .filter(Boolean),
   93:     [orderedExperienceSkills],
   94:   );
   95: 
   96:   const isWorking = disabled || isLoading;
   97: 
   98:   /*
   99:    * =========================================
  100:    * Attach Library Skill
  101:    * =========================================
  102:    */
  103: 
  104:   const handleSelectSkill = (skill) => {
  105:     if (isWorking || !skill?.id || experienceSkills.length >= maximumSkills) {
  106:       return;
  107:     }
  108: 
  109:     const alreadyAttached = experienceSkills.some(
  110:       (relationship) => relationship.skillId === skill.id,
  111:     );
  112: 
  113:     if (alreadyAttached) {
  114:       return;
  115:     }
  116: 
  117:     const relationship = createExperienceSkill({
  118:       skillId: skill.id,
  119:       nameSnapshot: skill.name,
  120:       categorySnapshot: skill.category,
  121:       typeSnapshot: skill.type,
  122:       level: "",
  123:       usageDescription: "",
  124:       order: experienceSkills.length,
  125:     });
  126: 
  127:     onChange?.(normalizeSkillOrder([...experienceSkills, relationship]));
  128:   };
  129: 
  130:   /*
  131:    * =========================================
  132:    * Create Library Skill
  133:    * =========================================
  134:    *
  135:    * SkillSelector will call handleSelectSkill()
  136:    * after this operation succeeds.
  137:    */
  138: 
  139:   const handleCreateSkill = async (skillData) => {
  140:     return findOrCreateSkill({
  141:       ...skillData,
  142:       source: skillData.source || "manual",
  143:       sourceContext: "experience",
  144:     });
  145:   };
  146: 
  147:   /*
  148:    * =========================================
  149:    * Remove Relationship
  150:    * =========================================
  151:    */
  152: 
  153:   const removeRelationship = (relationshipId) => {
  154:     onChange?.(
  155:       normalizeSkillOrder(
  156:         experienceSkills.filter(
  157:           (relationship) => relationship.id !== relationshipId,
  158:         ),
  159:       ),
  160:     );
  161:   };
  162: 
  163:   const handleRemoveSelectedSkill = (skill) => {
  164:     const relationship = experienceSkills.find(
  165:       (candidate) => candidate.skillId === skill.id,
  166:     );
  167: 
  168:     if (relationship) {
  169:       removeRelationship(relationship.id);
  170:     }
  171:   };
  172: 
  173:   /*
  174:    * =========================================
  175:    * Update Relationship
  176:    * =========================================
  177:    */
  178: 
  179:   const updateRelationship = (relationshipId, updates) => {
  180:     onChange?.(
  181:       normalizeSkillOrder(
  182:         orderedExperienceSkills.map((relationship) =>
  183:           relationship.id === relationshipId
  184:             ? {
  185:                 ...relationship,
  186:                 ...updates,
  187:               }
  188:             : relationship,
  189:         ),
  190:       ),
  191:     );
  192:   };
  193: 
  194:   /*
  195:    * =========================================
  196:    * Reorder Relationship
  197:    * =========================================
  198:    */
  199: 
  200:   const handleMove = (relationshipId, direction) => {
  201:     const currentIndex = orderedExperienceSkills.findIndex(
  202:       (relationship) => relationship.id === relationshipId,
  203:     );
  204: 
  205:     if (currentIndex === -1) {
  206:       return;
  207:     }
  208: 
  209:     const targetIndex =
  210:       direction === "up" ? currentIndex - 1 : currentIndex + 1;
  211: 
  212:     if (targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex >= orderedExperienceSkills.length) {
  213:       return;
  214:     }
  215: 
  216:     const reorderedSkills = [...orderedExperienceSkills];
  217: 
  218:     const [movedSkill] = reorderedSkills.splice(currentIndex, 1);
  219: 
  220:     reorderedSkills.splice(targetIndex, 0, movedSkill);
  221: 
  222:     onChange?.(normalizeSkillOrder(reorderedSkills));
  223:   };
  224: 
  225:   return (
  226:     <section
  227:       className="experience-form-section experience-skills-editor"
  228:       aria-labelledby={sectionTitleId}
  229:     >
  230:       <header className="experience-form-section-header">
  231:         <span aria-hidden="true" />
  232: 
  233:         <div>
  234:           <small>Professional Capabilities</small>
  235: 
  236:           <h3 id={sectionTitleId}>Skills Used in This Experience</h3>
  237: 
  238:           <p>
  239:             Select skills from your central Skill Library or create a reusable
  240:             skill and attach it to this Experience.
  241:           </p>
  242:         </div>
  243:       </header>
  244: 
  245:       {/*
  246:        * =========================================
  247:        * Shared Skill Selector
  248:        * =========================================
  249:        */}
  250: 
  251:       <SkillSelector
  252:         skills={activeSkills}
  253:         selectedSkillIds={selectedSkillIds}
  254:         maximumSelections={maximumSkills}
  255:         disabled={isWorking}
  256:         allowCreate
  257:         defaultNewSkillCategory="other"
  258:         defaultNewSkillType="professional"
  259:         title="Select Experience Skills"
  260:         description="Search the central Skill Library or create a new skill used in this professional experience."
  261:         emptyMessage="Add a new skill to begin building the shared Skill Library."
  262:         onSelect={handleSelectSkill}
  263:         onRemove={handleRemoveSelectedSkill}
  264:         onCreateSkill={handleCreateSkill}
  265:       />
  266: 
  267:       {/*
  268:        * =========================================
  269:        * AI Skill Suggestions
  270:        * =========================================
  271:        */}
  272: 
  273:       <ExperienceSkillSuggestions
  274:         experience={experience}
  275:         experienceSkills={experienceSkills}
  276:         maximumExperienceSkills={maximumSkills}
  277:         disabled={isWorking}
  278:         onChange={onChange}
  279:       />
  280: 
  281:       {/*
  282:        * =========================================
  283:        * Selected Relationships
  284:        * =========================================
  285:        */}
  286: 
  287:       <section className="experience-skills-selected">
  288:         <header>
  289:           <div>
  290:             <span>Selected Skills</span>
  291: 
  292:             <h4>Experience Skill Set</h4>
  293: 
  294:             <p>
  295:               Add Experience-specific proficiency and explain how each skill was
  296:               used.
  297:             </p>
  298:           </div>
  299: 
  300:           <strong>{orderedExperienceSkills.length}</strong>
  301:         </header>
  302: 
  303:         {orderedExperienceSkills.length > 0 ? (
  304:           <div className="experience-skills-selected-list">
  305:             {orderedExperienceSkills.map((relationship, index) => {
  306:               const information = getRelationshipInformation(
  307:                 relationship,
  308:                 skillsById,
  309:               );
  310: 
  311:               const relationshipError =
  312:                 fieldErrors[`skills.${index}.skillId`] ||
  313:                 fieldErrors[`skills.${index}.nameSnapshot`];
  314: 
  315:               const levelError = fieldErrors[`skills.${index}.level`];
  316: 
  317:               const usageError =
  318:                 fieldErrors[`skills.${index}.usageDescription`];
  319: 
  320:               const itemHasError = Boolean(
  321:                 relationshipError || levelError || usageError,
  322:               );
  323: 
  324:               return (
  325:                 <article
  326:                   key={relationship.id}
  327:                   className={`experience-skills-selected-item ${
  328:                     itemHasError ? "experience-skills-selected-item--error" : ""
  329:                   }`}
  330:                 >
  331:                   <div className="experience-skills-order">
  332:                     <span>{String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}</span>
  333: 
  334:                     <div>
  335:                       <button
  336:                         type="button"
  337:                         onClick={() => handleMove(relationship.id, "up")}
  338:                         disabled={isWorking || index === 0}
  339:                         aria-label={`Move ${information.name} up`}
  340:                       >
  341:                         â†‘
  342:                       </button>
  343:

  346:                         onClick={() => handleMove(relationship.id, "down")}

  351:                         aria-label={`Move ${information.name} down`}

  354:                       </button>

    1: import { useId, useMemo, useState } from "react";
    2: 
    3: import { EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS } from "../../../../config/experienceConfig.js";
    4:

   10:  * =========================================
   11:  * Helpers
   12:  * =========================================
   13:  */
   14: 
   15: function normalizeResponsibilityOrder(responsibilities) {
   16:   return responsibilities.map((responsibility, index) => ({
   17:     ...responsibility,
   18:     order: index,
   19:   }));
   20: }
   21: 
   22: function getResponsibilityText(responsibility) {
   23:   if (typeof responsibility === "string") {
   24:     return responsibility.trim();
   25:   }
   26: 
   27:   return responsibility?.text?.trim() || "";
   28: }
   29: 
   30: /*
   31:  * =========================================
   32:  * Responsibility Editor
   33:  * =========================================
   34:  */
   35: 
   36: function ResponsibilityEditor({
   37:   responsibilities = [],
   38:   fieldErrors = {},
   39:   disabled = false,
   40:   onChange,
   41: }) {
   42:   const sectionTitleId = useId();
   43:   const textareaId = useId();
   44: 
   45:   const [draftText, setDraftText] = useState("");
   46: 
   47:   const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState(null);
   48: 
   49:   const [editorError, setEditorError] = useState("");
   50: 
   51:   const isEditing = Boolean(editingId);
   52: 
   53:   const maximumItems = EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumResponsibilities;
   54: 
   55:   const maximumTextLength = EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS.responsibilityText;
   56: 
   57:   const hasReachedMaximum = responsibilities.length >= maximumItems;
   58: 
   59:   /*
   60:    * =========================================
   61:    * Ordered Responsibilities
   62:    * =========================================
   63:    */
   64: 
   65:   const orderedResponsibilities = useMemo(
   66:     () =>
   67:       [...responsibilities].sort(
   68:         (first, second) => (first.order ?? 0) - (second.order ?? 0),
   69:       ),
   70:     [responsibilities],
   71:   );
   72: 
   73:   /*
   74:    * =========================================
   75:    * Reset Editor
   76:    * =========================================
   77:    */
   78: 
   79:   const resetEditor = () => {
   80:     setDraftText("");
   81:     setEditingId(null);
   82:     setEditorError("");
   83:   };
   84: 
   85:   /*
   86:    * =========================================
   87:    * Duplicate Check
   88:    * =========================================
   89:    */
   90: 
   91:   const isDuplicateResponsibility = (text) => {
   92:     const normalizedText = text.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
   93: 
   94:     return responsibilities.some((responsibility) => {
   95:       if (responsibility.id === editingId) {
   96:         return false;
   97:       }
   98: 
   99:       return (
  100:         getResponsibilityText(responsibility).toLocaleLowerCase() ===
  101:         normalizedText
  102:       );
  103:     });
  104:   };
  105: 
  106:   /*
  107:    * =========================================
  108:    * Add or Update
  109:    * =========================================
  110:    */
  111: 
  112:   const handleSubmit = () => {
  113:     const normalizedText = draftText.trim();
  114: 
  115:     if (!normalizedText) {
  116:       setEditorError("Enter a responsibility before adding it.");
  117: 
  118:       return;
  119:     }
  120: 
  121:     if (normalizedText.length > maximumTextLength) {
  122:       setEditorError(
  123:         `A responsibility cannot exceed ${maximumTextLength} characters.`,
  124:       );
  125: 
  126:       return;
  127:     }
  128: 
  129:     if (!isEditing && hasReachedMaximum) {
  130:       setEditorError(
  131:         `You can add no more than ${maximumItems} responsibilities.`,
  132:       );
  133: 
  134:       return;
  135:     }
  136: 
  137:     if (isDuplicateResponsibility(normalizedText)) {
  138:       setEditorError("This responsibility has already been added.");
  139: 
  140:       return;
  141:     }
  142: 
  143:     if (isEditing) {
  144:       const updatedResponsibilities = responsibilities.map((responsibility) =>
  145:         responsibility.id === editingId
  146:           ? {
  147:               ...responsibility,
  148:               text: normalizedText,
  149:             }
  150:           : responsibility,
  151:       );
  152: 
  153:       onChange?.(normalizeResponsibilityOrder(updatedResponsibilities));
  154:     } else {
  155:       const newResponsibility = createResponsibility({
  156:         text: normalizedText,
  157:         order: responsibilities.length,
  158:       });
  159: 
  160:       onChange?.(
  161:         normalizeResponsibilityOrder([...responsibilities, newResponsibility]),
  162:       );
  163:     }
  164: 
  165:     resetEditor();
  166:   };
  167: 
  168:   /*
  169:    * =========================================
  170:    * Edit
  171:    * =========================================
  172:    */
  173: 
  174:   const handleEdit = (responsibility) => {
  175:     setEditingId(responsibility.id);
  176: 
  177:     setDraftText(getResponsibilityText(responsibility));
  178: 
  179:     setEditorError("");
  180:   };
  181: 
  182:   /*
  183:    * =========================================
  184:    * Remove
  185:    * =========================================
  186:    */
  187: 
  188:   const handleRemove = (responsibilityId) => {
  189:     const remainingResponsibilities = responsibilities.filter(
  190:       (responsibility) => responsibility.id !== responsibilityId,
  191:     );
  192: 
  193:     onChange?.(normalizeResponsibilityOrder(remainingResponsibilities));
  194: 
  195:     if (responsibilityId === editingId) {
  196:       resetEditor();
  197:     }
  198:   };
  199:

  201:    * =========================================
  202:    * Reorder
  203:    * =========================================
  204:    */
  205:

  207:     const currentIndex = orderedResponsibilities.findIndex(
  208:       (responsibility) => responsibility.id === responsibilityId,
  209:     );
  210: 
  211:     if (currentIndex === -1) {
  212:       return;
  213:     }
  214: 
  215:     const targetIndex =
  216:       direction === "up" ? currentIndex - 1 : currentIndex + 1;
  217: 
  218:     if (targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex >= orderedResponsibilities.length) {
  219:       return;
  220:     }
  221:

  223:

  225:       currentIndex,
  226:       1,
  227:     );
  228: 
  229:     reorderedResponsibilities.splice(targetIndex, 0, movedResponsibility);
  230: 
  231:     onChange?.(normalizeResponsibilityOrder(reorderedResponsibilities));
  232:   };
  233:

  235:    * =========================================
  236:    * Text Change
  237:    * =========================================

  239:

  242:     setEditorError("");
  243:   };
  244:

  246:     <section
  247:       className="experience-form-section responsibility-editor"
  248:       aria-labelledby={sectionTitleId}

  254:           <small>Responsibilities</small>

  256:           <h3 id={sectionTitleId}>Primary Responsibilities</h3>
  257: 
  258:           <p>
  259:             Add the important duties, activities, and ongoing responsibilities

  261:           </p>
  262:         </div>
  263:       </header>
  264: 
  265:       {/* =====================================

  268: 
  269:       <div className="responsibility-editor-form">
  270:         <div className="responsibility-editor-label-row">

  272:             {isEditing ? "Edit Responsibility" : "Add Responsibility"}

  275:           <span>

    4: function CertificateViewer({ certificate, isOwner = false }) {
    5:   const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
    6:   const closeButtonRef = useRef(null);
    7:   const openerRef = useRef(null);

   13:   const isImage = fileType.startsWith("image/");

   22:     };

   29:       document.body.style.overflow = previousOverflow;
   30:       document.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
   31:       openerRef.current?.focus();
   32:     };
   33:   }, [isOpen]);
   34: 
   35:   if (!certificate) return null;
   36:

   64:                 {isPdf ? "PDF" : fileUrl ? "DOC" : "â€”"}

    5: function formatMonth(value) {
    6:   if (!value) {
    7:     return "";
    8:   }
    9: 
   10:   const [year, month] = value.slice(0, 7).split("-").map(Number);
   11: 
   12:   if (!year || !month) {
   13:     return value;
   14:   }
   15: 
   16:   return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, {
   17:     month: "short",
   18:     year: "numeric",
   19:   }).format(new Date(year, month - 1));
   20: }

   26: function Certifications() {
   27:   const [certifications, setCertifications] = useState(INITIAL_CERTIFICATIONS);
   28: 
   29:   const [isFormOpen, setIsFormOpen] = useState(false);
   30: 
   31:   const [editingCertification, setEditingCertification] = useState(null);
   32: 
   33:   const objectUrlsRef = useRef(new Set());
   34: 
   35:   /*
   36:    * =========================================
   37:    * Object URL Cleanup
   38:    * =========================================
   39:    */
   40: 
   41:   const revokeObjectUrl = (url) => {
   42:     if (!url?.startsWith("blob:")) {
   43:       return;
   44:     }
   45: 
   46:     URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
   47: 
   48:     objectUrlsRef.current.delete(url);
   49:   };
   50: 
   51:   /*
   52:    * =========================================
   53:    * Add
   54:    * =========================================
   55:    */
   56: 
   57:   const handleAddCertification = () => {
   58:     setEditingCertification(null);
   59: 
   60:     setIsFormOpen(true);
   61:   };
   62: 
   63:   /*
   64:    * =========================================
   65:    * Edit
   66:    * =========================================
   67:    */
   68: 
   69:   const handleEditCertification = (certification) => {
   70:     setEditingCertification(certification);
   71: 
   72:     setIsFormOpen(true);
   73:   };
   74: 
   75:   /*
   76:    * =========================================
   77:    * Save
   78:    * =========================================
   79:    */
   80: 
   81:   const handleSaveCertification = (values) => {
   82:     let fileData;
   83: 
   84:     if (values.file) {
   85:       const fileUrl = URL.createObjectURL(values.file);
   86: 
   87:       objectUrlsRef.current.add(fileUrl);
   88: 
   89:       revokeObjectUrl(editingCertification?.fileUrl);
   90: 
   91:       fileData = {
   92:         file: values.file,
   93:         fileName: values.file.name,
   94:         fileUrl,
   95:         fileType: values.file.type,
   96:       };
   97:     } else if (values.removeExistingFile) {
   98:       revokeObjectUrl(editingCertification?.fileUrl);
   99: 
  100:       fileData = {
  101:         file: null,
  102:         fileName: "",
  103:         fileUrl: "",
  104:         fileType: "",
  105:       };
  106:     } else {
  107:       fileData = {
  108:         file: editingCertification?.file ?? null,
  109:         fileName: editingCertification?.fileName ?? "",
  110:         fileUrl: editingCertification?.fileUrl ?? "",
  111:         fileType: editingCertification?.fileType ?? "",
  112:       };
  113:     }
  114: 
  115:     const certificationData = {
  116:       name: values.name,
  117:       issuingOrganization: values.issuingOrganization,
  118:       issueDate: values.issueDate,
  119:       expirationDate: values.expirationDate,
  120:       credentialId: values.credentialId,
  121:       credentialUrl: values.credentialUrl,
  122:       description: values.description,
  123:       ...fileData,
  124:     };
  125: 
  126:     setCertifications((currentCertifications) => {
  127:       if (editingCertification) {
  128:         return currentCertifications.map((certification) =>
  129:           certification.id === editingCertification.id
  130:             ? {
  131:                 ...certification,
  132:                 ...certificationData,
  133:               }
  134:             : certification,
  135:         );
  136:       }
  137: 
  138:       const newCertification = {
  139:         id: crypto.randomUUID(),
  140:         ...certificationData,
  141:       };
  142: 
  143:       return [...currentCertifications, newCertification];
  144:     });
  145: 
  146:     setIsFormOpen(false);
  147: 
  148:     setEditingCertification(null);
  149:   };
  150: 
  151:   /*
  152:    * =========================================
  153:    * Cancel
  154:    * =========================================
  155:    */
  156: 
  157:   const handleCancelForm = () => {
  158:     setIsFormOpen(false);
  159: 
  160:     setEditingCertification(null);
  161:   };
  162: 
  163:   /*
  164:    * =========================================
  165:    * Delete
  166:    * =========================================
  167:    */
  168: 
  169:   const handleDeleteCertification = (id) => {
  170:     const certification = certifications.find((item) => item.id === id);
  171: 
  172:     revokeObjectUrl(certification?.fileUrl);
  173: 
  174:     setCertifications((currentCertifications) =>
  175:       currentCertifications.filter(
  176:         (certificationItem) => certificationItem.id !== id,
  177:       ),
  178:     );
  179:   };
  180:

  192:         URL.revokeObjectURL(url);

   33: /*
   34:  * =========================================
   35:  * Value Helpers
   36:  * =========================================
   37:  */
   38: 
   39: function getTextValue(value) {
   40:   return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
   41: }
   42: 
   43: function getArray(value) {
   44:   return Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
   45: }
   46: 
   47: function getSkillName(skill) {
   48:   if (typeof skill === "string") {
   49:     return skill.trim();
   50:   }
   51: 
   52:   return (
   53:     getTextValue(skill?.name) ||
   54:     getTextValue(skill?.value) ||
   55:     getTextValue(skill?.label) ||
   56:     getTextValue(skill?.title)
   57:   );
   58: }
   59: 
   60: function getAchievementText(achievement) {
   61:   if (typeof achievement === "string") {
   62:     return achievement.trim();
   63:   }
   64: 
   65:   return (
   66:     getTextValue(achievement?.value) ||
   67:     getTextValue(achievement?.description) ||
   68:     getTextValue(achievement?.text)
   69:   );
   70: }
   71: 
   72: function mergeInformation(primary = [], secondary = []) {
   73:   const combinedItems = [...getArray(primary), ...getArray(secondary)];
   74: 
   75:   const seenItems = new Set();
   76: 
   77:   return combinedItems.filter((item) => {
   78:     const identifier = item?.id || JSON.stringify(item);
   79: 
   80:     if (seenItems.has(identifier)) {
   81:       return false;
   82:     }
   83: 
   84:     seenItems.add(identifier);
   85: 
   86:     return true;
   87:   });
   88: }

   90: /*
   91:  * =========================================
   92:  * About Context
   93:  * =========================================
   94:  */
   95: 
   96: function buildAboutContext(profile, portfolioDraft) {
   97:   const selectedProfile = buildSelectedProfile(
   98:     profile,
   99:     portfolioDraft.profileSelections || [],
  100:   );
  101: 
  102:   const professionalTitle = selectedProfile.professionalTitles?.[0]?.name || "";
  103: 
  104:   const skills = mergeInformation(portfolioDraft.skills, profile?.skills)
  105:     .map(getSkillName)
  106:     .filter(Boolean);
  107: 
  108:   const experiences = mergeInformation(
  109:     portfolioDraft.experiences,
  110:     profile?.experiences,
  111:   ).map((experience) => ({
  112:     position:
  113:       getTextValue(experience?.position) ||
  114:       getTextValue(experience?.title) ||
  115:       getTextValue(experience?.role),
  116: 
  117:     company:
  118:       getTextValue(experience?.company) ||
  119:       getTextValue(experience?.organization) ||
  120:       getTextValue(experience?.employer),
  121: 
  122:     description:
  123:       getTextValue(experience?.description) ||
  124:       getTextValue(experience?.summary),
  125: 
  126:     achievements: getArray(
  127:       experience?.achievements ||
  128:         experience?.responsibilities ||
  129:         experience?.highlights,
  130:     )
  131:       .map(getAchievementText)
  132:       .filter(Boolean),
  133:   }));
  134: 
  135:   const projects = mergeInformation(
  136:     portfolioDraft.projects,
  137:     profile?.projects,
  138:   ).map((project) => ({
  139:     name: getTextValue(project?.name) || getTextValue(project?.title),
  140: 
  141:     description:
  142:       getTextValue(project?.description) || getTextValue(project?.summary),
  143: 
  144:     technologies: getArray(
  145:       project?.technologies || project?.skills || project?.tools,
  146:     )
  147:       .map(getSkillName)
  148:       .filter(Boolean),
  149:   }));
  150: 
  151:   const education = mergeInformation(
  152:     portfolioDraft.education,
  153:     profile?.education,
  154:   ).map((educationItem) => ({
  155:     degree:
  156:       getTextValue(educationItem?.degree) ||
  157:       getTextValue(educationItem?.program),
  158: 
  159:     fieldOfStudy:
  160:       getTextValue(educationItem?.fieldOfStudy) ||
  161:       getTextValue(educationItem?.major),
  162: 
  163:     institution:
  164:       getTextValue(educationItem?.institution) ||
  165:       getTextValue(educationItem?.school),
  166:   }));
  167: 
  168:   const certifications = mergeInformation(
  169:     portfolioDraft.certifications,
  170:     profile?.certifications,
  171:   ).map((certification) => ({
  172:     name:
  173:       getTextValue(certification?.name) || getTextValue(certification?.title),
  174: 
  175:     organization:
  176:       getTextValue(certification?.issuingOrganization) ||
  177:       getTextValue(certification?.organization),
  178:   }));
  179: 
  180:   const trainings = mergeInformation(
  181:     portfolioDraft.trainings,
  182:     profile?.trainings || profile?.training,
  183:   ).map((training) => ({
  184:     name:
  185:       getTextValue(training?.name) ||
  186:       getTextValue(training?.title) ||
  187:       getTextValue(training?.courseName),
  188: 
  189:     organization:
  190:       getTextValue(training?.organization) ||
  191:       getTextValue(training?.provider) ||
  192:       getTextValue(training?.institution),
  193: 
  194:     description:
  195:       getTextValue(training?.description) || getTextValue(training?.summary),
  196:   }));
  197: 
  198:   return {
  199:     documentType: "portfolio",
  200: 
  201:     targetRole:
  202:       getTextValue(portfolioDraft.targetRole) ||
  203:       getTextValue(portfolioDraft.heroSettings?.availability?.label),
  204: 
  205:     template: normalizePortfolioStyle(
  206:       portfolioDraft.heroSettings?.portfolioStyle,
  207:     ),
  208:

  210:

  217:

  219:       getTextValue(portfolioDraft.about?.text) ||
  220:       getTextValue(portfolioDraft.summary),

  222: }

  224: /*
  225:  * =========================================
  226:  * Context Fingerprint
  227:  * =========================================
  228:  */
  229: 
  230: function createContextFingerprint(context) {
  231:   const fingerprintValue = JSON.stringify({
  232:     portfolioStyle: context.template,
  233:     professionalTitle: context.professionalTitle,
  234:     skills: context.skills,
  235:     experiences: context.experiences,
  236:     projects: context.projects,
  237:     education: context.education,
  238:     certifications: context.certifications,
  239:     trainings: context.trainings,
  240:   });
  241: 
  242:   let hash = 0;
  243: 
  244:   for (let index = 0; index < fingerprintValue.length; index += 1) {
  245:     hash = (hash << 5) - hash + fingerprintValue.charCodeAt(index);
  246: 
  247:     hash |= 0;
  248:   }
  249: 
  250:   return `portfolio-about-${Math.abs(hash).toString(36)}`;
  251: }
  252: 
  253: /*
  254:  * =========================================
  255:  * Context Readiness
  256:  * =========================================
  257:  */
  258: 
  259: function calculateReadiness(context) {
  260:   const details = [
  261:     {
  262:       id: "portfolio-style",
  263:       label: "Portfolio style",
  264:       value: getPortfolioStyleOption(context.template).label,
  265:       count: 1,
  266:       weight: 1,
  267:     },
  268:     {
  269:       id: "title",
  270:       label: "Professional title",
  271:       count: context.professionalTitle ? 1 : 0,
  272:       weight: 2,
  273:     },
  274:     {
  275:       id: "experience",
  276:       label: "Experiences",
  277:       count: context.experiences.length,
  278:       weight: 3,
  279:     },
  280:     {
  281:       id: "skills",
  282:       label: "Skills",
  283:       count: context.skills.length,
  284:       weight: context.skills.length >= 3 ? 2 : 1,
  285:     },
  286:     {
  287:       id: "projects",
  288:       label: "Projects",
  289:       count: context.projects.length,
  290:       weight: 2,
  291:     },
  292:     {
  293:       id: "education",
  294:       label: "Education",
  295:       count: context.education.length,
  296:       weight: 1,
  297:     },
  298:     {
  299:       id: "certifications",
  300:       label: "Certifications",
  301:       count: context.certifications.length,
  302:       weight: 1,
  303:     },
  304:     {
  305:       id: "trainings",
  306:       label: "Training",
  307:       count: context.trainings.length,
  308:       weight: 1,
  309:     },
  310:   ];
  311: 
  312:   const score = details.reduce(
  313:     (currentScore, detail) =>
  314:       detail.count > 0 ? currentScore + detail.weight : currentScore,
  315:     0,
  316:   );
  317: 
  318:   if (score >= 10) {
  319:     return {
  320:       level: "excellent",
  321:       label: "Excellent",
  322:       description:
  323:         "Your professional information provides excellent context for a detailed and distinctive About section.",
  324:       details,
  325:     };
  326:   }
  327: 
  328:   if (score >= 7) {
  329:     return {
  330:       level: "strong",
  331:       label: "Strong",
  332:       description:
  333:         "Your saved information provides strong context for a professional About section.",
  334:       details,
  335:     };
  336:   }
  337: 
  338:   if (score >= 4) {
  339:     return {
  340:       level: "good",
  341:       label: "Good",
  342:       description:
  343:         "The AI can prepare a useful About draft, but more experience, projects, or skills would improve it.",
  344:       details,
  345:     };
  346:   }
  347: 
  348:   return {
  349:     level: "basic",
  350:     label: "Basic",
  351:     description:
  352:       "Add professional titles, experience, skills, projects, education, or training for a more specific About section.",
  353:     details,
  354:   };
  355: }
  356: 
  357: /*
  358:  * =========================================
  359:  * Response Normalization
  360:  * =========================================
  361:  */
  362: 
  363: function normalizeSuggestions(responseData) {
  364:   const responseSuggestions = Array.isArray(responseData?.suggestions)
  365:     ? responseData.suggestions
  366:     : [];
  367: 
  368:   return responseSuggestions
  369:     .map((suggestion, index) => {
  370:       if (typeof suggestion === "string") {
  371:         return {
  372:           id: `about-suggestion-${index + 1}`,
  373:           label: `Option ${index + 1}`,
  374:           text: suggestion.trim(),
  375:         };
  376:       }
  377: 
  378:       return {
  379:         id: suggestion?.id || `about-suggestion-${index + 1}`,
  380: 
  381:         label: suggestion?.label || `Option ${index + 1}`,
  382: 
  383:         text: getTextValue(suggestion?.text || suggestion?.summary),
  384:       };
  385:     })
  386:     .filter((suggestion) => suggestion.text)
  387:     .slice(0, 3);
  388: }
