  390: /*
  391:  * =========================================
  392:  * Portfolio About Builder
  393:  * =========================================
  394:  */
  395: 
  396: function PortfolioAboutBuilder({
  397:   profile = {},
  398:   portfolioDraft = {},
  399:   about = EMPTY_ABOUT,
  400:   onChange,
  401: }) {
  402:   const titleId = useId();
  403: 
  404:   const currentAbout = {
  405:     ...EMPTY_ABOUT,
  406:     ...about,
  407: 
  408:     text: typeof about === "string" ? about : about?.text || "",
  409: 
  410:     meta: {
  411:       ...EMPTY_ABOUT_META,
  412:       ...(typeof about === "object" ? about?.meta : {}),
  413:     },
  414:   };
  415: 
  416:   const [suggestions, setSuggestions] = useState([]);
  417: 
  418:   const [generationStatus, setGenerationStatus] = useState("idle");
  419: 
  420:   const [generationError, setGenerationError] = useState("");
  421: 
  422:   const [generationWarnings, setGenerationWarnings] = useState([]);
  423: 
  424:   const context = useMemo(
  425:     () =>
  426:       buildAboutContext(profile, {
  427:         ...portfolioDraft,
  428: 
  429:         about: currentAbout,
  430:       }),
  431:     [profile, portfolioDraft, currentAbout.text],
  432:   );
  433: 
  434:   const contextFingerprint = useMemo(
  435:     () => createContextFingerprint(context),
  436:     [context],
  437:   );
  438: 
  439:   const readiness = useMemo(() => calculateReadiness(context), [context]);
  440: 
  441:   const wordCount = currentAbout.text.trim()
  442:     ? currentAbout.text.trim().split(/\s+/).length
  443:     : 0;
  444: 
  445:   const characterCount = currentAbout.text.length;
  446: 
  447:   const isGenerating = generationStatus === "loading";
  448: 
  449:   const canGenerate = Boolean(
  450:     context.professionalTitle ||
  451:     context.experiences.length ||
  452:     context.projects.length ||
  453:     context.skills.length,
  454:   );
  455: 
  456:   const isOutdated =
  457:     currentAbout.meta.source === "ai" &&
  458:     Boolean(currentAbout.meta.contextFingerprint) &&
  459:     currentAbout.meta.contextFingerprint !== contextFingerprint;
  460: 
  461:   /*
  462:    * =========================================
  463:    * Manual Changes
  464:    * =========================================
  465:    */
  466: 
  467:   const handleTextChange = (value) => {
  468:     onChange?.({
  469:       text: value,
  470: 
  471:       meta: {
  472:         source: "manual",
  473:         status: value.trim() ? "draft" : "empty",
  474:         generatedAt: null,
  475:         contextFingerprint: "",
  476:         isStale: false,
  477:       },
  478:     });
  479: 
  480:     setGenerationError("");
  481:   };
  482: 
  483:   const handleClear = () => {
  484:     onChange?.({
  485:       ...EMPTY_ABOUT,
  486: 
  487:       meta: {
  488:         ...EMPTY_ABOUT_META,
  489:       },
  490:     });
  491: 
  492:     setSuggestions([]);
  493:     setGenerationWarnings([]);
  494:     setGenerationError("");
  495:     setGenerationStatus("idle");
  496:   };
  497: 
  498:   /*
  499:    * =========================================
  500:    * Generate Suggestions
  501:    * =========================================
  502:    */
  503: 
  504:   const handleGenerate = async () => {
  505:     if (!canGenerate || isGenerating) {
  506:       return;
  507:     }
  508: 
  509:     try {
  510:       setGenerationStatus("loading");
  511:       setGenerationError("");
  512:       setGenerationWarnings([]);
  513: 
  514:       const response = await fetch(API_ENDPOINTS.generateResumeSummary, {
  515:         method: "POST",
  516: 
  517:         headers: {
  518:           "Content-Type": "application/json",
  519:         },
  520: 
  521:         body: JSON.stringify({
  522:           ...context,
  523: 
  524:           generationRules: {
  525:             useOnlyProvidedFacts: true,
  526:             doNotInventQualifications: true,
  527:             doNotInventMetrics: true,
  528:             numberOfSuggestions: 3,
  529:             recommendedWords: "100â€“250 words",
  530:           },
  531:         }),
  532:       });
  533: 
  534:       const responseData = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
  535: 
  536:       if (!response.ok) {
  537:         throw new Error(
  538:           responseData.message || "The About-generation request failed.",
  539:         );
  540:       }
  541: 
  542:       const generatedSuggestions = normalizeSuggestions(responseData);
  543: 
  544:       if (generatedSuggestions.length !== 3) {
  545:         throw new Error(
  546:           "The AI did not return three usable About suggestions.",
  547:         );
  548:       }
  549: 
  550:       setSuggestions(generatedSuggestions);
  551: 
  552:       setGenerationWarnings(
  553:         Array.isArray(responseData.warnings) ? responseData.warnings : [],
  554:       );
  555: 
  556:       setGenerationStatus("success");
  557:     } catch (error) {
  558:       console.error("Unable to generate portfolio About suggestions:", error);
  559: 
  560:       setSuggestions([]);
  561:       setGenerationStatus("error");
  562: 
  563:       setGenerationError(
  564:         error.message || "The About suggestions could not be generated.",
  565:       );
  566:     }
  567:   };
  568: 
  569:   /*
  570:    * =========================================
  571:    * Suggestion Actions
  572:    * =========================================
  573:    */
  574: 
  575:   const saveSuggestion = (suggestion, status) => {
  576:     onChange?.({
  577:       text: suggestion.text,
  578: 
  579:       meta: {
  580:         source: "ai",
  581:         status,
  582:         generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  583:         contextFingerprint,
  584:         isStale: false,
  585:       },
  586:     });
  587: 
  588:     setSuggestions([]);
  589:     setGenerationWarnings([]);
  590:     setGenerationError("");
  591:     setGenerationStatus("idle");
  592:   };
  593: 
  594:   const handleAcceptSuggestion = (suggestion) => {
  595:     saveSuggestion(suggestion, "accepted");
  596:   };
  597: 
  598:   const handleEditSuggestion = (suggestion) => {
  599:     saveSuggestion(suggestion, "editing");
  600:   };
  601: 
  602:   const handleDismissSuggestions = () => {
  603:     setSuggestions([]);
  604:     setGenerationWarnings([]);
  605:     setGenerationError("");
  606:     setGenerationStatus("idle");
  607:   };
  608: 
  609:   return (
  610:     <section
  611:       className="portfolio-about-builder portfolio-editor-card"
  612:       aria-labelledby={titleId}
  613:     >
  614:       <header className="portfolio-about-builder-header">
  615:         <div>
  616:           <span>Professional Story</span>
  617: 
  618:           <h3 id={titleId}>Portfolio About</h3>
  619: 
  620:           <p>
  621:             Write your professional story or generate three first-person
  622:             suggestions using the information saved throughout your portfolio
  623:             and profile.
  624:           </p>
  625:         </div>
  626: 
  627:         <div className="portfolio-about-builder-header-actions">
  628:           <span
  629:             className={`portfolio-about-source portfolio-about-source--${currentAbout.meta.source}`}
  630:           >
  631:             {currentAbout.meta.source === "ai" ? "AI Assisted" : "Manual"}
  632:           </span>
  633: 
  634:           {currentAbout.text && (
  635:             <button type="button" onClick={handleClear}>
  636:               Clear
  637:             </button>
  638:           )}
  639:         </div>
  640:       </header>
  641: 
  642:       <AboutContextReadiness readiness={readiness} />
  643: 
  644:       {isOutdated && (
  645:         <div className="portfolio-about-outdated" role="status">
  646:           <div>
  647:             <strong>Your professional information has changed.</strong>
  648: 
  649:             <p>
  650:               This About section was generated using older information. You can
  651:               keep it, edit it, or generate updated suggestions.
  652:             </p>
  653:           </div>
  654: 
  655:           <button
  656:             type="button"
  657:             onClick={handleGenerate}
  658:             disabled={!canGenerate || isGenerating}
  659:           >
  660:             Regenerate
  661:           </button>
  662:         </div>
  663:       )}
  664: 
  665:       <AboutEditor
  666:         value={currentAbout.text}
  667:         wordCount={wordCount}
  668:         characterCount={characterCount}
  669:         isGenerating={isGenerating}
  670:         canGenerate={canGenerate}
  671:         hasSuggestions={suggestions.length > 0}
  672:         source={currentAbout.meta.source}
  673:         status={currentAbout.meta.status}
  674:         onChange={handleTextChange}
  675:         onGenerate={handleGenerate}
  676:       />
  677: 
  678:       {isGenerating && (
  679:         <div
  680:           className="portfolio-about-loading"
  681:           role="status"
  682:           aria-live="polite"
  683:         >
  684:           <span aria-hidden="true" />
  685: 
  686:           <div>
  687:             <strong>Generating your professional story</strong>
  688: 
  689:             <p>
  690:               The AI is reviewing your experience, projects, skills, education,
  691:               certifications, and training.
  692:             </p>
  693:           </div>
  694:         </div>
  695:       )}
  696: 
  697:       {generationError && (
  698:         <div className="portfolio-about-error" role="alert">
  699:           <div>
  700:             <strong>Unable to generate suggestions</strong>
  701: 
  702:             <p>{generationError}</p>
  703:           </div>
  704: 
  705:           <button
  706:             type="button"
  707:             onClick={handleGenerate}
  708:             disabled={!canGenerate || isGenerating}
  709:           >
  710:             Try Again
  711:           </button>
  712:         </div>
  713:       )}
  714: 
  715:       {generationWarnings.length > 0 && (
  716:         <div className="portfolio-about-warnings">
  717:           <strong>Suggestions for better results</strong>
  718: 
  719:           <ul>
  720:             {generationWarnings.map((warning, index) => (
  721:               <li key={`${warning}-${index}`}>{warning}</li>
  722:             ))}
  723:           </ul>
  724:         </div>
  725:       )}
  726: 
  727:       <AboutSuggestions
  728:         suggestions={suggestions}
  729:         onAccept={handleAcceptSuggestion}
  730:         onEdit={handleEditSuggestion}
  731:         onRegenerate={handleGenerate}
  732:         onDismiss={handleDismissSuggestions}
  733:         isGenerating={isGenerating}
  734:       />

  736:       <footer className="portfolio-about-notice">
  737:         <span aria-hidden="true">âœ¦</span>

  742:         </p>

   35: function getExternalUrl(value) {

   37: 
   38:   if (!normalizedValue) {
   39:     return "";
   40:   }
   41:

   44:     normalizedValue.startsWith("https://")
   45:   ) {
   46:     return normalizedValue;
   47:   }
   48: 
   49:   return `https://${normalizedValue}`;
   50: }

    1: import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
    2: 
    3: import { API_ENDPOINTS } from "../../../../../config/api.js";
    4: 
    5: import { buildSelectedProfile } from "../../../../../services/Portfolio/profileSelectionUtils.js";
    6: 
    7: import {
    8:   getPortfolioStyleOption,
    9:   normalizePortfolioStyle,
   10: } from "../../../../../services/Portfolio/portfolioStyleUtils.js";
   11: 
   12: import "./PortfolioTaglineGenerator.css";
   13: 
   14: function getText(value) {
   15:   return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
   16: }
   17: 
   18: function getArray(value) {
   19:   return Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
   20: }
   21: 
   22: function getSkillName(skill) {
   23:   if (typeof skill === "string") {
   24:     return skill.trim();
   25:   }
   26: 
   27:   return getText(skill?.name) || getText(skill?.value) || getText(skill?.label);
   28: }
   29: 
   30: function createFingerprint(context) {
   31:   const value = JSON.stringify(context);
   32: 
   33:   let hash = 0;
   34: 
   35:   for (let index = 0; index < value.length; index += 1) {
   36:     hash = (hash << 5) - hash + value.charCodeAt(index);
   37: 
   38:     hash |= 0;
   39:   }
   40: 
   41:   return `portfolio-tagline-${Math.abs(hash).toString(36)}`;
   42: }
   43: 
   44: function normalizeSuggestions(responseData) {
   45:   const suggestions = Array.isArray(responseData?.suggestions)
   46:     ? responseData.suggestions
   47:     : [];
   48: 
   49:   return suggestions
   50:     .map((suggestion, index) => ({
   51:       id: suggestion?.id || `tagline-${index + 1}`,
   52: 
   53:       label: suggestion?.label || `Option ${index + 1}`,
   54: 
   55:       text: getText(suggestion?.text || suggestion?.summary),
   56:     }))
   57:     .filter((suggestion) => suggestion.text)
   58:     .slice(0, 3);
   59: }
   60: 
   61: function PortfolioTaglineGenerator({
   62:   profile = {},
   63:   portfolioDraft = {},
   64:   tagline = "",
   65:   taglineMeta = {},
   66:   onChange,
   67: }) {
   68:   const [suggestions, setSuggestions] = useState([]);
   69: 
   70:   const [status, setStatus] = useState("idle");
   71: 
   72:   const [error, setError] = useState("");
   73: 
   74:   const context = useMemo(() => {
   75:     const selectedProfile = buildSelectedProfile(
   76:       profile,
   77:       portfolioDraft.profileSelections || [],
   78:     );
   79: 
   80:     const portfolioStyle = normalizePortfolioStyle(
   81:       portfolioDraft.heroSettings?.portfolioStyle,
   82:     );
   83: 
   84:     return {
   85:       documentType: "portfolio",
   86:       generationPurpose: "tagline",
   87: 
   88:       targetRole: "",
   89: 
   90:       template: portfolioStyle,
   91: 
   92:       professionalTitle: selectedProfile.professionalTitles?.[0]?.name || "",
   93: 
   94:       skills: getArray(portfolioDraft.skills).map(getSkillName).filter(Boolean),
   95: 
   96:       experiences: getArray(portfolioDraft.experiences),
   97: 
   98:       projects: getArray(portfolioDraft.projects),
   99: 
  100:       education: getArray(portfolioDraft.education),
  101: 
  102:       certifications: getArray(portfolioDraft.certifications),
  103: 
  104:       trainings: getArray(portfolioDraft.trainings),
  105: 
  106:       interests: getArray(portfolioDraft.interests),
  107: 
  108:       professionalGoals: getText(portfolioDraft.professionalGoals),
  109: 
  110:       existingSummary: tagline,
  111: 
  112:       generationRules: {
  113:         useOnlyProvidedFacts: true,
  114:         doNotInventQualifications: true,
  115:         doNotInventMetrics: true,
  116:         numberOfSuggestions: 3,
  117:         recommendedWords: "8â€“20 words",
  118:       },
  119:     };
  120:   }, [profile, portfolioDraft, tagline]);
  121: 
  122:   const fingerprint = useMemo(() => createFingerprint(context), [context]);
  123: 
  124:   const isGenerating = status === "loading";
  125: 
  126:   const canGenerate = Boolean(
  127:     context.professionalTitle ||
  128:     context.skills.length ||
  129:     context.experiences.length ||
  130:     context.projects.length,
  131:   );
  132: 
  133:   const isOutdated =
  134:     taglineMeta?.source === "ai" &&
  135:     Boolean(taglineMeta.contextFingerprint) &&
  136:     taglineMeta.contextFingerprint !== fingerprint;
  137: 
  138:   const handleGenerate = async () => {
  139:     if (!canGenerate || isGenerating) {
  140:       return;
  141:     }
  142: 
  143:     try {
  144:       setStatus("loading");
  145:       setError("");
  146: 
  147:       const response = await fetch(API_ENDPOINTS.generateResumeSummary, {
  148:         method: "POST",
  149: 
  150:         headers: {
  151:           "Content-Type": "application/json",
  152:         },
  153: 
  154:         body: JSON.stringify(context),
  155:       });
  156: 
  157:       const responseData = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
  158: 
  159:       if (!response.ok) {
  160:         throw new Error(responseData.message || "Unable to generate taglines.");
  161:       }
  162: 
  163:       const generatedSuggestions = normalizeSuggestions(responseData);
  164: 
  165:       if (generatedSuggestions.length !== 3) {
  166:         throw new Error("The AI did not return three usable taglines.");
  167:       }
  168: 
  169:       setSuggestions(generatedSuggestions);
  170: 
  171:       setStatus("success");
  172:     } catch (generationError) {
  173:       console.error("Unable to generate portfolio taglines:", generationError);
  174: 
  175:       setSuggestions([]);
  176:       setStatus("error");
  177: 
  178:       setError(
  179:         generationError.message || "The taglines could not be generated.",
  180:       );
  181:     }
  182:   };
  183: 
  184:   const handleAccept = (suggestion) => {
  185:     onChange?.({
  186:       tagline: suggestion.text,
  187: 
  188:       taglineMeta: {
  189:         source: "ai",
  190:         status: "accepted",
  191:         generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  192:         contextFingerprint: fingerprint,
  193:         isStale: false,
  194:       },
  195:     });
  196: 
  197:     setSuggestions([]);
  198:     setStatus("idle");
  199:     setError("");
  200:   };
  201: 
  202:   const handleDismiss = () => {
  203:     setSuggestions([]);
  204:     setStatus("idle");
  205:     setError("");
  206:   };
  207: 
  208:   const selectedStyle = getPortfolioStyleOption(context.template);
  209: 
  210:   return (
  211:     <section className="portfolio-tagline-generator">
  212:       <header>
  213:         <div>
  214:           <span>AI Assistance</span>
  215: 
  216:           <h5>Generate a Tagline</h5>
  217: 
  218:           <p>
  219:             Generate three 8â€“20-word taglines using your{" "}
  220:             {selectedStyle.label.toLowerCase()} style and saved professional
  221:             information. <br/> Complete your Profile, Projects, Experience, Education, Skills, Certifications and training sections first for the best results.
  222:           </p>
  223:         </div>
  224: 
  225:         <button
  226:           type="button"
  227:           onClick={handleGenerate}

  242:         </p>
  243:       )}
  244:

  246:         <p className="portfolio-tagline-help">
  247:           Select a professional title or add skills, experience, or projects

  249:         </p>

   21:     return crypto.randomUUID();
   22:   }
   23: 
   24:   return `profile-selection-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()

   29: function createSelection({ category, itemId, pictureUsage = "" }) {
   30:   return {

   33:     itemId,

   46: function ProfileInformationSelector({ profile, selections = [], onChange }) {
   47:   const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState("");
   48: 
   49:   const [selectedItemId, setSelectedItemId] = useState("");
   50: 
   51:   const [selectedPictureUsage, setSelectedPictureUsage] = useState("");
   52: 
   53:   const [editingSelectionId, setEditingSelectionId] = useState(null);
   54: 
   55:   const [error, setError] = useState("");
   56: 
   57:   /*
   58:    * =========================================
   59:    * Derived Information
   60:    * =========================================
   61:    */
   62: 
   63:   const isPictureCategory = selectedCategory === "profilePictures";
   64: 
   65:   const availableItems = useMemo(
   66:     () => getProfileSelectionOptions(profile, selectedCategory),
   67:     [profile, selectedCategory],
   68:   );
   69: 
   70:   const selectedPictureOption = useMemo(
   71:     () => availableItems.find((option) => option.id === selectedItemId) || null,
   72:     [availableItems, selectedItemId],
   73:   );
   74: 
   75:   const isEditing = Boolean(editingSelectionId);
   76: 
   77:   const hasAvailableInformation = availableItems.length > 0;
   78: 
   79:   const canChoosePictureUsage = isPictureCategory && hasAvailableInformation;
   80: 
   81:   const canChoosePictureFile =
   82:     isPictureCategory &&
   83:     hasAvailableInformation &&
   84:     Boolean(selectedPictureUsage);
   85: 
   86:   /*
   87:    * =========================================
   88:    * Form Reset
   89:    * =========================================
   90:    */
   91: 
   92:   const resetEditor = () => {
   93:     setSelectedCategory("");
   94:     setSelectedItemId("");
   95:     setSelectedPictureUsage("");
   96:     setEditingSelectionId(null);
   97:     setError("");
   98:   };
   99: 
  100:   /*
  101:    * =========================================
  102:    * Category Change
  103:    * =========================================
  104:    */
  105: 
  106:   const handleCategoryChange = (event) => {
  107:     setSelectedCategory(event.target.value);
  108: 
  109:     setSelectedItemId("");
  110:     setSelectedPictureUsage("");
  111:     setError("");
  112:   };
  113: 
  114:   /*
  115:    * =========================================
  116:    * Duplicate Detection
  117:    * =========================================
  118:    */
  119: 
  120:   const isDuplicateSelection = ({ category, itemId, pictureUsage = "" }) => {
  121:     return selections.some((selection) => {
  122:       if (selection.id === editingSelectionId) {
  123:         return false;
  124:       }
  125: 
  126:       if (category === "profilePictures") {
  127:         return (
  128:           selection.category === category &&
  129:           selection.itemId === itemId &&
  130:           selection.pictureUsage === pictureUsage
  131:         );
  132:       }
  133: 
  134:       return selection.category === category && selection.itemId === itemId;
  135:     });
  136:   };
  137: 
  138:   /*
  139:    * =========================================
  140:    * Submit
  141:    * =========================================
  142:    */
  143: 
  144:   const handleSubmit = (event) => {
  145:     event.preventDefault();
  146: 
  147:     if (!selectedCategory) {
  148:       setError("Choose an information type.");
  149: 
  150:       return;
  151:     }
  152: 
  153:     if (isPictureCategory && !selectedPictureUsage) {
  154:       setError("Choose where the picture will be used.");
  155: 
  156:       return;
  157:     }
  158: 
  159:     if (!selectedItemId) {
  160:       setError(
  161:         isPictureCategory
  162:           ? "Choose an uploaded picture."
  163:           : "Choose the information to include.",
  164:       );
  165: 
  166:       return;
  167:     }
  168:

  170:       category: selectedCategory,
  171:       itemId: selectedItemId,
  172: 
  173:       pictureUsage: isPictureCategory ? selectedPictureUsage : "",
  174:     };
  175: 
  176:     if (isDuplicateSelection(selectionData)) {
  177:       setError("This information has already been added.");
  178: 
  179:       return;
  180:     }

  184:         currentSelections.map((selection) =>
  185:           selection.id === editingSelectionId

  189:               }
  190:             : selection,
  191:         ),
  192:       );
  193:     } else {
  194:       onChange?.((currentSelections = []) => [
  195:         ...currentSelections,
  196:         createSelection(selectionData),

   34: function readPortfolioPreview() {

   37:     !window.sessionStorage
   38:   ) {
   39:     return {
   40:       portfolio: null,
   41:       error:
   42:         "Portfolio preview storage is unavailable in this browser.",

   55:

   57:       portfolio: null,

   60:     };
   61:   }

   68:     };

   78:       };

   64:       if (
   65:         currentValue === null ||
   66:         currentValue === undefined ||
   67:         typeof currentValue !== "object"
   68:       ) {
   69:         return undefined;
   70:       }
   71: 
   72:       return currentValue[fieldName];
   73:     }, source);

   78:     return item.trim();
   79:   }
   80: 
   81:   for (const field of fields) {
   82:     const value = field.includes(".")
   83:       ? getNestedValue(item, field)
   84:       : item?.[field];
   85: 
   86:     if (typeof value === "string" && value.trim()) {
   87:       return value.trim();
   88:     }
   89:   }

  486:  * =========================================
  487:  * Portfolio Project Entry
  488:  * =========================================
  489:  */
  490: 
  491: function PortfolioProjectEntry({ project }) {
  492:   const featuredMedia = useMemo(
  493:     () => getProjectFeaturedMedia(project),
  494:     [project],
  495:   );
  496: 
  497:   const [mediaUrl, setMediaUrl] = useState("");
  498:   const [mediaError, setMediaError] = useState(false);
  499: 
  500:   useEffect(() => {
  501:     let isActive = true;
  502:     let createdUrl = "";
  503: 
  504:     setMediaUrl("");
  505:     setMediaError(false);
  506: 
  507:     if (!featuredMedia) {
  508:       return undefined;
  509:     }
  510: 
  511:     resolveProjectAssetUrl({
  512:       projectId: project?.id,
  513:       asset: featuredMedia,
  514:       kind: "media",
  515:     })
  516:       .then((url) => {
  517:         if (!url) {
  518:           if (isActive) {
  519:             setMediaError(true);
  520:           }
  521:           return;
  522:         }
  523: 
  524:         if (isActive) {
  525:           createdUrl = url;
  526:           setMediaUrl(url);
  527:         } else {
  528:           revokeProjectAssetUrl(url);
  529:         }
  530:       })
  531:       .catch((error) => {
  532:         if (isActive) {
  533:           console.error("Failed to load Portfolio featured media:", error);
  534:           setMediaError(true);
  535:         }
  536:       });
  537: 
  538:     return () => {
  539:       isActive = false;
  540: 
  541:       if (createdUrl) {
  542:         revokeProjectAssetUrl(createdUrl);
  543:       }
  544:     };
  545:   }, [
  546:     project?.id,
  547:     featuredMedia?.id,
  548:     featuredMedia?.storageKey,
  549:     featuredMedia?.storageProvider,
  550:     featuredMedia?.backendAssetId,
  551:     featuredMedia?.externalUrl,
  552:   ]);
  553: 
  554:   const title = project?.title || "Untitled Project";
  555: 
  556:   const organizationName =
  557:     project?.organization?.name || project?.organization?.clientName || "";
  558: 
  559:   const summary =
  560:     project?.presentation?.shortSummary ||
  561:     project?.solution?.overview ||
  562:     project?.problem?.statement ||
  563:     "";
  564: 
  565:   const liveUrl =
  566:     project?.links?.liveUrl ||
  567:     project?.links?.caseStudyUrl ||
  568:     project?.links?.repositoryUrl ||
  569:     "";
  570: 
  571:   const technologies = Array.isArray(project?.technologies)
  572:     ? project.technologies.filter((technology) => technology?.name).slice(0, 6)
  573:     : [];
  574: 
  575:   const skillCount = Array.isArray(project?.skillRelationships)
  576:     ? project.skillRelationships.length
  577:     : 0;
  578: 
  579:   const isVideo =
  580:     featuredMedia?.type === "video" ||
  581:     featuredMedia?.mimeType?.startsWith("video/");
  582: 
  583:   return (
  584:     <article className="portfolio-view-project" role="listitem">
  585:       <div className="portfolio-view-project-media">
  586:         {mediaUrl && !mediaError && isVideo && (
  587:           <video
  588:             src={mediaUrl}
  589:             muted
  590:             playsInline
  591:             preload="metadata"
  592:             onError={() => setMediaError(true)}
  593:             aria-label={`Video preview for ${title}`}
  594:           />
  595:         )}
  596: 
  597:         {mediaUrl && !mediaError && !isVideo && (
  598:           <img
  599:             src={mediaUrl}
  600:             alt={
  601:               featuredMedia?.altText ||
  602:               featuredMedia?.caption ||
  603:               featuredMedia?.name ||
  604:               `${title} preview`
  605:             }
  606:             onError={() => setMediaError(true)}
  607:           />
  608:         )}
  609: 
  610:         {(!mediaUrl || mediaError) && (
  611:           <div className="portfolio-view-project-placeholder">
  612:             <small>Project</small>
  613: 
  614:             <strong>{title.slice(0, 1).toUpperCase()}</strong>
  615:           </div>
  616:         )}
  617: 
  618:         {project?.presentation?.isFeatured && (
  619:           <span className="portfolio-view-project-featured">Featured</span>
  620:         )}
  621:       </div>
  622: 
  623:       <div className="portfolio-view-project-content">
  624:         <div className="portfolio-view-project-labels">
  625:           <span>{getProjectCategoryLabel(project?.category)}</span>
  626: 
  627:           <span>
  628:             {getProjectLifecycleStatusLabel(project?.lifecycleStatus)}
  629:           </span>
  630:         </div>
  631: 
  632:         <header>
  633:           <h3>{title}</h3>
  634: 
  635:           <p>
  636:             {project?.role || "Role not specified"}
  637: 
  638:             {organizationName && ` Â· ${organizationName}`}
  639:           </p>
  640:         </header>
  641: 
  642:         {summary && <p className="portfolio-view-project-summary">{summary}</p>}
  643: 
  644:         <div className="portfolio-view-project-details">
  645:           {project?.dates && (
  646:             <span>
  647:               <small>Timeline</small>
  648: 
  649:               <strong>{getProjectDateRange(project)}</strong>
  650:             </span>
  651:           )}
  652: 
  653:           <span>
  654:             <small>Ownership</small>
  655: 
  656:             <strong>{getProjectOwnershipLabel(project?.ownership)}</strong>

  678:           </div>
  679:         )}
  680:

  683:             className="portfolio-view-project-link"
  684:             href={getExternalUrl(liveUrl)}
  685:             target="_blank"
  686:             rel="noopener noreferrer"
  687:           >
  688:             View Project
  689:             <span aria-hidden="true">â†—</span>
  690:           </a>

  694:   );
  695: }

   36:   if (

   39:   ) {
   40:     return `${prefix}-${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
   41:   }
   42:

   44: }

  189: function normalizeExternalUrl(value) {
  190:   const trimmedValue = getText(value);
  191: 
  192:   if (!trimmedValue) {
  193:     return "";
  194:   }
  195: 
  196:   if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(trimmedValue)) {
  197:     return trimmedValue;
  198:   }
  199: 
  200:   return `https://${trimmedValue}`;
  201: }

  203: function cleanProfessionalTitles(titles = []) {
  204:   const usedNames = new Set();
  205: 
  206:   return titles.reduce((cleanedTitles, title) => {
  207:     const name = getText(title?.name);
  208: 
  209:     /*
  210:      * Preserve archived records even if they are
  211:      * not currently shown by the editor.
  212:      */
  213: 
  214:     if (title?.status === "archived") {
  215:       cleanedTitles.push(title);
  216:       return cleanedTitles;
  217:     }
  218: 
  219:     if (!name) {
  220:       return cleanedTitles;
  221:     }
  222: 
  223:     const comparisonName = name.normalize("NFKC").toLocaleLowerCase();
  224: 
  225:     if (usedNames.has(comparisonName)) {
  226:       return cleanedTitles;
  227:     }
  228: 
  229:     usedNames.add(comparisonName);
  230: 
  231:     cleanedTitles.push({
  232:       ...title,
  233:       name,
  234:       status: title.status || "active",
  235:       updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  236:     });
  237: 
  238:     return cleanedTitles;
  239:   }, []);
  240: }
  241: 
  242: function cleanContactItems(items = [], category) {
  243:   const usedValues = new Set();
  244: 
  245:   return items.reduce((cleanedItems, item) => {
  246:     if (item?.status === "archived") {
  247:       cleanedItems.push(item);
  248:       return cleanedItems;
  249:     }
  250: 
  251:     let value = getText(item?.value);
  252: 
  253:     if (!value) {
  254:       return cleanedItems;
  255:     }
  256: 
  257:     if (category === "websites" || category === "socialLinks") {
  258:       value = normalizeExternalUrl(value);
  259:     }
  260: 
  261:     const comparisonValue = value.normalize("NFKC").toLocaleLowerCase();
  262: 
  263:     if (usedValues.has(comparisonValue)) {
  264:       return cleanedItems;
  265:     }
  266: 
  267:     usedValues.add(comparisonValue);
  268: 
  269:     cleanedItems.push({
  270:       ...item,
  271:       type:
  272:         item.type ||
  273:         CONTACT_INFORMATION_CONFIG[category]?.defaultType ||
  274:         "other",
  275:       value,
  276:       description: getText(item.description),
  277:       status: item.status || "active",
  278:       updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  279:     });
  280:

  282:   }, []);

  290:       cleanedPictures.push(picture);
  291: 
  292:       return cleanedPictures;
  293:     }
  294: 
  295:     const imageUrl = getText(
  296:       picture?.imageUrl || picture?.fileUrl || picture?.url,
  297:     );
  298: 
  299:     const useDefaultAvatar = picture?.useDefaultAvatar === true;
  300: 
  301:     /*
  302:      * An untouched empty editor row is discarded.
  303:      * A deliberately selected default avatar is saved.
  304:      */
  305: 
  306:     if (!imageUrl && !useDefaultAvatar) {
  307:       return cleanedPictures;
  308:     }
  309: 
  310:     const comparisonValue = useDefaultAvatar
  311:       ? `default-avatar-${picture.id}`
  312:       : getText(picture.fileName).toLocaleLowerCase() || imageUrl;
  313: 
  314:     if (usedPictures.has(comparisonValue)) {
  315:       return cleanedPictures;
  316:     }
  317: 
  318:     usedPictures.add(comparisonValue);
  319: 
  320:     cleanedPictures.push({
  321:       ...picture,
  322: 
  323:       imageUrl: useDefaultAvatar ? "" : imageUrl,
  324: 
  325:       storageKey: useDefaultAvatar ? "" : getText(picture.storageKey),
  326: 
  327:       fileName: useDefaultAvatar ? "" : getText(picture.fileName),
  328: 
  329:       fileType: useDefaultAvatar ? "" : getText(picture.fileType),
  330: 
  331:       fileSize: useDefaultAvatar ? 0 : Number(picture.fileSize) || 0,
  332: 
  333:       useDefaultAvatar,
  334: 
  335:       description: getText(picture.description),
  336: 
  337:       status: picture.status || "active",
  338: 
  339:       updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  340:     });
  341: 
  342:     return cleanedPictures;
  343:   }, []);
  344: }
  345: 
  346: function reindexCollection(items = []) {
  347:   return items.map((item, index) => ({
  348:     ...item,
  349:     order: index,
  350:   }));
  351: }

   29: function formatFileSize(fileSize) {
   30:   const numericFileSize = Number(fileSize);
   31: 
   32:   if (!Number.isFinite(numericFileSize) || numericFileSize <= 0) {
   33:     return "";
   34:   }
   35: 
   36:   if (numericFileSize < 1024) {
   37:     return `${numericFileSize} bytes`;
   38:   }
   39: 
   40:   if (numericFileSize < 1024 * 1024) {
   41:     return `${(numericFileSize / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
   42:   }
   43: 
   44:   return `${(numericFileSize / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} MB`;
   45: }

  279:             />

   36: function getArray(value) {
   37:   return Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
   38: }
   39: 
   40: function getText(value) {
   41:   return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
   42: }
   43: 
   44: function formatValue(value) {
   45:   const normalizedValue = getText(value);
   46: 
   47:   if (!normalizedValue) {
   48:     return "";
   49:   }
   50: 
   51:   return normalizedValue
   52:     .replace(/[-_]+/g, " ")
   53:     .replace(/\b\w/g, (character) => character.toUpperCase());
   54: }
   55: 
   56: function formatFileSize(value) {
   57:   const size = Number(value);
   58: 
   59:   if (!Number.isFinite(size) || size <= 0) {
   60:     return "";
   61:   }
   62: 
   63:   if (size < 1024) {
   64:     return `${size} B`;
   65:   }
   66: 
   67:   if (size < 1024 * 1024) {
   68:     return `${(size / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
   69:   }
   70: 
   71:   return `${(size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} MB`;
   72: }

  964: function MarkdownTextPreview({ url }) {
  965:   const [content, setContent] = useState("");
  966:   const [error, setError] = useState("");
  967: 
  968:   useEffect(() => {
  969:     const controller = new AbortController();
  970: 
  971:     setContent("");
  972:     setError("");
  973: 
  974:     fetch(url, { signal: controller.signal })
  975:       .then((response) => {
  976:         if (!response.ok) {
  977:           throw new Error("Unable to load Markdown document.");
  978:         }
  979: 
  980:         return response.text();
  981:       })
  982:       .then(setContent)
  983:       .catch((loadError) => {
  984:         if (loadError.name !== "AbortError") {
  985:           setError("Markdown preview unavailable.");
  986:         }
  987:       });
  988: 
  989:     return () => controller.abort();
  990:   }, [url]);
  991: 
  992:   if (error) {
  993:     return <p role="alert">{error}</p>;
  994:   }
  995: 
  996:   return (
  997:     <pre style={{
  998:       whiteSpace: "pre-wrap",
  999:       overflowWrap: "anywhere",
 1000:       padding: "1rem",
 1001:       overflow: "auto",
 1002:       width: "100%",
 1003:       maxHeight: "70vh",
 1004:     }}>
 1005:       {content}
 1006:     </pre>
 1007:   );
 1008: }

 1090: 
 1091:   const title =
 1092:     documentRecord?.name || documentRecord?.fileName || "Project Document";
 1093:

 1104:         }
 1105:       }}
 1106:     >
 1107:       <section
 1108:         className="project-detail-document-panel"

 1111:         aria-labelledby="project-detail-document-title"
 1112:       >
 1113:         <header>
 1114:           <div>

  148:     const acceptedUploads = [];
  149: 
  150:     let nextError = "";
  151: 
  152:     files.slice(0, availableSlots).forEach((file) => {
  153:       if (!isSupportedProjectDocument(file)) {
  154:         nextError =
  155:           "Upload a supported PDF, Word, PowerPoint, JPG, PNG, or WebP document.";
  156: 
  157:         return;
  158:       }
  159: 
  160:       if (!isProjectDocumentWithinSizeLimit(file)) {
  161:         nextError =
  162:           "Each supporting document must be non-empty and 20 MB or smaller.";
  163: 
  164:         return;
  165:       }
  166: 
  167:       const normalizedFileName = getText(file.name).toLocaleLowerCase();
  168: 
  169:       const duplicate = [
  170:         ...activeDocuments,
  171:         ...uploads,
  172:         ...acceptedUploads,
  173:       ].some((item) => {
  174:         const existingFileName = getText(
  175:           item.file?.name || item.fileName || item.name,
  176:         ).toLocaleLowerCase();
  177: 
  178:         return existingFileName && existingFileName === normalizedFileName;
  179:       });
  180: 
  181:       if (duplicate) {
  182:         nextError = `"${file.name}" has already been added.`;
  183: 
  184:         return;
  185:       }
  186: 
  187:       acceptedUploads.push({
  188:         assetId: createProjectId("project-document"),
  189: 
  190:         file,
  191: 
  192:         name: file.name,
  193: 
  194:         description: "",
  195: 
  196:         documentType: "supporting-evidence",
  197: 
  198:         visibility: "private",
  199: 
  200:         status: "active",
  201:       });
  202:     });
  203: 
  204:     if (files.length > availableSlots) {
  205:       nextError = `Only ${availableSlots} additional ${
  206:         availableSlots === 1 ? "document" : "documents"
  207:       } can be added.`;
  208:     }
  209: 
  210:     if (acceptedUploads.length > 0) {
  211:       onUploadsChange?.([...uploads, ...acceptedUploads]);
  212:     }
  213: 
  214:     setLocalError(nextError);
  215: 
  216:     event.target.value = "";
  217:   };
  218: 
  219:   /*
  220:    * =========================================
  221:    * Document Updates
  222:    * =========================================
  223:    */
  224: 
  225:   const updateExistingDocument = (documentId, field, value) => {
  226:     onChange?.(
  227:       documents.map((document) =>
  228:         document.id === documentId
  229:           ? {
  230:               ...document,
  231:               [field]: value,
  232:             }
  233:           : document,
  234:       ),
  235:     );
  236: 
  237:     setLocalError("");
  238:   };
  239: 
  240:   const updateStagedDocument = (assetId, field, value) => {
  241:     onUploadsChange?.(
  242:       uploads.map((upload) =>
  243:         upload.assetId === assetId
  244:           ? {
  245:               ...upload,
  246:               [field]: value,
  247:             }
  248:           : upload,
  249:       ),
  250:     );
  251: 
  252:     setLocalError("");
  253:   };
  254: 
  255:   /*
  256:    * =========================================
  257:    * Removal
  258:    * =========================================
  259:    */
  260: 
  261:   const removeExistingDocument = (document) => {
  262:     onChange?.(documents.filter((candidate) => candidate.id !== document.id));
  263: 
  264:     if (document.storageKey) {
  265:       onRemoveStoredAsset?.(document.storageKey);
  266:     }
  267: 
  268:     if (previewRef.current?.documentId === document.id) {
  269:       closePreview();
  270:     }
  271: 
  272:     setLocalError("");
  273:   };
  274: 
  275:   const removeStagedDocument = (upload) => {
  276:     onUploadsChange?.(
  277:       uploads.filter((item) => item.assetId !== upload.assetId),
  278:     );
  279: 
  280:     if (previewRef.current?.documentId === upload.assetId) {
  281:       closePreview();
  282:     }
  283: 
  284:     setLocalError("");
  285:   };
  286: 
  287:   /*
  288:    * =========================================

  294:     revokePreviewUrl(previewRef.current);
  295: 
  296:     previewRef.current = previewValue;
  297: 
  298:     setPreview(previewValue);
  299:   };
  300: 
  301:   const handleViewStoredDocument = async (document) => {
  302:     const requestId = previewRequestRef.current + 1;
  303: 
  304:     previewRequestRef.current = requestId;
  305: 
  306:     setLocalError("");
  307:

  309:       let url = "";
  310:       let ownsObjectUrl = false;
  311: 
  312:       url = await resolveProjectAssetUrl({
  313:           projectId,
  314:           asset: document,
  315:           kind: "document",
  316:         });
  317: 
  318:         ownsObjectUrl = Boolean(url && url.startsWith("blob:"));
  319: 
  320:       if (requestId !== previewRequestRef.current || !mountedRef.current) {
  321:         if (ownsObjectUrl) {
  322:           releaseProjectAssetUrl(url);
  323:         }
  324: 
  325:         return;
  326:       }
  327: 
  328:       if (!url) {
  329:         throw new Error("The document does not have a preview address.");
  330:       }
  331:

  333:         documentId: document.id,
  334:         title: getDocumentLabel(document),
  335:         url,
  336:         mimeType: document.mimeType || "",
  337:         ownsObjectUrl,
  338:       });
  339:     } catch (caughtError) {
  340:       if (requestId !== previewRequestRef.current || !mountedRef.current) {
  341:         return;
  342:       }
  343: 
  344:       setLocalError(
  345:         caughtError?.publicMessage ||
  346:           caughtError?.message ||
  347:           "The selected Project document could not be opened.",
  348:       );
  349:     }
  350:   };
  351: 
  352:   const handleViewStagedDocument = (upload) => {
  353:     if (
  354:       !upload?.file ||
  355:       typeof URL === "undefined" ||
  356:       typeof URL.createObjectURL !== "function"
  357:     ) {
  358:       setLocalError("The selected Project document cannot be previewed.");
  359: 
  360:       return;
  361:     }
  362: 
  363:     previewRequestRef.current += 1;
  364: 
  365:     const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(upload.file);
  366: 
  367:     showPreview({
  368:       documentId: upload.assetId,
  369:       title: getDocumentLabel(upload),
  370:       url: objectUrl,
  371:       mimeType: upload.file.type || "",
  372:       ownsObjectUrl: true,
  373:     });
  374: 
  375:     setLocalError("");
  376:   };
  377: 
  378:   /*
  379:    * =========================================

  381:    * =========================================

  411:       >
  412:         <input
  413:           type="file"
  414:           multiple

  420:               PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumDocuments

  611:  * =========================================
  612:  * Document Preview
  613:  * =========================================
  614:  */
  615: 
  616: function MarkdownTextPreview({ url }) {
  617:   const [content, setContent] = useState("");
  618:   const [error, setError] = useState("");
  619: 
  620:   useEffect(() => {
  621:     const controller = new AbortController();
  622: 
  623:     setContent("");
  624:     setError("");
  625: 
  626:     fetch(url, { signal: controller.signal })
  627:       .then((response) => {
  628:         if (!response.ok) {
  629:           throw new Error("Unable to load Markdown document.");
  630:         }
  631: 
  632:         return response.text();
  633:       })
  634:       .then(setContent)
  635:       .catch((loadError) => {
  636:         if (loadError.name !== "AbortError") {
  637:           setError("Markdown preview unavailable.");
  638:         }
  639:       });
  640: 
  641:     return () => controller.abort();
  642:   }, [url]);
  643: 
  644:   if (error) {
  645:     return <p role="alert">{error}</p>;
  646:   }
  647: 
  648:   return (
  649:     <pre style={{
  650:       whiteSpace: "pre-wrap",
  651:       overflowWrap: "anywhere",
  652:       padding: "1rem",
  653:       overflow: "auto",
  654:       width: "100%",
  655:       maxHeight: "70vh",
  656:     }}>
  657:       {content}
  658:     </pre>
  659:   );
  660: }
  661: function DocumentPreview({ preview, onClose }) {
  662:   useEffect(() => {
  663:     const handleKeyDown = (event) => {
  664:       if (event.key === "Escape") {
  665:         onClose();
  666:       }
  667:     };
  668: 
  669:     window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  670: 
  671:     return () => {
  672:       window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  673:     };
  674:   }, [onClose]);
  675: 
  676:   const isImage = preview.mimeType.startsWith("image/");
  677:   const isMarkdown = preview.mimeType === "text/markdown" || /\.md$/i.test(preview.title);
  678: 
  679:   return (
  680:     <div
  681:       className="project-document-preview-backdrop"
  682:       role="presentation"
  683:       onMouseDown={(event) => {
  684:         if (event.target === event.currentTarget) {
  685:           onClose();
  686:         }
  687:       }}
  688:     >
  689:       <section
  690:         className="project-document-preview"
  691:         role="dialog"
  692:         aria-modal="true"
  693:         aria-label={`Preview ${preview.title}`}
  694:       >
  695:         <header>
  696:           <div>
  697:             <small>Project Document</small>
  698: 
  699:             <h4>{preview.title}</h4>
  700:           </div>
  701: 
  702:           <button
  703:             type="button"
  704:             onClick={onClose}
  705:             aria-label="Close document preview"
  706:           >
  707:             Ã—
  708:           </button>
  709:         </header>
  710: 
  711:         <div className="project-document-preview-content">
  712:           {isImage ? (
  713:             <img src={preview.url} alt={preview.title} />
  714:           ) : isMarkdown ? (
  715:             <MarkdownTextPreview url={preview.url} />
  716:           ) : (
  717:             <iframe src={preview.url} title={preview.title} />
  718:           )}
  719:         </div>
  720: 
  721:         <footer>
  722:           <a href={preview.url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
  723:             Open in New Tab
  724:           </a>
  725: 
  726:           <a href={preview.url} download={preview.title}>
  727:             Download
  728:           </a>
  729:         </footer>
  730:       </section>
  731:     </div>
  732:   );
  733: }

  993: function FormSection({ label, title, description, children }) {
  994:   return (
  995:     <section className="project-form-section">
  996:       <header className="project-form-section-header">
  997:         <span aria-hidden="true" />
  998:         <div>
  999:           <small>{label}</small>
 1000:           <h3>{title}</h3>
 1001:           <p>{description}</p>
 1002:         </div>
 1003:       </header>
 1004:       {children}
 1005:     </section>
 1006:   );
 1007: }
 1008: 
 1009: function FormField({
 1010:   field,
 1011:   label,
 1012:   required = false,
 1013:   error = "",
 1014:   help = "",
 1015:   count = "",
 1016:   wide = false,
 1017:   children,
 1018: }) {
 1019:   return (
 1020:     <label
 1021:       className={
 1022:         "project-form-field " +
 1023:         (wide ? "project-form-wide " : "") +
 1024:         (error ? "project-form-field--error" : "")
 1025:       }
 1026:       data-field={field}
 1027:     >
 1028:       <span>
 1029:         <strong>
 1030:           {label}
 1031:           {required && <i aria-hidden="true"> *</i>}
 1032:         </strong>
 1033:         {count && <small>{count}</small>}
 1034:       </span>
 1035:       {children}
 1036:       {help && !error && <small className="project-form-help">{help}</small>}
 1037:       {error && (
 1038:         <small className="project-form-field-error" role="alert">
 1039:           {error}
 1040:         </small>
 1041:       )}
 1042:     </label>
 1043:   );
 1044: }
 1045: 
 1046: function SelectField({ id, field, label, value, options, onChange, ...props }) {
 1047:   return (
 1048:     <FormField field={field} label={label} {...props}>
 1049:       <select
 1050:         id={id}
 1051:         value={value}
 1052:         onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}
 1053:         disabled={props.disabled}
 1054:       >
 1055:         {options.map((option) => (
 1056:           <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>
 1057:             {option.label}
 1058:           </option>
 1059:         ))}
 1060:       </select>
 1061:     </FormField>
 1062:   );
 1063: }
 1064: 
 1065: function TextAreaField({
 1066:   field,
 1067:   label,
 1068:   value,
 1069:   limit,
 1070:   rows,
 1071:   onChange,
 1072:   ...props
 1073: }) {
 1074:   return (
 1075:     <FormField
 1076:       field={field}
 1077:       label={label}
 1078:       count={value.length + "/" + limit}
 1079:       wide
 1080:       {...props}
 1081:     >
 1082:       <textarea
 1083:         rows={rows}
 1084:         value={value}
 1085:         onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}
 1086:         maxLength={limit}
 1087:         placeholder={props.placeholder}
 1088:         disabled={props.disabled}
 1089:       />
 1090:     </FormField>
 1091:   );
 1092: }
 1093: 
 1094: function OrderedTextEditor({
 1095:   title,
 1096:   itemLabel,
 1097:   values = [],
 1098:   maximumItems,
 1099:   disabled,
 1100:   onChange,
 1101: }) {
 1102:   const add = () =>
 1103:     onChange([
 1104:       ...values,
 1105:       {
 1106:         id: createProjectId("project-" + itemLabel.toLowerCase()),
 1107:         text: "",
 1108:         order: values.length,
 1109:       },
 1110:     ]);
 1111:   const update = (index, value) =>
 1112:     onChange(
 1113:       values.map((item, itemIndex) =>
 1114:         itemIndex === index ? { ...item, text: value } : item,
 1115:       ),
 1116:     );
 1117:   const remove = (index) =>
 1118:     onChange(
 1119:       values
 1120:         .filter((_, itemIndex) => itemIndex !== index)
 1121:         .map((item, order) => ({ ...item, order })),
 1122:     );
 1123: 
 1124:   return (
 1125:     <div className="project-form-collection-editor">
 1126:       <header>
 1127:         <div>
 1128:           <h4>{title}</h4>
 1129:           <p>Add focused, outcome-oriented statements.</p>
 1130:         </div>
 1131:         <button
 1132:           type="button"
 1133:           onClick={add}
 1134:           disabled={disabled || values.length >= maximumItems}
 1135:         >
 1136:           Add {itemLabel}
 1137:         </button>
 1138:       </header>
 1139:       {values.map((item, index) => (
 1140:         <div className="project-form-ordered-row" key={item.id}>
 1141:           <span>{String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}</span>
 1142:           <textarea

 1309: function CollectionEditor({

   37:  * =========================================
   38:  * Featured Media Normalization
   39:  * =========================================
   40:  */
   41: 
   42: function normalizeFeaturedMedia(
   43:   media,
   44:   uploads,
   45:   preferredAssetId = "",
   46:   preferredSource = "",
   47: ) {
   48:   const existingMedia = Array.isArray(media) ? media : [];
   49: 
   50:   const stagedUploads = Array.isArray(uploads) ? uploads : [];
   51: 
   52:   let selectedSource = "";
   53:   let selectedId = "";
   54: 
   55:   if (
   56:     preferredSource === "stored" &&
   57:     existingMedia.some(
   58:       (item) => item.id === preferredAssetId && isPublicMedia(item),
   59:     )
   60:   ) {
   61:     selectedSource = "stored";
   62:     selectedId = preferredAssetId;
   63:   } else if (
   64:     preferredSource === "staged" &&
   65:     stagedUploads.some(
   66:       (item) => item.assetId === preferredAssetId && isPublicMedia(item),
   67:     )
   68:   ) {
   69:     selectedSource = "staged";
   70:     selectedId = preferredAssetId;
   71:   } else {
   72:     const existingFeatured = existingMedia.find(
   73:       (item) => item.isFeatured && isPublicMedia(item),
   74:     );
   75: 
   76:     const stagedFeatured = stagedUploads.find(
   77:       (item) => item.isFeatured && isPublicMedia(item),
   78:     );
   79: 
   80:     const fallbackExisting = existingMedia.find(isPublicMedia);
   81: 
   82:     const fallbackStaged = stagedUploads.find(isPublicMedia);
   83: 
   84:     if (existingFeatured) {
   85:       selectedSource = "stored";
   86:       selectedId = existingFeatured.id;
   87:     } else if (stagedFeatured) {
   88:       selectedSource = "staged";
   89:       selectedId = stagedFeatured.assetId;
   90:     } else if (fallbackExisting) {
   91:       selectedSource = "stored";
   92:       selectedId = fallbackExisting.id;
   93:     } else if (fallbackStaged) {
   94:       selectedSource = "staged";
   95:       selectedId = fallbackStaged.assetId;
   96:     }
   97:   }
   98: 
   99:   return {
  100:     media: existingMedia.map((item) => ({
  101:       ...item,
  102: 
  103:       isFeatured: selectedSource === "stored" && item.id === selectedId,
  104:     })),
  105: 
  106:     uploads: stagedUploads.map((item) => ({
  107:       ...item,
  108: 
  109:       isFeatured: selectedSource === "staged" && item.assetId === selectedId,
  110:     })),
  111: 
  112:     featuredId: selectedId,
  113:   };
  114: }

  122: function StoredMediaPreview({
  123:   projectId,
  124:   asset,
  125:   type,
  126:   name,

  131:   const storageProvider = asset?.storageProvider || "";
  132:   const backendAssetId = asset?.backendAssetId || "";
  133:   const [previewUrl, setPreviewUrl] = useState(externalUrl);
  134:

  136:

  138:     let isActive = true;
  139:     let objectUrl = "";

  144:

  146:       setPreviewUrl(externalUrl);
  147:       setPreviewError("");

  152:     setPreviewError("");

  166:

  169:           return;
  170:         }
  171: 
  172:         setPreviewUrl(url);
  173:       })
  174:       .catch((error) => {
  175:         if (!isActive) return;
  176:

  178: 
  179:         setPreviewError(

  185:

  187:       isActive = false;

  192:     };
  193:   }, [
  194:     projectId,

  196:     externalUrl,

  198:     backendAssetId,

  232: function StagedMediaPreview({ file, type, name, altText }) {

  234: 
  235:   useEffect(() => {
  236:     if (
  237:       !file ||

  242:

  247:

  249:

  251:       URL.revokeObjectURL(objectUrl);
  252:     };
  253:   }, [file]);
  254: 
  255:   if (!previewUrl) {
  256:     return (
  257:       <div className="project-media-preview-empty">Preview unavailable</div>

  274:     <img

  348: 
  349: function ProjectMediaEditor({
  350:   projectId,
  351:   media = [],
  352:   uploads = [],
  353:   featuredMediaId = "",
  354:   disabled = false,
  355:   error = "",
  356:   onChange,

  360: }) {
  361:   const [localError, setLocalError] = useState("");
  362: 
  363:   const activeMedia = useMemo(() => media.filter(isActiveMedia), [media]);
  364: 
  365:   const featuredId = useMemo(() => {
  366:     const storedSelectionExists = activeMedia.some(
  367:       (item) => item.id === featuredMediaId,

  369: 
  370:     const stagedSelectionExists = uploads.some(
  371:       (item) => item.assetId === featuredMediaId,

  374:     const preferredSource = storedSelectionExists

  381:       activeMedia,
  382:       uploads,
  383:       featuredMediaId,
  384:       preferredSource,
  385:     );
  386: 
  387:     return normalized.featuredId;
  388:   }, [activeMedia, uploads, featuredMediaId]);
  389: 
  390:   /*
  391:    * =========================================
  392:    * Commit Both Media Collections
  393:    * =========================================
  394:    */
  395: 
  396:   const commitCollections = (
  397:     nextMedia,
  398:     nextUploads,
  399:     preferredAssetId = "",
  400:     preferredSource = "",
  401:   ) => {

  404:       nextUploads,
  405:       preferredAssetId,
  406:       preferredSource,

  418:   /*
  419:    * =========================================
  420:    * File Selection
  421:    * =========================================
  422:    */
  423: 
  424:   const handleFileSelection = (event) => {
  425:     const files = Array.from(event.target.files || []);
  426:

  428:       PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumMedia - activeMedia.length - uploads.length;

  433:       );

  436: 
  437:       return;
  438:     }

  442:     let nextError = "";

  445:       if (!isSupportedProjectMedia(file)) {
  446:         nextError = "Upload JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4, or WebM files.";
  447: 
  448:         return;
  449:       }
  450: 
  451:       if (!isProjectMediaWithinSizeLimit(file)) {
  452:         nextError = file.type.startsWith("video/")
  453:           ? "Videos must be 150 MB or smaller and cannot be empty."
  454:           : "Images must be 12 MB or smaller and cannot be empty.";
  455: 
  456:         return;
  457:       }
  458: 
  459:       const normalizedFileName = getText(file.name).toLocaleLowerCase();
  460: 
  461:       const duplicate = [...activeMedia, ...uploads, ...acceptedUploads].some(
  462:         (item) => {
  463:           const existingFileName = getText(
  464:             item.file?.name || item.fileName || item.name,
  465:           ).toLocaleLowerCase();
  466: 
  467:           return existingFileName && existingFileName === normalizedFileName;
  468:         },
  469:       );
  470: 
  471:       if (duplicate) {
  472:         nextError = `"${file.name}" has already been added.`;
  473: 
  474:         return;
  475:       }

  477:       const isVideo = file.type.startsWith("video/");
  478: 
  479:       acceptedUploads.push({
  480:         assetId: createProjectId("project-media"),
  481: 
  482:         file,
  483:

  487: 
  488:         caption: "",

  491: 
  492:         visibility: "public",
  493: 
  494:         status: "active",
  495: 
  496:         isFeatured: false,
  497:       });
  498:     });
  499: 
  500:     if (files.length > availableSlots) {
  501:       nextError = `Only ${availableSlots} additional ${
  502:         availableSlots === 1 ? "media item" : "media items"
  503:       } can be added.`;
  504:     }
  505: 
  506:     if (acceptedUploads.length > 0) {
  507:       commitCollections(media, [...uploads, ...acceptedUploads]);
  508:     }

  510:     setLocalError(nextError);
  511: 
  512:     event.target.value = "";

  514:

  518:    * =========================================

  520:

  523:       item.id === mediaId
  524:         ? {
  525:             ...item,
  526:             [field]: value,
  527:           }

  542:       item.assetId === assetId
  543:         ? {
  544:             ...item,
  545:             [field]: value,
  546:           }
  547:         : item,

  571:       item.id === mediaId
  572:         ? {
  573:             ...item,
  574:             visibility,
  575:             isFeatured: visibility === "private" ? false : item.isFeatured,
  576:           }
  577:         : item,
  578:     );
  579: 
  580:     commitCollections(nextMedia, uploads);
  581:   };
  582:

  584:     const nextUploads = uploads.map((item) =>
  585:       item.assetId === assetId
  586:         ? {
  587:             ...item,

  589:             isFeatured: visibility === "private" ? false : item.isFeatured,
  590:           }
  591:         : item,
  592:     );

  606:     commitCollections(nextMedia, uploads);
  607: 
  608:     if (item.storageKey) {

  611:   };
  612: 
  613:   const removeStagedMedia = (assetId) => {
  614:     const nextUploads = uploads.filter((item) => item.assetId !== assetId);
  615: 
  616:     commitCollections(media, nextUploads);

  112: function getUserName(user) {
  113:   if (!user || typeof user !== "object") {
  114:     return "";
  115:   }
  116: 
  117:   const directName = [user.displayName, user.fullName, user.name].find(
  118:     (value) => typeof value === "string" && value.trim(),
  119:   );
  120: 
  121:   if (directName) {
  122:     return directName.trim();
  123:   }
  124: 
  125:   const combinedName = [user.firstName, user.lastName]
  126:     .filter((value) => typeof value === "string" && value.trim())
  127:     .map((value) => value.trim())
  128:     .join(" ");
  129: 
  130:   return combinedName;
  131: }

  133: function getUserEmail(user) {
  134:   return typeof user?.email === "string" ? user.email.trim().toLowerCase() : "";
  135: }

  137: /*
  138:  * =========================================
  139:  * Initial Form
  140:  * =========================================
  141:  */
  142: 
  143: function createInitialForm(user) {
  144:   return {
  145:     name: getUserName(user),
  146:     email: getUserEmail(user),
  147:     category: "",
  148:     subject: "",
  149:     message: "",
  150:     replyConsent: false,
  151:   };

  154: /*
  155:  * =========================================
  156:  * Validation
  157:  * =========================================
  158:  */
  159: 
  160: function validateContactForm(form) {
  161:   const errors = {};
  162: 
  163:   const name = form.name.trim();
  164:   const email = form.email.trim();
  165:   const subject = form.subject.trim();
  166:   const message = form.message.trim();
  167: 
  168:   if (!name) {
  169:     errors.name = "Enter your name.";
  170:   } else if (name.length > MAXIMUM_NAME_LENGTH) {
  171:     errors.name = `Name cannot contain more than ${MAXIMUM_NAME_LENGTH} characters.`;
  172:   }
  173: 
  174:   if (!email) {
  175:     errors.email = "Enter your email address.";
  176:   } else if (email.length > MAXIMUM_EMAIL_LENGTH) {
  177:     errors.email = "Email address is too long.";
  178:   } else if (!EMAIL_PATTERN.test(email)) {
  179:     errors.email = "Enter a valid email address.";
  180:   }
  181: 
  182:   if (!form.category) {
  183:     errors.category = "Select the type of request.";
  184:   }
  185: 
  186:   if (!subject) {
  187:     errors.subject = "Enter a short subject.";
  188:   } else if (subject.length > MAXIMUM_SUBJECT_LENGTH) {
  189:     errors.subject = `Subject cannot contain more than ${MAXIMUM_SUBJECT_LENGTH} characters.`;
  190:   }
  191: 
  192:   if (!message) {
  193:     errors.message = "Describe how we can help.";
  194:   } else if (message.length < 20) {
  195:     errors.message =
  196:       "Include at least 20 characters so the request can be understood.";
  197:   } else if (message.length > MAXIMUM_MESSAGE_LENGTH) {
  198:     errors.message = `Message cannot contain more than ${MAXIMUM_MESSAGE_LENGTH} characters.`;
  199:   }
  200: 
  201:   if (!form.replyConsent) {
  202:     errors.replyConsent =
  203:       "Confirm that we may use your email address to respond.";
  204:   }
  205: 
  206:   return errors;
  207: }
  208: 
  209: /*
  210:  * =========================================
  211:  * Backend-Ready Payload
  212:  * =========================================
  213:  *
  214:  * This structure can later be passed to:
  215:  *
  216:  * POST /api/support/contact
  217:  *
  218:  * Do not add session tokens, cookies, passwords,
  219:  * OTPs, or browser security values to this body.
  220:  */
  221: 
  222: function createContactPayload(form) {
  223:   return {
  224:     name: form.name.trim(),
  225:     email: form.email.trim().toLowerCase(),
  226:     category: form.category,
  227:     subject: form.subject.trim(),
  228:     message: form.message.trim(),
  229:     replyConsent: Boolean(form.replyConsent),
  230:   };
  231: }
  232: 
  233: /*
  234:  * =========================================
  235:  * First Field Error

  237:  */
  238: 
  239: function getFieldError(errors, fieldName) {
  240:   return typeof errors?.[fieldName] === "string" ? errors[fieldName] : "";
  241: }
  242: 
  243: function getCategoryLabel(categoryValue) {
  244:   return (
  245:     requestCategories.find((category) => category.value === categoryValue)
  246:       ?.label || "Support request"
  247:   );
  248: }
  249: 
  250: function formatReceiptDate(value) {
  251:   if (!value) {
  252:     return "";
  253:   }
  254: 
  255:   const date = new Date(value);
  256: 
  257:   if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) {
  258:     return "";
  259:   }
  260: 
  261:   return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, {
  262:     dateStyle: "medium",
  263: 
  264:     timeStyle: "short",
  265:   }).format(date);
  266: }
  267: 
  268: /*
  269:  * =========================================
  270:  * Contact Page
  271:  * =========================================
  272:  */
  273: 
  274: function Contact() {
  275:   const { user, isAuthenticated } = useAuth();
  276: 
  277:   const [form, setForm] = useState(() => createInitialForm(user));
  278: 
  279:   const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState({});
  280: 
  281:   const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  282: 
  283:   const [submissionError, setSubmissionError] = useState("");
  284: 
  285:   const [requestReceipt, setRequestReceipt] = useState(null);
  286: 
  287:   /*
  288:    * =========================================
  289:    * Document Title
  290:    * =========================================
  291:    */
  292: 
  293:   useEffect(() => {
  294:     const previousTitle = document.title;
  295: 
  296:     document.title = "Contact | Portfolio Platform";
  297: 
  298:     return () => {
  299:       document.title = previousTitle;
  300:     };
  301:   }, []);
  302: 
  303:   /*
  304:    * =========================================
  305:    * Authenticated User Prefill
  306:    * =========================================
  307:    *
  308:    * Do not overwrite anything already typed.
  309:    */
  310: 
  311:   useEffect(() => {
  312:     if (!isAuthenticated || !user) {
  313:       return;
  314:     }
  315: 
  316:     setForm((currentForm) => ({
  317:       ...currentForm,
  318:       name: currentForm.name || getUserName(user),
  319:       email: currentForm.email || getUserEmail(user),
  320:     }));
  321:   }, [isAuthenticated, user]);
  322: 
  323:   const selectedCategory = useMemo(
  324:     () =>
  325:       requestCategories.find((category) => category.value === form.category) ||
  326:       null,
  327:     [form.category],
  328:   );
  329: 
  330:   const remainingMessageCharacters =
  331:     MAXIMUM_MESSAGE_LENGTH - form.message.length;
  332: 
  333:   /*
  334:    * =========================================
  335:    * Input Changes
  336:    * =========================================
  337:    */
  338: 
  339:   function updateField(fieldName, value) {
  340:     setForm((currentForm) => ({
  341:       ...currentForm,
  342: 
  343:       [fieldName]: value,
  344:     }));
  345: 
  346:     setFieldErrors((currentErrors) => ({
  347:       ...currentErrors,
  348: 
  349:       [fieldName]: undefined,
  350:     }));
  351: 
  352:     setSubmissionError("");
  353: 
  354:     /*
  355:      * Starting another request removes the
  356:      * receipt from the previous submission.
  357:      */
  358: 
  359:     setRequestReceipt(null);
  360:   }
  361: 
  362:   /*
  363:    * =========================================
  364:    * Preview Submission
  365:    * =========================================
  366:    */
  367: 
  368:   async function handleSubmit(event) {
  369:     event.preventDefault();
  370: 
  371:     if (isSubmitting) {
  372:       return;
  373:     }
  374: 
  375:     setSubmissionError("");
  376:     setRequestReceipt(null);
  377: 
  378:     const validationErrors = validateContactForm(form);
  379: 
  380:     if (Object.keys(validationErrors).length > 0) {
  381:       setFieldErrors(validationErrors);
  382: 
  383:       const firstErrorField = [
  384:         "name",
  385:         "email",
  386:         "category",
  387:         "subject",
  388:         "message",
  389:         "replyConsent",
  390:       ].find((fieldName) => validationErrors[fieldName]);
  391: 
  392:       if (firstErrorField) {
  393:         document.getElementById(`contact-${firstErrorField}`)?.focus();
  394:       }
  395: 
  396:       return;
  397:     }
  398: 
  399:     setFieldErrors({});
  400:     setIsSubmitting(true);
  401: 
  402:     try {
  403:       const result = await submitContactRequest(createContactPayload(form));
  404: 
  405:       if (!result?.request?.id) {
  406:         throw new Error("The server did not return a contact-request receipt.");
  407:       }
  408: 
  409:       setRequestReceipt({
  410:         id: result.request.id,
  411: 
  412:         category: result.request.category,
  413: 
  414:         status: result.request.status,
  415: 
  416:         createdAt: result.request.createdAt,
  417: 
  418:         message:
  419:           result.message || "Your support request was submitted successfully.",
  420:       });
  421: 
  422:       /*
  423:        * Reset the form while preserving any
  424:        * authenticated-user prefill values.
  425:        */
  426: 
  427:       setForm(createInitialForm(user));

   11:  * Not Found Page

   13:  */
   14: 
   15: function NotFound() {
   16:   const location = useLocation();
   17: 
   18:   const navigate = useNavigate();
   19: 
   20:   const { isAuthenticated, isInitializing } = useAuth();
   21: 
   22:   /*
   23:    * =========================================
   24:    * Document Title
   25:    * =========================================
   26:    */
   27: 
   28:   useEffect(() => {
   29:     const previousTitle = document.title;
   30: 
   31:     document.title = "Page Not Found | Portfolio Platform";
   32: 
   33:     return () => {
   34:       document.title = previousTitle;
   35:     };
   36:   }, []);
   37: 
   38:   /*
   39:    * =========================================
   40:    * Previous Page
   41:    * =========================================
   42:    */
   43: 
   44:   function handleGoBack() {
   45:     /*
   46:      * A directly opened URL may not have a
   47:      * useful application-history entry.
   48:      */
   49: 
   50:     if (window.history.length > 1) {
   51:       navigate(-1);
   52: 
   53:       return;
   54:     }

   56:     navigate("/", {
   57:       replace: true,
   58:     });
   59:   }

   62:     <div className="not-found-page">
   63:       <section className="not-found-content" aria-labelledby="not-found-title">

   76:

   80:         {/*
   81:          * =====================================
   82:          * Explanation

   84:          */}
   85:

  175: /*
  176:  * =========================================
  177:  * Context Fingerprint
  178:  * =========================================
  179:  */
  180: 
  181: function createContextFingerprint(context) {
  182:   const contextValue = JSON.stringify({
  183:     documentType: context.documentType,
  184:     targetRole: context.targetRole,
  185:     template: context.template,
  186:     professionalTitle: context.professionalTitle,
  187:     skills: context.skills,
  188:     experiences: context.experiences,
  189:     projects: context.projects,
  190:     education: context.education,
  191:     certifications: context.certifications,
  192:   });
  193: 
  194:   let hash = 0;
  195: 
  196:   for (let index = 0; index < contextValue.length; index += 1) {
  197:     hash = (hash << 5) - hash + contextValue.charCodeAt(index);
  198:     hash |= 0;
  199:   }
  200: 
  201:   return `summary-${Math.abs(hash).toString(36)}`;
  202: }
  203: 
  204: /*
  205:  * =========================================
  206:  * Readiness
  207:  * =========================================
  208:  */
  209: 
  210: function getContextReadiness(context) {
  211:   let score = 0;
  212: 
  213:   if (context.targetRole) {
  214:     score += 2;
  215:   }
  216: 
  217:   if (context.professionalTitle) {
  218:     score += 2;
  219:   }
  220: 
  221:   if (context.skills.length >= 3) {
  222:     score += 2;
  223:   } else if (context.skills.length > 0) {
  224:     score += 1;
  225:   }
  226: 
  227:   if (context.experiences.length > 0) {
  228:     score += 2;
  229:   }
  230: 
  231:   if (context.projects.length > 0) {
  232:     score += 1;
  233:   }
  234: 
  235:   if (context.education.length > 0) {
  236:     score += 1;
  237:   }
  238: 
  239:   if (context.certifications.length > 0) {
  240:     score += 1;
  241:   }
  242: 
  243:   if (score >= 9) {
  244:     return {
  245:       level: "excellent",
  246:       label: "Excellent",
  247:       description:
  248:         "Your saved information provides excellent context for a targeted summary.",
  249:     };
  250:   }
  251: 
  252:   if (score >= 6) {
  253:     return {
  254:       level: "strong",
  255:       label: "Strong",
  256:       description:
  257:         "Your profile provides strong context for a professional summary.",
  258:     };
  259:   }
  260: 
  261:   if (score >= 4) {
  262:     return {
  263:       level: "good",
  264:       label: "Good",
  265:       description:
  266:         "The AI can generate a useful draft, but additional information can improve it.",
  267:     };
  268:   }
  269: 
  270:   return {
  271:     level: "basic",
  272:     label: "Basic",
  273:     description:
  274:       "Add skills, experience, or projects for a more specific summary.",
  275:   };

  316: function ProfessionalSummaryBuilder({

  332: 
  333:   const [generationWarnings, setGenerationWarnings] = useState([]);
  334: 
  335:   const currentSummaryMeta = {
  336:     ...EMPTY_SUMMARY_META,

  339: 
  340:   /*

  363: 
  364:   const readiness = useMemo(
  365:     () => getContextReadiness(summaryContext),
  366:     [summaryContext],
  367:   );
  368: 
  369:   const selectedTemplate =
  370:     TEMPLATE_GUIDANCE[summaryContext.template] ||
  371:     TEMPLATE_GUIDANCE.professional;
  372: 
  373:   const canGenerate = Boolean(
  374:     summaryContext.targetRole || summaryContext.professionalTitle,
  375:   );
  376: 
  377:   const isGenerating = generationStatus === "loading";
  378: 
  379:   const isAiSummaryStale =
  380:     currentSummaryMeta.source === "ai" &&
  381:     Boolean(currentSummaryMeta.contextFingerprint) &&
  382:     currentSummaryMeta.contextFingerprint !== contextFingerprint;
  383: 
  384:   /*
  385:    * =========================================
  386:    * Counts

  391:

  403:     onChange?.({
  404:       summary: value,
  405:

  428:

  431:       setGenerationError("");

  217: function ResumeEntry({

  260: function formatDateRange(startDate, endDate, isCurrent) {
  261:   const start = formatDate(startDate);
  262:   const end = isCurrent ? "Present" : formatDate(endDate);
  263: 
  264:   if (start && end) {
  265:     return `${start} â€“ ${end}`;
  266:   }
  267: 
  268:   return start || end;
  269: }
  270: 
  271: function formatDate(dateValue) {
  272:   if (!dateValue) {
  273:     return "";
  274:   }
  275: 
  276:   const date = new Date(`${dateValue}T00:00:00`);
  277: 
  278:   if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) {
  279:     return dateValue;
  280:   }
  281: 
  282:   return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
  283:     month: "short",
  284:     year: "numeric",
  285:   }).format(date);

  414:               : "resume-header-field-optional"
  415:           }
  416:         >
  417:           {required ? "Required" : "Optional"}
  418:         </span>
  419:       </label>
  420: 
  421:       <select
  422:         id={id}
  423:         value={value}
  424:         onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}
  425:         disabled={!hasOptions}
  426:         required={required}
  427:       >
  428:         <option value="">{hasOptions ? placeholder : emptyMessage}</option>
  429: 
  430:         {options.map((option) => (
  431:           <option key={option.id} value={option.id}>
  432:             {option.label}
  433: 
  434:             {option.displayValue && option.displayValue !== option.label
  435:               ? ` â€” ${option.displayValue}`
  436:               : ""}
  437:           </option>
  438:         ))}
  439:       </select>
  440:     </div>
  441:   );
