  109: async function printResumeDocument(resumeElement, fileName) {
  110:   if (!resumeElement) {
  111:     throw new Error("The printable resume could not be found.");
  112:   }
  113: 
  114:   const printFrame = document.createElement("iframe");
  115: 
  116:   printFrame.setAttribute("title", "Resume PDF export");
  117:   printFrame.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
  118:   printFrame.tabIndex = -1;
  119: 
  120:   Object.assign(printFrame.style, {
  121:     position: "fixed",
  122:     top: "0",
  123:     left: "-100000px",
  124:     width: "816px",
  125:     height: "1056px",
  126:     border: "0",
  127:     opacity: "0",
  128:     pointerEvents: "none",
  129:   });
  130: 
  131:   document.body.appendChild(printFrame);
  132: 
  133:   const frameWindow = printFrame.contentWindow;
  134:   const frameDocument = printFrame.contentDocument;
  135: 
  136:   if (!frameWindow || !frameDocument) {
  137:     printFrame.remove();
  138: 
  139:     throw new Error("The PDF document could not be created.");
  140:   }
  141: 
  142:   /*
  143:    * Copy the application's stylesheets so
  144:    * ResumeDocument keeps its normal design.
  145:    */
  146: 
  147:   const applicationStyles = Array.from(
  148:     document.querySelectorAll('link[rel="stylesheet"], style'),
  149:   )
  150:     .map((styleElement) => styleElement.outerHTML)
  151:     .join("\n");
  152: 
  153:   const safeTitle =
  154:     String(fileName || "Resume")
  155:       .trim()
  156:       .replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]+/g, "-") || "Resume";
  157: 
  158:   const previousPageTitle = document.title;
  159: 
  160:   /*
  161:    * Chrome often uses the parent page title as
  162:    * the suggested Save as PDF filename, even
  163:    * when an iframe is being printed.
  164:    */
  165: 
  166:   document.title = safeTitle;
  167: 
  168:   const resumeMarkup = resumeElement.outerHTML;
  169: 
  170:   const frameLoaded = new Promise((resolve) => {
  171:     printFrame.addEventListener("load", resolve, {
  172:       once: true,
  173:     });
  174: 
  175:     /*
  176:      * Fallback in case the browser does not
  177:      * dispatch a second iframe load event.
  178:      */
  179: 
  180:     window.setTimeout(resolve, 700);
  181:   });
  182: 
  183:   frameDocument.open();
  184: 
  185:   frameDocument.write(`
  186:     <!doctype html>
  187: 
  188:     <html lang="en">
  189:       <head>
  190:         <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  191: 
  192:         <meta
  193:           name="viewport"
  194:           content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"
  195:         />
  196: 
  197:         <title>${safeTitle}</title>
  198: 
  199:         ${applicationStyles}
  200: 
  201:         <style>
  202:           @page {
  203:             size: Letter;
  204:             margin: 0;
  205:           }
  206: 
  207:           html,
  208:           body {
  209:             width: 8.5in;
  210:             min-height: 11in;
  211:             margin: 0;
  212:             padding: 0;
  213:             background: #ffffff;
  214:           }
  215:

  218:           }
  219:

  221:           *::before,

  224:             print-color-adjust: exact;
  225:             -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
  226:           }

  311:     once: true,

   18: 
   19: function formatDateTime(value) {
   20:   if (!value) {
   21:     return "Not available";
   22:   }
   23: 
   24:   const date = new Date(value);
   25: 
   26:   if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) {
   27:     return "Not available";
   28:   }
   29: 
   30:   return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, {
   31:     dateStyle: "medium",
   32: 
   33:     timeStyle: "short",
   34:   }).format(date);
   35: }
   36: 
   37: /*
   38:  * =========================================
   39:  * Relative Activity
   40:  * =========================================
   41:  */
   42: 
   43: function formatRelativeActivity(value) {
   44:   if (!value) {
   45:     return "Activity time unavailable";
   46:   }
   47: 
   48:   const date = new Date(value);
   49: 
   50:   if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) {
   51:     return "Activity time unavailable";
   52:   }
   53: 
   54:   const differenceMilliseconds = Date.now() - date.getTime();
   55: 
   56:   if (differenceMilliseconds < 0) {
   57:     return formatDateTime(value);
   58:   }

   60:   const differenceMinutes = Math.floor(differenceMilliseconds / (60 * 1000));
   61: 
   62:   if (differenceMinutes < 1) {
   63:     return "Active less than a minute ago";
   64:   }
   65: 
   66:   if (differenceMinutes < 60) {
   67:     return `Active ${differenceMinutes} minute${
   68:       differenceMinutes === 1 ? "" : "s"
   69:     } ago`;
   70:   }
   71: 
   72:   const differenceHours = Math.floor(differenceMinutes / 60);
   73: 
   74:   if (differenceHours < 24) {
   75:     return `Active ${differenceHours} hour${
   76:       differenceHours === 1 ? "" : "s"
   77:     } ago`;
   78:   }
   79: 
   80:   const differenceDays = Math.floor(differenceHours / 24);
   81: 
   82:   if (differenceDays < 30) {
   83:     return `Active ${differenceDays} day${differenceDays === 1 ? "" : "s"} ago`;
   84:   }
   85: 
   86:   return `Last active ${formatDateTime(value)}`;
   87: }

  158:        * A skill in the Languages category must
  159:        * use the Language Skill type.
  160:        */
  161: 
  162:       type:
  163:         category === "language"
  164:           ? "language"
  165:           : currentData.type === "language"
  166:             ? "professional"
  167:             : currentData.type,
  168: 
  169:       language: {
  170:         ...currentData.language,
  171: 
  172:         proficiency:
  173:           category === "language" ? currentData.language.proficiency : "",
  174:       },
  175:     }));
  176: 
  177:     clearFieldError("category");
  178:     clearFieldError("type");
  179:     clearFieldError("language.proficiency");
  180:   };
  181: 
  182:   const handleTypeChange = (event) => {
  183:     const type = event.target.value;
  184: 
  185:     setFormData((currentData) => ({
  186:       ...currentData,
  187:       type,
  188: 
  189:       category:
  190:         type === "language"
  191:           ? "language"
  192:           : currentData.category === "language"
  193:             ? "other"
  194:             : currentData.category,
  195: 
  196:       language: {
  197:         ...currentData.language,
  198: 
  199:         proficiency:
  200:           type === "language" ? currentData.language.proficiency : "",
  201:       },
  202:     }));
  203: 
  204:     clearFieldError("type");
  205:     clearFieldError("category");
  206:     clearFieldError("language.proficiency");
  207:   };
  208: 
  209:   /*
  210:    * =========================================
  211:    * Alias Management
  212:    * =========================================
  213:    */
  214: 
  215:   const handleAddAlias = () => {
  216:     const alias = aliasDraft.trim();
  217: 
  218:     if (!alias) {
  219:       setAliasError("Enter an alias before adding it.");
  220: 
  221:       return;
  222:     }
  223: 
  224:     if (alias.length > SKILL_FIELD_LIMITS.alias) {
  225:       setAliasError(
  226:         `An alias cannot exceed ${SKILL_FIELD_LIMITS.alias} characters.`,
  227:       );
  228: 
  229:       return;
  230:     }
  231: 
  232:     if (formData.aliases.length >= SKILL_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumAliases) {
  233:       setAliasError(
  234:         `Add no more than ${SKILL_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumAliases} aliases.`,
  235:       );
  236: 
  237:       return;
  238:     }
  239: 
  240:     const normalizedAlias = normalizeSkillNameForComparison(alias);
  241: 
  242:     const normalizedSkillName = normalizeSkillNameForComparison(formData.name);
  243: 
  244:     if (normalizedSkillName && normalizedAlias === normalizedSkillName) {
  245:       setAliasError("An alias cannot be the same as the primary skill name.");
  246: 
  247:       return;
  248:     }
  249: 
  250:     const isDuplicate = formData.aliases.some(
  251:       (existingAlias) =>
  252:         normalizeSkillNameForComparison(existingAlias) === normalizedAlias,
  253:     );
  254: 
  255:     if (isDuplicate) {
  256:       setAliasError("This alias has already been added.");
  257: 
  258:       return;
  259:     }
  260: 
  261:     setFormData((currentData) => ({
  262:       ...currentData,
  263:       aliases: [...currentData.aliases, alias],
  264:     }));
  265: 
  266:     setAliasDraft("");
  267:     setAliasError("");
  268:     clearFieldError("aliases");
  269:   };
  270: 
  271:   const handleAliasKeyDown = (event) => {
  272:     if (event.key !== "Enter") {
  273:       return;
  274:     }
  275: 
  276:     event.preventDefault();
  277: 
  278:     handleAddAlias();
  279:   };
  280: 
  281:   const handleRemoveAlias = (aliasIndex) => {
  282:     setFormData((currentData) => ({
  283:       ...currentData,
  284: 
  285:       aliases: currentData.aliases.filter((_, index) => index !== aliasIndex),
  286:     }));
  287: 
  288:     setAliasError("");
  289:     clearFieldError("aliases");
  290:   };
  291: 
  292:   /*
  293:    * =========================================
  294:    * Submit
  295:    * =========================================
  296:    */
  297: 
  298:   const handleSubmit = async (event) => {
  299:     event.preventDefault();
  300: 
  301:     setSubmissionError("");
  302:     setAliasError("");
  303: 
  304:     const validationResult = validateSkill(formData, {
  305:       existingSkills,
  306:       excludeSkillId: initialSkill?.id || "",
  307:     });
  308: 
  309:     setFieldErrors(validationResult.fieldErrors);
  310:     setWarnings(validationResult.warnings);
  311: 
  312:     if (!validationResult.isValid) {
  313:       setSubmissionError(
  314:         `${validationResult.errors.length} ${
  315:           validationResult.errors.length === 1
  316:             ? "problem must"
  317:             : "problems must"
  318:         } be corrected before saving.`,
  319:       );
  320: 
  321:       return;
  322:     }
  323: 
  324:     try {
  325:       await onSubmit?.(formData);
  326:     } catch (error) {
  327:       const serviceFieldErrors =
  328:         error?.fieldErrors || error?.validation?.fieldErrors || {};
  329: 
  330:       setFieldErrors(serviceFieldErrors);
  331: 
  332:       setWarnings(error?.warnings || error?.validation?.warnings || []);
  333: 
  334:       setSubmissionError(
  335:         error?.publicMessage ||
  336:           error?.message ||
  337:           "The skill could not be saved.",
  338:       );
  339:     }
  340:   };
  341: 
  342:   const getFieldId = (fieldName) => `${formId}-${fieldName}`;
  343: 
  344:   const isLanguageSkill = formData.type === "language";
  345: 
  346:   return (
  347:     <form className="skill-form" onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate>
  348:       {/*
  349:        * =========================================
  350:        * Identity
  351:        * =========================================
  352:        */}
  353: 
  354:       <section
  355:         className="skill-form-section"
  356:         aria-labelledby={`${formId}-identity-title`}
  357:       >
  358:         <header className="skill-form-section-header">
  359:           <span aria-hidden="true" />
  360: 
  361:           <div>
  362:             <small>Skill Identity</small>
  363: 
  364:             <h3 id={`${formId}-identity-title`}>Name and Classification</h3>
  365: 
  366:             <p>
  367:               Give the skill a clear professional name and classify it for
  368:               searching, Experiences, RÃ©sumÃ©s, and Portfolios.
  369:             </p>
  370:           </div>
  371:         </header>
  372: 
  373:         <div className="skill-form-grid">
  374:           <FormField
  375:             className="skill-form-field--full"
  376:             id={getFieldId("name")}
  377:             label="Skill Name"
  378:             required
  379:             error={fieldErrors.name}
  380:             count={`${formData.name.length}/${SKILL_FIELD_LIMITS.name}`}
  381:           >
  382:             <input
  383:               id={getFieldId("name")}
  384:               type="text"
  385:               value={formData.name}
  386:               onChange={(event) => updateField("name", event.target.value)}
  387:               maxLength={SKILL_FIELD_LIMITS.name}
  388:               placeholder="Example: Active Directory"
  389:               autoComplete="off"
  390:               disabled={isSaving}
  391:             />
  392:           </FormField>
  393: 
  394:           <FormField
  395:             id={getFieldId("category")}
  396:             label="Category"
  397:             required
  398:             error={fieldErrors.category}
  399:           >
  400:             <select
  401:               id={getFieldId("category")}
  402:               value={formData.category}
  403:               onChange={handleCategoryChange}
  404:               disabled={isSaving}
  405:             >
  406:               {SKILL_CATEGORY_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
  407:                 <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>
  408:                   {option.label}
  409:                 </option>
  410:               ))}
  411:             </select>
  412:           </FormField>
  413: 
  414:           <FormField
  415:             id={getFieldId("type")}
  416:             label="Skill Type"
  417:             required
  418:             error={fieldErrors.type}
  419:           >
  420:             <select
  421:               id={getFieldId("type")}
  422:               value={formData.type}
  423:               onChange={handleTypeChange}
  424:               disabled={isSaving}
  425:             >
  426:               {SKILL_TYPE_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
  427:                 <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>
  428:                   {option.label}
  429:                 </option>
  430:               ))}
  431:             </select>
  432:           </FormField>
  433: 
  434:           <FormField
  435:             className="skill-form-field--full"
  436:             id={getFieldId("description")}
  437:             label="Professional Description"
  438:             error={fieldErrors.description}
  439:             count={`${formData.description.length}/${SKILL_FIELD_LIMITS.description}`}
  440:             help="Explain what the skill is and how you apply it professionally."
  441:           >
  442:             <textarea
  443:               id={getFieldId("description")}
  444:               value={formData.description}
  445:               onChange={(event) =>
  446:                 updateField("description", event.target.value)
  447:               }
  448:               rows={5}
  449:               maxLength={SKILL_FIELD_LIMITS.description}
  450:               placeholder="Example: Administration of users, groups, permissions, Group Policy, authentication, and directory services."
  451:               disabled={isSaving}
  452:             />
  453:           </FormField>
  454:         </div>
  455:       </section>
  456: 
  457:       {/*
  458:        * =========================================
  459:        * Aliases
  460:        * =========================================
  461:        */}
  462: 
  463:       <section
  464:         className="skill-form-section"
  465:         aria-labelledby={`${formId}-aliases-title`}
  466:       >
  467:         <header className="skill-form-section-header">
  468:           <span aria-hidden="true" />
  469: 
  470:           <div>
  471:             <small>Alternative Names</small>
  472: 
  473:             <h3 id={`${formId}-aliases-title`}>Skill Aliases</h3>
  474: 
  475:             <p>
  476:               Add abbreviations or alternative names so the library can
  477:               recognize equivalent skills and prevent duplicates.
  478:             </p>
  479:           </div>
  480:         </header>
  481: 
  482:         <div className="skill-form-alias-editor">
  483:           <div className="skill-form-alias-input">
  484:             <label htmlFor={getFieldId("alias")}>New Alias</label>
  485: 
  486:             <div>
  487:               <input
  488:                 id={getFieldId("alias")}
  489:                 type="text"
  490:                 value={aliasDraft}
  491:                 onChange={(event) => {
  492:                   setAliasDraft(event.target.value);
  493:                   setAliasError("");
  494:                 }}
  495:                 onKeyDown={handleAliasKeyDown}
  496:                 maxLength={SKILL_FIELD_LIMITS.alias}
  497:                 placeholder="Example: AD"
  498:                 disabled={isSaving}
  499:               />
  500: 
  501:               <button
  502:                 type="button"
  503:                 onClick={handleAddAlias}
  504:                 disabled={
  505:                   isSaving ||
  506:                   formData.aliases.length >= SKILL_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumAliases
  507:                 }
  508:               >
  509:                 Add Alias
  510:               </button>
  511:             </div>
  512: 
  513:             <small>
  514:               {formData.aliases.length}/{SKILL_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumAliases}{" "}
  515:               aliases
  516:             </small>
  517:           </div>
  518: 
  519:           {(aliasError || fieldErrors.aliases) && (
  520:             <p className="skill-form-alias-error" role="alert">
  521:               {aliasError || fieldErrors.aliases}
  522:             </p>
  523:           )}
  524: 
  525:           {formData.aliases.length > 0 ? (
  526:             <div className="skill-form-alias-list">
  527:               {formData.aliases.map((alias, index) => (
  528:                 <div
  529:                   key={`${alias}-${index}`}
  530:                   className={
  531:                     fieldErrors[`aliases.${index}`]
  532:                       ? "skill-form-alias--error"
  533:                       : ""
  534:                   }
  535:                 >
  536:                   <span>{alias}</span>
  537: 
  538:                   <button
  539:                     type="button"
  540:                     onClick={() => handleRemoveAlias(index)}
  541:                     disabled={isSaving}
  542:                     aria-label={`Remove alias ${alias}`}
  543:                   >
  544:                     Ã—
  545:                   </button>
  546: 
  547:                   {fieldErrors[`aliases.${index}`] && (
  548:                     <small role="alert">
  549:                       {fieldErrors[`aliases.${index}`]}
  550:                     </small>
  551:                   )}
  552:                 </div>
  553:               ))}
  554:             </div>
  555:           ) : (
  556:             <div className="skill-form-alias-empty">No aliases added.</div>
  557:           )}
  558:         </div>
  559:       </section>
  560: 
  561:       {/*
  562:        * =========================================
  563:        * Proficiency
  564:        * =========================================
  565:        */}
  566: 
  567:       <section
  568:         className="skill-form-section"
  569:         aria-labelledby={`${formId}-proficiency-title`}
  570:       >
  571:         <header className="skill-form-section-header">
  572:           <span aria-hidden="true" />
  573: 
  574:           <div>
  575:             <small>Capability Level</small>
  576: 
  577:             <h3 id={`${formId}-proficiency-title`}>
  578:               Proficiency and Experience
  579:             </h3>
  580: 
  581:             <p>
  582:               Record your general proficiency, approximate experience, and when
  583:               the skill was last used.
  584:             </p>
  585:           </div>
  586:         </header>
  587: 
  588:         <div className="skill-form-grid">
  589:           {isLanguageSkill ? (
  590:             <FormField
  591:               id={getFieldId("language-proficiency")}
  592:               label="Language Proficiency"
  593:               error={fieldErrors["language.proficiency"]}
  594:             >
  595:               <select
  596:                 id={getFieldId("language-proficiency")}
  597:                 value={formData.language.proficiency}
  598:                 onChange={(event) =>
  599:                   updateNestedField(
  600:                     "language",
  601:                     "proficiency",
  602:                     event.target.value,
  603:                   )
  604:                 }
  605:                 disabled={isSaving}
  606:               >
  607:                 {LANGUAGE_PROFICIENCY_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
  608:                   <option
  609:                     key={option.value || "not-specified"}
  610:                     value={option.value}
  611:                   >
  612:                     {option.label}
  613:                   </option>
  614:                 ))}
  615:               </select>
  616:             </FormField>
  617:           ) : (
  618:             <FormField
  619:               id={getFieldId("proficiency")}
  620:               label="General Proficiency"
  621:               error={fieldErrors["proficiency.level"]}
  622:             >
  623:               <select
  624:                 id={getFieldId("proficiency")}
  625:                 value={formData.proficiency.level}
  626:                 onChange={(event) =>
  627:                   updateNestedField("proficiency", "level", event.target.value)
  628:                 }
  629:                 disabled={isSaving}
  630:               >
  631:                 {SKILL_PROFICIENCY_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
  632:                   <option
  633:                     key={option.value || "not-specified"}
  634:                     value={option.value}
  635:                   >
  636:                     {option.label}
  637:                   </option>
  638:                 ))}
  639:               </select>
  640:             </FormField>
  641:           )}
  642: 
  643:           <FormField
  644:             id={getFieldId("years")}
  645:             label="Years of Experience"
  646:             error={fieldErrors["proficiency.yearsOfExperience"]}
  647:             help="Optional. One decimal place is supported."
  648:           >
  649:             <input
  650:               id={getFieldId("years")}
  651:               type="number"
  652:               min="0"
  653:               max={SKILL_FIELD_LIMITS.yearsOfExperience}
  654:               step="0.1"
  655:               value={formData.proficiency.yearsOfExperience ?? ""}
  656:               onChange={(event) =>
  657:                 updateNestedField(
  658:                   "proficiency",
  659:                   "yearsOfExperience",
  660:                   event.target.value,
  661:                 )
  662:               }
  663:               placeholder="Example: 5"
  664:               disabled={isSaving}
  665:             />
  666:           </FormField>
  667: 
  668:           <FormField
  669:             id={getFieldId("last-used")}
  670:             label="Last Used"
  671:             error={fieldErrors["proficiency.lastUsedDate"]}
  672:             help="Leave blank if you do not want to record a date."
  673:           >
  674:             <input
  675:               id={getFieldId("last-used")}
  676:               type="month"
  677:               value={formData.proficiency.lastUsedDate}
  678:               onChange={(event) =>
  679:                 updateNestedField(
  680:                   "proficiency",
  681:                   "lastUsedDate",
  682:                   event.target.value,
  683:                 )
  684:               }
  685:               disabled={isSaving}
  686:             />
  687:           </FormField>
  688:         </div>
  689:       </section>
  690: 
  691:       {/*
  692:        * =========================================
  693:        * Management
  694:        * =========================================
  695:        */}
  696: 
  697:       <section
  698:         className="skill-form-section"
  699:         aria-labelledby={`${formId}-management-title`}
  700:       >
  701:         <header className="skill-form-section-header">
  702:           <span aria-hidden="true" />
  703: 
  704:           <div>
  705:             <small>Library Management</small>
  706: 
  707:             <h3 id={`${formId}-management-title`}>Status and Private Notes</h3>
  708: 
  709:             <p>
  710:               Manage availability and save private information that should not
  711:               appear automatically on public documents.
  712:             </p>
  713:           </div>
  714:         </header>
  715: 
  716:         <div className="skill-form-private-notice">
  717:           <span aria-hidden="true">â—</span>
  718: 
  719:           <p>
  720:             Private notes are for internal career management and should not
  721:             appear automatically on RÃ©sumÃ©s or public Portfolios.
  722:           </p>
  723:         </div>
  724: 
  725:         <div className="skill-form-grid">
  726:           <FormField
  727:             id={getFieldId("status")}
  728:             label="Record Status"
  729:             error={fieldErrors.status}
  730:           >
  731:             <select
  732:               id={getFieldId("status")}
  733:               value={formData.status}
  734:               onChange={(event) => updateField("status", event.target.value)}
  735:               disabled={isSaving}
  736:             >
  737:               {SKILL_STATUS_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
  738:                 <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>
  739:                   {option.label}
  740:                 </option>
  741:               ))}
  742:             </select>
  743:           </FormField>
  744: 
  745:           <div className="skill-form-source">
  746:             <span>Record Source</span>
  747: 
  748:             <strong>{getSkillSourceLabel(formData.source)}</strong>
  749: 
  750:             {formData.sourceContext && (
  751:               <small>Context: {formData.sourceContext}</small>
  752:             )}
  753:           </div>
  754: 
  755:           <FormField
  756:             className="skill-form-field--full"
  757:             id={getFieldId("notes")}
  758:             label="Private Notes"
  759:             error={fieldErrors.notes}
  760:             count={`${formData.notes.length}/${SKILL_FIELD_LIMITS.notes}`}
  761:           >
  762:             <textarea
  763:               id={getFieldId("notes")}
  764:               value={formData.notes}
  765:               onChange={(event) => updateField("notes", event.target.value)}
  766:               rows={4}
  767:               maxLength={SKILL_FIELD_LIMITS.notes}
  768:               placeholder="Add private learning goals, interview reminders, certifications, or supporting context."
  769:               disabled={isSaving}
  770:             />
  771:           </FormField>
  772:         </div>
  773:       </section>
  774: 
  775:       {/*
  776:        * =========================================
  777:        * Warnings
  778:        * =========================================
  779:        */}
  780: 
  781:       {warnings.length > 0 && (
  782:         <section className="skill-form-warnings">
  783:           <strong>Suggestions for a stronger skill record</strong>
  784: 
  785:           <ul>
  786:             {warnings.map((warning, index) => (
  787:               <li key={`${warning.code}-${warning.field}-${index}`}>
  788:                 {warning.message}
  789:               </li>
  790:             ))}
  791:           </ul>
  792:         </section>
  793:       )}
  794: 
  795:       {/*
  796:        * =========================================
  797:        * Submission Error
  798:        * =========================================
  799:        */}
  800: 
  801:       {submissionError && (
  802:         <div className="skill-form-submission-error" role="alert">
  803:           <strong>Unable to save this skill</strong>
  804: 
  805:           <p>{submissionError}</p>
  806:         </div>
  807:       )}
  808: 
  809:       {/*
  810:        * =========================================
  811:        * Actions
  812:        * =========================================
  813:        */}
  814: 
  815:       <footer className="skill-form-actions">
  816:         <button
  817:           type="button"
  818:           className="skill-form-cancel-button"
  819:           onClick={onCancel}
  820:           disabled={isSaving}
  821:         >
  822:           Cancel
  823:         </button>
  824: 
  825:         <button
  826:           type="submit"
  827:           className="skill-form-save-button"
  828:           disabled={isSaving}
  829:         >
  830:           {isSaving ? "Saving..." : isEditing ? "Save Changes" : "Save Skill"}
  831:         </button>
  832:       </footer>
  833:     </form>
  834:   );
  835: }
  836: 
  837: /*
  838:  * =========================================
  839:  * Form Field
  840:  * =========================================
  841:  */
  842: 
  843: function FormField({
  844:   id,
  845:   label,
  846:   required = false,
  847:   error = "",
  848:   help = "",
  849:   count = "",
  850:   className = "",
  851:   children,
  852: }) {
  853:   return (
  854:     <div
  855:       className={`skill-form-field ${className} ${
  856:         error ? "skill-form-field--error" : ""
  857:       }`}
  858:     >
  859:       <div className="skill-form-label-row">
  860:         <label htmlFor={id}>
  861:           {label}
  862: 
  863:           {required && <span aria-hidden="true">*</span>}
  864:         </label>
  865: 
  866:         {count && <small>{count}</small>}
  867:       </div>
  868: 
  869:       {children}
  870: 
  871:       {help && !error && <small className="skill-form-help">{help}</small>}
  872: 
  873:       {error && (
  874:         <p className="skill-form-field-error" role="alert">
  875:           {error}
  876:         </p>
  877:       )}
  878:     </div>
  879:   );
  880: }

  604:    */
  605: 
  606:   const handleCreateCertification = async () => {
  607:     setEditorError("");
  608: 
  609:     if (typeof onCreateCertification !== "function") {
  610:       setEditorError(
  611:         "Creating a Certification is not available in this Training form.",
  612:       );

  614:     }
  615:

  617:       setEditorError(

  619:       );

  621:     }
  622:

  624:     const normalizedIssuerName = certificationIssuerName.trim();
  625:     const normalizedCredentialId = certificationCredentialId.trim();
  626:     const normalizedVerificationUrl = certificationVerificationUrl.trim();
  627: 
  628:     if (!normalizedName) {
  629:       setEditorError("Enter the Certification name.");
  630:       return;
  631:     }
  632: 
  633:     if (!normalizedIssuerName) {
  634:       setEditorError("Enter the issuing organization.");
  635:       return;
  636:     }

  645:       certificationExpirationDate &&
  646:       certificationExpirationDate < certificationIssueDate

  648:       setEditorError(
  649:         "The expiration date cannot be earlier than the issue date.",
  650:       );

  665:         return;
  666:       }
  667:     }

  696:               : certificationExpirationDate,

  807:   /*
  808:    * =========================================
  809:    * Resolve Manual Document URL
  810:    * =========================================
  811:    */
  812: 
  813:   const getDocumentUrl = async (trainingDocument) => {
  814:     if (trainingDocument.fileUrl) {
  815:       return {
  816:         url: trainingDocument.fileUrl,
  817:         temporary: false,
  818:       };
  819:     }
  820: 
  821:     if (!trainingDocument.storageKey) {
  822:       const error = new Error(
  823:         "The document does not have a valid storage location.",
  824:       );
  825: 
  826:       error.publicMessage = "The document file is unavailable.";
  827: 
  828:       throw error;
  829:     }
  830: 
  831:     const url = await createStoredDocumentUrl(trainingDocument.storageKey);
  832: 
  833:     return {
  834:       url,
  835:       temporary: true,
  836:     };
  837:   };

  839:   /*
  840:    * =========================================
  841:    * Preview Manual Document
  842:    * =========================================
  843:    */
  844: 
  845:   const handlePreview = async (trainingDocument) => {
  846:     try {
  847:       setEditorError("");
  848:       setWorkingDocumentId(trainingDocument.id);
  849: 
  850:       const { url, temporary } = await getDocumentUrl(trainingDocument);
  851: 
  852:       const previewWindow = window.open(url, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer");
  853: 
  854:       if (!previewWindow) {
  855:         if (temporary) {
  856:           revokeDocumentUrl(url);
  857:         }
  858: 
  859:         throw new Error("The browser blocked the document preview window.");
  860:       }
  861: 
  862:       if (temporary) {
  863:         window.setTimeout(() => {
  864:           revokeDocumentUrl(url);
  865:         }, 60000);
  866:       }
  867:     } catch (error) {
  868:       setEditorError(
  869:         error?.publicMessage ||
  870:           error?.message ||
  871:           "The document could not be opened.",
  872:       );
  873:     } finally {
  874:       setWorkingDocumentId("");
  875:     }
  876:   };

  878:   /*
  879:    * =========================================
  880:    * Download Manual Document
  881:    * =========================================
  882:    */
  883: 
  884:   const handleDownload = async (trainingDocument) => {
  885:     try {
  886:       setEditorError("");
  887:       setWorkingDocumentId(trainingDocument.id);
  888: 
  889:       const { url, temporary } = await getDocumentUrl(trainingDocument);

  895:         trainingDocument.fileName || trainingDocument.name || "document";
  896:       link.rel = "noopener";
  897: 
  898:       window.document.body.appendChild(link);
  899:       link.click();
  900:       link.remove();
  901: 
  902:       if (temporary) {
  903:         window.setTimeout(() => {
  904:           revokeDocumentUrl(url);
  905:         }, 1000);
  906:       }
  907:     } catch (error) {
  908:       setEditorError(
  909:         error?.publicMessage ||
  910:           error?.message ||
  911:           "The document could not be downloaded.",
  912:       );
  913:     } finally {
  914:       setWorkingDocumentId("");
  915:     }

  940:         trainingDocument.storageKey

  942:         await deleteStoredDocumentFile(trainingDocument.storageKey);
  943:       }

  945:       const remainingDocuments = safeDocuments.filter(
  946:         (candidate) => candidate.id !== trainingDocument.id,
  947:       );

  949:       await onChange?.(normalizeDocumentOrder(remainingDocuments));

  951:       setEditorError(
  952:         error?.publicMessage ||
  953:           error?.message ||
  954:           "The document could not be removed.",
  955:       );
  956:     } finally {

  961:   /*
  962:    * =========================================
  963:    * Reorder Manual Documents
  964:    * =========================================
  965:    */
  966: 
  967:   const handleMove = (documentId, direction) => {
  968:     const currentIndex = orderedDocuments.findIndex(
  969:       (document) => document.id === documentId,
  970:     );
  971: 
  972:     if (currentIndex === -1) {
  973:       return;
  974:     }
  975: 
  976:     const targetIndex =
  977:       direction === "up" ? currentIndex - 1 : currentIndex + 1;
  978: 
  979:     if (targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex >= orderedDocuments.length) {
  980:       return;
  981:     }
  982: 
  983:     const reorderedDocuments = [...orderedDocuments];
  984: 
  985:     const [movedDocument] = reorderedDocuments.splice(currentIndex, 1);
  986: 
  987:     reorderedDocuments.splice(targetIndex, 0, movedDocument);
  988: 
  989:     onChange?.(normalizeDocumentOrder(reorderedDocuments));
  990:   };

  398:             : currentData.completion?.certificateEarned === true,
  399: 
  400:           /*
  401:            * Fill empty Training credential fields from
  402:            * the linked Certification without overwriting
  403:            * manually entered information.
  404:            */
  405: 
  406:           credentialId:
  407:             shouldBeLinked && !currentData.completion?.credentialId
  408:               ? credentialId
  409:               : currentData.completion?.credentialId || "",
  410: 
  411:           credentialUrl:
  412:             shouldBeLinked && !currentData.completion?.credentialUrl
  413:               ? credentialUrl
  414:               : currentData.completion?.credentialUrl || "",
  415:         },
  416:       };
  417:     });
  418: 
  419:     setFieldErrors((currentErrors) => {
  420:       const nextErrors = {
  421:         ...currentErrors,
  422:       };
  423: 
  424:       Object.keys(nextErrors).forEach((field) => {
  425:         if (
  426:           field === "certificationRelationships" ||
  427:           field === "relatedCertificationIds" ||
  428:           field === "completion.certificateEarned" ||
  429:           field === "completion.credentialId" ||
  430:           field === "completion.credentialUrl" ||
  431:           field.startsWith("certificationRelationships.")
  432:         ) {
  433:           delete nextErrors[field];
  434:         }
  435:       });
  436: 
  437:       return nextErrors;
  438:     });
  439: 
  440:     setSubmitError("");
  441:   };
  442: 
  443:   /*
  444:    * =========================================
  445:    * Submission
  446:    * =========================================
  447:    */

  449:   const handleSubmit = async (event) => {

  452:     const validation = validateTraining(formData, {
  453:       certifications,
  454:     });

  456:     setFieldErrors(validation.fieldErrors || {});
  457:     setWarnings(validation.warnings || []);
  458: 
  459:     if (!validation.isValid) {
  460:       const errorCount = validation.errors?.length || 0;
  461: 
  462:       setSubmitError(
  463:         `${errorCount} ${
  464:           errorCount === 1 ? "problem must" : "problems must"
  465:         } be corrected before saving.`,
  466:       );
  467: 
  468:       const firstError = validation.errors?.[0];
  469: 
  470:       if (firstError?.field) {
  471:         document
  472:           .querySelector(`[data-field="${firstError.field}"]`)
  473:           ?.scrollIntoView({
  474:             behavior: "smooth",
  475:             block: "center",
  476:           });
  477:       }
  478: 
  479:       return;
  480:     }
  481: 
  482:     try {
  483:       setSubmitError("");
  484: 
  485:       await onSubmit?.(formData);
  486:     } catch (error) {
  487:       setFieldErrors(error?.fieldErrors || {});
  488: 
  489:       setSubmitError(
  490:         error?.publicMessage ||
  491:           error?.message ||
  492:           "The training record could not be saved.",
  493:       );
  494:     }
  495:   };
  496:

   49: 
   50:   maximumItems = 20,
   51:   fieldPath,
   52: 
   53:   fieldErrors = {},
   54:   disabled = false,
   55: 
   56:   createItem,
   57:   onChange,
   58: }) {
   59:   const titleId = useId();
   60: 
   61:   const [draft, setDraft] = useState(() => createEmptyDraft(fields));
   62: 
   63:   const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState(null);
   64: 
   65:   const [editorError, setEditorError] = useState("");
   66: 
   67:   /*
   68:    * Reset the draft if the editor configuration changes.
   69:    */
   70: 
   71:   useEffect(() => {
   72:     setDraft(createEmptyDraft(fields));
   73:     setEditingId(null);
   74:     setEditorError("");
   75:   }, [fields]);
   76: 
   77:   const orderedItems = useMemo(
   78:     () =>
   79:       [...values].sort(
   80:         (first, second) => (first.order ?? 0) - (second.order ?? 0),
   81:       ),
   82:     [values],
   83:   );
   84: 
   85:   const isEditing = Boolean(editingId);
   86: 
   87:   const hasReachedMaximum = values.length >= maximumItems;
   88: 
   89:   /*
   90:    * =========================================
   91:    * Draft Management
   92:    * =========================================
   93:    */
   94: 
   95:   const resetEditor = () => {
   96:     setDraft(createEmptyDraft(fields));
   97:     setEditingId(null);
   98:     setEditorError("");
   99:   };
  100: 
  101:   const updateDraft = (fieldName, value) => {
  102:     setDraft((current) => ({
  103:       ...current,
  104:       [fieldName]: value,
  105:     }));
  106: 
  107:     setEditorError("");
  108:   };
  109: 
  110:   /*
  111:    * =========================================
  112:    * Duplicate Detection
  113:    * =========================================
  114:    */
  115: 
  116:   const isDuplicate = (primaryValue) => {
  117:     const normalizedValue = getText(primaryValue)
  118:       .normalize("NFKC")
  119:       .toLocaleLowerCase();
  120: 
  121:     if (!normalizedValue) {
  122:       return false;
  123:     }
  124: 
  125:     return values.some((item) => {
  126:       if (item.id === editingId) {
  127:         return false;
  128:       }
  129: 
  130:       return (
  131:         getText(item?.[primaryField]).normalize("NFKC").toLocaleLowerCase() ===
  132:         normalizedValue
  133:       );
  134:     });
  135:   };
  136: 
  137:   /*
  138:    * =========================================
  139:    * Draft Validation
  140:    * =========================================
  141:    */
  142: 
  143:   const validateDraft = () => {
  144:     for (const field of fields) {
  145:       const value = getText(draft[field.name]);
  146: 
  147:       if (field.required !== false && !value) {
  148:         return `Enter ${field.label.toLowerCase()}.`;
  149:       }
  150: 
  151:       if (field.maximumLength && value.length > field.maximumLength) {
  152:         return `${field.label} cannot exceed ${field.maximumLength} characters.`;
  153:       }
  154:     }
  155: 
  156:     const primaryValue = getText(draft[primaryField]);
  157: 
  158:     if (!primaryValue) {
  159:       const primaryConfiguration = fields.find(
  160:         (field) => field.name === primaryField,
  161:       );
  162: 
  163:       return `Enter ${(
  164:         primaryConfiguration?.label || itemLabel
  165:       ).toLowerCase()}.`;
  166:     }
  167: 
  168:     if (isDuplicate(primaryValue)) {
  169:       return `This ${itemLabel.toLowerCase()} has already been added.`;
  170:     }
  171: 
  172:     if (!isEditing && hasReachedMaximum) {
  173:       return `Add no more than ${maximumItems} ${itemLabel.toLowerCase()} records.`;
  174:     }
  175: 
  176:     return "";
  177:   };
  178: 
  179:   /*
  180:    * =========================================
  181:    * Save
  182:    * =========================================
  183:    */
  184: 
  185:   const handleSave = () => {
  186:     const validationError = validateDraft();
  187: 
  188:     if (validationError) {
  189:       setEditorError(validationError);
  190:       return;
  191:     }
  192: 
  193:     const normalizedDraft = fields.reduce((result, field) => {
  194:       result[field.name] = getText(draft[field.name]);
  195: 
  196:       return result;
  197:     }, {});
  198: 
  199:     if (isEditing) {
  200:       onChange?.(
  201:         normalizeOrder(
  202:           values.map((item) =>
  203:             item.id === editingId
  204:               ? {
  205:                   ...item,
  206:                   ...normalizedDraft,
  207:                 }
  208:               : item,
  209:           ),
  210:         ),
  211:       );
  212:     } else {
  213:       if (typeof createItem !== "function") {
  214:         setEditorError(
  215:           `The ${itemLabel.toLowerCase()} creation function is unavailable.`,
  216:         );
  217: 
  218:         return;
  219:       }
  220: 
  221:       const createdItem = createItem({
  222:         ...normalizedDraft,
  223:         order: values.length,
  224:       });
  225: 
  226:       onChange?.(normalizeOrder([...values, createdItem]));
  227:     }
  228: 
  229:     resetEditor();
  230:   };
  231: 
  232:   /*
  233:    * =========================================
  234:    * Edit
  235:    * =========================================
  236:    */
  237: 
  238:   const handleEdit = (item) => {
  239:     const nextDraft = fields.reduce((result, field) => {
  240:       result[field.name] =
  241:         typeof item?.[field.name] === "string" ? item[field.name] : "";
  242: 
  243:       return result;
  244:     }, {});
  245: 
  246:     setDraft(nextDraft);
  247:     setEditingId(item.id);
  248:     setEditorError("");
  249:   };
  250: 
  251:   /*
  252:    * =========================================
  253:    * Remove
  254:    * =========================================
  255:    */
  256: 
  257:   const handleRemove = (itemId) => {
  258:     onChange?.(normalizeOrder(values.filter((item) => item.id !== itemId)));
  259: 
  260:     if (editingId === itemId) {
  261:       resetEditor();
  262:     }
  263:   };
  264: 
  265:   /*
  266:    * =========================================
  267:    * Reorder
  268:    * =========================================
  269:    */
  270: 
  271:   const handleMove = (itemId, direction) => {
  272:     const currentIndex = orderedItems.findIndex((item) => item.id === itemId);
  273: 
  274:     if (currentIndex === -1) {
  275:       return;
  276:     }
  277: 
  278:     const targetIndex =
  279:       direction === "up" ? currentIndex - 1 : currentIndex + 1;
  280: 
  281:     if (targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex >= orderedItems.length) {
  282:       return;
  283:     }
  284: 
  285:     const reorderedItems = [...orderedItems];
  286: 
  287:     const [movedItem] = reorderedItems.splice(currentIndex, 1);
  288: 
  289:     reorderedItems.splice(targetIndex, 0, movedItem);
  290: 
  291:     onChange?.(normalizeOrder(reorderedItems));
  292:   };
  293: 
  294:   /*
  295:    * =========================================
  296:    * Render
  297:    * =========================================
  298:    */
  299: 
  300:   return (
  301:     <section
  302:       className="training-form-section training-ordered-editor"
  303:       aria-labelledby={titleId}
  304:     >
  305:       <header className="training-form-section-header">
  306:         <span aria-hidden="true" />
  307: 
  308:         <div>
  309:           <small>{label}</small>
  310: 
  311:           <h3 id={titleId}>{title}</h3>
  312: 
  313:           <p>{description}</p>
  314:         </div>
  315:       </header>
  316: 
  317:       <div className="training-ordered-editor-form">
  318:         {fields.map((field) => {
  319:           const value = draft[field.name] || "";
  320: 
  321:           return (
  322:             <div
  323:               className={`training-ordered-editor-field ${
  324:                 field.wide ? "training-ordered-editor-wide" : ""
  325:               }`}
  326:               key={field.name}
  327:             >
  328:               <div className="training-ordered-editor-label">
  329:                 <label htmlFor={`${titleId}-${field.name}`}>
  330:                   {field.label}
  331: 
  332:                   {field.required !== false ? (
  333:                     <small> Required</small>
  334:                   ) : (
  335:                     <small> Optional</small>
  336:                   )}
  337:                 </label>
  338: 
  339:                 {field.maximumLength && (
  340:                   <span>
  341:                     {value.length}/{field.maximumLength}
  342:                   </span>

  344:               </div>
  345: 
  346:               {field.multiline ? (
  347:                 <textarea
  348:                   id={`${titleId}-${field.name}`}
  349:                   rows={field.rows || 3}
  350:                   value={value}
  351:                   onChange={(event) =>
  352:                     updateDraft(field.name, event.target.value)
  353:                   }
  354:                   maxLength={field.maximumLength}
  355:                   placeholder={field.placeholder}
  356:                   disabled={disabled}
  357:                 />
  358:               ) : (
  359:                 <input
  360:                   id={`${titleId}-${field.name}`}
  361:                   type="text"
  362:                   value={value}
  363:                   onChange={(event) =>
  364:                     updateDraft(field.name, event.target.value)
  365:                   }
  366:                   maxLength={field.maximumLength}
  367:                   placeholder={field.placeholder}
  368:                   disabled={disabled}
  369:                 />
  370:               )}
  371:             </div>
  372:           );
  373:         })}
  374: 
  375:         {editorError && (
  376:           <p
  377:             className="training-ordered-editor-error training-ordered-editor-wide"
  378:             role="alert"
  379:           >
  380:             {editorError}

    1: import { Navigate, Outlet } from "react-router-dom";
    2: 
    3: import { useAuth } from "../context/AuthContext.jsx";
    4: 
    5: import "./RouteGuards.css";
    6: 
    7: /*
    8:  * =========================================
    9:  * Guest Route
   10:  * =========================================
   11:  *
   12:  * Authentication pages use this guard so an
   13:  * already authenticated user is directed to
   14:  * the main application dashboard.
   15:  */
   16: 
   17: function GuestRoute({ children = null }) {
   18:   const { isAuthenticated, isInitializing } = useAuth();
   19: 
   20:   if (isInitializing) {
   21:     return (
   22:       <main className="route-guard-status" aria-live="polite" aria-busy="true">
   23:         <div className="route-guard-spinner" aria-hidden="true" />
   24: 
   25:         <p>Checking your session...</p>
   26:       </main>
   27:     );
   28:   }
   29: 
   30:   if (isAuthenticated) {
   31:     return <Navigate to="/dashboard" replace />;
   32:   }
   33: 
   34:   return children || <Outlet />;
   35: }
   36: 
   37: export default GuestRoute;

FILE: D:\Documents\Project\Portfolio\portfolio-plateform\frontend\src\routes\ProtectedRoute.jsx
--------------------------------------------------
    1: import { Navigate, Outlet } from "react-router-dom";
    2: 
    3: import { AUTH_STATUS, useAuth } from "../context/AuthContext.jsx";
    4: 
    5: import "./RouteGuards.css";
    6: 
    7: /*
    8:  * =========================================
    9:  * Protected Route
   10:  * =========================================
   11:  *
   12:  * This component does not provide backend
   13:  * security. Every protected API endpoint must
   14:  * still validate the server-side session.
   15:  */
   16: 
   17: function ProtectedRoute({ children = null }) {
   18:   const {
   19:     status,
   20:     error,
   21:     isAuthenticated,
   22:     isInitializing,
   23:     restoreAuthentication,
   24:   } = useAuth();
   25: 
   26:   /*
   27:    * Wait for initial cookie-based session
   28:    * restoration before redirecting.
   29:    */
   30: 
   31:   if (isInitializing) {
   32:     return (
   33:       <main className="route-guard-status" aria-live="polite" aria-busy="true">
   34:         <div className="route-guard-spinner" aria-hidden="true" />
   35: 
   36:         <p>Checking your session...</p>
   37:       </main>
   38:     );
   39:   }
   40: 
   41:   /*
   42:    * A backend or network failure is different
   43:    * from an ordinary signed-out state.
   44:    */
   45: 
   46:   if (status === AUTH_STATUS.ERROR) {
   47:     return (
   48:       <main className="route-guard-status" role="alert">
   49:         <div className="route-guard-panel">
   50:           <span className="route-guard-eyebrow">Connection problem</span>
   51: 
   52:           <h1>We could not verify your session</h1>
   53: 
   54:           <p>
   55:             {error?.message ||
   56:               "The authentication service is temporarily unavailable."}
   57:           </p>
   58: 
   59:           <button
   60:             type="button"
   61:             onClick={() => {
   62:               void restoreAuthentication();
   63:             }}
   64:           >
   65:             Try Again
   66:           </button>
   67:         </div>
   68:       </main>
   69:     );
   70:   }
   71: 
   72:   /*
   73:    * Do not preserve the previous protected
   74:    * location. A future successful login will
   75:    * always begin at /dashboard.
   76:    */
   77: 
   78:   if (!isAuthenticated) {
   79:     return <Navigate to="/auth/login" replace />;
   80:   }
   81: 
   82:   return children || <Outlet />;
   83: }
   84: 
   85: export default ProtectedRoute;

    1: import { apiDelete, apiGet, apiPost } from "../apiClient.js";

    3: /*
    4:  * =========================================
    5:  * Session Normalization
    6:  * =========================================
    7:  */
    8: 
    9: function normalizeSession(session) {
   10:   if (!session || typeof session !== "object" || !session.id) {
   11:     return null;
   12:   }
   13: 
   14:   return {
   15:     id: session.id,
   16: 
   17:     deviceName:
   18:       typeof session.deviceName === "string" && session.deviceName.trim()
   19:         ? session.deviceName.trim()
   20:         : "Unknown device",
   21: 
   22:     createdAt: session.createdAt || null,
   23: 
   24:     lastUsedAt: session.lastUsedAt || null,
   25: 
   26:     expiresAt: session.expiresAt || null,
   27: 
   28:     isCurrent: Boolean(session.isCurrent),
   29:   };
   30: }

   89: export class ApiError extends Error {
   90:   constructor({
   91:     message,
   92:     status = 0,
   93:     code = "API_REQUEST_FAILED",
   94:     fieldErrors = {},
   95:     errors = [],
   96:     details = null,

  102:       cause,

  105:     this.name = "ApiError";
  106:

  108:

  110:

  112:       fieldErrors && typeof fieldErrors === "object" ? fieldErrors : {};

  115:

  124: /*
  125:  * =========================================
  126:  * Endpoint Normalization
  127:  * =========================================
  128:  */
  129: 
  130: function normalizeEndpoint(endpoint) {
  131:   if (typeof endpoint !== "string" || !endpoint.trim()) {
  132:     throw new TypeError("A relative API endpoint is required.");
  133:   }
  134: 
  135:   const normalizedEndpoint = endpoint.trim();
  136: 
  137:   /*
  138:    * Prevent accidental cookie-bearing
  139:    * requests to arbitrary external origins.
  140:    */
  141: 
  142:   if (/^[a-z][a-z\d+\-.]*:\/\//i.test(normalizedEndpoint)) {
  143:     throw new TypeError("API endpoints must be relative paths.");
  144:   }
  145: 
  146:   return normalizedEndpoint.startsWith("/")
  147:     ? normalizedEndpoint
  148:     : `/${normalizedEndpoint}`;
  149: }
  150: 
  151: /*
  152:  * =========================================
  153:  * Query Parameters
  154:  * =========================================
  155:  */
  156: 
  157: function appendQueryParameters(url, query) {
  158:   if (!query || typeof query !== "object") {
  159:     return url;
  160:   }
  161: 
  162:   const requestUrl = new URL(url);
  163: 
  164:   for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(query)) {
  165:     if (value === undefined || value === null || value === "") {
  166:       continue;
  167:     }
  168: 
  169:     if (Array.isArray(value)) {
  170:       for (const item of value) {
  171:         requestUrl.searchParams.append(name, String(item));
  172:       }
  173: 
  174:       continue;
  175:     }
  176: 
  177:     requestUrl.searchParams.set(name, String(value));
  178:   }
  179: 
  180:   return requestUrl.toString();
  181: }
  182: 
  183: /*
  184:  * =========================================
  185:  * Request Body Preparation
  186:  * =========================================
  187:  */
  188: 
  189: function isFormData(value) {
  190:   return typeof FormData !== "undefined" && value instanceof FormData;
  191: }
  192: 
  193: function isUrlSearchParams(value) {
  194:   return (
  195:     typeof URLSearchParams !== "undefined" && value instanceof URLSearchParams
  196:   );
  197: }
  198: 
  199: function isBlob(value) {
  200:   return typeof Blob !== "undefined" && value instanceof Blob;
  201: }
  202: 
  203: function shouldSerializeAsJson(body) {
  204:   return (
  205:     body !== undefined &&
  206:     body !== null &&
  207:     typeof body === "object" &&
  208:     !isFormData(body) &&
  209:     !isUrlSearchParams(body) &&
  210:     !isBlob(body) &&
  211:     !(body instanceof ArrayBuffer)
  212:   );
  213: }
  214: 
  215: function prepareRequestBody({ body, headers }) {
  216:   if (body === undefined || body === null) {
  217:     return undefined;
  218:   }
  219: 
  220:   if (shouldSerializeAsJson(body)) {
  221:     if (!headers.has("Content-Type")) {
  222:       headers.set("Content-Type", "application/json");
  223:     }
  224: 
  225:     return JSON.stringify(body);
  226:   }
  227: 
  228:   /*
  229:    * Never set Content-Type manually for
  230:    * FormData. The browser must add its
  231:    * multipart boundary.
  232:    */
  233: 
  234:   return body;
  235: }
  236: 
  237: /*
  238:  * =========================================
  239:  * Response Parsing
  240:  * =========================================
  241:  */
  242: 
  243: async function parseResponseBody(response) {
  244:   if (response.status === 204 || response.status === 205) {
  245:     return null;
  246:   }
  247: 
  248:   const text = await response.text();
  249: 
  250:   if (!text) {
  251:     return null;
  252:   }
  253: 
  254:   const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") || "";
  255: 
  256:   if (contentType.includes("application/json")) {
  257:     try {
  258:       return JSON.parse(text);
  259:     } catch {
  260:       return {
  261:         message: "The server returned an invalid JSON response.",
  262:       };
  263:     }
  264:   }
  265: 
  266:   /*
  267:    * Some development proxies may omit the
  268:    * JSON content type. Attempt JSON parsing
  269:    * before treating the body as plain text.
  270:    */
  271: 
  272:   try {
  273:     return JSON.parse(text);
  274:   } catch {
  275:     return {
  276:       message: text,
  277:     };
  278:   }
  279: }
  280:

  283:  * API Error Creation

  285:  */
  286: 
  287: function createResponseError({ response, data, method, url }) {
  288:   const error = new ApiError({
  289:     message: data?.message || `The server returned HTTP ${response.status}.`,
  290: 
  291:     status: response.status,
  292: 
  293:     code: data?.code || "API_REQUEST_FAILED",
  294: 
  295:     fieldErrors: data?.fieldErrors,
  296: 
  297:     errors: data?.errors,
  298: 
  299:     details: data?.details,
  300: 
  301:     method,
  302: 
  303:     url,
  304:   });
  305: 
  306:   notifyInvalidAuthenticationSession(error);
  307: 
  308:   return error;
  309: }

  311: /*
  312:  * =========================================
  313:  * Timeout and Abort Signal
  314:  * =========================================
  315:  */
  316: 
  317: function createRequestAbortController({ signal, timeoutMs }) {
  318:   const controller = new AbortController();
  319: 
  320:   let wasTimedOut = false;
  321: 
  322:   const handleExternalAbort = () => {
  323:     controller.abort(signal?.reason);
  324:   };
  325: 
  326:   if (signal) {
  327:     if (signal.aborted) {
  328:       handleExternalAbort();
  329:     } else {
  330:       signal.addEventListener("abort", handleExternalAbort, {
  331:         once: true,
  332:       });
  333:     }
  334:   }
  335: 
  336:   const timeoutId = globalThis.setTimeout(() => {
  337:     wasTimedOut = true;
  338: 
  339:     controller.abort();
  340:   }, timeoutMs);
  341: 
  342:   return {
  343:     signal: controller.signal,
  344: 
  345:     wasTimedOut() {
  346:       return wasTimedOut;
  347:     },
  348: 
  349:     cleanup() {
  350:       globalThis.clearTimeout(timeoutId);
  351: 
  352:       signal?.removeEventListener?.("abort", handleExternalAbort);
  353:     },
  354:   };
  355: }
  356: 
  357: /*
  358:  * =========================================
  359:  * API Request
  360:  * =========================================
  361:  */
  362: 
  363: export async function apiRequest(
  364:   endpoint,
  365:   {
  366:     method = "GET",
  367:     body,
  368:     query,
  369:     headers: customHeaders,
  370:     signal,
  371:     timeoutMs = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS,
  372:     cache = "no-store",
  373:   } = {},
  374: ) {
  375:   const normalizedMethod = String(method).trim().toUpperCase() || "GET";
  376: 
  377:   const normalizedEndpoint = normalizeEndpoint(endpoint);
  378: 
  379:   const requestUrl = appendQueryParameters(
  380:     `${API_BASE_URL}${normalizedEndpoint}`,
  381:     query,
  382:   );
  383: 
  384:   const headers = new Headers(customHeaders || {});
  385: 
  386:   if (!headers.has("Accept")) {
  387:     headers.set("Accept", "application/json");
  388:   }
  389: 
  390:   const requestBody = prepareRequestBody({
  391:     body,
  392: 
  393:     headers,
  394:   });
  395: 
  396:   const abortState = createRequestAbortController({
  397:     signal,
  398: 
  399:     timeoutMs: Number(timeoutMs) > 0 ? Number(timeoutMs) : DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS,
  400:   });
  401: 
  402:   try {
  403:     const response = await fetch(requestUrl, {
  404:       method: normalizedMethod,
  405: 
  406:       /*
  407:        * Required for HttpOnly session
  408:        * cookies on cross-origin requests.
  409:        */
  410: 
  411:       credentials: "include",
  412: 
  413:       headers,
  414: 
  415:       body: ["GET", "HEAD"].includes(normalizedMethod)
  416:         ? undefined
  417:         : requestBody,
  418: 
  419:       signal: abortState.signal,
  420: 
  421:       cache,
  422:     });
  423: 
  424:     const data = await parseResponseBody(response);
  425: 
  426:     if (!response.ok) {
  427:       throw createResponseError({
  428:         response,
  429: 
  430:         data,
  431: 
  432:         method: normalizedMethod,
  433: 
  434:         url: requestUrl,
  435:       });
  436:     }
  437: 
  438:     return data;
  439:   } catch (error) {
  440:     if (error instanceof ApiError) {
  441:       throw error;
  442:     }
  443: 
  444:     if (error?.name === "AbortError") {
  445:       throw new ApiError({
  446:         message: abortState.wasTimedOut()
  447:           ? "The server took too long to respond."
  448:           : "The request was canceled.",
  449: 
  450:         status: 0,
  451: 
  452:         code: abortState.wasTimedOut()
  453:           ? "API_REQUEST_TIMEOUT"
  454:           : "API_REQUEST_ABORTED",
  455: 
  456:         method: normalizedMethod,
  457: 
  458:         url: requestUrl,
  459: 
  460:         cause: error,
  461:       });
  462:     }
  463: 
  464:     throw new ApiError({
  465:       message:
  466:         "Unable to connect to the server. Check your connection and try again.",
  467: 
  468:       status: 0,
  469: 
  470:       code: "API_NETWORK_ERROR",
  471: 
  472:       method: normalizedMethod,
  473: 
  474:       url: requestUrl,
  475: 
  476:       cause: error,
  477:     });
  478:   } finally {
  479:     abortState.cleanup();
  480:   }
  481: }
  482: 
  483: /*

  141: function requestToPromise(request) {
  142:   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  143:     request.onsuccess = () => {
  144:       resolve(request.result);
  145:     };
  146: 
  147:     request.onerror = () => {
  148:       reject(
  149:         request.error ||
  150:           createCertificationDocumentStorageError(
  151:             "An IndexedDB request failed.",
  152:             "The certificate document operation could not be completed.",
  153:           ),
  154:       );
  155:     };
  156:   });
  157: }
  158: 
  159: function transactionToPromise(transaction) {
  160:   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  161:     transaction.oncomplete = () => {
  162:       resolve();
  163:     };
  164: 
  165:     transaction.onerror = () => {
  166:       reject(
  167:         transaction.error ||
  168:           createCertificationDocumentStorageError(
  169:             "The IndexedDB transaction failed.",
  170:             "The certificate document operation could not be completed.",
  171:           ),
  172:       );
  173:     };
  174: 
  175:     transaction.onabort = () => {
  176:       reject(
  177:         transaction.error ||
  178:           createCertificationDocumentStorageError(
  179:             "The IndexedDB transaction was aborted.",
  180:             "The certificate document operation was cancelled.",
  181:           ),
  182:       );
  183:     };
  184:   });
  185: }

  187: /*
  188:  * =========================================
  189:  * Open Database
  190:  * =========================================
  191:  */
  192: 
  193: function openCertificationDocumentDatabase() {
  194:   const indexedDb = getIndexedDb();
  195: 
  196:   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  197:     const request = indexedDb.open(
  198:       CERTIFICATION_DOCUMENT_DATABASE_NAME,
  199:       CERTIFICATION_DOCUMENT_DATABASE_VERSION,
  200:     );
  201: 
  202:     request.onupgradeneeded = () => {
  203:       const database = request.result;
  204: 
  205:       let store;
  206: 
  207:       if (
  208:         !database.objectStoreNames.contains(CERTIFICATION_DOCUMENT_STORE_NAME)
  209:       ) {
  210:         store = database.createObjectStore(CERTIFICATION_DOCUMENT_STORE_NAME, {
  211:           keyPath: "storageKey",
  212:         });
  213:       } else {
  214:         store = request.transaction.objectStore(
  215:           CERTIFICATION_DOCUMENT_STORE_NAME,
  216:         );
  217:       }
  218: 
  219:       if (!store.indexNames.contains(CERTIFICATION_ID_INDEX_NAME)) {
  220:         store.createIndex(CERTIFICATION_ID_INDEX_NAME, "certificationId", {
  221:           unique: false,
  222:         });
  223:       }
  224:     };
  225: 
  226:     request.onsuccess = () => {
  227:       resolve(request.result);
  228:     };
  229: 
  230:     request.onerror = () => {
  231:       reject(
  232:         createCertificationDocumentStorageError(
  233:           "Unable to open the Certification document database.",
  234:           "Certificate document storage could not be opened.",
  235:           request.error,
  236:         ),
  237:       );
  238:     };
  239: 
  240:     request.onblocked = () => {
  241:       reject(
  242:         createCertificationDocumentStorageError(
  243:           "The Certification document database upgrade was blocked.",
  244:           "Close other tabs using this portfolio and try again.",
  245:         ),
  246:       );
  247:     };
  248:   });
  249: }

  281: export async function writeCertificationDocument({
  282:   file,
  283:   certificationId = "",
  284:   documentId = "",
  285:   storageKey = "",
  286: } = {}) {
  287:   validateDocumentFile(file);
  288: 
  289:   const normalizedCertificationId = getText(certificationId);
  290: 
  291:   const normalizedDocumentId =
  292:     getText(documentId) || createId("certification-document");
  293: 
  294:   const normalizedStorageKey =
  295:     getText(storageKey) ||
  296:     createCertificationDocumentStorageKey(
  297:       normalizedCertificationId,
  298:       normalizedDocumentId,
  299:     );
  300: 
  301:   const database = await openCertificationDocumentDatabase();
  302: 
  303:   const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
  304: 
  305:   /*
  306:    * Store a Blob instead of the original File object.
  307:    * The file name and type remain available in metadata.
  308:    */
  309: 
  310:   const blob = file.slice(0, file.size, file.type);
  311: 
  312:   const record = {
  313:     storageKey: normalizedStorageKey,
  314: 
  315:     certificationId: normalizedCertificationId,
  316: 
  317:     documentId: normalizedDocumentId,
  318: 
  319:     fileName: getText(file.name),
  320: 
  321:     extension: getCertificationDocumentExtension(file.name),
  322: 
  323:     mimeType: getText(file.type) || "application/octet-stream",
  324: 
  325:     size: Number(file.size) || 0,
  326: 
  327:     previewMode: getCertificationDocumentPreviewMode({
  328:       fileName: file.name,
  329:       mimeType: file.type,
  330:     }),
  331: 
  332:     blob,
  333: 
  334:     createdAt: timestamp,
  335:     updatedAt: timestamp,
  336:   };
  337: 
  338:   try {
  339:     const transaction = database.transaction(
  340:       CERTIFICATION_DOCUMENT_STORE_NAME,
  341:       "readwrite",
  342:     );
  343: 
  344:     const store = transaction.objectStore(CERTIFICATION_DOCUMENT_STORE_NAME);
  345: 
  346:     const existingRecord = await requestToPromise(
  347:       store.get(normalizedStorageKey),
  348:     );
  349: 
  350:     if (existingRecord?.createdAt) {
  351:       record.createdAt = existingRecord.createdAt;
  352:     }
  353: 
  354:     store.put(record);
  355: 
  356:     await transactionToPromise(transaction);
  357: 
  358:     /*
  359:      * Return metadata only.
  360:      * Do not return the stored Blob as part of the
  361:      * Certification model.
  362:      */
  363: 
  364:     return {
  365:       storageKey: record.storageKey,
  366: 
  367:       certificationId: record.certificationId,
  368: 
  369:       documentId: record.documentId,
  370: 
  371:       fileName: record.fileName,
  372: 
  373:       extension: record.extension,
  374: 
  375:       mimeType: record.mimeType,
  376: 
  377:       size: record.size,
  378: 
  379:       previewMode: record.previewMode,
  380: 
  381:       createdAt: record.createdAt,
  382: 
  383:       updatedAt: record.updatedAt,
  384:     };
  385:   } catch (error) {
  386:     if (error?.name === "CertificationDocumentStorageError") {
  387:       throw error;
  388:     }
  389: 
  390:     throw createCertificationDocumentStorageError(
  391:       "Unable to save the Certification document.",
  392:       "The certificate document could not be saved.",
  393:       error,
  394:     );

  396:     database.close();

  490: export async function deleteCertificationDocument(storageKey) {
  491:   const normalizedStorageKey = getText(storageKey);
  492: 
  493:   if (!normalizedStorageKey) {
  494:     return false;
  495:   }
  496: 
  497:   const database = await openCertificationDocumentDatabase();

  501:       CERTIFICATION_DOCUMENT_STORE_NAME,

  520:

  523:     throw createCertificationDocumentStorageError(
  524:       "Unable to delete the Certification document.",
  525:       "The certificate document could not be deleted.",
  526:       error,
  527:     );
  528:   } finally {
  529:     database.close();
  530:   }

  534:  * =========================================
  535:  * Delete Multiple Documents
  536:  * =========================================
  537:  */
  538: 
  539: export async function deleteCertificationDocuments(storageKeys = []) {
  540:   const keys = [...new Set(getArray(storageKeys).map(getText).filter(Boolean))];
  541: 
  542:   if (keys.length === 0) {
  543:     return 0;
  544:   }
  545: 
  546:   const database = await openCertificationDocumentDatabase();
  547: 
  548:   try {
  549:     const transaction = database.transaction(
  550:       CERTIFICATION_DOCUMENT_STORE_NAME,
  551:       "readwrite",
  552:     );
  553: 
  554:     const store = transaction.objectStore(CERTIFICATION_DOCUMENT_STORE_NAME);
  555: 
  556:     keys.forEach((key) => {
  557:       store.delete(key);
  558:     });
  559: 
  560:     await transactionToPromise(transaction);
  561: 
  562:     return keys.length;
  563:   } catch (error) {
  564:     throw createCertificationDocumentStorageError(
  565:       "Unable to delete Certification documents.",
  566:       "One or more certificate documents could not be deleted.",
  567:       error,
  568:     );
  569:   } finally {
  570:     database.close();
  571:   }
  572: }

  584:     return [];
  585:   }
  586:

  638: 
  639: export async function clearCertificationDocumentStorage() {

  674:       "readonly",
  675:     );

  678: 
  679:     const documentCount = await requestToPromise(store.count());
  680: 
  681:     await transactionToPromise(transaction);
  682:

  685: 
  686:       databaseVersion: CERTIFICATION_DOCUMENT_DATABASE_VERSION,
  687: 
  688:       storeName: CERTIFICATION_DOCUMENT_STORE_NAME,
  689: 
  690:       documentCount,
  691:     };
  692:   } catch (error) {
  693:     throw createCertificationDocumentStorageError(
  694:       "Unable to inspect Certification document storage.",
  695:       "Certificate document storage information could not be loaded.",
  696:       error,
  697:     );

  699:     database.close();

  123: function findMatchingCertification(

  371: export async function createCertification(
  372:   certificationData,
  373:   {
  374:     documentUploads = [],
  375:     skills = null,
  376:     trainingRecords = null,
  377:     educationRecords = null,
  378:   } = {},
  379: ) {
  380:   const certifications = readStoredCertifications();
  381: 
  382:   let certification = createCertificationModel(certificationData);
  383: 
  384:   const stored = await storeDocumentUploads(certification.id, documentUploads);
  385: 
  386:   if (stored.documents.length > 0) {
  387:     certification = normalizeCertification({
  388:       ...certification,
  389: 
  390:       supportingDocuments: [
  391:         ...certification.supportingDocuments,
  392:         ...stored.documents,
  393:       ],
  394:     });
  395:   }
  396: 
  397:   try {
  398:     const validation = validateForSave(certification, {
  399:       skills,
  400:       trainingRecords,
  401:       educationRecords,

  405:       certifications,
  406:       validation.certification,
  407:     );
  408: 
  409:     if (duplicate) {
  410:       throw createDuplicateError(duplicate);
  411:     }
  412: 
  413:     const transaction = saveCertificationWithTrainingSync({
  414:       certificationRecords: [...certifications, validation.certification],
  415: 
  416:       changedCertificationIds: [validation.certification.id],
  417:     });
  418: 
  419:     const savedCertification =
  420:       transaction.certificationRecords.find(
  421:         (record) => record.id === validation.certification.id,
  422:       ) || validation.certification;
  423: 
  424:     return {
  425:       certification: savedCertification,
  426:       warnings: validation.warnings,
  427:     };
  428:   } catch (error) {
  429:     await rollbackStoredDocuments(stored.storageKeys);
  430: 
  431:     throw error;
  432:   }
  433: }

  435: /*
  436:  * =========================================
  437:  * Update Certification
  438:  * =========================================
  439:  */
  440: 
  441: export async function updateCertification(
  442:   certificationId,
  443:   certificationData,
  444:   {
  445:     documentUploads = [],
  446:     skills = null,
  447:     trainingRecords = null,
  448:     educationRecords = null,
  449:   } = {},
  450: ) {
  451:   const normalizedId = getText(certificationId);
  452: 
  453:   const certifications = readStoredCertifications();
  454: 
  455:   const certificationIndex = findCertificationIndex(
  456:     certifications,
  457:     normalizedId,
  458:   );
  459: 
  460:   if (certificationIndex < 0) {
  461:     throw createNotFoundError(normalizedId);
  462:   }
  463: 
  464:   const currentCertification = certifications[certificationIndex];
  465: 
  466:   let nextCertification = updateCertificationModel(
  467:     currentCertification,
  468:     certificationData,
  469:   );
  470: 
  471:   const stored = await storeDocumentUploads(normalizedId, documentUploads);
  472: 
  473:   if (stored.documents.length > 0) {
  474:     nextCertification = normalizeCertification({
  475:       ...nextCertification,
  476: 
  477:       supportingDocuments: [
  478:         ...nextCertification.supportingDocuments,
  479:         ...stored.documents,
  480:       ],
  481:     });
  482:   }
  483: 
  484:   try {
  485:     const validation = validateForSave(nextCertification, {
  486:       skills,
  487:       trainingRecords,
  488:       educationRecords,
  489:     });
  490: 
  491:     const duplicate = findMatchingCertification(
  492:       certifications,
  493:       validation.certification,
  494:       normalizedId,
  495:     );
  496: 
  497:     if (duplicate) {
  498:       throw createDuplicateError(duplicate);
  499:     }
  500: 
  501:     const removedStorageKeys = getRemovedDocumentStorageKeys(
  502:       currentCertification,
  503:       validation.certification,
  504:     );
  505: 
  506:     const nextCertifications = [...certifications];
  507: 
  508:     nextCertifications[certificationIndex] = validation.certification;
  509: 
  510:     const transaction = saveCertificationWithTrainingSync({
  511:       certificationRecords: nextCertifications,
  512: 
  513:       changedCertificationIds: [validation.certification.id],
  514:     });
  515: 
  516:     await removeUnusedDocuments(removedStorageKeys);
  517: 
  518:     const savedCertification =
  519:       transaction.certificationRecords.find(
  520:         (record) => record.id === validation.certification.id,
  521:       ) || validation.certification;
  522: 
  523:     return {
  524:       certification: savedCertification,
  525:       warnings: validation.warnings,
  526:     };
  527:   } catch (error) {
  528:     await rollbackStoredDocuments(stored.storageKeys);
  529: 
  530:     throw error;
  531:   }
  532: }

  536:  * Archive Certification
