  540: export async function archiveCertification(certificationId) {
  541:   const certification = getCertificationById(certificationId);
  542: 
  543:   if (!certification) {
  544:     throw createNotFoundError(getText(certificationId));
  545:   }
  546: 
  547:   if (certification.status === "archived") {
  548:     return certification;
  549:   }
  550: 
  551:   const certifications = readStoredCertifications();
  552: 
  553:   const certificationIndex = findCertificationIndex(
  554:     certifications,
  555:     certification.id,
  556:   );
  557: 
  558:   const archivedCertification = normalizeCertification({
  559:     ...certification,
  560: 
  561:     status: "archived",
  562: 
  563:     updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  564:   });
  565: 
  566:   certifications[certificationIndex] = archivedCertification;
  567: 
  568:   const transaction = saveCertificationWithTrainingSync({
  569:     certificationRecords: certifications,
  570: 
  571:     changedCertificationIds: [archivedCertification.id],
  572:   });
  573: 
  574:   return (
  575:     transaction.certificationRecords.find(
  576:       (record) => record.id === archivedCertification.id,
  577:     ) || archivedCertification
  578:   );
  579: }

  581: /*
  582:  * =========================================
  583:  * Restore Certification
  584:  * =========================================
  585:  */
  586: 
  587: export async function restoreCertification(certificationId) {
  588:   const certification = getCertificationById(certificationId);
  589: 
  590:   if (!certification) {
  591:     throw createNotFoundError(getText(certificationId));
  592:   }
  593: 
  594:   if (certification.status !== "archived") {
  595:     return certification;
  596:   }
  597: 
  598:   const certifications = readStoredCertifications();
  599: 
  600:   const duplicate = findMatchingCertification(
  601:     certifications,
  602:     certification,
  603:     certification.id,
  604:   );
  605: 
  606:   if (duplicate && duplicate.status !== "archived") {
  607:     throw createDuplicateError(duplicate);
  608:   }
  609: 
  610:   const certificationIndex = findCertificationIndex(
  611:     certifications,
  612:     certification.id,
  613:   );
  614: 
  615:   const restoredCertification = normalizeCertification({
  616:     ...certification,
  617: 
  618:     status: "active",
  619: 
  620:     updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  621:   });
  622: 
  623:   certifications[certificationIndex] = restoredCertification;
  624: 
  625:   const transaction = saveCertificationWithTrainingSync({
  626:     certificationRecords: certifications,
  627: 
  628:     changedCertificationIds: [restoredCertification.id],
  629:   });
  630: 
  631:   return (
  632:     transaction.certificationRecords.find(
  633:       (record) => record.id === restoredCertification.id,
  634:     ) || restoredCertification
  635:   );
  636: }

  638: /*
  639:  * =========================================
  640:  * Delete Certification
  641:  * =========================================
  642:  */
  643: 
  644: export async function deleteCertification(certificationId) {
  645:   const normalizedId = getText(certificationId);
  646: 
  647:   const certifications = readStoredCertifications();
  648: 
  649:   const certificationIndex = findCertificationIndex(
  650:     certifications,
  651:     normalizedId,
  652:   );
  653: 
  654:   if (certificationIndex < 0) {
  655:     throw createNotFoundError(normalizedId);
  656:   }
  657: 
  658:   const certification = certifications[certificationIndex];
  659: 
  660:   const nextCertifications = certifications.filter(
  661:     (record) => record.id !== normalizedId,
  662:   );
  663: 
  664:   /*
  665:    * Remove the metadata first.
  666:    *
  667:    * If IndexedDB cleanup fails, the deleted
  668:    * Certification does not reappear.
  669:    */
  670: 
  671:   saveCertificationWithTrainingSync({
  672:     certificationRecords: nextCertifications,
  673: 
  674:     deletedCertificationIds: [normalizedId],
  675:   });
  676: 
  677:   try {
  678:     await deleteCertificationDocumentsForCertification(normalizedId);
  679:   } catch {
  680:     await removeUnusedDocuments(getDocumentStorageKeys(certification));
  681:   }
  682: 
  683:   return certification;
  684: }

  687:  * =========================================
  688:  * Add Document
  689:  * =========================================
  690:  */
  691: 
  692: export async function addCertificationDocument(
  693:   certificationId,
  694:   file,
  695:   documentInformation = {},
  696:   validationCollections = {},
  697: ) {
  698:   const certification = getCertificationById(certificationId);
  699: 
  700:   if (!certification) {
  701:     throw createNotFoundError(getText(certificationId));
  702:   }
  703: 
  704:   const hasActiveDocument = certification.supportingDocuments.some(
  705:     (document) => document.status !== "archived",
  706:   );
  707: 
  708:   return updateCertification(certification.id, certification, {
  709:     ...validationCollections,
  710: 
  711:     documentUploads: [
  712:       {
  713:         file,
  714: 
  715:         metadata: documentInformation,
  716: 
  717:         isPrimary: documentInformation.isPrimary ?? !hasActiveDocument,
  718:       },
  719:     ],
  720:   });
  721: }
  722: 
  723: /*
  724:  * =========================================
  725:  * Remove Document
  726:  * =========================================
  727:  */
  728: 
  729: export async function removeCertificationDocument(
  730:   certificationId,
  731:   documentId,
  732:   validationCollections = {},
  733: ) {
  734:   const certification = getCertificationById(certificationId);
  735: 
  736:   if (!certification) {
  737:     throw createNotFoundError(getText(certificationId));
  738:   }
  739: 
  740:   const normalizedDocumentId = getText(documentId);
  741: 
  742:   const document = certification.supportingDocuments.find(
  743:     (item) => item.id === normalizedDocumentId,
  744:   );
  745: 
  746:   if (!document) {
  747:     throw createCertificationServiceError(
  748:       "CERTIFICATION_DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND",
  749:       `Certification document not found: ${normalizedDocumentId}`,
  750:       "The selected certificate document could not be found.",
  751:       {
  752:         certificationId: certification.id,
  753: 
  754:         documentId: normalizedDocumentId,
  755:       },
  756:     );
  757:   }
  758: 
  759:   const supportingDocuments = certification.supportingDocuments.filter(
  760:     (item) => item.id !== normalizedDocumentId,
  761:   );
  762: 
  763:   return updateCertification(
  764:     certification.id,
  765:     {
  766:       ...certification,
  767:       supportingDocuments,
  768:     },
  769:     validationCollections,
  770:   );
  771: }
  772: 
  773: /*
  774:  * =========================================
  775:  * Set Primary Preview Document
  776:  * =========================================
  777:  */
  778: 
  779: export async function setPrimaryCertificationDocument(
  780:   certificationId,
  781:   documentId,
  782:   validationCollections = {},
  783: ) {
  784:   const certification = getCertificationById(certificationId);
  785: 
  786:   if (!certification) {
  787:     throw createNotFoundError(getText(certificationId));
  788:   }
  789: 
  790:   const normalizedDocumentId = getText(documentId);
  791: 
  792:   const selectedDocument = certification.supportingDocuments.find(
  793:     (document) =>
  794:       document.id === normalizedDocumentId && document.status !== "archived",
  795:   );
  796: 
  797:   if (!selectedDocument) {
  798:     throw createCertificationServiceError(
  799:       "CERTIFICATION_DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND",
  800:       `Active Certification document not found: ${normalizedDocumentId}`,
  801:       "The selected document could not be used as the preview.",
  802:     );
  803:   }
  804: 
  805:   const supportingDocuments = certification.supportingDocuments.map(
  806:     (document) => ({
  807:       ...document,
  808: 
  809:       isPrimary:
  810:         document.id === normalizedDocumentId && document.status !== "archived",
  811:     }),
  812:   );
  813: 
  814:   return updateCertification(
  815:     certification.id,
  816:     {
  817:       ...certification,
  818:       supportingDocuments,
  819:     },
  820:     validationCollections,
  821:   );
  822: }

  824: /*
  825:  * =========================================
  826:  * Replace Document File
  827:  * =========================================
  828:  */
  829: 
  830: export async function replaceCertificationDocumentFile(
  831:   certificationId,
  832:   documentId,
  833:   file,
  834:   validationCollections = {},
  835: ) {
  836:   const certification = getCertificationById(certificationId);
  837: 
  838:   if (!certification) {
  839:     throw createNotFoundError(getText(certificationId));
  840:   }
  841: 
  842:   const normalizedDocumentId = getText(documentId);
  843: 
  844:   const currentDocument = certification.supportingDocuments.find(
  845:     (document) => document.id === normalizedDocumentId,
  846:   );
  847: 
  848:   if (!currentDocument) {
  849:     throw createCertificationServiceError(
  850:       "CERTIFICATION_DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND",
  851:       `Certification document not found: ${normalizedDocumentId}`,
  852:       "The selected certificate document could not be found.",
  853:     );
  854:   }
  855: 
  856:   /*
  857:    * Preserve the existing document so it can be
  858:    * restored if metadata validation fails.
  859:    */
  860: 
  861:   const previousStoredDocument = await readCertificationDocument(
  862:     currentDocument.storageKey,
  863:   );
  864: 
  865:   const stored = await writeCertificationDocument({
  866:     file,
  867: 
  868:     certificationId: certification.id,
  869: 
  870:     documentId: currentDocument.id,
  871: 
  872:     storageKey: currentDocument.storageKey,
  873:   });
  874: 
  875:   const replacement = createCertificationDocument({
  876:     ...currentDocument,
  877: 
  878:     fileName: stored.fileName,
  879:     extension: stored.extension,
  880:     mimeType: stored.mimeType,
  881:     size: stored.size,
  882:     storageKey: stored.storageKey,
  883:     previewMode: stored.previewMode,
  884: 
  885:     updatedAt: stored.updatedAt,
  886: 
  887:     uploadedAt: stored.updatedAt,
  888:   });
  889: 
  890:   const supportingDocuments = certification.supportingDocuments.map(
  891:     (document) =>
  892:       document.id === normalizedDocumentId ? replacement : document,
  893:   );
  894: 
  895:   try {
  896:     return await updateCertification(
  897:       certification.id,
  898:       {
  899:         ...certification,
  900:         supportingDocuments,
  901:       },
  902:       validationCollections,
  903:     );
  904:   } catch (error) {
  905:     /*
  906:      * Restore the previous Blob if updating the
  907:      * Certification metadata fails.
  908:      */
  909: 
  910:     if (previousStoredDocument?.blob && typeof File !== "undefined") {
  911:       const previousFile = new File(
  912:         [previousStoredDocument.blob],
  913:         previousStoredDocument.fileName,
  914:         {
  915:           type: previousStoredDocument.mimeType,
  916:         },
  917:       );
  918: 
  919:       await writeCertificationDocument({
  920:         file: previousFile,
  921: 
  922:         certificationId: certification.id,
  923: 
  924:         documentId: currentDocument.id,
  925: 
  926:         storageKey: currentDocument.storageKey,
  927:       }).catch(() => {});
  928:     }
  929: 
  930:     throw error;
  931:   }
  932: }

   16: function createCertificationStorageError(message, publicMessage, cause = null) {
   17:   const error = new Error(message);
   18: 
   19:   error.name = "CertificationStorageError";
   20:   error.code = "CERTIFICATION_STORAGE_ERROR";
   21:   error.publicMessage = publicMessage;

   32:  * Browser Storage
   33:  * =========================================
   34:  */
   35: 
   36: function getBrowserStorage() {
   37:   if (typeof window === "undefined" || !window.localStorage) {
   38:     throw createCertificationStorageError(
   39:       "Certification storage is unavailable.",
   40:       "Certification storage is not supported in this environment.",
   41:     );
   42:   }

   47: /*
   48:  * =========================================
   49:  * Empty Storage Document
   50:  * =========================================
   51:  */
   52: 
   53: function createEmptyCertificationStorageDocument() {
   54:   return {
   55:     storageVersion: CERTIFICATION_STORAGE_VERSION,
   56: 
   57:     certificationModelVersion: CERTIFICATION_MODEL_VERSION,
   58: 
   59:     certificationRecords: [],
   60: 
   61:     updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
   62:   };
   63: }
   64: 
   65: /*
   66:  * =========================================
   67:  * Parse Storage Document
   68:  * =========================================
   69:  */
   70: 
   71: function parseCertificationStorageDocument(value) {
   72:   if (!value) {
   73:     return createEmptyCertificationStorageDocument();
   74:   }
   75: 
   76:   let parsedValue;
   77: 
   78:   try {
   79:     parsedValue = JSON.parse(value);
   80:   } catch (cause) {
   81:     throw createCertificationStorageError(
   82:       "Unable to parse stored certification data.",
   83:       "The saved Certification Library could not be read.",
   84:       cause,
   85:     );
   86:   }
   87: 
   88:   /*
   89:    * Support the original format where the stored
   90:    * value was only an array of certifications.
   91:    */
   92: 
   93:   if (Array.isArray(parsedValue)) {
   94:     return {
   95:       ...createEmptyCertificationStorageDocument(),
   96: 
   97:       certificationRecords: normalizeCertificationCollection(parsedValue),
   98:     };
   99:   }
  100: 
  101:   if (!parsedValue || typeof parsedValue !== "object") {
  102:     throw createCertificationStorageError(
  103:       "Stored certification data has an invalid structure.",
  104:       "The saved Certification Library has an invalid format.",
  105:     );
  106:   }
  107: 
  108:   return {
  109:     storageVersion:
  110:       Number(parsedValue.storageVersion) || CERTIFICATION_STORAGE_VERSION,
  111: 
  112:     certificationModelVersion:
  113:       Number(parsedValue.certificationModelVersion) ||
  114:       CERTIFICATION_MODEL_VERSION,
  115: 
  116:     certificationRecords: normalizeCertificationCollection(
  117:       parsedValue.certificationRecords ||
  118:         parsedValue.certifications ||
  119:         parsedValue.records,
  120:     ),
  121: 
  122:     updatedAt:
  123:       typeof parsedValue.updatedAt === "string"
  124:         ? parsedValue.updatedAt
  125:         : new Date().toISOString(),
  126:   };
  127: }
  128: 
  129: /*
  130:  * =========================================
  131:  * Read Storage
  132:  * =========================================
  133:  */
  134: 
  135: export function readCertificationStorage() {
  136:   const storage = getBrowserStorage();
  137: 
  138:   try {
  139:     return parseCertificationStorageDocument(
  140:       storage.getItem(CERTIFICATION_STORAGE_KEY),
  141:     );
  142:   } catch (error) {
  143:     if (error?.name === "CertificationStorageError") {
  144:       throw error;
  145:     }
  146: 
  147:     throw createCertificationStorageError(
  148:       "Unable to read Certification Library storage.",
  149:       "Your saved certification records could not be loaded.",
  150:       error,
  151:     );
  152:   }
  153: }
  154: 
  155: /*
  156:  * =========================================
  157:  * Write Storage
  158:  * =========================================
  159:  */
  160: 
  161: export function writeCertificationStorage(certificationRecords) {
  162:   const storage = getBrowserStorage();
  163: 
  164:   const document = {
  165:     storageVersion: CERTIFICATION_STORAGE_VERSION,
  166: 
  167:     certificationModelVersion: CERTIFICATION_MODEL_VERSION,
  168: 
  169:     /*
  170:      * normalizeCertificationCollection removes
  171:      * transient File, Blob, and object-URL values
  172:      * because they are not part of the model.
  173:      *
  174:      * Only document metadata and IndexedDB storage
  175:      * keys are written to localStorage.
  176:      */
  177: 
  178:     certificationRecords:
  179:       normalizeCertificationCollection(certificationRecords),
  180: 
  181:     updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  182:   };
  183: 
  184:   try {
  185:     storage.setItem(CERTIFICATION_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(document));
  186: 
  187:     return document;
  188:   } catch (error) {
  189:     throw createCertificationStorageError(
  190:       "Unable to write Certification Library storage.",
  191:       "Your certification records could not be saved.",
  192:       error,
  193:     );
  194:   }
  195: }

  217: /*
  218:  * =========================================
  219:  * Update Collection
  220:  * =========================================
  221:  */
  222: 
  223: export function updateStoredCertifications(updater) {
  224:   if (typeof updater !== "function") {
  225:     throw createCertificationStorageError(
  226:       "The certification updater must be a function.",
  227:       "The Certification Library could not be updated.",
  228:     );
  229:   }
  230: 
  231:   const currentRecords = [...readStoredCertifications()];
  232: 
  233:   const nextRecords = updater(currentRecords);
  234: 
  235:   if (!Array.isArray(nextRecords)) {
  236:     throw createCertificationStorageError(
  237:       "The certification updater did not return an array.",
  238:       "The Certification Library could not be updated.",
  239:     );
  240:   }
  241: 
  242:   return replaceStoredCertifications(nextRecords);
  243: }

  257:       "The saved Certification Library could not be cleared.",
  258:       error,
  259:     );
  260:   }
  261: }

  257: 
  258: function findMatchingCertification(certifications, training) {
  259:   const trainingCredentialId = normalizeComparisonText(
  260:     training?.completion?.credentialId,
  261:   );
  262: 
  263:   const trainingCredentialUrl = normalizeComparisonText(
  264:     training?.completion?.credentialUrl,
  265:   );
  266: 
  267:   /*
  268:    * Credential ID is the strongest match.
  269:    */
  270: 
  271:   if (trainingCredentialId) {
  272:     const credentialMatch = certifications.find(
  273:       (certification) =>
  274:         getCertificationCredentialId(certification) === trainingCredentialId,
  275:     );
  276: 
  277:     if (credentialMatch) {
  278:       return credentialMatch;
  279:     }
  280:   }
  281: 
  282:   /*
  283:    * Verification URL is the next strongest match.
  284:    */
  285: 
  286:   if (trainingCredentialUrl) {
  287:     const urlMatch = certifications.find(
  288:       (certification) =>
  289:         getCertificationVerificationUrl(certification) ===
  290:         trainingCredentialUrl,
  291:     );
  292: 
  293:     if (urlMatch) {
  294:       return urlMatch;
  295:     }
  296:   }
  297: 
  298:   /*
  299:    * Fall back to Training title and provider name.
  300:    */
  301: 
  302:   const trainingTitle = normalizeComparisonText(training?.title);
  303: 
  304:   const providerName = normalizeComparisonText(training?.provider?.name);
  305: 
  306:   if (!trainingTitle || !providerName) {
  307:     return null;
  308:   }
  309: 
  310:   return (
  311:     certifications.find(
  312:       (certification) =>
  313:         normalizeComparisonText(certification?.name) === trainingTitle &&
  314:         normalizeComparisonText(certification?.issuingOrganization?.name) ===
  315:           providerName,
  316:     ) || null
  317:   );
  318: }

  335: function addTrainingRelationship(certification, training) {
  336:   const currentRelationships = getArray(
  337:     certification?.relatedRecords?.trainingRelationships,
  338:   );
  339: 
  340:   const alreadyLinked = currentRelationships.some(
  341:     (relationship) =>
  342:       getText(relationship?.trainingId || relationship?.trainingRecordId) ===
  343:       training.id,
  344:   );
  345: 
  346:   if (alreadyLinked) {
  347:     return certification;
  348:   }
  349: 
  350:   if (
  351:     currentRelationships.length >=
  352:     CERTIFICATION_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumRelatedTrainingRecords
  353:   ) {
  354:     throw createMigrationError({
  355:       message:
  356:         `Certification "${certification.id}" cannot accept ` +
  357:         `Training relationship "${training.id}".`,
  358: 
  359:       publicMessage:
  360:         "A Certification reached its maximum number of linked Training records.",
  361: 
  362:       code: "CERTIFICATION_TRAINING_MIGRATION_RELATIONSHIP_LIMIT",
  363: 
  364:       details: {
  365:         certificationId: certification.id,
  366:         trainingId: training.id,
  367:       },
  368:     });
  369:   }
  370: 
  371:   return normalizeCertification({
  372:     ...certification,
  373: 
  374:     relatedRecords: {
  375:       ...certification.relatedRecords,
  376: 
  377:       trainingRelationships: [
  378:         ...currentRelationships,
  379: 
  380:         createCertificationTrainingRelationship(
  381:           training,
  382:           currentRelationships.length,
  383:         ),
  384:       ],
  385:     },
  386: 
  387:     updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  388:   });
  389: }

  490: /*
  491:  * =========================================
  492:  * File Conversion
  493:  * =========================================
  494:  */
  495: 
  496: function createFileFromStoredValue(storedFile, document) {
  497:   if (typeof File === "undefined") {
  498:     return null;
  499:   }
  500: 
  501:   if (storedFile instanceof File) {
  502:     return storedFile;
  503:   }
  504: 
  505:   if (typeof Blob !== "undefined" && storedFile instanceof Blob) {
  506:     return new File(
  507:       [storedFile],
  508:       getText(document?.fileName) ||
  509:         getText(document?.name) ||
  510:         "certificate-document",
  511:       {
  512:         type:
  513:           getText(document?.mimeType) ||
  514:           storedFile.type ||
  515:           "application/octet-stream",
  516: 
  517:         lastModified: Date.now(),
  518:       },
  519:     );
  520:   }
  521: 
  522:   return null;
  523: }

  525: async function copyTrainingCertificateDocuments(
  526:   training,
  527:   certification,
  528:   report,
  529: ) {
  530:   const copiedDocuments = [];
  531:   const copiedStorageKeys = [];
  532: 
  533:   const legacyDocuments = getLegacyCertificateDocuments(training);
  534: 
  535:   for (const legacyDocument of legacyDocuments) {
  536:     const originalStorageKey = getText(legacyDocument?.storageKey);
  537: 
  538:     if (!originalStorageKey) {
  539:       report.documentFailures.push({
  540:         trainingId: training.id,
  541:         certificationId: certification.id,
  542:         documentId: getText(legacyDocument?.id),
  543:         fileName: getText(legacyDocument?.fileName),
  544:         reason: "The Training document has no storage key.",
  545:       });
  546: 
  547:       continue;
  548:     }
  549: 
  550:     try {
  551:       const storedValue = await getStoredDocumentFile(originalStorageKey);
  552: 
  553:       const file = createFileFromStoredValue(storedValue, legacyDocument);
  554: 
  555:       if (!file) {
  556:         throw new Error("The Training document file is unavailable.");
  557:       }
  558: 
  559:       if (!isSupportedCertificationDocument(file)) {
  560:         throw new Error(
  561:           "The Training document format is not supported by Certification storage.",
  562:         );
  563:       }
  564: 
  565:       if (!isCertificationDocumentWithinSizeLimit(file)) {
  566:         throw new Error(
  567:           "The Training document exceeds the Certification file-size limit.",
  568:         );
  569:       }
  570: 
  571:       const storedDocument = await writeCertificationDocument({
  572:         file,
  573:         certificationId: certification.id,
  574:       });
  575: 
  576:       copiedStorageKeys.push(storedDocument.storageKey);
  577: 
  578:       const copiedDocument = createCertificationDocument(
  579:         {
  580:           id: storedDocument.documentId,
  581: 
  582:           documentType: "certificate",
  583: 
  584:           name:
  585:             getText(legacyDocument?.name) ||
  586:             getText(certification?.name) ||
  587:             storedDocument.fileName,
  588: 
  589:           description:
  590:             getText(legacyDocument?.description) ||
  591:             "Certificate migrated from the Training Library.",
  592: 
  593:           fileName: storedDocument.fileName,
  594:           extension: storedDocument.extension,
  595:           mimeType: storedDocument.mimeType,
  596:           size: storedDocument.size,
  597:           storageKey: storedDocument.storageKey,
  598:           previewMode: storedDocument.previewMode,
  599: 
  600:           isPrimary: copiedDocuments.length === 0,
  601: 
  602:           status: "active",
  603: 
  604:           uploadedAt:
  605:             getText(legacyDocument?.uploadedAt) || storedDocument.updatedAt,
  606: 
  607:           createdAt: storedDocument.createdAt,
  608:           updatedAt: storedDocument.updatedAt,
  609:         },
  610:         copiedDocuments.length,
  611:       );
  612: 
  613:       copiedDocuments.push(copiedDocument);
  614: 
  615:       report.documentCopies.push({
  616:         trainingId: training.id,
  617:         certificationId: certification.id,
  618:         sourceDocumentId: getText(legacyDocument?.id),
  619:         sourceStorageKey: originalStorageKey,
  620:         certificationStorageKey: storedDocument.storageKey,
  621:         fileName: storedDocument.fileName,
  622:       });
  623:     } catch (error) {
  624:       report.documentFailures.push({
  625:         trainingId: training.id,
  626:         certificationId: certification.id,
  627:         documentId: getText(legacyDocument?.id),
  628:         fileName: getText(legacyDocument?.fileName),
  629:         reason:
  630:           error?.publicMessage ||
  631:           error?.message ||
  632:           "The document could not be migrated.",
  633:       });
  634:     }
  635:   }
  636: 
  637:   return {
  638:     certification: normalizeCertification({
  639:       ...certification,
  640: 
  641:       supportingDocuments: copiedDocuments,
  642: 
  643:       visibility: {
  644:         ...certification.visibility,
  645: 
  646:         showSupportingDocuments: copiedDocuments.length > 0,
  647:       },
  648:     }),
  649: 
  650:     copiedStorageKeys,
  651:   };
  652: }

  669:

  671: 
  672:     linked: [],
  673: 
  674:     skipped: [],
  675: 
  676:     documentCopies: [],

  679: 
  680:     failures: [],

  682:     completedAt: "",

  686: /*
  687:  * =========================================
  688:  * Main Migration
  689:  * =========================================
  690:  */
  691: 
  692: export async function migrateLegacyTrainingCertifications({
  693:   force = false,
  694: } = {}) {
  695:   const previousState = readMigrationState();
  696: 
  697:   if (
  698:     !force &&
  699:     Number(previousState?.version) >= CERTIFICATION_TRAINING_MIGRATION_VERSION
  700:   ) {
  701:     return {
  702:       ...createMigrationReport(),
  703: 
  704:       alreadyCompleted: true,
  705: 
  706:       completedAt: getText(previousState?.completedAt),
  707: 
  708:       previousState,
  709:     };
  710:   }
  711: 
  712:   const report = createMigrationReport();
  713: 
  714:   const originalTrainingRecords =
  715:     normalizeTrainingCollection(readStoredTraining());
  716: 
  717:   const originalCertificationRecords = normalizeCertificationCollection(
  718:     readStoredCertifications(),
  719:   );
  720: 
  721:   report.examined = originalTrainingRecords.length;
  722: 
  723:   const eligibleTrainingRecords = originalTrainingRecords.filter(
  724:     hasLegacyCertificateInformation,
  725:   );
  726: 
  727:   report.eligible = eligibleTrainingRecords.length;
  728: 
  729:   let nextCertificationRecords = [...originalCertificationRecords];
  730: 
  731:   const changedCertificationIds = new Set();
  732: 
  733:   const copiedStorageKeys = [];
  734: 
  735:   try {
  736:     for (const training of eligibleTrainingRecords) {
  737:       const recordCopiedStorageKeyStart = copiedStorageKeys.length;
  738:       try {
  739:         const linkedCertificationIds = getTrainingCertificationIds(training);
  740: 
  741:         /*
  742:          * This Training has already been migrated or
  743:          * manually linked. Do not create another record.
  744:          */
  745: 
  746:         if (linkedCertificationIds.length > 0) {
  747:           report.skipped.push({
  748:             trainingId: training.id,
  749:             reason: "Training already has a Certification relationship.",
  750:             certificationIds: linkedCertificationIds,
  751:           });
  752: 
  753:           continue;
  754:         }
  755: 
  756:         let certification = findMatchingCertification(
  757:           nextCertificationRecords,
  758:           training,
  759:         );
  760: 
  761:         if (certification) {
  762:           certification = addTrainingRelationship(certification, training);
  763: 
  764:           nextCertificationRecords = nextCertificationRecords.map((record) =>
  765:             record.id === certification.id ? certification : record,
  766:           );
  767: 
  768:           changedCertificationIds.add(certification.id);
  769: 
  770:           report.linked.push({
  771:             trainingId: training.id,
  772:             certificationId: certification.id,
  773:             created: false,
  774:           });
  775: 
  776:           continue;
  777:         }
  778: 
  779:         certification = createCertificationFromTraining(training);
  780: 
  781:         const copied = await copyTrainingCertificateDocuments(
  782:           training,
  783:           certification,
  784:           report,
  785:         );
  786: 
  787:         certification = copied.certification;
  788: 
  789:         copiedStorageKeys.push(...copied.copiedStorageKeys);
  790: 
  791:         const validation = validateCertification(certification, {
  792:           trainingRecords: originalTrainingRecords,
  793:         });
  794: 
  795:         if (!validation.isValid) {
  796:           throw createMigrationError({
  797:             message:
  798:               `Migrated Certification for Training ` +
  799:               `"${training.id}" did not pass validation.`,
  800: 
  801:             publicMessage:
  802:               "A legacy Training certificate could not be converted.",
  803: 
  804:             code: "CERTIFICATION_TRAINING_MIGRATION_VALIDATION_FAILED",
  805: 
  806:             details: {
  807:               trainingId: training.id,
  808:               validation,
  809:             },
  810:           });
  811:         }
  812: 
  813:         certification = validation.certification;
  814: 
  815:         nextCertificationRecords.push(certification);
  816: 
  817:         changedCertificationIds.add(certification.id);
  818: 
  819:         report.created.push({
  820:           trainingId: training.id,
  821:           certificationId: certification.id,
  822:           name: certification.name,
  823:         });
  824: 
  825:         report.linked.push({
  826:           trainingId: training.id,
  827:           certificationId: certification.id,
  828:           created: true,
  829:         });
  830:       } catch (recordError) {
  831:         report.failures.push({
  832:           trainingId: training.id,
  833: 
  834:           message:
  835:             recordError?.publicMessage ||
  836:             recordError?.message ||
  837:             "The Training certificate could not be migrated.",
  838: 
  839:           code:
  840:             recordError?.code ||
  841:             "CERTIFICATION_TRAINING_RECORD_MIGRATION_FAILED",
  842:         });
  843:       }
  844:     }
  845: 
  846:     /*
  847:      * Even if no new Certification was needed, write the
  848:      * migration marker so the scan is not repeated.
  849:      */
  850: 
  851:     if (changedCertificationIds.size > 0) {
  852:       saveCertificationWithTrainingSync({
  853:         certificationRecords: normalizeCertificationCollection(
  854:           nextCertificationRecords,
  855:         ),
  856: 
  857:         changedCertificationIds: [...changedCertificationIds],
  858:       });
  859:     }
  860: 
  861:     report.completedAt = new Date().toISOString();
  862: 
  863:     writeMigrationState(report);
  864: 
  865:     return report;
  866:   } catch (recordError) {
  867:     const recordStorageKeys = copiedStorageKeys.splice(
  868:       recordCopiedStorageKeyStart,
  869:     );
  870: 
  871:     if (recordStorageKeys.length > 0) {
  872:       await deleteCertificationDocuments(recordStorageKeys).catch(() => {});
  873:     }
  874: 
  875:     report.failures.push({
  876:       trainingId: training.id,
  877: 
  878:       message:
  879:         recordError?.publicMessage ||
  880:         recordError?.message ||
  881:         "The Training certificate could not be migrated.",
  882: 
  883:       code:
  884:         recordError?.code || "CERTIFICATION_TRAINING_RECORD_MIGRATION_FAILED",
  885:     });
  886:   }
  887: }

  202:   return normalizeCertification({
  203:     ...certification,
  204: 
  205:     relatedRecords: {
  206:       ...certification.relatedRecords,
  207:       trainingRelationships,
  208:     },
  209: 
  210:     updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  211:   });
  212: }
  213: 
  214: /*
  215:  * =========================================
  216:  * Add or Remove One Relationship
  217:  * =========================================
  218:  */
  219: 
  220: function synchronizeCertificationWithTraining(
  221:   certification,
  222:   training,
  223:   shouldBeLinked,
  224: ) {
  225:   const currentRelationships = getArray(
  226:     certification?.relatedRecords?.trainingRelationships,
  227:   );
  228: 
  229:   const existingRelationship = currentRelationships.find(
  230:     (relationship) => getText(relationship?.trainingId) === training.id,
  231:   );
  232: 
  233:   /*
  234:    * The Certification is not linked and does not
  235:    * need to be linked. Preserve it unchanged.
  236:    */
  237: 
  238:   if (!shouldBeLinked && !existingRelationship) {
  239:     return certification;
  240:   }
  241: 
  242:   const nextRelationships = currentRelationships.filter(
  243:     (relationship) => getText(relationship?.trainingId) !== training.id,
  244:   );
  245: 
  246:   if (shouldBeLinked) {
  247:     nextRelationships.push(
  248:       createCertificationTrainingRelationship(
  249:         training,
  250:         nextRelationships.length,
  251:       ),
  252:     );
  253:   }
  254: 
  255:   return normalizeCertification({
  256:     ...certification,
  257: 
  258:     relatedRecords: {
  259:       ...certification.relatedRecords,
  260: 
  261:       trainingRelationships: nextRelationships,
  262:     },
  263: 
  264:     updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  265:   });
  266: }
  267: 
  268: function synchronizeTrainingWithCertification(
  269:   training,
  270:   certification,
  271:   shouldBeLinked,
  272: ) {
  273:   const currentRelationships = getArray(training?.certificationRelationships);
  274: 
  275:   const existingRelationship = currentRelationships.find(
  276:     (relationship) =>
  277:       getText(relationship?.certificationId) === certification.id,
  278:   );
  279: 
  280:   /*
  281:    * This Training is not linked and does not need
  282:    * to be linked. Preserve the record unchanged.
  283:    */
  284: 
  285:   if (!shouldBeLinked && !existingRelationship) {
  286:     return training;
  287:   }
  288: 
  289:   const nextRelationships = currentRelationships.filter(
  290:     (relationship) =>
  291:       getText(relationship?.certificationId) !== certification.id,
  292:   );
  293: 
  294:   if (shouldBeLinked) {
  295:     nextRelationships.push(
  296:       createTrainingCertificationRelationship(
  297:         certification,
  298:         nextRelationships.length,
  299:       ),
  300:     );
  301:   }
  302: 
  303:   const certificationRelationships = nextRelationships.map(
  304:     (relationship, index) => ({
  305:       ...relationship,
  306:       order: index,
  307:     }),
  308:   );
  309: 
  310:   const certificationState = getText(certification?.credential?.state);
  311: 
  312:   const representsEarnedCertificate =
  313:     shouldBeLinked && ["active", "expired"].includes(certificationState);
  314: 
  315:   return {
  316:     ...training,
  317: 
  318:     certificationRelationships,
  319: 
  320:     relatedCertificationIds: certificationRelationships.map(
  321:       (relationship) => relationship.certificationId,
  322:     ),
  323: 
  324:     completion: {
  325:       ...training.completion,
  326: 
  327:       certificateEarned: representsEarnedCertificate
  328:         ? true
  329:         : training.completion?.certificateEarned === true,
  330:     },
  331: 
  332:     updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  333:   };
  334: }
  335: 
  336: /*
  337:  * =========================================
  338:  * Application-Level Transaction
  339:  * =========================================
  340:  */
  341: 
  342: function commitCollections({
  343:   originalTrainingRecords,
  344:   originalCertificationRecords,
  345:   nextTrainingRecords,
  346:   nextCertificationRecords,
  347: }) {
  348:   let trainingWriteCompleted = false;
  349:   let certificationWriteCompleted = false;
  350: 
  351:   try {
  352:     const storedTrainingRecords = replaceStoredTraining(nextTrainingRecords);
  353: 
  354:     trainingWriteCompleted = true;
  355: 
  356:     const storedCertificationRecords = replaceStoredCertifications(
  357:       nextCertificationRecords,
  358:     );
  359: 
  360:     certificationWriteCompleted = true;
  361: 
  362:     return {
  363:       trainingRecords: storedTrainingRecords,
  364:       certificationRecords: storedCertificationRecords,
  365:     };
  366:   } catch (cause) {
  367:     const rollbackErrors = [];
  368: 
  369:     if (trainingWriteCompleted || certificationWriteCompleted) {
  370:       try {
  371:         replaceStoredTraining(originalTrainingRecords);
  372:       } catch (rollbackError) {
  373:         rollbackErrors.push({
  374:           collection: "training",
  375:           error: rollbackError,
  376:         });
  377:       }
  378: 
  379:       try {
  380:         replaceStoredCertifications(originalCertificationRecords);
  381:       } catch (rollbackError) {
  382:         rollbackErrors.push({
  383:           collection: "certifications",
  384:           error: rollbackError,
  385:         });
  386:       }
  387:     }
  388: 
  389:     throw createRelationshipError(
  390:       rollbackErrors.length > 0
  391:         ? "TRAINING_CERTIFICATION_ROLLBACK_FAILED"
  392:         : "TRAINING_CERTIFICATION_TRANSACTION_FAILED",
  393: 
  394:       "Training and Certification relationship synchronization failed.",
  395: 
  396:       rollbackErrors.length > 0
  397:         ? "The relationship update failed and could not be completely restored. Reload both libraries before making more changes."
  398:         : "The Training and Certification relationship could not be saved.",
  399: 
  400:       {
  401:         rollbackErrors,
  402:         trainingWriteCompleted,
  403:         certificationWriteCompleted,
  404:       },
  405: 
  406:       cause,
  407:     );
  408:   }
  409: }
  410: 
  411: /*
  412:  * =========================================
  413:  * Training-Authoritative Synchronization
  414:  * =========================================
  415:  */
  416: 
  417: export function saveTrainingWithCertificationSync({
  418:   trainingRecords,
  419:   changedTrainingIds = [],
  420:   deletedTrainingIds = [],
  421: } = {}) {
  422:   const originalTrainingRecords = readStoredTraining();
  423: 
  424:   const originalCertificationRecords = readStoredCertifications();
  425: 
  426:   let nextTrainingRecords = normalizeTrainingCollection(trainingRecords);
  427: 
  428:   let nextCertificationRecords = normalizeCertificationCollection(
  429:     originalCertificationRecords,
  430:   );
  431: 
  432:   const changedIds = createIdSet(changedTrainingIds);
  433: 
  434:   const deletedIds = createIdSet(deletedTrainingIds);
  435: 
  436:   const trainingMap = createRecordMap(nextTrainingRecords);
  437: 
  438:   const certificationMap = createRecordMap(nextCertificationRecords);
  439: 
  440:   /*
  441:    * Remove deleted Training records from every
  442:    * Certification relationship collection.
  443:    */
  444: 
  445:   if (deletedIds.size > 0) {
  446:     nextCertificationRecords = nextCertificationRecords.map((certification) => {
  447:       const currentRelationships = getArray(
  448:         certification?.relatedRecords?.trainingRelationships,
  449:       );
  450: 
  451:       const remainingRelationships = currentRelationships.filter(
  452:         (relationship) => !deletedIds.has(getText(relationship?.trainingId)),
  453:       );
  454: 
  455:       if (remainingRelationships.length === currentRelationships.length) {
  456:         return certification;
  457:       }
  458: 
  459:       return normalizeCertification({
  460:         ...certification,
  461: 
  462:         relatedRecords: {
  463:           ...certification.relatedRecords,
  464: 
  465:           trainingRelationships: remainingRelationships,
  466:         },
  467: 
  468:         updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  469:       });
  470:     });
  471:   }
  472: 
  473:   /*
  474:    * For a Training save, Training is authoritative:
  475:    * its selected Certification IDs determine which
  476:    * Certification records should point back to it.
  477:    */
  478: 
  479:   changedIds.forEach((trainingId) => {
  480:     const training = requireTraining(trainingMap, trainingId);
  481: 
  482:     const selectedCertificationIds = new Set(
  483:       getTrainingCertificationIds(training),
  484:     );
  485: 
  486:     selectedCertificationIds.forEach((certificationId) => {
  487:       requireCertification(certificationMap, certificationId);
  488:     });
  489: 
  490:     nextCertificationRecords = nextCertificationRecords.map((certification) =>
  491:       synchronizeCertificationWithTraining(
  492:         certification,
  493:         training,
  494:         selectedCertificationIds.has(certification.id),
  495:       ),
  496:     );
  497:   });
  498: 
  499:   /*
  500:    * Refresh both snapshot directions after the
  501:    * relationship membership is synchronized.
  502:    */
  503: 
  504:   const refreshedCertificationMap = createRecordMap(nextCertificationRecords);
  505: 
  506:   nextTrainingRecords = nextTrainingRecords.map((training) =>
  507:     changedIds.has(training.id)
  508:       ? refreshTrainingCertificationRelationships(
  509:           training,
  510:           refreshedCertificationMap,
  511:         )
  512:       : training,
  513:   );
  514: 
  515:   return commitCollections({
  516:     originalTrainingRecords,
  517:     originalCertificationRecords,
  518:     nextTrainingRecords,
  519:     nextCertificationRecords,
  520:   });
  521: }
  522: 
  523: /*
  524:  * =========================================
  525:  * Certification-Authoritative Synchronization
  526:  * =========================================
  527:  */
  528: 
  529: export function saveCertificationWithTrainingSync({
  530:   certificationRecords,
  531:   changedCertificationIds = [],
  532:   deletedCertificationIds = [],
  533: } = {}) {
  534:   const originalTrainingRecords = readStoredTraining();
  535: 
  536:   const originalCertificationRecords = readStoredCertifications();
  537: 
  538:   let nextTrainingRecords = normalizeTrainingCollection(
  539:     originalTrainingRecords,
  540:   );
  541: 
  542:   let nextCertificationRecords =
  543:     normalizeCertificationCollection(certificationRecords);
  544: 
  545:   const changedIds = createIdSet(changedCertificationIds);
  546: 
  547:   const deletedIds = createIdSet(deletedCertificationIds);
  548: 
  549:   const trainingMap = createRecordMap(nextTrainingRecords);
  550: 
  551:   const certificationMap = createRecordMap(nextCertificationRecords);
  552: 
  553:   /*
  554:    * Remove deleted Certification records from
  555:    * all Training records.
  556:    */
  557: 
  558:   if (deletedIds.size > 0) {
  559:     nextTrainingRecords = nextTrainingRecords.map((training) => {
  560:       const remainingRelationships = getArray(
  561:         training?.certificationRelationships,
  562:       ).filter(
  563:         (relationship) =>
  564:           !deletedIds.has(getText(relationship?.certificationId)),
  565:       );
  566: 
  567:       return {
  568:         ...training,
  569: 
  570:         certificationRelationships: remainingRelationships,
  571: 
  572:         relatedCertificationIds: remainingRelationships.map(
  573:           (relationship) => relationship.certificationId,
  574:         ),
  575:       };
  576:     });
  577:   }
  578: 
  579:   /*
  580:    * For a Certification save, Certification is
  581:    * authoritative: its Training relationships
  582:    * determine which Training records point back.
  583:    */
  584: 
  585:   changedIds.forEach((certificationId) => {
  586:     const certification = requireCertification(
  587:       certificationMap,
  588:       certificationId,
  589:     );
  590: 
  591:     const selectedTrainingIds = new Set(
  592:       getCertificationTrainingIds(certification),
  593:     );
  594: 
  595:     selectedTrainingIds.forEach((trainingId) => {
  596:       requireTraining(trainingMap, trainingId);
  597:     });
  598: 
  599:     nextTrainingRecords = nextTrainingRecords.map((training) =>
  600:       synchronizeTrainingWithCertification(
  601:         training,
  602:         certification,
  603:         selectedTrainingIds.has(training.id),
  604:       ),
  605:     );
  606:   });
  607: 
  608:   const refreshedTrainingMap = createRecordMap(nextTrainingRecords);
  609: 
  610:   nextCertificationRecords = nextCertificationRecords.map((certification) =>
  611:     changedIds.has(certification.id)
  612:       ? refreshCertificationTrainingRelationships(
  613:           certification,
  614:           refreshedTrainingMap,
  615:         )
  616:       : certification,
  617:   );
  618: 
  619:   return commitCollections({
  620:     originalTrainingRecords,
  621:     originalCertificationRecords,
  622:     nextTrainingRecords,
  623:     nextCertificationRecords,
  624:   });
  625: }

  129: export function formatCertificationDate(
  130:   value,
  131:   { locale = "en-US", fallback = "" } = {},
  132: ) {
  133:   const normalizedValue = getText(value);
  134: 
  135:   if (!/^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/.test(normalizedValue)) {
  136:     return fallback;
  137:   }
  138: 
  139:   const [year, month] = normalizedValue.split("-").map(Number);
  140:

  142: 
  143:   return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, {
  144:     month: "short",
  145:     year: "numeric",
  146:     timeZone: "UTC",
  147:   }).format(date);
  148: }

  150: export function getCertificationDateRange(certification, options = {}) {
  151:   const issueDate = formatCertificationDate(
  152:     certification?.dates?.issueDate,
  153:     options,
  154:   );
  155: 
  156:   if (certification?.dates?.doesNotExpire && issueDate) {
  157:     return `Issued ${issueDate} Â· No expiration`;
  158:   }
  159: 
  160:   const expirationDate = formatCertificationDate(
  161:     certification?.dates?.expirationDate,
  162:     options,
  163:   );
  164: 
  165:   if (issueDate && expirationDate) {
  166:     return `Issued ${issueDate} Â· ` + `Expires ${expirationDate}`;
  167:   }
  168: 
  169:   if (issueDate) {
  170:     return `Issued ${issueDate}`;
  171:   }
  172: 
  173:   if (expirationDate) {
  174:     return `Expires ${expirationDate}`;
  175:   }
  176: 
  177:   return "";

  322: export function searchCertifications(certifications = [], query = "") {
  323:   const normalizedQuery = normalizeSearchValue(query);
  324: 
  325:   if (!normalizedQuery) {
  326:     return [...getArray(certifications)];
  327:   }
  328: 
  329:   const terms = normalizedQuery.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  330:

  333:

  348:     issuerType = "all",

  350:     status = "all",
  351:     document = "all",
  352:     training = "all",
  353:   } = filters;
  354: 
  355:   return getArray(certifications).filter((certification) => {
  356:     if (type !== "all" && certification?.certificationType !== type) {
  357:       return false;
  358:     }
  359: 
  360:     if (
  361:       credentialState !== "all" &&
  362:       getCertificationCredentialState(certification) !== credentialState
  363:     ) {
  364:       return false;
  365:     }
  366: 
  367:     if (
  368:       issuerType !== "all" &&
  369:       certification?.issuingOrganization?.type !== issuerType
  370:     ) {
  371:       return false;
  372:     }
  373: 
  374:     if (source !== "all" && certification?.source !== source) {
  375:       return false;
  376:     }
  377: 
  378:     if (status !== "all" && certification?.status !== status) {
  379:       return false;
  380:     }
  381: 
  382:     const hasDocument = hasCertificationDocument(certification);
  383: 
  384:     if (document === "with-document" && !hasDocument) {
  385:       return false;
  386:     }
  387: 
  388:     if (document === "without-document" && hasDocument) {
  389:       return false;
  390:     }
  391: 
  392:     const hasTraining =
  393:       getCertificationTrainingRelationships(certification).length > 0;
  394: 
  395:     if (training === "linked" && !hasTraining) {
  396:       return false;
  397:     }
  398: 
  399:     if (training === "not-linked" && hasTraining) {
  400:       return false;
  401:     }
  402: 
  403:     return true;
  404:   });
  405: }
  406: 
  407: /*
  408:  * =========================================
  409:  * Sorting
  410:  * =========================================
  411:  */
  412: 
  413: export function sortCertifications(
  414:   certifications = [],
  415:   sortOption = "name-ascending",
  416: ) {
  417:   const sorted = [...getArray(certifications)];
  418: 
  419:   sorted.sort((firstCertification, secondCertification) => {
  420:     switch (sortOption) {
  421:       case "name-descending":
  422:         return compareText(secondCertification?.name, firstCertification?.name);
  423: 
  424:       case "issuer-ascending":
  425:         return (
  426:           compareText(
  427:             firstCertification?.issuingOrganization?.name,
  428: 
  429:             secondCertification?.issuingOrganization?.name,
  430:           ) || compareText(firstCertification?.name, secondCertification?.name)
  431:         );
  432: 
  433:       case "issue-newest":
  434:         return (
  435:           getMonthTimestamp(secondCertification?.dates?.issueDate) -
  436:             getMonthTimestamp(firstCertification?.dates?.issueDate) ||
  437:           compareText(firstCertification?.name, secondCertification?.name)
  438:         );
  439: 
  440:       case "expiration-soonest": {
  441:         const firstExpiration = firstCertification?.dates?.doesNotExpire
  442:           ? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY
  443:           : getMonthTimestamp(
  444:               firstCertification?.dates?.expirationDate,
  445: 
  446:               Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY,
  447:             );
  448: 
  449:         const secondExpiration = secondCertification?.dates?.doesNotExpire
  450:           ? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY
  451:           : getMonthTimestamp(
  452:               secondCertification?.dates?.expirationDate,
  453: 
  454:               Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY,
  455:             );
  456: 
  457:         return (
  458:           firstExpiration - secondExpiration ||
  459:           compareText(firstCertification?.name, secondCertification?.name)
  460:         );
  461:       }
  462: 
  463:       case "recently-created":
  464:         return (
  465:           getTimestamp(secondCertification?.createdAt) -
  466:             getTimestamp(firstCertification?.createdAt) ||
  467:           compareText(firstCertification?.name, secondCertification?.name)
  468:         );
  469: 
  470:       case "recently-updated":
  471:         return (
  472:           getTimestamp(secondCertification?.updatedAt) -
  473:             getTimestamp(firstCertification?.updatedAt) ||
  474:           compareText(firstCertification?.name, secondCertification?.name)
  475:         );
  476: 
  477:       case "name-ascending":
  478:       default:
  479:         return compareText(firstCertification?.name, secondCertification?.name);
  480:     }
  481:   });
  482: 
  483:   return sorted;
  484: }

  542: 
  543:     expiredCredentials: credentialStates.expired,
  544: 
  545:     plannedCredentials: credentialStates.planned,
  546: 
  547:     withDocuments: activeRecords.filter(hasCertificationDocument).length,
  548: 
  549:     withoutDocuments: activeRecords.filter(
  550:       (certification) => !hasCertificationDocument(certification),
  551:     ).length,

  557:

  561:

  564:         .map((certification) =>
  565:           normalizeSearchValue(certification.issuingOrganization?.name),
  566:         )
  567:         .filter(Boolean),
  568:     ).size,
  569:   };

  523:     );

   90:         const store = database.createObjectStore(DOCUMENT_FILE_STORE, {
   91:           keyPath: "storageKey",

   93: 
   94:         store.createIndex("recordId", "recordId", {
   95:           unique: false,

   97:

   99:           unique: false,
  100:         });
  101:

  103:           unique: false,
  104:         });
  105:       }
  106:     };
  107:

  110:     };
  111: 
  112:     request.onerror = () => {

  389: /*
  390:  * =========================================
  391:  * Delete Multiple Stored Documents
  392:  * =========================================
  393:  *
  394:  * All document deletions run inside one IndexedDB
  395:  * transaction. If a request fails, IndexedDB aborts
  396:  * the transaction and preserves the remaining files.
  397:  *
  398:  * A missing document is considered successfully
  399:  * cleaned because no stored binary remains for its key.
  400:  */
  401: 
  402: export async function deleteStoredDocuments(storageKeys = []) {
  403:   if (!Array.isArray(storageKeys)) {
  404:     throw createDocumentStorageError({
  405:       message: "Document storage keys must be provided as an array.",
  406: 
  407:       publicMessage:
  408:         "The supporting documents could not be prepared for deletion.",
  409: 
  410:       code: "INVALID_DOCUMENT_STORAGE_KEYS",
  411:     });
  412:   }
  413: 
  414:   const normalizedStorageKeys = [
  415:     ...new Set(
  416:       storageKeys
  417:         .map((storageKey) =>
  418:           typeof storageKey === "string" ? storageKey.trim() : "",
  419:         )
  420:         .filter(Boolean),
  421:     ),
  422:   ];
  423: 
  424:   const emptyResult = {
  425:     requested: 0,
  426:     deleted: 0,
  427:     failed: 0,
  428:     missing: 0,
  429:     deletedKeys: [],
  430:     missingKeys: [],
  431:     failures: [],
  432:   };
  433: 
  434:   if (normalizedStorageKeys.length === 0) {
  435:     return emptyResult;
  436:   }
  437: 
  438:   const database = await openDocumentDatabase();
  439: 
  440:   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  441:     const transaction = database.transaction(DOCUMENT_FILE_STORE, "readwrite");
  442: 
  443:     const store = transaction.objectStore(DOCUMENT_FILE_STORE);
  444: 
  445:     const deletedKeys = [];
  446: 
  447:     const missingKeys = [];
  448: 
  449:     const failures = [];
  450: 
  451:     let hasSettled = false;
  452: 
  453:     const closeDatabase = () => {
  454:       try {
  455:         database.close();
  456:       } catch {
  457:         /*
  458:          * The operation has already completed.
  459:          */
  460:       }
  461:     };
  462: 
  463:     const rejectDeletion = (cause = null) => {
  464:       if (hasSettled) {
  465:         return;
  466:       }
  467: 
  468:       hasSettled = true;
  469: 
  470:       closeDatabase();
  471: 
  472:       const error = createDocumentStorageError({
  473:         message: "One or more supporting documents could not be deleted.",
  474: 
  475:         publicMessage:
  476:           "The education record was preserved because its supporting documents could not be removed.",
  477: 
  478:         code: "DOCUMENT_BULK_DELETE_FAILED",
  479: 
  480:         cause,
  481:       });
  482: 
  483:       error.cleanup = {
  484:         requested: normalizedStorageKeys.length,
  485: 
  486:         /*
  487:          * An aborted transaction rolls back successful
  488:          * delete requests, so the committed count is zero.
  489:          */
  490: 
  491:         deleted: 0,
  492: 
  493:         failed: Math.max(failures.length, 1),
  494: 
  495:         missing: 0,
  496: 
  497:         deletedKeys: [],
  498: 
  499:         missingKeys: [],
  500: 
  501:         failures:
  502:           failures.length > 0
  503:             ? failures
  504:             : [
  505:                 {
  506:                   storageKey: "",
  507:                   message:
  508:                     cause?.message ||
  509:                     "The IndexedDB deletion transaction failed.",
  510:                 },
  511:               ],
  512:       };
  513: 
  514:       reject(error);
  515:     };
  516: 
  517:     normalizedStorageKeys.forEach((storageKey) => {
  518:       const getRequest = store.get(storageKey);
  519: 
  520:       getRequest.onsuccess = () => {
  521:         if (!getRequest.result) {
  522:           missingKeys.push(storageKey);
  523:           return;
  524:         }
  525: 
  526:         const deleteRequest = store.delete(storageKey);
  527: 
  528:         deleteRequest.onsuccess = () => {
  529:           deletedKeys.push(storageKey);
  530:         };
  531: 
  532:         deleteRequest.onerror = () => {
  533:           failures.push({
  534:             storageKey,
  535: 
  536:             message:
  537:               deleteRequest.error?.message ||
  538:               "The document could not be deleted.",
  539:           });
  540: 
  541:           try {
  542:             transaction.abort();
  543:           } catch {
  544:             rejectDeletion(deleteRequest.error);
  545:           }
  546:         };
  547:       };
  548: 
  549:       getRequest.onerror = () => {
  550:         failures.push({
  551:           storageKey,
  552: 
  553:           message:
  554:             getRequest.error?.message ||
  555:             "The document could not be checked before deletion.",
  556:         });
  557: 
  558:         try {
  559:           transaction.abort();
  560:         } catch {
  561:           rejectDeletion(getRequest.error);
  562:         }
  563:       };
  564:     });
  565: 
  566:     transaction.oncomplete = () => {
  567:       if (hasSettled) {
  568:         return;
  569:       }
  570: 
  571:       hasSettled = true;
  572: 
  573:       closeDatabase();
  574: 
  575:       resolve({
  576:         requested: normalizedStorageKeys.length,
  577: 
  578:         /*
  579:          * Missing files are considered successfully
  580:          * cleaned because nothing remains in IndexedDB.
  581:          */
  582: 
  583:         deleted: deletedKeys.length + missingKeys.length,
  584: 
  585:         failed: 0,
  586: 
  587:         missing: missingKeys.length,
  588: 
  589:         deletedKeys,
  590: 
  591:         missingKeys,
  592: 
  593:         failures: [],
  594:       });
  595:     };
  596: 
  597:     transaction.onerror = (event) => {
  598:       event.preventDefault();
  599: 
  600:       rejectDeletion(transaction.error);
  601:     };
  602: 
  603:     transaction.onabort = () => {
  604:       rejectDeletion(transaction.error);
  605:     };
  606:   });
  607: }
  608: 
  609: /*
  610:  * =========================================
  611:  * Delete Record Files
  612:  * =========================================
  613:  */
  614: 
  615: export async function deleteDocumentFilesForRecord(recordId) {
  616:   if (!recordId) {
  617:     return {
  618:       recordId: "",
  619:       deletedCount: 0,
  620:     };
  621:   }
  622: 
  623:   const database = await openDocumentDatabase();
  624: 
  625:   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  626:     const transaction = database.transaction(DOCUMENT_FILE_STORE, "readwrite");
  627: 
  628:     const store = transaction.objectStore(DOCUMENT_FILE_STORE);
  629: 
  630:     const index = store.index("recordId");
  631: 
  632:     const request = index.openCursor(IDBKeyRange.only(recordId));
  633: 
  634:     let deletedCount = 0;
  635: 
  636:     request.onsuccess = (event) => {
  637:       const cursor = event.target.result;
  638: 
  639:       if (!cursor) {
  640:         return;
  641:       }
  642: 
  643:       cursor.delete();
  644:       deletedCount += 1;
  645:       cursor.continue();
  646:     };
  647: 
  648:     transaction.oncomplete = () => {
  649:       database.close();
  650: 
  651:       resolve({
  652:         recordId,
  653:         deletedCount,
  654:       });
  655:     };
  656: 
  657:     transaction.onerror = () => {
  658:       const cause = transaction.error;
  659: 
  660:       database.close();
  661: 
  662:       reject(
  663:         createDocumentStorageError({
  664:           message: "Unable to remove record documents.",
  665: 
  666:           publicMessage: "Some supporting documents could not be removed.",
  667: 
  668:           cause,
  669:         }),
  670:       );
  671:     };
  672:   });
  673: }

   11: 
   12: export function getFileExtension(fileName) {
   13:   if (typeof fileName !== "string") {
   14:     return "";
   15:   }
   16: 
   17:   const normalizedName = fileName.trim();
   18: 
   19:   const lastDotIndex = normalizedName.lastIndexOf(".");
   20: 
   21:   if (lastDotIndex === -1 || lastDotIndex === normalizedName.length - 1) {
   22:     return "";
   23:   }
   24: 
   25:   return normalizedName.slice(lastDotIndex + 1).toLocaleLowerCase();
   26: }
   27: 
   28: export function getDocumentFileFormat(fileOrMetadata) {
   29:   const fileName =
   30:     typeof fileOrMetadata === "string"
   31:       ? fileOrMetadata
   32:       : fileOrMetadata?.name || fileOrMetadata?.fileName || "";
   33: 
   34:   const mimeType =
   35:     typeof fileOrMetadata === "object"
   36:       ? String(
   37:           fileOrMetadata?.type || fileOrMetadata?.mimeType || "",
   38:         ).toLocaleLowerCase()
   39:       : "";
   40: 
   41:   const extension = getFileExtension(fileName);
   42: 
   43:   return (
   44:     DOCUMENT_FILE_FORMATS.find((format) => format.extension === extension) ||
   45:     DOCUMENT_FILE_FORMATS.find((format) =>
   46:       format.mimeTypes.includes(mimeType),
   47:     ) ||
   48:     null
   49:   );
   50: }

   53:  * =========================================
   54:  * File Validation
   55:  * =========================================
   56:  */
   57: 
   58: export function validateDocumentFile(file) {
   59:   const errors = [];
   60: 
   61:   if (!(file instanceof File)) {
   62:     errors.push({
   63:       field: "file",
   64:       code: "file_required",
   65:       message: "Select a document to upload.",
   66:     });
   67: 
   68:     return {
   69:       isValid: false,
   70:       errors,
   71:       format: null,
   72:     };
   73:   }
   74: 
   75:   const format = getDocumentFileFormat(file);
   76: 
   77:   if (!format) {
   78:     errors.push({
   79:       field: "file",
   80:       code: "unsupported_file_type",
   81:       message:
   82:         "This file type is not supported. Upload a PDF, Word document, text document, or supported image.",
   83:     });
   84:   }
   85: 
   86:   if (file.size <= 0) {
   87:     errors.push({
   88:       field: "file",
   89:       code: "empty_file",
   90:       message: "The selected file is empty.",
   91:     });
   92:   }
   93: 
   94:   if (file.size > DOCUMENT_FILE_LIMITS.maximumFileSizeBytes) {
   95:     errors.push({
   96:       field: "file",
   97:       code: "file_too_large",
   98:       message: `The document cannot exceed ${formatFileSize(
   99:         DOCUMENT_FILE_LIMITS.maximumFileSizeBytes,
  100:       )}.`,
  101:     });
  102:   }
  103: 
  104:   if (file.name.length > DOCUMENT_FILE_LIMITS.fileName) {
  105:     errors.push({
  106:       field: "file",
  107:       code: "file_name_too_long",
  108:       message: `The file name cannot exceed ${DOCUMENT_FILE_LIMITS.fileName} characters.`,
  109:     });
  110:   }
  111: 
  112:   return {
  113:     isValid: errors.length === 0,
  114:     errors,
  115:     format,
  116:   };
  117: }

  120:  * =========================================
  121:  * File Display
  122:  * =========================================
  123:  */
  124: 
  125: export function formatFileSize(bytes) {
  126:   const numericBytes = Number(bytes);
  127: 
  128:   if (!Number.isFinite(numericBytes) || numericBytes < 0) {
  129:     return "";
  130:   }
  131: 
  132:   if (numericBytes === 0) {
  133:     return "0 bytes";
  134:   }
  135: 
  136:   const units = ["bytes", "KB", "MB", "GB"];
  137: 
  138:   const unitIndex = Math.min(
  139:     Math.floor(Math.log(numericBytes) / Math.log(1024)),
  140:     units.length - 1,
  141:   );
  142: 
  143:   const value = numericBytes / 1024 ** unitIndex;
  144: 
  145:   return `${value.toFixed(unitIndex === 0 ? 0 : 1)} ${units[unitIndex]}`;
  146: }

  330: /*
  331:  * =========================================
  332:  * Delete Education
  333:  * =========================================
  334:  */
  335: 
  336: export async function deleteEducation(educationId) {
  337:   if (!educationId) {
  338:     throw createEducationServiceError({
  339:       message: "An education ID is required.",
  340: 
  341:       publicMessage: "The education record could not be identified.",
  342: 
  343:       code: "EDUCATION_ID_REQUIRED",
  344: 
  345:       status: 400,
  346:     });
  347:   }
  348: 
  349:   /*
  350:    * Step 1: Locate the record before deleting
  351:    * either its metadata or document binaries.
  352:    */
  353: 
  354:   const records = readStoredEducation();
  355: 
  356:   const recordToDelete = records.find(
  357:     (education) => education.id === educationId,
  358:   );
  359: 
  360:   if (!recordToDelete) {
  361:     throw createEducationNotFoundError(educationId);
  362:   }
  363: 
  364:   const credentialName =
  365:     recordToDelete.credential?.name || "Unnamed Credential";
  366: 
  367:   const institutionName =
  368:     recordToDelete.institution?.name || "Institution not provided";
  369: 
  370:   /*
  371:    * Step 2: Collect unique valid IndexedDB keys.
  372:    * Documents using external fileUrl values do not
  373:    * belong to IndexedDB and are not deleted here.
  374:    */
  375: 
  376:   const documentStorageKeys = getEducationDocumentStorageKeys(recordToDelete);
  377: 
  378:   let documentCleanup;
  379: 
  380:   /*
  381:    * Step 3: Delete binary documents first.
  382:    *
  383:    * deleteStoredDocuments() uses one IndexedDB
  384:    * transaction. If it fails, the transaction is
  385:    * aborted and the Education metadata is preserved.
  386:    */
  387: 
  388:   try {
  389:     documentCleanup = await deleteStoredDocuments(documentStorageKeys);
  390:   } catch (cleanupError) {
  391:     throw createEducationServiceError({
  392:       message:
  393:         `Education record "${educationId}" was preserved because ` +
  394:         "its supporting-document cleanup failed.",
  395: 
  396:       publicMessage:
  397:         cleanupError?.publicMessage ||
  398:         "The education record was not deleted because its supporting documents could not be removed.",
  399: 
  400:       code: "EDUCATION_DOCUMENT_CLEANUP_FAILED",
  401: 
  402:       status: 500,
  403: 
  404:       details: {
  405:         educationId,
  406: 
  407:         credentialName,
  408: 
  409:         institutionName,
  410: 
  411:         phase: "document-cleanup",
  412: 
  413:         recordPreserved: true,
  414: 
  415:         documentStorageKeys,
  416: 
  417:         documents: cleanupError?.cleanup || {
  418:           requested: documentStorageKeys.length,
  419:           deleted: 0,
  420:           failed: documentStorageKeys.length,
  421:           missing: 0,
  422:           deletedKeys: [],
  423:           missingKeys: [],
  424:           failures: [],
  425:         },
  426: 
  427:         originalErrorCode: cleanupError?.code || "DOCUMENT_BULK_DELETE_FAILED",
  428:       },
  429:     });
  430:   }
  431: 
  432:   /*
  433:    * Step 4: Delete Education metadata only after
  434:    * the IndexedDB transaction completes successfully.
  435:    */
  436: 
  437:   const remainingRecords = records.filter(
  438:     (education) => education.id !== educationId,
  439:   );
  440: 
  441:   try {
  442:     replaceStoredEducation(remainingRecords);
  443:   } catch (storageError) {
  444:     /*
  445:      * IndexedDB and localStorage cannot share one
  446:      * browser transaction. At this point the binary
  447:      * files are gone, but the Education metadata may
  448:      * still exist. Report this explicitly so a future
  449:      * backend can support true transactional deletion.
  450:      */
  451: 
  452:     throw createEducationServiceError({
  453:       message:
  454:         `Supporting documents for Education record "${educationId}" were ` +
  455:         "deleted, but its localStorage metadata could not be removed.",
  456: 
  457:       publicMessage:

   44: function getBrowserStorage() {

   46:     throw createEducationStorageError(

   48:       "Education storage is currently unavailable.",

   68: function createEmptyStorageDocument() {
   69:   return {
   70:     storageVersion: EDUCATION_STORAGE_VERSION,
   71: 
   72:     educationModelVersion: EDUCATION_MODEL_VERSION,
   73: 
   74:     educationRecords: [],

   80: /*
   81:  * =========================================
   82:  * Parse Storage Document
   83:  * =========================================
   84:  */
   85: 
   86: function parseStorageDocument(value) {
   87:   if (!value) {
   88:     return createEmptyStorageDocument();
   89:   }
   90: 
   91:   let parsedValue;
   92: 
   93:   try {
   94:     parsedValue = JSON.parse(value);
   95:   } catch (cause) {
   96:     throw createEducationStorageError(
   97:       "Unable to parse stored education data.",
   98:       "The saved education data could not be read.",
   99:       cause,
  100:     );
  101:   }
  102: 
  103:   /*
  104:    * Support legacy storage containing the
  105:    * collection directly as an array.
  106:    */
  107: 
  108:   if (Array.isArray(parsedValue)) {
  109:     return {
  110:       ...createEmptyStorageDocument(),
  111: 
  112:       educationRecords: normalizeEducationCollection(parsedValue),
  113:     };
  114:   }
  115: 
  116:   if (!parsedValue || typeof parsedValue !== "object") {
  117:     throw createEducationStorageError(
  118:       "The stored education document has an invalid structure.",
  119:       "The saved education data has an invalid format.",
  120:     );
  121:   }
  122: 
  123:   return {
  124:     storageVersion:
  125:       Number(parsedValue.storageVersion) || EDUCATION_STORAGE_VERSION,
  126: 
  127:     educationModelVersion:
  128:       Number(parsedValue.educationModelVersion) || EDUCATION_MODEL_VERSION,
  129: 
  130:     educationRecords: normalizeEducationCollection(
  131:       parsedValue.educationRecords ||
  132:         parsedValue.education ||
  133:         parsedValue.records,
  134:     ),
  135: 
  136:     updatedAt:
  137:       typeof parsedValue.updatedAt === "string"
  138:         ? parsedValue.updatedAt
  139:         : new Date().toISOString(),
  140:   };
  141: }

   92: /*
   93:  * =========================================
   94:  * Date Parsing and Formatting
   95:  * =========================================
   96:  */
   97: 
   98: export function parseEducationDate(value) {
   99:   const text = getText(value);
  100: 
  101:   const match = text.match(
  102:     /^(\d{4})-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])(?:-(0[1-9]|[12]\d|3[01]))?$/,
  103:   );
  104: 
  105:   if (!match) {
  106:     return null;
  107:   }
  108: 
  109:   const year = Number(match[1]);
  110:   const month = Number(match[2]);
  111:   const day = match[3] ? Number(match[3]) : 1;
  112: 
  113:   const date = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day));
  114: 
  115:   if (
  116:     match[3] &&
  117:     (date.getUTCFullYear() !== year ||
  118:       date.getUTCMonth() !== month - 1 ||
  119:       date.getUTCDate() !== day)
  120:   ) {
  121:     return null;
  122:   }
  123: 
  124:   return {
  125:     value: text,
  126:     date,
  127:     year,
  128:     month,
  129:     day,
  130:     hasDay: Boolean(match[3]),
  131:   };
  132: }
  133: 
  134: export function formatEducationDate(
  135:   value,
  136:   { locale = "en-US", includeDay = false, fallback = "" } = {},
  137: ) {
  138:   const parsed = parseEducationDate(value);
  139: 
  140:   if (!parsed) {
  141:     return fallback;
  142:   }
  143: 
  144:   return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(
  145:     locale,
  146:     includeDay && parsed.hasDay
  147:       ? {
  148:           month: "short",
  149:           day: "numeric",
  150:           year: "numeric",
  151:           timeZone: "UTC",
  152:         }
  153:       : {
  154:           month: "short",
  155:           year: "numeric",
  156:           timeZone: "UTC",
  157:         },
  158:   ).format(parsed.date);
  159: }

  289:  * =========================================

  291: 
  292: export function filterEducation(educationRecords = [], filters = {}) {
  293:   const {
  294:     credentialType = "all",
  295:     institutionType = "all",
  296:     status = "all",
  297:     timeline = "all",
  298:     hasHonors = false,
  299:     hasSkills = false,
  300:   } = filters;
  301: 
  302:   return getArray(educationRecords).filter((education) => {
  303:     if (
  304:       credentialType !== "all" &&
  305:       education?.credential?.type !== credentialType
  306:     ) {
  307:       return false;
  308:     }
  309: 
  310:     if (
  311:       institutionType !== "all" &&
  312:       education?.institution?.type !== institutionType
  313:     ) {
  314:       return false;
  315:     }
  316: 
  317:     if (status !== "all" && education?.status !== status) {
  318:       return false;
  319:     }
  320: 
  321:     if (timeline === "current" && education?.dates?.isCurrent !== true) {
  322:       return false;
  323:     }
  324: 
  325:     if (timeline === "completed" && education?.dates?.isCurrent === true) {
  326:       return false;
  327:     }
  328: 
  329:     if (hasHonors && getArray(education?.academic?.honors).length === 0) {
  330:       return false;
  331:     }
  332: 
  333:     if (hasSkills && getArray(education?.skillRelationships).length === 0) {
  334:       return false;
  335:     }
  336: 
  337:     return true;
  338:   });
  339: }

  341: /*

  343:  * Sorting
  344:  * =========================================

  346: 
  347: function compareText(firstValue, secondValue) {
  348:   return getText(firstValue).localeCompare(getText(secondValue), undefined, {
  349:     sensitivity: "base",
  350:   });
  351: }
  352: 
  353: function getDateSortValue(value) {
  354:   const parsed = parseEducationDate(value);
  355: 
  356:   return parsed ? parsed.date.getTime() : 0;
  357: }
  358: 
  359: export function sortEducation(educationRecords = [], sortOption = "newest") {
  360:   const sorted = [...getArray(educationRecords)];
  361: 
  362:   sorted.sort((first, second) => {
  363:     switch (sortOption) {
  364:       case "oldest":
  365:         return (
  366:           getDateSortValue(first?.dates?.startDate) -
  367:           getDateSortValue(second?.dates?.startDate)
  368:         );
  369: 
  370:       case "credential-ascending":
  371:         return compareText(
  372:           getEducationCredentialName(first),
  373:           getEducationCredentialName(second),
  374:         );
  375: 
  376:       case "institution-ascending":
  377:         return compareText(
  378:           getEducationInstitutionName(first),
  379:           getEducationInstitutionName(second),
  380:         );
  381: 
  382:       case "recently-updated":
  383:         return (
  384:           new Date(second?.updatedAt || 0).getTime() -
  385:           new Date(first?.updatedAt || 0).getTime()
  386:         );
  387: 
  388:       case "newest":
  389:       default: {
  390:         const firstCurrent = first?.dates?.isCurrent === true;
  391: 
  392:         const secondCurrent = second?.dates?.isCurrent === true;
  393: 
  394:         if (firstCurrent !== secondCurrent) {
  395:           return firstCurrent ? -1 : 1;
  396:         }
  397: 
  398:         const firstEnd = firstCurrent
  399:           ? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
  400:           : getDateSortValue(first?.dates?.endDate);
  401: 
  402:         const secondEnd = secondCurrent
  403:           ? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
  404:           : getDateSortValue(second?.dates?.endDate);
  405: 
  406:         return (
  407:           secondEnd - firstEnd ||
  408:           getDateSortValue(second?.dates?.startDate) -
  409:             getDateSortValue(first?.dates?.startDate)
  410:         );
  411:       }
  412:     }

  436: export function getEducationCompleteness(education) {

  439:       id: "institution",
  440:       label: "Institution",
  441:       complete: Boolean(getText(education?.institution?.name)),
  442:       weight: 2,
  443:     },
  444:     {
