  446:       label: "Credential",
  447:       complete: Boolean(
  448:         getText(education?.credential?.name) &&
  449:         getText(education?.credential?.type),
  450:       ),
  451:       weight: 2,
  452:     },
  453:     {
  454:       id: "dates",
  455:       label: "Education dates",
  456:       complete: Boolean(
  457:         getText(education?.dates?.startDate) &&
  458:         (education?.dates?.isCurrent || getText(education?.dates?.endDate)),
  459:       ),
  460:       weight: 2,
  461:     },
  462:     {
  463:       id: "field",
  464:       label: "Field of study",
  465:       complete: Boolean(getText(education?.credential?.fieldOfStudy)),
  466:       weight: 1,
  467:     },
  468:     {
  469:       id: "description",
  470:       label: "Description",
  471:       complete: Boolean(getText(education?.description)),
  472:       weight: 1,
  473:     },
  474:     {
  475:       id: "details",
  476:       label: "Academic details",
  477:       complete:
  478:         getArray(education?.academic?.honors).length > 0 ||
  479:         getArray(education?.coursework).length > 0 ||
  480:         getArray(education?.activities).length > 0,
  481:       weight: 1,
  482:     },
  483:     {
  484:       id: "skills",
  485:       label: "Related skills",
  486:       complete: getArray(education?.skillRelationships).length > 0,
  487:       weight: 1,
  488:     },
  489:   ];
  490: 
  491:   const maximumScore = checks.reduce((total, check) => total + check.weight, 0);
  492: 
  493:   const score = checks.reduce(
  494:     (total, check) => total + (check.complete ? check.weight : 0),
  495:     0,
  496:   );
  497: 
  498:   const percentage = Math.round((score / maximumScore) * 100);
  499: 
  500:   let level = "basic";
  501:   let label = "Basic";
  502: 
  503:   if (percentage >= 90) {
  504:     level = "excellent";
  505:     label = "Excellent";
  506:   } else if (percentage >= 70) {
  507:     level = "strong";
  508:     label = "Strong";
  509:   } else if (percentage >= 50) {
  510:     level = "developing";
  511:     label = "Developing";
  512:   }
  513: 
  514:   return {
  515:     score,
  516:     maximumScore,
  517:     percentage,
  518:     level,
  519:     label,
  520:     checks,
  521: 
  522:     completedChecks: checks.filter((check) => check.complete),
  523: 
  524:     missingChecks: checks.filter((check) => !check.complete),
  525:   };
  526: }

   87: function findDuplicateIndexes(values, getIdentity) {
   88:   const seen = new Map();
   89:   const duplicates = [];
   90: 
   91:   values.forEach((value, index) => {
   92:     const identity = getText(getIdentity(value)).toLocaleLowerCase();
   93: 
   94:     if (!identity) {
   95:       return;
   96:     }
   97: 
   98:     if (seen.has(identity)) {
   99:       duplicates.push({
  100:         firstIndex: seen.get(identity),
  101:         duplicateIndex: index,
  102:       });
  103: 
  104:       return;
  105:     }
  106: 
  107:     seen.set(identity, index);
  108:   });
  109: 
  110:   return duplicates;

  132: 
  133: const EDUCATION_DATE_PATTERN =
  134:   /^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])(?:-(0[1-9]|[12]\d|3[01]))?$/;
  135: 
  136: function isValidEducationDate(value) {
  137:   const text = getText(value);
  138: 
  139:   if (!text || !EDUCATION_DATE_PATTERN.test(text)) {
  140:     return false;
  141:   }
  142: 
  143:   if (text.length === 7) {
  144:     return true;
  145:   }
  146: 
  147:   const [year, month, day] = text.split("-").map(Number);
  148: 
  149:   const date = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day));
  150: 
  151:   return (
  152:     date.getUTCFullYear() === year &&
  153:     date.getUTCMonth() === month - 1 &&
  154:     date.getUTCDate() === day
  155:   );
  156: }
  157: 
  158: function getComparableDate(value, useEndOfMonth = false) {
  159:   if (!isValidEducationDate(value)) {
  160:     return null;
  161:   }
  162: 
  163:   const [year, month, suppliedDay] = getText(value).split("-").map(Number);
  164: 
  165:   let day = suppliedDay;
  166: 
  167:   if (!day) {
  168:     day = useEndOfMonth ? new Date(Date.UTC(year, month, 0)).getUTCDate() : 1;
  169:   }
  170: 
  171:   return Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day);
  172: }

  179: 
  180: function isValidWebsite(value) {
  181:   const text = getText(value);
  182: 
  183:   if (!text) {
  184:     return true;
  185:   }
  186: 
  187:   try {
  188:     const normalizedUrl = /^https?:\/\//i.test(text) ? text : `https://${text}`;
  189: 
  190:     const url = new URL(normalizedUrl);
  191: 
  192:     return ["http:", "https:"].includes(url.protocol) && Boolean(url.hostname);
  193:   } catch {
  194:     return false;
  195:   }
  196: }

  515: /*
  516:  * =========================================
  517:  * Named Ordered Items
  518:  * =========================================
  519:  */
  520: 
  521: function validateNamedItems(
  522:   collector,
  523:   values,
  524:   { field, itemLabel, nameLimit, descriptionLimit, maximumItems },
  525: ) {
  526:   const items = getArray(values);
  527: 
  528:   if (items.length > maximumItems) {
  529:     collector.addError(
  530:       field,
  531:       `Add no more than ${maximumItems} ${itemLabel.toLowerCase()} records.`,
  532:       "too_many_items",
  533:     );
  534:   }
  535: 
  536:   items.forEach((item, index) => {
  537:     const itemObject = getObject(item);
  538: 
  539:     const name =
  540:       typeof item === "string"
  541:         ? getText(item)
  542:         : getText(itemObject.name || itemObject.title);
  543: 
  544:     if (!name) {
  545:       collector.addError(
  546:         `${field}.${index}.name`,
  547:         `${itemLabel} name cannot be empty.`,
  548:         "required",
  549:       );
  550: 
  551:       return;
  552:     }
  553: 
  554:     validateTextLength(
  555:       collector,
  556:       `${field}.${index}.name`,
  557:       name,
  558:       nameLimit,
  559:       `${itemLabel} name`,
  560:     );
  561: 
  562:     validateTextLength(
  563:       collector,
  564:       `${field}.${index}.description`,
  565:       itemObject.description,
  566:       descriptionLimit,
  567:       `${itemLabel} description`,
  568:     );
  569: 
  570:     validateOrder(collector, `${field}.${index}.order`, itemObject.order);
  571:   });
  572: 
  573:   findDuplicateIndexes(items, (item) =>
  574:     typeof item === "string" ? item : item?.name || item?.title || "",
  575:   ).forEach(({ duplicateIndex }) => {
  576:     collector.addError(
  577:       `${field}.${duplicateIndex}.name`,
  578:       `This ${itemLabel.toLowerCase()} has already been added.`,
  579:       "duplicate",
  580:     );
  581:   });
  582: }

  627: 
  628: function validateSkillRelationships(collector, education) {
  629:   const relationships = getArray(education.skillRelationships);
  630: 
  631:   if (relationships.length > EDUCATION_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumSkills) {
  632:     collector.addError(
  633:       "skillRelationships",
  634:       `Add no more than ${EDUCATION_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumSkills} skills.`,
  635:       "too_many_items",
  636:     );
  637:   }
  638: 
  639:   relationships.forEach((relationship, index) => {
  640:     const item = getObject(relationship);
  641: 
  642:     const skillId = getSkillRelationshipId(item);
  643: 
  644:     const nameSnapshot = getSkillSnapshotName(item);
  645: 
  646:     if (!skillId && !nameSnapshot) {
  647:       collector.addError(
  648:         `skillRelationships.${index}.skillId`,
  649:         "Select a saved skill or provide a skill name.",
  650:         "required",
  651:       );
  652: 
  653:       return;
  654:     }
  655: 
  656:     if (skillId && !nameSnapshot) {
  657:       collector.addError(
  658:         `skillRelationships.${index}.nameSnapshot`,
  659:         "Store the skill name snapshot with this relationship.",
  660:         "required_snapshot",
  661:       );
  662:     }
  663: 
  664:     if (!skillId && nameSnapshot) {
  665:       collector.addWarning(
  666:         `skillRelationships.${index}.skillId`,
  667:         `"${nameSnapshot}" is not connected to the central Skill Library.`,
  668:         "missing_skill_relationship",
  669:       );
  670:     }
  671: 
  672:     validateTextLength(
  673:       collector,
  674:       `skillRelationships.${index}.skillId`,
  675:       skillId,
  676:       200,
  677:       "Skill identifier",
  678:     );
  679: 
  680:     validateTextLength(
  681:       collector,
  682:       `skillRelationships.${index}.nameSnapshot`,
  683:       nameSnapshot,
  684:       EDUCATION_FIELD_LIMITS.skillName,
  685:       "Skill name",
  686:     );
  687: 
  688:     validateTextLength(
  689:       collector,
  690:       `skillRelationships.${index}.categorySnapshot`,
  691:       item.categorySnapshot,
  692:       EDUCATION_FIELD_LIMITS.skillCategory,
  693:       "Skill category snapshot",
  694:     );
  695: 
  696:     validateTextLength(
  697:       collector,
  698:       `skillRelationships.${index}.typeSnapshot`,
  699:       item.typeSnapshot,
  700:       EDUCATION_FIELD_LIMITS.skillType,
  701:       "Skill type snapshot",
  702:     );
  703: 
  704:     validateOrder(collector, `skillRelationships.${index}.order`, item.order);
  705:   });
  706: 
  707:   findDuplicateIndexes(relationships, (relationship) => {
  708:     const skillId = getSkillRelationshipId(relationship);
  709: 
  710:     return skillId
  711:       ? `id:${skillId}`
  712:       : `name:${getSkillSnapshotName(relationship)}`;
  713:   }).forEach(({ duplicateIndex }) => {

  715:       `skillRelationships.${duplicateIndex}.skillId`,
  716:       "This skill has already been connected to the education record.",
  717:       "duplicate",
  718:     );
  719:   });
  720: }

 1055: export function assertValidEducation(education) {

 1057:

 1059:     return validation;
 1060:   }
 1061:

 1063:     "The education record contains invalid or incomplete information.",
 1064:   );

 1068:   error.code = "EDUCATION_VALIDATION_FAILED";
 1069: 
 1070:   error.status = 400;
 1071: 
 1072:   error.publicMessage =
 1073:     "Correct the highlighted education information before saving.";
 1074: 
 1075:   error.validation = validation;
 1076:   error.errors = validation.errors;
 1077:   error.warnings = validation.warnings;
 1078:   error.fieldErrors = validation.fieldErrors;
 1079: 
 1080:   throw error;
 1081: }

 1085:  * Validation Summary
 1086:  * =========================================

 1088: 
 1089: export function getEducationValidationSummary(education) {
 1090:   const validation = validateEducation(education);
 1091: 
 1092:   if (!validation.isValid) {
 1093:     return `${validation.errors.length} ${
 1094:       validation.errors.length === 1 ? "problem must" : "problems must"
 1095:     } be corrected before saving.`;
 1096:   }
 1097: 
 1098:   if (validation.warnings.length > 0) {
 1099:     return `Ready to save with ${validation.warnings.length} ${
 1100:       validation.warnings.length === 1 ? "suggestion" : "suggestions"
 1101:     } for improvement.`;
 1102:   }
 1103: 
 1104:   return "This education record is complete and ready to save.";
 1105: }

   11: export function prepareExperienceApiPayload(experience) {
   12:   if (
   13:     !experience ||
   14:     typeof experience !== "object" ||
   15:     Array.isArray(experience)
   16:   ) {
   17:     throw new TypeError("A valid Experience object is required.");
   18:   }
   19: 
   20:   const payload = structuredClone(experience);
   21: 
   22:   for (const field of SERVER_OWNED_EXPERIENCE_FIELDS) {
   23:     delete payload[field];
   24:   }
   25: 
   26:   return payload;
   27: }
   28: 
   29: export function getExperienceRowVersion(experience) {
   30:   const rowVersion = experience?.rowVersion;
   31: 
   32:   if (
   33:     typeof rowVersion !== "string" ||
   34:     !/^[A-Za-z0-9+/]{10}[AEIMQUYcgkosw048]=$/.test(rowVersion)
   35:   ) {
   36:     throw new TypeError(
   37:       "A valid Experience rowVersion is required.",
   38:     );
   39:   }
   40: 
   41:   return rowVersion;
   42: }

    1: import { updateExperienceModel } from "../../models/experienceModel.js";
    2: import { assertValidExperience } from "./experienceValidation.js";
    3: import { getExperienceRowVersion } from "./experienceApiAdapter.js";
    4: 
    5: import * as database from "./experienceDatabaseService.js";
    6: 
    7: /*
    8:  * Compatibility layer for the existing React Experience context.
    9:  *
   10:  * Not connected to ExperienceDataContext yet.
   11:  * Does not access localStorage.
   12:  *
   13:  * The caller supplies the collection currently loaded by React.
   14:  * Its rowVersion is deliberately used without refreshing it first,
   15:  * so stale writes produce a concurrency conflict.
   16:  */
   17: 
   18: function requireCollection(experiences) {
   19:   if (!Array.isArray(experiences)) {
   20:     throw new TypeError("The loaded Experience collection is required.");
   21:   }
   22: 
   23:   return experiences;
   24: }
   25: 
   26: function findLoadedExperience(experiences, experienceId) {
   27:   const collection = requireCollection(experiences);
   28: 
   29:   const experience = collection.find(
   30:     (item) => item?.id === experienceId,
   31:   );
   32: 
   33:   if (!experience) {
   34:     const error = new Error("The requested Experience is not loaded.");
   35: 
   36:     error.name = "ExperienceServiceError";
   37:     error.code = "EXPERIENCE_NOT_LOADED";
   38:     error.status = 404;
   39: 
   40:     throw error;
   41:   }
   42: 
   43:   getExperienceRowVersion(experience);
   44: 
   45:   return experience;
   46: }
   47: 
   48: function requireUpdates(updates) {
   49:   if (
   50:     !updates ||
   51:     typeof updates !== "object" ||
   52:     Array.isArray(updates)
   53:   ) {
   54:     throw new TypeError("Experience updates must be an object.");
   55:   }
   56: 
   57:   if (
   58:     Object.hasOwn(updates, "id") ||
   59:     Object.hasOwn(updates, "rowVersion") ||
   60:     Object.hasOwn(updates, "createdAt") ||
   61:     Object.hasOwn(updates, "updatedAt")
   62:   ) {
   63:     throw new TypeError(
   64:       "Experience updates cannot override server-owned fields.",
   65:     );
   66:   }
   67: 
   68:   return updates;
   69: }
   70:

   72:   return database.getExperiences(options);
   73: }

   77: }

   80:   assertValidExperience(experienceData);
   81: 
   82:   return database.createExperience(experienceData);
   83: }
   84: 
   85: export async function updateExperience(
   86:   experiences,
   87:   experienceId,
   88:   updates,
   89: ) {
   90:   const current = findLoadedExperience(experiences, experienceId);
   91: 
   92:   requireUpdates(updates);
   93: 
   94:   const updated = updateExperienceModel(current, updates);
   95: 
   96:   assertValidExperience(updated);
   97: 
   98:   return database.updateExperience(experienceId, updated);

  106: export async function createExperience(experienceData) {
  107:   /*
  108:    * Validate before normalization so invalid or
  109:    * oversized input is not silently truncated.
  110:    */
  111: 
  112:   assertValidExperience(experienceData);
  113: 
  114:   const experiences = readStoredExperiences();
  115:

  117: 
  118:   const duplicateId = experiences.some((item) => item.id === experience.id);
  119: 
  120:   if (duplicateId) {
  121:     throw createServiceError({
  122:       message: `Experience ID "${experience.id}" already exists.`,
  123:       publicMessage:
  124:         "This experience could not be created because its identifier already exists.",
  125:       code: "EXPERIENCE_ID_CONFLICT",
  126:       status: 409,
  127:     });
  128:   }
  129: 
  130:   replaceStoredExperiences([experience, ...experiences]);
  131: 
  132:   return resolveAsync(experience);
  133: }

  137:  * Update Experience

  140: 
  141: export async function updateExperience(experienceId, updates) {
  142:   if (!experienceId) {
  143:     throw createServiceError({
  144:       message: "An experience ID is required to update an experience.",
  145:       publicMessage: "The experience could not be identified.",
  146:       code: "EXPERIENCE_ID_REQUIRED",
  147:       status: 400,
  148:     });
  149:   }
  150: 
  151:   const experiences = readStoredExperiences();
  152: 
  153:   const experienceIndex = experiences.findIndex(
  154:     (experience) => experience.id === experienceId,
  155:   );
  156: 
  157:   if (experienceIndex === -1) {
  158:     throw createNotFoundError(experienceId);
  159:   }
  160: 
  161:   const currentExperience = experiences[experienceIndex];
  162: 
  163:   /*
  164:    * Merge the record before validating it because
  165:    * updates may include only part of the model.
  166:    */
  167: 
  168:   const mergedExperience = {
  169:     ...currentExperience,
  170:     ...updates,
  171: 
  172:     position: {
  173:       ...currentExperience.position,
  174:       ...updates?.position,
  175:     },
  176: 
  177:     organization: {
  178:       ...currentExperience.organization,
  179:       ...updates?.organization,
  180:     },
  181: 
  182:     location: {
  183:       ...currentExperience.location,
  184:       ...updates?.location,
  185:     },
  186: 
  187:     dates: {
  188:       ...currentExperience.dates,
  189:       ...updates?.dates,
  190:     },
  191: 
  192:     leadership: {
  193:       ...currentExperience.leadership,
  194:       ...updates?.leadership,
  195:     },
  196: 
  197:     privateInformation: {
  198:       ...currentExperience.privateInformation,
  199:       ...updates?.privateInformation,
  200:     },
  201: 
  202:     visibility: {
  203:       ...currentExperience.visibility,
  204:       ...updates?.visibility,
  205:     },
  206:   };
  207: 
  208:   assertValidExperience(mergedExperience);
  209: 
  210:   const updatedExperience = updateExperienceModel(currentExperience, updates);
  211: 
  212:   const nextExperiences = [...experiences];
  213: 
  214:   nextExperiences[experienceIndex] = updatedExperience;
  215: 
  216:   replaceStoredExperiences(nextExperiences);
  217: 
  218:   return resolveAsync(updatedExperience);
  219: }

  253:     throw createServiceError({

  255:       publicMessage: "The experience could not be identified.",
  256:       code: "EXPERIENCE_ID_REQUIRED",
  257:       status: 400,

  259:   }
  260:

   84: function migrateVersionOneSkill(skill, index) {
   85:   if (typeof skill === "string") {
   86:     return {
   87:       id: "",
   88:       skillId: "",
   89:       nameSnapshot: skill,
   90:       categorySnapshot: "",
   91:       typeSnapshot: "",
   92:       level: "",
   93:       usageDescription: "",
   94:       order: index,
   95:     };
   96:   }
   97: 
   98:   const source = skill && typeof skill === "object" ? skill : {};
   99: 
  100:   return {
  101:     ...source,
  102: 
  103:     skillId: source.skillId || source.profileSkillId || "",
  104: 
  105:     nameSnapshot:
  106:       source.nameSnapshot || source.name || source.label || source.value || "",
  107: 
  108:     categorySnapshot: source.categorySnapshot || source.category || "",
  109: 
  110:     typeSnapshot: source.typeSnapshot || source.type || "",
  111: 
  112:     level: source.level || source.proficiency || "",
  113: 
  114:     usageDescription: source.usageDescription || source.description || "",
  115: 
  116:     order:
  117:       Number.isInteger(source.order) && source.order >= 0
  118:         ? source.order
  119:         : index,
  120:   };
  121: }

  123: function migrateVersionOneTechnology(technology, index) {

  125:     return {
  126:       id: "",
  127:       skillId: "",
  128:       nameSnapshot: technology,

  130:       category: "",
  131:       proficiency: "",

  133:       order: index,
  134:     };

  138:

  140:     source.nameSnapshot || source.name || source.label || source.value || "";

  161:

  169: function migrateExperienceModelVersionOne(experience) {
  170:   const source = experience && typeof experience === "object" ? experience : {};
  171: 
  172:   return {
  173:     ...source,
  174: 
  175:     modelVersion: 2,
  176: 
  177:     skills: Array.isArray(source.skills)
  178:       ? source.skills.map(migrateVersionOneSkill)
  179:       : [],
  180: 
  181:     technologies: Array.isArray(source.technologies)
  182:       ? source.technologies.map(migrateVersionOneTechnology)
  183:       : [],
  184:   };

  188:  * =========================================
  189:  * Model Migration Pipeline
  190:  * =========================================
  191:  */
  192: 
  193: function migrateExperienceModel(experience) {
  194:   const source = experience && typeof experience === "object" ? experience : {};
  195: 
  196:   let migratedExperience = source;
  197: 
  198:   const sourceVersion = Number(source.modelVersion) || 1;
  199: 
  200:   if (sourceVersion < 2) {
  201:     migratedExperience = migrateExperienceModelVersionOne(migratedExperience);
  202:   }
  203: 
  204:   return migratedExperience;
  205: }

  207: function migrateExperienceCollection(experiences) {
  208:   if (!Array.isArray(experiences)) {
  209:     return [];
  210:   }
  211: 
  212:   return experiences.map(migrateExperienceModel);
  213: }

  223:

  228: 
  229:     experienceModelVersion: EXPERIENCE_MODEL_VERSION,
  230: 
  231:     experiences: normalizeExperienceCollection(experiences),
  232: 
  233:     updatedAt:
  234:       typeof source.updatedAt === "string"
  235:         ? source.updatedAt
  236:         : new Date().toISOString(),
  237:   };
  238: }
  239: 
  240: /*
  241:  * =========================================
  242:  * Parse Storage Document
  243:  * =========================================
  244:  */
  245: 
  246: function parseStorageDocument(value) {
  247:   if (!value) {
  248:     return {
  249:       document: createEmptyStorageDocument(),
  250:       migrated: false,
  251:     };
  252:   }
  253: 
  254:   let parsedValue;
  255: 
  256:   try {
  257:     parsedValue = JSON.parse(value);
  258:   } catch (cause) {
  259:     throw createStorageError(
  260:       "Unable to parse stored experience data.",
  261:       "The saved experience data could not be read.",
  262:       cause,
  263:     );
  264:   }
  265: 
  266:   /*
  267:    * Legacy storage may contain the experience
  268:    * collection directly as an array.
  269:    */
  270: 
  271:   if (Array.isArray(parsedValue)) {
  272:     return {
  273:       document: migrateStorageDocument({
  274:         storageVersion: 1,
  275:         experienceModelVersion: 1,
  276:         experiences: parsedValue,
  277:       }),
  278: 
  279:       migrated: true,
  280:     };
  281:   }
  282: 
  283:   if (!parsedValue || typeof parsedValue !== "object") {
  284:     throw createStorageError(
  285:       "The stored experience document has an invalid structure.",
  286:       "The saved experience data has an invalid format.",
  287:     );
  288:   }
  289: 
  290:   const storageVersion = Number(parsedValue.storageVersion) || 1;
  291: 
  292:   const modelVersion = Number(parsedValue.experienceModelVersion) || 1;
  293: 
  294:   const requiresMigration =
  295:     storageVersion < EXPERIENCE_STORAGE_VERSION ||
  296:     modelVersion < EXPERIENCE_MODEL_VERSION ||
  297:     parsedValue.experiences?.some(
  298:       (experience) =>
  299:         Number(experience?.modelVersion || 1) < EXPERIENCE_MODEL_VERSION,
  300:     );
  301: 
  302:   if (requiresMigration) {
  303:     return {
  304:       document: migrateStorageDocument(parsedValue),
  305: 
  306:       migrated: true,
  307:     };
  308:   }
  309: 
  310:   return {
  311:     document: {
  312:       storageVersion: EXPERIENCE_STORAGE_VERSION,
  313: 
  314:       experienceModelVersion: EXPERIENCE_MODEL_VERSION,
  315: 
  316:       experiences: normalizeExperienceCollection(parsedValue.experiences),
  317: 
  318:       updatedAt:
  319:         typeof parsedValue.updatedAt === "string"
  320:           ? parsedValue.updatedAt
  321:           : new Date().toISOString(),
  322:     },
  323: 
  324:     migrated: false,
  325:   };
  326: }
  327: 
  328: /*
  329:  * =========================================
  330:  * Read Storage
  331:  * =========================================
  332:  */
  333: 
  334: export function readExperienceStorage() {
  335:   const storage = getBrowserStorage();
  336: 
  337:   try {
  338:     const storedValue = storage.getItem(EXPERIENCE_STORAGE_KEY);
  339: 
  340:     const { document, migrated } = parseStorageDocument(storedValue);
  341: 
  342:     /*
  343:      * Persist the upgraded representation so the
  344:      * migration does not run during every read.
  345:      */
  346: 
  347:     if (migrated) {
  348:       const migratedDocument = {
  349:         ...document,
  350:         updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  351:       };
  352: 
  353:       storage.setItem(EXPERIENCE_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(migratedDocument));
  354: 
  355:       return migratedDocument;
  356:     }
  357: 
  358:     return document;
  359:   } catch (error) {
  360:     if (error?.name === "ExperienceStorageError") {
  361:       throw error;
  362:     }
  363: 
  364:     throw createStorageError(
  365:       "Unable to read experience storage.",
  366:       "Your saved experiences could not be loaded.",
  367:       error,
  368:     );
  369:   }
  370: }

   32: /*
   33:  * =========================================
   34:  * Date Parsing
   35:  * =========================================
   36:  */
   37: 
   38: export function parseExperienceDate(value) {
   39:   const text = getText(value);
   40: 
   41:   if (!text) {
   42:     return null;
   43:   }
   44: 
   45:   const match = text.match(
   46:     /^(\d{4})-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])(?:-(0[1-9]|[12]\d|3[01]))?$/,
   47:   );
   48: 
   49:   if (!match) {
   50:     return null;
   51:   }
   52: 
   53:   const year = Number(match[1]);
   54:   const month = Number(match[2]);
   55:   const day = match[3] ? Number(match[3]) : 1;
   56: 
   57:   const date = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day));
   58: 
   59:   /*
   60:    * Reject impossible complete dates, such as
   61:    * February 31.
   62:    */
   63: 
   64:   if (
   65:     match[3] &&
   66:     (date.getUTCFullYear() !== year ||
   67:       date.getUTCMonth() !== month - 1 ||
   68:       date.getUTCDate() !== day)
   69:   ) {
   70:     return null;
   71:   }
   72: 
   73:   return {
   74:     value: text,
   75:     date,
   76:     year,
   77:     month,
   78:     day,
   79:     hasDay: Boolean(match[3]),
   80:   };
   81: }

  107:       : {

  110:           timeZone: "UTC",
  111:         };
  112:

  146: /*
  147:  * =========================================
  148:  * Duration Calculation
  149:  * =========================================
  150:  */
  151: 
  152: function getCurrentUtcDateParts() {
  153:   const currentDate = new Date();
  154: 
  155:   return {
  156:     year: currentDate.getUTCFullYear(),
  157:     month: currentDate.getUTCMonth() + 1,
  158:     day: currentDate.getUTCDate(),
  159:   };
  160: }
  161: 
  162: export function calculateExperienceDuration(experience) {
  163:   const dates = getObject(experience?.dates);
  164: 
  165:   const start = parseExperienceDate(dates.startDate);
  166: 
  167:   if (!start) {
  168:     return null;
  169:   }
  170: 
  171:   let end;
  172: 
  173:   if (dates.isCurrent) {
  174:     const current = getCurrentUtcDateParts();
  175: 
  176:     end = {
  177:       year: current.year,
  178:       month: current.month,
  179:       day: current.day,
  180:       hasDay: true,
  181:     };
  182:   } else {
  183:     end = parseExperienceDate(dates.endDate);
  184:   }
  185: 
  186:   if (!end) {
  187:     return null;
  188:   }
  189: 
  190:   let totalMonths = (end.year - start.year) * 12 + (end.month - start.month);
  191: 
  192:   /*
  193:    * If exact days are supplied and the ending day
  194:    * is earlier than the starting day, the final
  195:    * month has not been completed.
  196:    */
  197: 
  198:   if (start.hasDay && end.hasDay && end.day < start.day) {
  199:     totalMonths -= 1;
  200:   }
  201: 
  202:   /*
  203:    * Month-only employment dates represent calendar
  204:    * months. Count the ending month as part of the
  205:    * experience.
  206:    */
  207: 
  208:   if (!start.hasDay && !end.hasDay) {
  209:     totalMonths += 1;
  210:   }
  211: 
  212:   totalMonths = Math.max(totalMonths, 0);
  213: 
  214:   return {
  215:     totalMonths,
  216:     years: Math.floor(totalMonths / 12),
  217:     months: totalMonths % 12,
  218:   };
  219: }

  222:  * =========================================
  223:  * Duration Formatting
  224:  * =========================================
  225:  */
  226: 
  227: export function formatExperienceDuration(
  228:   experience,
  229:   { compact = false, fallback = "" } = {},
  230: ) {
  231:   const duration = calculateExperienceDuration(experience);
  232: 
  233:   if (!duration) {
  234:     return fallback;
  235:   }
  236: 
  237:   const { totalMonths, years, months } = duration;
  238: 
  239:   if (totalMonths === 0) {
  240:     return compact ? "< 1 mo" : "Less than one month";
  241:   }
  242: 
  243:   const durationParts = [];
  244: 
  245:   if (years > 0) {
  246:     durationParts.push(
  247:       compact
  248:         ? `${years} yr${years === 1 ? "" : "s"}`
  249:         : `${years} ${years === 1 ? "year" : "years"}`,
  250:     );
  251:   }
  252: 
  253:   if (months > 0) {
  254:     durationParts.push(
  255:       compact
  256:         ? `${months} mo${months === 1 ? "" : "s"}`
  257:         : `${months} ${months === 1 ? "month" : "months"}`,
  258:     );
  259:   }
  260: 
  261:   return durationParts.join(" ");
  262: }

  525: export function filterExperiences(experiences, filters = {}) {
  526:   const {
  527:     category = "all",
  528:     employmentType = "all",
  529:     workArrangement = "all",
  530:     status = "all",
  531:     timeline = "all",
  532:     hasAchievements = false,
  533:     hasSkillsOrTechnologies = false,
  534:   } = filters;
  535: 
  536:   return getArray(experiences).filter((experience) => {
  537:     if (category !== "all" && experience.category !== category) {
  538:       return false;
  539:     }
  540: 
  541:     if (
  542:       employmentType !== "all" &&
  543:       experience.position?.employmentType !== employmentType
  544:     ) {
  545:       return false;
  546:     }
  547: 
  548:     if (
  549:       workArrangement !== "all" &&
  550:       experience.position?.workArrangement !== workArrangement
  551:     ) {
  552:       return false;
  553:     }
  554: 
  555:     if (status !== "all" && experience.status !== status) {
  556:       return false;
  557:     }
  558: 
  559:     if (timeline === "current" && experience.dates?.isCurrent !== true) {
  560:       return false;
  561:     }
  562: 
  563:     if (timeline === "previous" && experience.dates?.isCurrent === true) {
  564:       return false;
  565:     }
  566: 
  567:     if (hasAchievements && getArray(experience.achievements).length === 0) {
  568:       return false;
  569:     }
  570: 
  571:     if (
  572:       hasSkillsOrTechnologies &&
  573:       getArray(experience.skills).length === 0 &&
  574:       getArray(experience.technologies).length === 0
  575:     ) {
  576:       return false;
  577:     }
  578: 
  579:     return true;
  580:   });
  581: }
  582: 
  583: /*
  584:  * =========================================
  585:  * Sort Date Helpers
  586:  * =========================================
  587:  */
  588: 
  589: function getDateSortValue(value) {
  590:   const parsedDate = parseExperienceDate(value);
  591: 
  592:   return parsedDate ? parsedDate.date.getTime() : 0;
  593: }
  594: 
  595: function compareTextValues(firstValue, secondValue) {
  596:   return getText(firstValue).localeCompare(getText(secondValue), undefined, {
  597:     sensitivity: "base",
  598:   });
  599: }
  600: 
  601: /*
  602:  * =========================================
  603:  * Sort Experiences
  604:  * =========================================
  605:  */
  606: 
  607: export function sortExperiences(experiences, sortOption = "newest") {
  608:   const sortedExperiences = [...getArray(experiences)];
  609: 
  610:   sortedExperiences.sort((firstExperience, secondExperience) => {
  611:     switch (sortOption) {
  612:       case "oldest":
  613:         return (
  614:           getDateSortValue(firstExperience.dates?.startDate) -
  615:           getDateSortValue(secondExperience.dates?.startDate)
  616:         );
  617: 
  618:       case "position-ascending":
  619:         return compareTextValues(
  620:           getExperiencePositionTitle(firstExperience),
  621:           getExperiencePositionTitle(secondExperience),
  622:         );
  623: 
  624:       case "position-descending":
  625:         return compareTextValues(
  626:           getExperiencePositionTitle(secondExperience),
  627:           getExperiencePositionTitle(firstExperience),
  628:         );
  629: 
  630:       case "organization-ascending":
  631:         return compareTextValues(
  632:           getExperienceOrganizationName(firstExperience),
  633:           getExperienceOrganizationName(secondExperience),
  634:         );
  635: 
  636:       case "organization-descending":
  637:         return compareTextValues(
  638:           getExperienceOrganizationName(secondExperience),
  639:           getExperienceOrganizationName(firstExperience),
  640:         );
  641: 
  642:       case "recently-updated":
  643:         return (
  644:           new Date(secondExperience.updatedAt || 0).getTime() -
  645:           new Date(firstExperience.updatedAt || 0).getTime()
  646:         );
  647: 
  648:       case "newest":
  649:       default: {
  650:         /*
  651:          * Current positions appear first.
  652:          */
  653: 
  654:         const firstIsCurrent = firstExperience.dates?.isCurrent === true;
  655: 
  656:         const secondIsCurrent = secondExperience.dates?.isCurrent === true;
  657: 
  658:         if (firstIsCurrent !== secondIsCurrent) {
  659:           return firstIsCurrent ? -1 : 1;
  660:         }
  661: 
  662:         const firstEndDate = firstIsCurrent
  663:           ? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
  664:           : getDateSortValue(firstExperience.dates?.endDate);
  665: 
  666:         const secondEndDate = secondIsCurrent
  667:           ? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER
  668:           : getDateSortValue(secondExperience.dates?.endDate);
  669: 
  670:         if (firstEndDate !== secondEndDate) {
  671:           return secondEndDate - firstEndDate;
  672:         }
  673: 
  674:         return (
  675:           getDateSortValue(secondExperience.dates?.startDate) -
  676:           getDateSortValue(firstExperience.dates?.startDate)
  677:         );
  678:       }
  679:     }
  680:   });
  681: 
  682:   return sortedExperiences;
  683: }
  684: 
  685: /*
  686:  * =========================================
  687:  * Search, Filter and Sort
  688:  * =========================================
  689:  */
  690: 
  691: export function prepareExperienceCollection({
  692:   experiences = [],
  693:   query = "",
  694:   filters = {},
  695:   sortOption = "newest",
  696: } = {}) {
  697:   const searchedExperiences = searchExperiences(experiences, query);
  698: 
  699:   const filteredExperiences = filterExperiences(searchedExperiences, filters);
  700: 
  701:   return sortExperiences(filteredExperiences, sortOption);
  702: }
  703: 
  704: /*
  705:  * =========================================
  706:  * Experience Statistics
  707:  * =========================================
  708:  */
  709: 
  710: export function getExperienceStatistics(experiences) {
  711:   const collection = getArray(experiences);
  712: 
  713:   const active = collection.filter(
  714:     (experience) => experience.status !== "archived",
  715:   );
  716: 
  717:   const archived = collection.filter(
  718:     (experience) => experience.status === "archived",
  719:   );
  720: 
  721:   const current = active.filter(
  722:     (experience) => experience.dates?.isCurrent === true,
  723:   );
  724: 
  725:   const previous = active.filter(
  726:     (experience) => experience.dates?.isCurrent !== true,
  727:   );
  728: 
  729:   const withAchievements = active.filter(
  730:     (experience) => getArray(experience.achievements).length > 0,
  731:   );
  732: 
  733:   return {
  734:     total: collection.length,
  735:     active: active.length,
  736:     archived: archived.length,
  737:     current: current.length,
  738:     previous: previous.length,
  739:     withAchievements: withAchievements.length,
  740:   };
  741: }

   60:  * =========================================
   61:  * Date Helpers

   64: 
   65: const EXPERIENCE_DATE_PATTERN =
   66:   /^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])(?:-(0[1-9]|[12]\d|3[01]))?$/;
   67: 
   68: function isValidExperienceDate(value) {
   69:   const text = getText(value);
   70: 
   71:   if (!text || !EXPERIENCE_DATE_PATTERN.test(text)) {
   72:     return false;
   73:   }
   74: 
   75:   /*
   76:    * YYYY-MM dates are valid after passing the
   77:    * regular expression.
   78:    */
   79: 
   80:   if (text.length === 7) {
   81:     return true;
   82:   }
   83: 
   84:   /*
   85:    * Validate complete YYYY-MM-DD dates so values
   86:    * such as February 31 are rejected.
   87:    */
   88: 
   89:   const [year, month, day] = text.split("-").map(Number);
   90: 
   91:   const date = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day));
   92: 
   93:   return (
   94:     date.getUTCFullYear() === year &&
   95:     date.getUTCMonth() === month - 1 &&
   96:     date.getUTCDate() === day
   97:   );
   98: }
   99: 
  100: function getComparableDate(value, useEndOfMonth = false) {
  101:   const text = getText(value);
  102: 
  103:   if (!isValidExperienceDate(text)) {
  104:     return null;
  105:   }
  106: 
  107:   const [year, month, suppliedDay] = text.split("-").map(Number);
  108: 
  109:   let day = suppliedDay;
  110: 
  111:   if (!day) {
  112:     day = useEndOfMonth ? new Date(Date.UTC(year, month, 0)).getUTCDate() : 1;
  113:   }
  114: 
  115:   return Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day);
  116: }

  123: 
  124: function isValidWebsite(value) {
  125:   const text = getText(value);
  126: 
  127:   if (!text) {
  128:     return true;
  129:   }
  130: 
  131:   try {
  132:     const normalizedUrl = /^https?:\/\//i.test(text) ? text : `https://${text}`;
  133: 
  134:     const url = new URL(normalizedUrl);
  135: 
  136:     return ["http:", "https:"].includes(url.protocol) && Boolean(url.hostname);
  137:   } catch {
  138:     return false;
  139:   }
  140: }

  192: function findDuplicateIndexes(values, getIdentity) {
  193:   const seen = new Map();
  194:   const duplicates = [];
  195: 
  196:   values.forEach((value, index) => {
  197:     const identity = getIdentity(value).trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
  198: 
  199:     if (!identity) {
  200:       return;
  201:     }
  202: 
  203:     if (seen.has(identity)) {
  204:       duplicates.push({
  205:         firstIndex: seen.get(identity),
  206:         duplicateIndex: index,
  207:       });
  208: 
  209:       return;
  210:     }
  211: 
  212:     seen.set(identity, index);
  213:   });
  214: 
  215:   return duplicates;
  216: }

  574:       `achievements.${duplicateIndex}.text`,
  575:       "This achievement has already been added.",
  576:       "duplicate",
  577:     );
  578:   });
  579: }
  580: 
  581: /*
  582:  * =========================================
  583:  * Central Skill Relationship Helpers
  584:  * =========================================
  585:  */
  586: 
  587: const EXPERIENCE_SKILL_LEVEL_VALUES = [
  588:   "",
  589:   "foundational",
  590:   "intermediate",
  591:   "advanced",
  592:   "expert",
  593: ];
  594: 
  595: function getRelationshipSkillId(value) {
  596:   const relationship = getObject(value);
  597: 
  598:   return getText(relationship.skillId || relationship.profileSkillId);
  599: }
  600: 
  601: function getSkillSnapshotName(value) {
  602:   const relationship = getObject(value);
  603: 
  604:   return getText(
  605:     relationship.nameSnapshot ||
  606:       relationship.name ||
  607:       relationship.label ||
  608:       relationship.value,
  609:   );
  610: }
  611: 
  612: function validateRelationshipIdentifier(collector, field, value, label) {
  613:   if (!value) {
  614:     return;
  615:   }
  616: 
  617:   if (typeof value !== "string") {
  618:     collector.addError(
  619:       field,
  620:       `${label} has an invalid identifier.`,
  621:       "invalid_identifier",
  622:     );
  623: 
  624:     return;
  625:   }
  626: 
  627:   if (value.trim().length > 200) {
  628:     collector.addError(
  629:       field,
  630:       `${label} identifier cannot exceed 200 characters.`,
  631:       "too_long",
  632:     );
  633:   }
  634: }
  635: 
  636: function validateRelationshipOrder(collector, field, value) {
  637:   if (value === undefined || value === null || value === "") {
  638:     return;
  639:   }
  640: 
  641:   if (!Number.isInteger(value) || value < 0) {
  642:     collector.addError(
  643:       field,
  644:       "Relationship order must be a whole number of zero or greater.",
  645:       "invalid_order",
  646:     );
  647:   }
  648: }
  649: 
  650: function validateRelationshipProficiency(collector, field, value, label) {
  651:   const proficiency = getText(value);
  652: 
  653:   if (!EXPERIENCE_SKILL_LEVEL_VALUES.includes(proficiency)) {
  654:     collector.addError(
  655:       field,
  656:       `Select a valid ${label.toLowerCase()} proficiency level.`,
  657:       "invalid_option",
  658:     );
  659:   }
  660: }
  661: 
  662: /*
  663:  * =========================================
  664:  * Skills
  665:  * =========================================
  666:  */
  667: 
  668: function validateSkills(collector, experience) {
  669:   const skills = getArray(experience.skills);
  670: 
  671:   if (skills.length > EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumSkills) {
  672:     collector.addError(
  673:       "skills",
  674:       `Add no more than ${EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumSkills} skills.`,
  675:       "too_many_items",
  676:     );
  677:   }
  678: 
  679:   skills.forEach((skill, index) => {
  680:     const relationship = getObject(skill);
  681: 
  682:     const skillId = getRelationshipSkillId(relationship);
  683: 
  684:     const nameSnapshot = getSkillSnapshotName(relationship);
  685: 
  686:     const categorySnapshot = getText(relationship.categorySnapshot);
  687: 
  688:     const typeSnapshot = getText(relationship.typeSnapshot);
  689: 
  690:     const level = relationship.level ?? "";
  691: 
  692:     const usageDescription = relationship.usageDescription;
  693: 
  694:     validateRelationshipIdentifier(
  695:       collector,
  696:       `skills.${index}.id`,
  697:       relationship.id,
  698:       "Skill relationship",
  699:     );
  700: 
  701:     validateRelationshipIdentifier(
  702:       collector,
  703:       `skills.${index}.skillId`,
  704:       skillId,
  705:       "Central skill",
  706:     );
  707: 
  708:     if (!skillId && !nameSnapshot) {
  709:       collector.addError(
  710:         `skills.${index}.skillId`,
  711:         "Select a saved skill or provide a skill name.",
  712:         "required",
  713:       );
  714: 
  715:       return;
  716:     }
  717: 
  718:     /*
  719:      * A snapshot is required even when the central
  720:      * Skill Library relationship exists. This keeps
  721:      * the experience readable if the central record
  722:      * is archived, deleted, or temporarily unavailable.
  723:      */
  724: 
  725:     if (skillId && !nameSnapshot) {
  726:       collector.addError(
  727:         `skills.${index}.nameSnapshot`,
  728:         "Store the skill name snapshot with this relationship.",
  729:         "required_snapshot",
  730:       );
  731:     }
  732: 
  733:     if (!skillId && nameSnapshot) {
  734:       collector.addWarning(
  735:         `skills.${index}.skillId`,
  736:         `"${nameSnapshot}" is a legacy skill without a central Skill Library relationship.`,
  737:         "missing_skill_relationship",
  738:       );
  739:     }
  740: 
  741:     validateTextLength(
  742:       collector,
  743:       `skills.${index}.nameSnapshot`,
  744:       nameSnapshot,
  745:       EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS.skillName,
  746:       "Skill name",
  747:     );
  748: 
  749:     validateTextLength(
  750:       collector,
  751:       `skills.${index}.categorySnapshot`,
  752:       categorySnapshot,
  753:       EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS.skillCategory,
  754:       "Skill category snapshot",
  755:     );
  756: 
  757:     validateTextLength(
  758:       collector,
  759:       `skills.${index}.typeSnapshot`,
  760:       typeSnapshot,
  761:       EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS.skillType,
  762:       "Skill type snapshot",
  763:     );
  764: 
  765:     validateTextLength(
  766:       collector,
  767:       `skills.${index}.level`,
  768:       level,
  769:       EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS.skillLevel,
  770:       "Experience-specific proficiency",
  771:     );
  772: 
  773:     validateRelationshipProficiency(
  774:       collector,
  775:       `skills.${index}.level`,
  776:       level,
  777:       "Skill",
  778:     );
  779: 
  780:     validateTextLength(
  781:       collector,
  782:       `skills.${index}.usageDescription`,
  783:       usageDescription,
  784:       EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS.skillUsageDescription,
  785:       "Skill usage description",
  786:     );
  787: 
  788:     validateRelationshipOrder(
  789:       collector,
  790:       `skills.${index}.order`,
  791:       relationship.order,
  792:     );
  793:   });
  794: 
  795:   /*
  796:    * Prefer the permanent central skill ID for
  797:    * duplicate detection. Fall back to the snapshot
  798:    * name for migrated or legacy records.
  799:    */
  800: 
  801:   const duplicates = findDuplicateIndexes(skills, (skill) => {
  802:     const skillId = getRelationshipSkillId(skill);
  803: 
  804:     if (skillId) {
  805:       return `id:${skillId}`;
  806:     }
  807: 
  808:     return `name:${getSkillSnapshotName(skill)}`;
  809:   });
  810: 
  811:   duplicates.forEach(({ duplicateIndex }) => {
  812:     collector.addError(
  813:       `skills.${duplicateIndex}.skillId`,
  814:       "This skill has already been added to the experience.",
  815:       "duplicate",
  816:     );
  817:   });
  818: }

 1004: function validateLeadership(collector, experience) {

 1008:     leadership.hasLeadershipResponsibilities === true;

 1013:     peopleManaged !== "" &&

 1020:       collector.addError(

 1023:         "invalid_number",
 1024:       );
 1025:     }

 1027:     if (numberValue > 100000) {
 1028:       collector.addError(
 1029:         "leadership.peopleManaged",
 1030:         "Enter a realistic number of people managed.",
 1031:         "invalid_number",
 1032:       );
 1033:     }
 1034: 
 1035:     if (!hasLeadershipResponsibilities && numberValue > 0) {
 1036:       collector.addWarning(
 1037:         "leadership.hasLeadershipResponsibilities",

 1039:         "leadership_mismatch",
 1040:       );
 1041:     }

 1045:     collector,
 1046:     "leadership.description",
 1047:     leadership.description,
 1048:     EXPERIENCE_FIELD_LIMITS.leadershipDescription,
 1049:     "Leadership description",
 1050:   );

 1080:  * =========================================
 1081:  * Meaningful Content
 1082:  * =========================================
 1083:  */
 1084: 
 1085: function validateMeaningfulContent(collector, experience) {
 1086:   const hasOverview = hasText(experience.overview);
 1087: 
 1088:   const hasResponsibility = getArray(experience.responsibilities).some(
 1089:     (responsibility) => hasText(getItemText(responsibility)),
 1090:   );
 1091: 
 1092:   const hasAchievement = getArray(experience.achievements).some((achievement) =>
 1093:     hasText(getItemText(achievement)),
 1094:   );
 1095: 
 1096:   if (!hasOverview && !hasResponsibility && !hasAchievement) {
 1097:     collector.addError(
 1098:       "overview",
 1099:       "Add an overview, responsibility, or achievement that explains what you did.",
 1100:       "insufficient_content",
 1101:     );
 1102:   }
 1103: 
 1104:   if (!hasAchievement) {
 1105:     collector.addWarning(
 1106:       "achievements",
 1107:       "Consider adding at least one achievement or outcome to strengthen this experience.",
 1108:       "missing_achievement",
 1109:     );
 1110:   }
 1111: 
 1112:   const hasCapability =
 1113:     getArray(experience.skills).some((skill) => {
 1114:       return Boolean(
 1115:         getRelationshipSkillId(skill) || getSkillSnapshotName(skill),
 1116:       );
 1117:     }) ||
 1118:     getArray(experience.technologies).some((technology) => {
 1119:       return Boolean(
 1120:         getRelationshipSkillId(technology) || getSkillSnapshotName(technology),
 1121:       );
 1122:     });
 1123: 
 1124:   if (!hasCapability) {
 1125:     collector.addWarning(
 1126:       "skills",
 1127:       "Consider adding relevant skills or technologies used in this role.",
 1128:       "missing_capability",
 1129:     );
 1130:   }
 1131: }

 1159:   validateRequiredInformation(collector, experience);
 1160: 
 1161:   validateConfiguredOptions(collector, experience);

 1180:

 1194: /*
 1195:  * =========================================
 1196:  * Assertion for Save Operations
 1197:  * =========================================
 1198:  */
 1199: 
 1200: export function assertValidExperience(experience) {
 1201:   const validationResult = validateExperience(experience);
 1202: 
 1203:   if (validationResult.isValid) {
 1204:     return validationResult;
 1205:   }
 1206: 
 1207:   const error = new Error(
 1208:     "The experience contains invalid or incomplete information.",
 1209:   );
 1210: 
 1211:   error.name = "ExperienceValidationError";
 1212:   error.code = "EXPERIENCE_VALIDATION_FAILED";
 1213:   error.status = 400;
 1214: 
 1215:   error.validation = validationResult;
 1216:   error.errors = validationResult.errors;
 1217:   error.fieldErrors = validationResult.fieldErrors;
 1218: 
 1219:   throw error;
 1220: }

 1222: /*
 1223:  * =========================================
 1224:  * Human-Readable Summary
 1225:  * =========================================
 1226:  */
 1227: 
 1228: export function getExperienceValidationSummary(experience) {
 1229:   const validationResult = validateExperience(experience);
 1230: 
 1231:   if (!validationResult.isValid) {
 1232:     return `${validationResult.errors.length} ${
 1233:       validationResult.errors.length === 1 ? "problem must" : "problems must"
 1234:     } be corrected before saving.`;
 1235:   }
 1236: 
 1237:   if (validationResult.warnings.length > 0) {
 1238:     return `Ready to save with ${validationResult.warnings.length} ${
 1239:       validationResult.warnings.length === 1 ? "suggestion" : "suggestions"
 1240:     } for improvement.`;
 1241:   }
 1242: 
 1243:   return "This experience is complete and ready to save.";
 1244: }

   22:   return Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
   23: }
   24: 
   25: function getObject(value) {
   26:   return value && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value)
   27:     ? value
   28:     : {};
   29: }
   30: 
   31: function hasOwn(object, fieldName) {
   32:   return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(object, fieldName);
   33: }
   34:

   36:  * =========================================
   37:  * Portfolio Service Error
   38:  * =========================================

   40: 
   41: function createPortfolioServiceError(code, message, publicMessage) {
   42:   const error = new Error(message);
   43:

   45:   error.code = code;
   46:   error.publicMessage = publicMessage;

   52:  * =========================================
   53:  * Browser Storage
   54:  * =========================================
   55:  */
   56: 
   57: function requireLocalStorage() {
   58:   if (typeof window === "undefined" || !window.localStorage) {
   59:     throw createPortfolioServiceError(
   60:       "PORTFOLIO_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE",
   61:       "Browser localStorage is unavailable.",
   62:       "Portfolio storage is not available in this browser.",
   63:     );
   64:   }
   65: 
   66:   return window.localStorage;
   67: }

   69: /*
   70:  * =========================================
   71:  * Storage Key
   72:  * =========================================
   73:  */
   74: 
   75: export function createPortfolioStorageKey(username, portfolioSlug) {
   76:   const normalizedUsername = getText(username);
   77: 
   78:   const normalizedSlug = getText(portfolioSlug);
   79: 
   80:   if (!normalizedUsername || !normalizedSlug) {
   81:     throw createPortfolioServiceError(
   82:       "PORTFOLIO_IDENTITY_REQUIRED",
   83:       "The portfolio username and slug are required.",
   84:       "The portfolio username and slug are required.",
   85:     );
   86:   }
   87: 
   88:   return [
   89:     PUBLIC_PORTFOLIO_STORAGE_PREFIX,
   90:     normalizedUsername,
   91:     normalizedSlug,
   92:   ].join(":");
   93: }
   94: 
   95: /*
   96:  * =========================================
   97:  * Public Project Normalization
   98:  * =========================================
   99:  */
  100: 
  101: function createSafePublicProject(project) {
  102:   const source = getObject(project);
  103: 
  104:   if (!source.id) {
  105:     return null;
  106:   }
  107: 
  108:   /*
  109:    * A complete internal Project contains a
  110:    * visibility object, privateInformation, or
  111:    * recordStatus. createPublicProject applies
  112:    * all configured privacy rules directly.
  113:    */
  114: 
  115:   const isInternalProject =
  116:     hasOwn(source, "visibility") ||
  117:     hasOwn(source, "privateInformation") ||
  118:     hasOwn(source, "recordStatus");
  119: 
  120:   if (isInternalProject) {
  121:     return createPublicProject(source);
  122:   }
  123: 
  124:   /*
  125:    * Portfolio.jsx already creates public-safe
  126:    * Project snapshots. Public media and public
  127:    * documents no longer contain their internal
  128:    * visibility/status fields.
  129:    *
  130:    * Restore those public classifications before
  131:    * normalizing the snapshot again. This prevents
  132:    * valid public documents from being interpreted
  133:    * as private by the Project model defaults.
  134:    */
  135: 
  136:   return createPublicProject({
  137:     ...source,
  138: 
  139:     media: getArray(source.media).map((mediaItem) => ({
  140:       ...getObject(mediaItem),
  141:       visibility: "public",
  142:       status: "active",
  143:     })),
  144: 
  145:     supportingDocuments: getArray(source.supportingDocuments).map(
  146:       (documentRecord) => ({
  147:         ...getObject(documentRecord),
  148:         visibility: "public",
  149:         status: "active",
  150:       }),
  151:     ),
  152: 
  153:     visibility: {
  154:       showOrganization: source.organization !== null,
  155:       showLocation: source.location !== null,
  156:       showDates: source.dates !== null,
  157:       showLinks: source.links !== null,
  158:       showProblem: source.problem !== null,
  159:       showSolution: source.solution !== null,
  160:       showResults: source.results !== null,
  161:       showSkills: Array.isArray(source.skillRelationships),
  162:       showTechnologies: Array.isArray(source.technologies),
  163:       showRelatedRecords: source.relatedRecords !== null,
  164:       showAwards: Array.isArray(source.awards),
  165:       showMedia: Array.isArray(source.media),
  166:       showSupportingDocuments: Array.isArray(source.supportingDocuments),
  167:     },
  168:   });
  169: }
  170: 
  171: /*
  172:  * =========================================
  173:  * Public Project Collection
  174:  * =========================================
  175:  */
  176: 
  177: function createSafePublicProjects(projects) {
  178:   const seenProjectIds = new Set();
  179: 
  180:   return getArray(projects).reduce((collection, project) => {
  181:     const publicProject = createSafePublicProject(project);
  182: 
  183:     if (!publicProject?.id || seenProjectIds.has(publicProject.id)) {
  184:       return collection;
  185:     }
  186: 
  187:     seenProjectIds.add(publicProject.id);
  188: 
  189:     collection.push(publicProject);
  190: 
  191:     return collection;
  192:   }, []);
  193: }
  194: 
  195: /*
  196:  * =========================================
  197:  * Public Portfolio Normalization
  198:  * =========================================
  199:  */
  200: 
  201: function createPublicPortfolioRecord(portfolio) {
  202:   const source = getObject(portfolio);
  203: 
  204:   const username = getText(source.username);
  205: 
  206:   const slug = getText(source.slug);
  207: 
  208:   if (!username || !slug) {
  209:     throw createPortfolioServiceError(
  210:       "PORTFOLIO_IDENTITY_REQUIRED",
  211:       "The portfolio username and slug are required.",
  212:       "The portfolio username and slug are required.",
  213:     );
  214:   }
  215: 
  216:   /*
  217:    * Only fields used by the public PortfolioView
  218:    * are included. Editor-only information such as
  219:    * profileSelections is not stored publicly.
  220:    */
  221: 
  222:   return {
  223:     id: getText(source.id),
  224: 
  225:     username,
  226: 
  227:     slug,
  228: 
  229:     portfolioName: getText(source.portfolioName) || "Professional Portfolio",
  230: 
  231:     heroSettings: getObject(source.heroSettings),
  232: 
  233:     selectedProfile: getObject(source.selectedProfile),
  234: 
  235:     about:
  236:       typeof source.about === "string" ? source.about : getObject(source.about),
  237: 
  238:     summary: getText(source.summary),
  239: 
  240:     experiences: getArray(source.experiences),
  241: 
  242:     education: getArray(source.education),
  243: 
  244:     skills: getArray(source.skills),
  245: 
  246:     certifications: getArray(source.certifications),
  247: 
  248:     trainings: getArray(source.trainings),
  249: 
  250:     projects: createSafePublicProjects(source.projects),
  251: 
  252:     featuredResume: source.featuredResume
  253:       ? getObject(source.featuredResume)
  254:       : null,
  255: 
  256:     sectionVisibility: getObject(source.sectionVisibility),
  257: 
  258:     isPublished: true,
  259: 
  260:     updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  261:   };
  262: }
  263: 
  264: /*
  265:  * =========================================
  266:  * Validate Stored Portfolio
  267:  * =========================================
  268:  */
  269: 
  270: function validateStoredPortfolio(value, username, portfolioSlug) {
  271:   const portfolio = getObject(value);
  272: 
  273:   if (
  274:     !portfolio.username ||
  275:     !portfolio.slug ||
  276:     portfolio.username !== username ||
  277:     portfolio.slug !== portfolioSlug
  278:   ) {
  279:     throw createPortfolioServiceError(
  280:       "PORTFOLIO_STORAGE_INVALID",
  281:       "The stored portfolio identity is invalid.",
  282:       "The requested portfolio contains invalid stored data.",
  283:     );
  284:   }
  285: 
  286:   if (portfolio.isPublished !== true) {
  287:     throw createPortfolioServiceError(
  288:       "PORTFOLIO_NOT_PUBLISHED",
  289:       "The requested portfolio is not published.",
  290:       "This portfolio is not currently published.",
  291:     );
  292:   }
  293: 
  294:   return portfolio;
  295: }
  296: 
  297: /*
  298:  * =========================================
  299:  * Save Public Portfolio
  300:  * =========================================
  301:  */
  302: 
  303: export async function savePortfolio(portfolio) {
  304:   const storage = requireLocalStorage();
  305: 
  306:   const portfolioToSave = createPublicPortfolioRecord(portfolio);
  307: 
  308:   const storageKey = createPortfolioStorageKey(
  309:     portfolioToSave.username,
  310:     portfolioToSave.slug,
  311:   );
  312: 
  313:   try {
  314:     storage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(portfolioToSave));
  315:   } catch (error) {
  316:     throw createPortfolioServiceError(
  317:       "PORTFOLIO_SAVE_FAILED",
  318:       error?.message || "The public portfolio could not be stored.",
  319:       "The portfolio could not be published in this browser.",
  320:     );
  321:   }
  322: 
  323:   return portfolioToSave;
  324: }
  325: 
  326: /*
  327:  * =========================================
  328:  * Get Public Portfolio
  329:  * =========================================
  330:  */
  331: 
  332: export async function getPublicPortfolio(username, portfolioSlug) {
  333:   const storage = requireLocalStorage();
  334: 
  335:   const normalizedUsername = getText(username);
  336: 
  337:   const normalizedSlug = getText(portfolioSlug);
  338: 
  339:   const storageKey = createPortfolioStorageKey(
  340:     normalizedUsername,
  341:     normalizedSlug,
  342:   );
  343: 
  344:   let storedPortfolio = "";
  345: 
  346:   try {
  347:     storedPortfolio = storage.getItem(storageKey) || "";
  348:   } catch (error) {
  349:     throw createPortfolioServiceError(
  350:       "PORTFOLIO_READ_FAILED",
  351:       error?.message || "The public portfolio could not be read.",
  352:       "The portfolio could not be loaded from this browser.",
  353:     );
  354:   }
  355: 
  356:   if (!storedPortfolio) {
  357:     throw createPortfolioServiceError(
  358:       "PORTFOLIO_NOT_FOUND",
  359:       `Portfolio not found: ${normalizedUsername}/${normalizedSlug}`,
  360:       "The requested portfolio could not be found.",
  361:     );
  362:   }
  363: 
  364:   let parsedPortfolio;
  365: 
  366:   try {
  367:     parsedPortfolio = JSON.parse(storedPortfolio);
  368:   } catch {
  369:     throw createPortfolioServiceError(
  370:       "PORTFOLIO_STORAGE_INVALID",
  371:       "The stored public portfolio contains invalid JSON.",
  372:       "The requested portfolio contains invalid stored data.",
  373:     );
  374:   }
  375: 
  376:   return validateStoredPortfolio(
  377:     parsedPortfolio,
  378:     normalizedUsername,
  379:     normalizedSlug,
  380:   );
  381: }

  206: export function buildSelectedProfile(profile, selections = []) {
  207:   const selectedProfile = {
  208:     firstName: "",
  209:     middleName: "",
  210:     lastName: "",
  211:     professionalTitles: [],
  212:     emails: [],
  213:     phones: [],
  214:     websites: [],
  215:     locations: [],
  216:     socialLinks: [],
  217:     profilePictures: [],
  218:     selectedName: "",
  219:   };
  220: 
  221:   if (!profile) {
  222:     return selectedProfile;
  223:   }
  224: 
  225:   selections.forEach((selection) => {
  226:     if (!selection?.category || !selection?.itemId) {
  227:       return;
  228:     }
  229: 
  230:     const selectedOption = getSelectedProfileValue(profile, selection);
  231: 
  232:     if (!selectedOption) {
  233:       return;
  234:     }
  235: 
  236:     /*
  237:      * =========================================
  238:      * Selected Name
  239:      * =========================================
  240:      */
  241: 
  242:     if (selection.category === "name") {
  243:       selectedProfile.selectedName = selectedOption.displayValue;
  244: 
  245:       return;
  246:     }
  247: 
  248:     /*
  249:      * =========================================
  250:      * Selected Reusable Information
  251:      * =========================================
  252:      */
  253: 
  254:     const selectedItem = profile[selection.category]?.find(
  255:       (item) => item.id === selection.itemId,
  256:     );
  257: 
  258:     if (!selectedItem) {
  259:       return;
  260:     }
  261: 
  262:     /*
  263:      * =========================================
  264:      * Selected Picture
  265:      * =========================================
  266:      *
  267:      * Pictures stored in the reusable profile
  268:      * do not have a permanent purpose.
  269:      *
  270:      * The portfolio selection assigns the
  271:      * picture usage, such as:
  272:      *
  273:      * - profile
  274:      * - headshot
  275:      * - avatar
  276:      * - header-background
  277:      * - portfolio-background
  278:      * - logo
  279:      * - icon
  280:      */
  281: 
  282:     if (selection.category === "profilePictures") {
  283:       if (!selection.pictureUsage) {
  284:         return;
  285:       }
  286: 
  287:       selectedProfile.profilePictures.push({
  288:         ...selectedItem,
  289:         type: selection.pictureUsage,
  290:       });
  291: 
  292:       return;
  293:     }
  294: 
  295:     /*
  296:      * =========================================
  297:      * Other Profile Categories
  298:      * =========================================
  299:      */
  300: 
  301:     if (!Array.isArray(selectedProfile[selection.category])) {
  302:       return;
  303:     }
  304: 
  305:     selectedProfile[selection.category].push(selectedItem);
  306:   });
  307: 
  308:   return selectedProfile;
  309: }

  251:       (a, b) =>

  429:   const candidate = {
  430:     ...profile,
  431: 
  432:     [collectionName]: nextCollection,
  433: 
  434:     preferences: shouldAssignPrimary
  435:       ? {
  436:           ...profile.preferences,
  437: 
  438:           [preferenceName]: newItem.id,
  439:         }
  440:       : profile.preferences,
  441: 
  442:     updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  443:   };
  444: 
  445:   const savedProfile = saveValidatedProfile(candidate);
  446: 
  447:   return {
  448:     profile: savedProfile,
  449: 
  450:     item:
  451:       savedProfile[collectionName].find((item) => item.id === newItem.id) ||
  452:       null,
  453: 
  454:     created: true,
  455:   };
  456: }

  557: /*
  558:  * =========================================
  559:  * Reorder Collection
  560:  * =========================================
  561:  */
  562: 
  563: export async function reorderProfileCollection(collectionName, orderedItemIds) {
  564:   assertCollectionName(collectionName);
  565: 
  566:   if (!Array.isArray(orderedItemIds)) {
  567:     throw createProfileServiceError({
  568:       message: "Profile item order must be an array of IDs.",
  569: 
  570:       publicMessage: "The Profile information could not be reordered.",
  571: 
  572:       code: "INVALID_PROFILE_ITEM_ORDER",
  573:       status: 400,
  574:     });
  575:   }
  576: 
  577:   const profile = readStoredProfile();
  578: 
  579:   const currentCollection = profile[collectionName] || [];
  580: 
  581:   const currentIds = new Set(currentCollection.map((item) => item.id));
  582: 
  583:   const requestedIds = new Set(orderedItemIds);
  584: 
  585:   const containsEveryItem =
  586:     currentIds.size === requestedIds.size &&
  587:     [...currentIds].every((id) => requestedIds.has(id));
  588: 
  589:   if (!containsEveryItem) {
  590:     throw createProfileServiceError({
  591:       message:
  592:         "The supplied Profile item order does not match the current collection.",
  593: 
  594:       publicMessage:
  595:         "The Profile information could not be reordered because its item list changed.",
  596: 
  597:       code: "PROFILE_ITEM_ORDER_MISMATCH",
  598:       status: 409,
  599:     });
  600:   }
  601: 
  602:   const itemById = new Map(currentCollection.map((item) => [item.id, item]));
  603: 
  604:   const nextCollection = orderedItemIds.map((itemId, index) => ({
  605:     ...itemById.get(itemId),
  606: 
  607:     order: index,
  608:     updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  609:   }));
  610: 
  611:   const candidate = {
  612:     ...profile,
  613: 
  614:     [collectionName]: nextCollection,
  615: 
  616:     updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  617:   };
  618: 
  619:   return saveValidatedProfile(candidate);
  620: }

  627: 
  628: export async function setPrimaryProfileItem(collectionName, itemId) {
  629:   assertCollectionName(collectionName);
  630: 
  631:   const normalizedItemId = assertItemId(itemId);
  632: 
  633:   const preferenceName = getPrimaryPreferenceName(collectionName);
  634: 
  635:   if (!preferenceName) {
  636:     throw createProfileServiceError({
  637:       message: `Collection "${collectionName}" does not support a primary item.`,
  638: 
  639:       publicMessage:
  640:         "This Profile information category cannot have a primary item.",
  641: 
  642:       code: "PRIMARY_ITEM_NOT_SUPPORTED",
  643:       status: 400,
  644:     });
  645:   }
  646: 
  647:   const profile = readStoredProfile();
  648: 
  649:   const selectedItem = (profile[collectionName] || []).find(
  650:     (item) => item.id === normalizedItemId,
  651:   );
  652: 
  653:   if (!selectedItem) {
  654:     throw createProfileItemNotFoundError(collectionName, normalizedItemId);
  655:   }
  656: 
  657:   if (selectedItem.status === "archived") {
  658:     throw createProfileServiceError({
  659:       message: "An archived Profile item cannot be assigned as primary.",
  660: 
  661:       publicMessage:
  662:         "Restore this Profile information before making it primary.",
  663: 
  664:       code: "ARCHIVED_PRIMARY_PROFILE_ITEM",
  665:       status: 400,
  666:     });
  667:   }
  668: 
  669:   const candidate = {
  670:     ...profile,
  671: 
  672:     preferences: {
  673:       ...profile.preferences,
  674: 
  675:       [preferenceName]: normalizedItemId,
  676:     },
  677: 
  678:     updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  679:   };
  680: 
  681:   const savedProfile = saveValidatedProfile(candidate);
  682: 
  683:   return {
  684:     profile: savedProfile,
  685:     item: selectedItem,
  686:     preferenceName,
  687:   };
  688: }

   77: function isQuotaError(error) {
   78:   return (
   79:     error?.name === "QuotaExceededError" ||
   80:     error?.name === "NS_ERROR_DOM_QUOTA_REACHED" ||
   81:     error?.code === 22 ||
   82:     error?.code === 1014
   83:   );

   86: function normalizeStorageError(error, operation = "access") {
   87:   if (error?.name === "ProfileStorageError") {
   88:     return error;
   89:   }
   90: 
   91:   if (isQuotaError(error)) {
   92:     return createProfileStorageError({
   93:       message:
   94:         "The browser does not have enough localStorage capacity to save the Profile.",
   95:       publicMessage:
   96:         "The Profile could not be saved because browser storage is full. Remove large local pictures or try again.",
   97:       code: "PROFILE_STORAGE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED",
   98:       originalError: error,
   99:     });
  100:   }
  101: 
  102:   return createProfileStorageError({
  103:     message: `Unable to ${operation} the locally stored Profile: ${
  104:       error?.message || "Unknown storage error"
  105:     }`,
  106: 
  107:     publicMessage: "The locally stored Profile could not be accessed.",
  108: 
  109:     code: "PROFILE_STORAGE_FAILED",
  110:     originalError: error,
  111:   });

  115:  * =========================================
  116:  * Storage Envelope

  120: function createStorageEnvelope(profile) {
  121:   return {
  122:     storageVersion: PROFILE_STORAGE_VERSION,
  123:     savedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  124:     profile: normalizeProfile(profile),
  125:   };
  126: }
  127: 
  128: function isStorageEnvelope(value) {
  129:   return Boolean(
  130:     value &&
  131:     typeof value === "object" &&
  132:     !Array.isArray(value) &&
  133:     value.profile &&
  134:     typeof value.profile === "object" &&
  135:     !Array.isArray(value.profile),
  136:   );
  137: }

  139: /*
  140:  * =========================================
  141:  * Parse Stored Value
  142:  * =========================================
  143:  */
  144: 
  145: function parseStoredProfile(rawValue) {
  146:   const parsedValue = JSON.parse(rawValue);
  147: 
  148:   /*
  149:    * Current format:
  150:    *
  151:    * {
  152:    *   storageVersion,
  153:    *   savedAt,
  154:    *   profile
  155:    * }
  156:    */
  157: 
  158:   if (isStorageEnvelope(parsedValue)) {
  159:     return {
  160:       profile: normalizeProfile(parsedValue.profile),
  161: 
  162:       storageVersion: Number(parsedValue.storageVersion) || 0,
  163: 
  164:       savedAt:
  165:         typeof parsedValue.savedAt === "string" ? parsedValue.savedAt : "",
  166: 
  167:       wasLegacyFormat: false,
  168:     };
  169:   }
  170: 
  171:   /*
  172:    * Legacy format:
  173:    *
  174:    * {
  175:    *   firstName,
  176:    *   lastName,
  177:    *   professionalTitles,
  178:    *   emails,
  179:    *   ...
  180:    * }
  181:    */
  182: 
  183:   if (
  184:     parsedValue &&
  185:     typeof parsedValue === "object" &&
  186:     !Array.isArray(parsedValue)
  187:   ) {
  188:     return {
  189:       profile: normalizeProfile(parsedValue),
  190:       storageVersion: 0,
  191:       savedAt: "",
  192:       wasLegacyFormat: true,
  193:     };
  194:   }
  195: 
  196:   throw createProfileStorageError({
  197:     message: "The stored Profile does not contain a valid object.",
  198:     publicMessage: "The locally stored Profile has an invalid format.",
  199:     code: "INVALID_PROFILE_STORAGE_FORMAT",
  200:   });
  201: }
