  206:  * =========================================
  207:  */
  208: 
  209: function preserveCorruptedValue(storage, storageKey, rawValue) {
  210:   if (!rawValue) {
  211:     return "";
  212:   }
  213: 
  214:   const corruptedKey = `${storageKey}:corrupted:${Date.now()}`;
  215: 
  216:   try {
  217:     storage.setItem(corruptedKey, rawValue);
  218: 
  219:     return corruptedKey;
  220:   } catch (error) {
  221:     /*
  222:      * Storage may already be full. Failure to
  223:      * preserve corrupted data must not prevent
  224:      * the application from recovering.
  225:      */
  226: 
  227:     console.error("Unable to preserve corrupted Profile storage:", error);
  228: 
  229:     return "";
  230:   }
  231: }
  232: 
  233: /*
  234:  * =========================================
  235:  * Find Legacy Profile
  236:  * =========================================
  237:  */
  238: 
  239: function findLegacyStoredProfile(storage) {
  240:   for (const legacyKey of LEGACY_PROFILE_STORAGE_KEYS) {
  241:     const rawValue = storage.getItem(legacyKey);
  242: 
  243:     if (!rawValue) {
  244:       continue;
  245:     }
  246: 
  247:     try {
  248:       const parsedResult = parseStoredProfile(rawValue);
  249: 
  250:       return {
  251:         ...parsedResult,
  252:         legacyKey,
  253:       };
  254:     } catch (error) {
  255:       console.error(
  256:         `Unable to read legacy Profile storage "${legacyKey}":`,
  257:         error,
  258:       );
  259:     }
  260:   }
  261: 
  262:   return null;
  263: }
  264: 
  265: /*
  266:  * =========================================
  267:  * Save Profile
  268:  * =========================================
  269:  */
  270: 
  271: export function replaceStoredProfile(profileValue) {
  272:   try {
  273:     const storage = getLocalStorage();
  274: 
  275:     const normalizedProfile = normalizeProfile(profileValue);
  276: 
  277:     const envelope = createStorageEnvelope(normalizedProfile);
  278: 
  279:     storage.setItem(PROFILE_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(envelope));
  280: 
  281:     return normalizedProfile;
  282:   } catch (error) {
  283:     throw normalizeStorageError(error, "save");
  284:   }
  285: }
  286: 
  287: /*
  288:  * =========================================
  289:  * Read Profile
  290:  * =========================================
  291:  *
  292:  * fallbackProfile lets the future context pass
  293:  * your existing in-memory INITIAL_PROFILE during
  294:  * the first migration.
  295:  */
  296: 
  297: export function readStoredProfile({
  298:   fallbackProfile = null,
  299:   migrateLegacy = true,
  300: } = {}) {
  301:   let storage;
  302: 
  303:   try {
  304:     storage = getLocalStorage();
  305:   } catch (error) {
  306:     throw normalizeStorageError(error, "read");
  307:   }
  308: 
  309:   const rawValue = storage.getItem(PROFILE_STORAGE_KEY);
  310: 
  311:   /*
  312:    * Current storage exists.
  313:    */
  314: 
  315:   if (rawValue) {
  316:     try {
  317:       const result = parseStoredProfile(rawValue);
  318: 
  319:       /*
  320:        * Rewrite raw legacy objects or older
  321:        * envelopes into the current format.
  322:        */
  323: 
  324:       if (
  325:         migrateLegacy &&
  326:         (result.wasLegacyFormat ||
  327:           result.storageVersion !== PROFILE_STORAGE_VERSION)
  328:       ) {
  329:         replaceStoredProfile(result.profile);
  330:       }
  331: 
  332:       return result.profile;
  333:     } catch (error) {
  334:       const corruptedBackupKey = preserveCorruptedValue(
  335:         storage,
  336:         PROFILE_STORAGE_KEY,
  337:         rawValue,
  338:       );
  339: 
  340:       try {
  341:         storage.removeItem(PROFILE_STORAGE_KEY);
  342:       } catch (removeError) {
  343:         console.error(
  344:           "Unable to remove corrupted Profile storage:",
  345:           removeError,
  346:         );
  347:       }
  348: 
  349:       console.error("The stored Profile was corrupted.", {
  350:         error,
  351:         corruptedBackupKey,
  352:       });
  353:     }
  354:   }
  355: 
  356:   /*
  357:    * Search earlier storage keys.
  358:    */
  359: 
  360:   if (migrateLegacy) {
  361:     const legacyResult = findLegacyStoredProfile(storage);
  362: 
  363:     if (legacyResult) {
  364:       const migratedProfile = replaceStoredProfile(legacyResult.profile);
  365: 
  366:       /*
  367:        * Remove only the successfully migrated
  368:        * legacy value.
  369:        */
  370: 
  371:       try {
  372:         storage.removeItem(legacyResult.legacyKey);
  373:       } catch (error) {
  374:         console.error(
  375:           "Unable to remove migrated legacy Profile storage:",
  376:           error,
  377:         );
  378:       }
  379: 
  380:       return migratedProfile;
  381:     }
  382:   }
  383: 
  384:   /*
  385:    * First application load:
  386:    * normalize and persist the supplied fallback.
  387:    */
  388: 
  389:   if (fallbackProfile && typeof fallbackProfile === "object") {
  390:     return replaceStoredProfile(fallbackProfile);
  391:   }
  392: 
  393:   const emptyProfile = createEmptyProfile();
  394: 
  395:   return replaceStoredProfile(emptyProfile);
  396: }
  397: 
  398: /*
  399:  * =========================================
  400:  * Storage Metadata
  401:  * =========================================
  402:  */
  403: 
  404: export function readStoredProfileMetadata() {
  405:   try {
  406:     const storage = getLocalStorage();
  407: 
  408:     const rawValue = storage.getItem(PROFILE_STORAGE_KEY);
  409: 
  410:     if (!rawValue) {
  411:       return {
  412:         exists: false,
  413:         storageVersion: null,
  414:         savedAt: "",
  415:       };
  416:     }
  417: 
  418:     const parsedValue = JSON.parse(rawValue);
  419: 
  420:     if (!isStorageEnvelope(parsedValue)) {
  421:       return {
  422:         exists: true,
  423:         storageVersion: 0,
  424:         savedAt: "",
  425:       };
  426:     }
  427: 
  428:     return {
  429:       exists: true,
  430: 
  431:       storageVersion: Number(parsedValue.storageVersion) || 0,
  432: 
  433:       savedAt:
  434:         typeof parsedValue.savedAt === "string" ? parsedValue.savedAt : "",
  435:     };
  436:   } catch (error) {
  437:     throw normalizeStorageError(error, "read Profile storage metadata from");
  438:   }
  439: }
  440: 
  441: /*
  442:  * =========================================
  443:  * Storage Presence
  444:  * =========================================
  445:  */
  446: 
  447: export function hasStoredProfile() {
  448:   try {
  449:     const storage = getLocalStorage();
  450: 
  451:     return Boolean(storage.getItem(PROFILE_STORAGE_KEY));
  452:   } catch {
  453:     return false;
  454:   }
  455: }
  456: 
  457: /*
  458:  * =========================================
  459:  * Remove Profile
  460:  * =========================================
  461:  */
  462: 
  463: export function removeStoredProfile() {
  464:   try {
  465:     const storage = getLocalStorage();
  466: 
  467:     const existed = Boolean(storage.getItem(PROFILE_STORAGE_KEY));
  468: 
  469:     storage.removeItem(PROFILE_STORAGE_KEY);
  470: 
  471:     return {
  472:       removed: existed,
  473:       storageKey: PROFILE_STORAGE_KEY,
  474:     };
  475:   } catch (error) {
  476:     throw normalizeStorageError(error, "remove");
  477:   }
  478: }
  479: 
  480: /*
  481:  * =========================================
  482:  * Explicit Migration
  483:  * =========================================
  484:  */
  485: 
  486: export function migrateStoredProfile(fallbackProfile = null) {
  487:   return readStoredProfile({
  488:     fallbackProfile,
  489:     migrateLegacy: true,
  490:   });
  491: }
  492: 
  493: /*
  494:  * =========================================
  495:  * Reset Profile
  496:  * =========================================
  497:  */
  498: 
  499: export function resetStoredProfile(fallbackProfile = null) {
  500:   const nextProfile =
  501:     fallbackProfile && typeof fallbackProfile === "object"
  502:       ? normalizeProfile(fallbackProfile)
  503:       : createEmptyProfile();
  504: 
  505:   return replaceStoredProfile(nextProfile);
  506: }

  101: export function sortProfileItems(items = []) {
  102:   return getArray(items)
  103:     .map((item, index) => ({
  104:       item,
  105:       originalIndex: index,
  106:     }))
  107:     .sort((firstEntry, secondEntry) => {
  108:       const orderDifference =
  109:         getItemOrder(firstEntry.item, firstEntry.originalIndex) -
  110:         getItemOrder(secondEntry.item, secondEntry.originalIndex);
  111: 
  112:       if (orderDifference !== 0) {
  113:         return orderDifference;
  114:       }
  115: 
  116:       const firstCreatedAt = getText(firstEntry.item?.createdAt);
  117: 
  118:       const secondCreatedAt = getText(secondEntry.item?.createdAt);
  119: 
  120:       if (firstCreatedAt && secondCreatedAt) {
  121:         const dateDifference =
  122:           new Date(firstCreatedAt).getTime() -
  123:           new Date(secondCreatedAt).getTime();
  124: 
  125:         if (Number.isFinite(dateDifference) && dateDifference !== 0) {
  126:           return dateDifference;
  127:         }
  128:       }
  129: 
  130:       return firstEntry.originalIndex - secondEntry.originalIndex;
  131:     })
  132:     .map((entry) => entry.item);
  133: }

  531: export function getProfileCompleteness(profile) {
  532:   const primaryProfessionalTitle = getPrimaryProfessionalTitle(profile);
  533: 
  534:   const primaryEmail = getPrimaryEmail(profile);
  535: 
  536:   const primaryPhone = getPrimaryPhone(profile);
  537:

  539:

  541: 
  542:   const primarySocialLink = getPrimarySocialLink(profile);
  543: 
  544:   const primaryPicture = getPrimaryProfilePicture(profile);
  545: 
  546:   const details = [
  547:     {
  548:       id: "name",
  549:       label: "Name",
  550: 
  551:       complete: Boolean(
  552:         getText(profile?.firstName) && getText(profile?.lastName),
  553:       ),
  554: 
  555:       weight: 3,
  556: 
  557:       value:
  558:         getProfileFullName(profile, {
  559:           fallback: "",
  560:         }) || "Not provided",
  561:     },
  562: 
  563:     {
  564:       id: "professionalTitle",
  565:       label: "Professional Title",
  566: 
  567:       complete: Boolean(getText(primaryProfessionalTitle?.name)),
  568: 
  569:       weight: 2,
  570: 
  571:       value: getText(primaryProfessionalTitle?.name) || "Not provided",
  572:     },
  573: 
  574:     {
  575:       id: "email",
  576:       label: "Email",
  577: 
  578:       complete: Boolean(getText(primaryEmail?.value)),
  579: 
  580:       weight: 2,
  581: 
  582:       value: getText(primaryEmail?.value) || "Not provided",
  583:     },
  584: 
  585:     {
  586:       id: "phone",
  587:       label: "Phone",
  588: 
  589:       complete: Boolean(getText(primaryPhone?.value)),
  590: 
  591:       weight: 1,
  592: 
  593:       value: getText(primaryPhone?.value) || "Not provided",
  594:     },
  595: 
  596:     {
  597:       id: "location",
  598:       label: "Location",
  599: 
  600:       complete: Boolean(getText(primaryLocation?.value)),
  601: 
  602:       weight: 1,
  603: 
  604:       value: getText(primaryLocation?.value) || "Not provided",
  605:     },
  606: 
  607:     {
  608:       id: "onlinePresence",
  609:       label: "Online Presence",
  610: 
  611:       complete: Boolean(
  612:         getText(primaryWebsite?.value) || getText(primarySocialLink?.value),
  613:       ),
  614: 
  615:       weight: 1,
  616: 
  617:       value:
  618:         getText(primaryWebsite?.value) ||
  619:         getText(primarySocialLink?.value) ||
  620:         "Not provided",
  621:     },
  622: 
  623:     {
  624:       id: "picture",
  625:       label: "Profile Picture",
  626: 
  627:       complete: hasConfiguredProfilePicture(primaryPicture),
  628: 
  629:       weight: 1,
  630: 
  631:       value: hasConfiguredProfilePicture(primaryPicture)
  632:         ? usesDefaultProfileAvatar(primaryPicture)
  633:           ? "Default avatar"
  634:           : "Uploaded picture"
  635:         : "Not provided",
  636:     },
  637:   ];
  638: 
  639:   const maximumScore = details.reduce(
  640:     (total, detail) => total + detail.weight,
  641:     0,
  642:   );
  643: 
  644:   const score = details.reduce(
  645:     (total, detail) => total + (detail.complete ? detail.weight : 0),
  646:     0,
  647:   );
  648: 
  649:   const percentage =
  650:     maximumScore > 0 ? Math.round((score / maximumScore) * 100) : 0;
  651: 
  652:   let level = "empty";
  653:   let label = "Not Started";
  654: 
  655:   let description = "Add your identity and professional contact information.";
  656: 
  657:   if (percentage === 100) {
  658:     level = "complete";
  659:     label = "Complete";
  660: 
  661:     description =
  662:       "The Profile contains all recommended professional information.";
  663:   } else if (percentage >= 75) {
  664:     level = "strong";
  665:     label = "Strong";
  666: 
  667:     description =
  668:       "The Profile has strong reusable information with only a few optional details missing.";
  669:   } else if (percentage >= 40) {
  670:     level = "developing";
  671:     label = "Developing";
  672: 
  673:     description =
  674:       "The Profile is usable, but additional professional and contact information would improve it.";
  675:   } else if (percentage > 0) {
  676:     level = "basic";
  677:     label = "Basic";
  678: 
  679:     description =
  680:       "The Profile contains limited information and should be expanded.";
  681:   }
  682: 
  683:   return {
  684:     level,
  685:     label,
  686:     description,
  687: 
  688:     score,
  689:     maximumScore,
  690:     percentage,
  691: 
  692:     completedCount: details.filter((detail) => detail.complete).length,
  693: 
  694:     totalCount: details.length,
  695: 
  696:     details,
  697:   };
  698: }

  706: export function getProfileStatistics(profile) {
  707:   const collectionStatistics = getArray(PROFILE_COLLECTION_NAMES).reduce(
  708:     (statistics, collectionName) => {
  709:       const allItems = getProfileCollection(profile, collectionName);
  710:

  717:       statistics[collectionName] = {
  718:         total: allItems.length,
  719:         active: activeItems.length,
  720:         archived: archivedItems.length,
  721:       };
  722: 
  723:       statistics.totalItems += allItems.length;
  724: 
  725:       statistics.activeItems += activeItems.length;
  726: 
  727:       statistics.archivedItems += archivedItems.length;
  728: 
  729:       return statistics;
  730:     },
  731:     {
  732:       totalItems: 0,
  733:       activeItems: 0,
  734:       archivedItems: 0,
  735:     },
  736:   );
  737: 
  738:   const completeness = getProfileCompleteness(profile);
  739: 
  740:   const primaryPicture = getPrimaryProfilePicture(profile);

  743:     ...collectionStatistics,
  744:

  746: 
  747:     completenessPercentage: completeness.percentage,
  748:

  771:  * =========================================
  772:  * Searchable Text
  773:  * =========================================
  774:  */
  775: 
  776: export function createProfileSearchText(profile) {
  777:   if (!profile) {
  778:     return "";
  779:   }
  780: 
  781:   const searchableValues = [
  782:     profile.firstName,
  783:     profile.middleName,
  784:     profile.lastName,
  785:   ];
  786: 
  787:   getArray(PROFILE_COLLECTION_NAMES).forEach((collectionName) => {
  788:     getProfileCollection(profile, collectionName).forEach((item) => {
  789:       searchableValues.push(
  790:         item?.name,
  791:         item?.value,
  792:         item?.description,
  793:         item?.type,
  794:         item?.fileName,
  795: 
  796:         usesDefaultProfileAvatar(item) ? "default avatar" : "",
  797:       );
  798:     });
  799:   });
  800: 
  801:   return searchableValues
  802:     .map(getText)
  803:     .filter(Boolean)
  804:     .join(" ")
  805:     .normalize("NFKC")
  806:     .toLocaleLowerCase();
  807: }
  808: 
  809: export function profileMatchesSearch(profile, query) {
  810:   const normalizedQuery = getText(query).normalize("NFKC").toLocaleLowerCase();
  811: 
  812:   if (!normalizedQuery) {
  813:     return true;
  814:   }
  815: 
  816:   return createProfileSearchText(profile).includes(normalizedQuery);
  817: }

   67: function createValidationCollector() {
   68:   const errors = [];
   69:   const warnings = [];
   70:   const conflicts = [];
   71: 
   72:   return {
   73:     errors,
   74:     warnings,
   75:     conflicts,
   76: 
   77:     addError(field, message, code = "invalid") {

   79:     },
   80: 
   81:     addWarning(field, message, code = "warning") {
   82:       warnings.push(createIssue(field, message, code));
   83:     },
   84: 
   85:     addConflict(field, message, conflictingItem, code = "duplicate") {
   86:       const conflict = {
   87:         ...createIssue(field, message, code),
   88: 
   89:         conflictingItemId: conflictingItem?.id || "",
   90: 
   91:         conflictingValue: conflictingItem?.value || conflictingItem?.name || "",
   92:       };
   93: 
   94:       conflicts.push(conflict);
   95:       errors.push(conflict);
   96:     },
   97:   };

  106: function validateTextLength(collector, field, value, maximumLength, label) {
  107:   if (typeof value !== "string" || !Number.isFinite(Number(maximumLength))) {
  108:     return;
  109:   }
  110: 
  111:   if (value.trim().length > Number(maximumLength)) {
  112:     collector.addError(
  113:       field,
  114:       `${label} cannot exceed ${maximumLength} characters.`,
  115:       "too_long",
  116:     );
  117:   }
  118: }

  126: function validatePersonName(
  127:   collector,
  128:   field,
  129:   value,
  130:   label,
  131:   maximumLength,
  132:   required,
  133: ) {
  134:   const name = getText(value);
  135: 
  136:   if (!name) {
  137:     if (required) {
  138:       collector.addError(
  139:         field,
  140:         `Enter your ${label.toLowerCase()}.`,
  141:         "required",
  142:       );
  143:     }
  144: 
  145:     return;
  146:   }
  147: 
  148:   validateTextLength(collector, field, value, maximumLength, label);
  149: 
  150:   if (name.length < 2) {
  151:     collector.addError(
  152:       field,
  153:       `${label} must contain at least two characters.`,
  154:       "too_short",
  155:     );
  156:   }
  157: 
  158:   /*
  159:    * Supports letters from different languages,
  160:    * spaces, apostrophes, periods and hyphens.
  161:    */
  162: 
  163:   if (!/^[\p{L}\p{M} .'-]+$/u.test(name)) {
  164:     collector.addError(
  165:       field,
  166:       `${label} contains unsupported characters.`,
  167:       "invalid_name",
  168:     );
  169:   }
  170: 
  171:   if (!/\p{L}/u.test(name)) {
  172:     collector.addError(
  173:       field,
  174:       `${label} must contain at least one letter.`,
  175:       "invalid_name",
  176:     );
  177:   }

  307: function validateCollectionIds(collector, collection, category) {
  308:   const seenIds = new Set();
  309: 
  310:   getArray(collection).forEach((item, index) => {

  327:         "duplicate_id",
  328:       );

  331:     }
  332:

  334:   });

  343: function validateProfessionalTitles(collector, profile) {
  344:   const titles = getArray(profile.professionalTitles);
  345:

  347: 
  348:   titles.forEach((titleValue, index) => {

  354:

  361: 
  362:       return;
  363:     }
  364: 
  365:     validateTextLength(
  366:       collector,
  367:       `${fieldPrefix}.name`,
  368:       title.name,
  369:       PROFILE_FIELD_LIMITS.professionalTitle,
  370:       "Professional title",
  371:     );
  372: 
  373:     validateTextLength(
  374:       collector,
  375:       `${fieldPrefix}.description`,
  376:       title.description,
  377:       PROFILE_FIELD_LIMITS.description,
  378:       "Professional title description",
  379:     );
  380: 
  381:     if (title.status && !isValidProfileItemStatus(title.status)) {
  382:       collector.addError(
  383:         `${fieldPrefix}.status`,
  384:         "Select a valid professional-title status.",
  385:         "invalid_option",
  386:       );
  387:     }
  388: 
  389:     const comparisonName = normalizeComparisonValue(name);
  390: 
  391:     if (seenTitles.has(comparisonName)) {
  392:       collector.addConflict(
  393:         `${fieldPrefix}.name`,
  394:         `"${name}" has already been added as a professional title.`,
  395:         titles[seenTitles.get(comparisonName)],
  396:         "duplicate_professional_title",
  397:       );
  398: 
  399:       return;
  400:     }
  401: 
  402:     seenTitles.set(comparisonName, index);
  403:   });
  404: 
  405:   validateCollectionIds(collector, titles, "professionalTitles");
  406: }
  407: 
  408: /*
  409:  * =========================================
  410:  * Email Validation
  411:  * =========================================
  412:  */
  413: 
  414: const EMAIL_PATTERN = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/;
  415: 
  416: function validateEmailValue(collector, field, value) {
  417:   if (!EMAIL_PATTERN.test(value)) {
  418:     collector.addError(field, "Enter a valid email address.", "invalid_email");
  419:   }
  420: }
  421: 
  422: /*
  423:  * =========================================
  424:  * Phone Validation
  425:  * =========================================
  426:  */
  427: 
  428: function validatePhoneValue(collector, field, value) {
  429:   const digits = value.replace(/[^\d]/g, "");
  430: 
  431:   if (digits.length < 7) {
  432:     collector.addError(
  433:       field,
  434:       "Enter a phone number containing at least seven digits.",
  435:       "invalid_phone",
  436:     );
  437:   }
  438: 
  439:   if (digits.length > 20) {
  440:     collector.addError(
  441:       field,
  442:       "The phone number contains too many digits.",
  443:       "invalid_phone",
  444:     );
  445:   }
  446: 
  447:   if (!/^[\d\s()+\-./]+$/.test(value)) {
  448:     collector.addError(
  449:       field,
  450:       "The phone number contains unsupported characters.",
  451:       "invalid_phone",
  452:     );
  453:   }
  454: }
  455: 
  456: /*
  457:  * =========================================
  458:  * URL Validation
  459:  * =========================================
  460:  */
  461: 
  462: function validateExternalUrl(collector, field, value, label) {
  463:   let parsedUrl;
  464: 
  465:   try {
  466:     parsedUrl = new URL(normalizeProfileExternalUrl(value));
  467:   } catch {
  468:     collector.addError(
  469:       field,
  470:       `Enter a valid ${label.toLowerCase()} URL.`,
  471:       "invalid_url",
  472:     );
  473: 
  474:     return;
  475:   }
  476: 
  477:   if (parsedUrl.protocol !== "http:" && parsedUrl.protocol !== "https:") {
  478:     collector.addError(
  479:       field,
  480:       `${label} must use HTTP or HTTPS.`,
  481:       "invalid_protocol",
  482:     );
  483:   }
  484: 
  485:   if (!parsedUrl.hostname) {
  486:     collector.addError(
  487:       field,
  488:       `Enter a valid ${label.toLowerCase()} domain.`,
  489:       "invalid_url",
  490:     );
  491:   }
  492: }
  493: 
  494: /*
  495:  * =========================================
  496:  * Contact Collections
  497:  * =========================================
  498:  */
  499: 
  500: function getContactComparisonValue(category, value) {
  501:   if (category === "phones") {
  502:     return normalizePhoneForComparison(value);
  503:   }
  504: 
  505:   if (category === "websites" || category === "socialLinks") {
  506:     return normalizeUrlForComparison(value);
  507:   }
  508: 
  509:   return normalizeComparisonValue(value);
  510: }
  511: 
  512: function validateContactCollection(collector, profile, category) {
  513:   const config = CONTACT_INFORMATION_CONFIG[category];
  514: 
  515:   const items = getArray(profile[category]);
  516: 
  517:   const seenValues = new Map();
  518: 
  519:   items.forEach((itemValue, index) => {
  520:     const item = getObject(itemValue);
  521: 
  522:     const fieldPrefix = `${category}.${index}`;
  523: 
  524:     const value = getText(item.value);
  525: 
  526:     if (!value) {
  527:       collector.addError(
  528:         `${fieldPrefix}.value`,
  529:         `Enter a ${config.singular.toLowerCase()}.`,
  530:         "required",
  531:       );
  532: 
  533:       return;
  534:     }
  535: 
  536:     validateTextLength(
  537:       collector,
  538:       `${fieldPrefix}.value`,
  539:       item.value,
  540:       config.maximumValueLength,
  541:       config.singular,
  542:     );
  543: 
  544:     validateTextLength(
  545:       collector,
  546:       `${fieldPrefix}.description`,
  547:       item.description,
  548:       PROFILE_FIELD_LIMITS.description,
  549:       `${config.singular} description`,
  550:     );
  551: 
  552:     if (!isValidContactType(category, item.type)) {
  553:       collector.addError(
  554:         `${fieldPrefix}.type`,
  555:         `Select a valid ${config.singular.toLowerCase()} type.`,
  556:         "invalid_option",
  557:       );
  558:     }
  559: 
  560:     if (item.status && !isValidProfileItemStatus(item.status)) {
  561:       collector.addError(
  562:         `${fieldPrefix}.status`,
  563:         `Select a valid ${config.singular.toLowerCase()} status.`,
  564:         "invalid_option",
  565:       );
  566:     }
  567: 
  568:     if (category === "emails") {
  569:       validateEmailValue(collector, `${fieldPrefix}.value`, value);
  570:     }
  571: 
  572:     if (category === "phones") {
  573:       validatePhoneValue(collector, `${fieldPrefix}.value`, value);
  574:     }
  575: 
  576:     if (category === "websites") {
  577:       validateExternalUrl(collector, `${fieldPrefix}.value`, value, "Website");
  578:     }
  579: 
  580:     if (category === "socialLinks") {
  581:       validateExternalUrl(
  582:         collector,
  583:         `${fieldPrefix}.value`,
  584:         value,
  585:         "Social profile",
  586:       );
  587:     }
  588: 
  589:     const comparisonValue = getContactComparisonValue(category, value);
  590: 
  591:     if (seenValues.has(comparisonValue)) {
  592:       collector.addConflict(
  593:         `${fieldPrefix}.value`,
  594:         `This ${config.singular.toLowerCase()} has already been added.`,
  595:         items[seenValues.get(comparisonValue)],
  596:         `duplicate_${category}`,
  597:       );
  598: 
  599:       return;
  600:     }
  601: 
  602:     seenValues.set(comparisonValue, index);
  603:   });
  604: 
  605:   validateCollectionIds(collector, items, category);
  606: }
  607: 
  608: /*
  609:  * =========================================
  610:  * Picture Helpers
  611:  * =========================================
  612:  */
  613: 
  614: function isRemoteImageUrl(value) {
  615:   try {
  616:     const parsedUrl = new URL(value);
  617: 
  618:     return parsedUrl.protocol === "http:" || parsedUrl.protocol === "https:";
  619:   } catch {
  620:     return false;
  621:   }
  622: }
  623: 
  624: function validatePictureDimension(collector, field, value, label) {
  625:   if (value === "" || value === null || value === undefined) {
  626:     return;
  627:   }
  628: 
  629:   const numericValue = Number(value);
  630: 
  631:   if (
  632:     !Number.isFinite(numericValue) ||
  633:     numericValue <= 0 ||
  634:     !Number.isInteger(numericValue)
  635:   ) {
  636:     collector.addError(
  637:       field,
  638:       `${label} must be a positive whole number.`,
  639:       "invalid_dimension",
  640:     );
  641:   }
  642: }
  643: 
  644: /*
  645:  * =========================================
  646:  * Picture Validation
  647:  * =========================================
  648:  */
  649: 
  650: function validateProfilePictures(collector, profile) {
  651:   const pictures = getArray(profile.profilePictures);
  652: 
  653:   pictures.forEach((pictureValue, index) => {
  654:     const picture = getObject(pictureValue);
  655: 
  656:     const fieldPrefix = `profilePictures.${index}`;
  657: 
  658:     const imageUrl = getText(
  659:       picture.imageUrl || picture.fileUrl || picture.url,
  660:     );
  661: 
  662:     const useDefaultAvatar = picture.useDefaultAvatar === true;
  663: 
  664:     /*
  665:      * =========================================
  666:      * Default Avatar Type
  667:      * =========================================
  668:      */
  669: 
  670:     if (
  671:       picture.useDefaultAvatar !== undefined &&
  672:       typeof picture.useDefaultAvatar !== "boolean"
  673:     ) {
  674:       collector.addError(
  675:         `${fieldPrefix}.useDefaultAvatar`,
  676:         "Default-avatar selection must be true or false.",
  677:         "invalid_boolean",
  678:       );
  679:     }
  680: 
  681:     /*
  682:      * A saved picture must use one source:
  683:      *
  684:      * 1. An uploaded/remote image.
  685:      * 2. The generated default avatar.
  686:      */
  687: 
  688:     if (!imageUrl && !useDefaultAvatar) {
  689:       collector.addError(
  690:         `${fieldPrefix}.imageUrl`,
  691:         "Select a picture or choose the default avatar.",
  692:         "picture_required",
  693:       );
  694:     }
  695: 
  696:     /*
  697:      * An image and default avatar cannot both be active.
  698:      */
  699: 
  700:     if (imageUrl && useDefaultAvatar) {
  701:       collector.addError(
  702:         `${fieldPrefix}.useDefaultAvatar`,
  703:         "A picture cannot use an uploaded image and the default avatar at the same time.",
  704:         "conflicting_picture_source",
  705:       );
  706:     }
  707: 
  708:     /*
  709:      * =========================================
  710:      * Uploaded Image Validation
  711:      * =========================================
  712:      *
  713:      * File URL and metadata validation must only run
  714:      * when an actual image is present.
  715:      */
  716: 
  717:     if (imageUrl) {
  718:       if (!isRemoteImageUrl(imageUrl)) {
  719:         collector.addError(
  720:           `${fieldPrefix}.imageUrl`,
  721:           "The picture must contain a valid image URL.",
  722:           "invalid_image_url",
  723:         );
  724:       }
  725: 
  726:       validateTextLength(
  727:         collector,
  728:         `${fieldPrefix}.imageUrl`,
  729:         imageUrl,
  730:         PROFILE_FIELD_LIMITS.imageUrl,
  731:         "Image URL",
  732:       );
  733: 
  734:       validateTextLength(
  735:         collector,
  736:         `${fieldPrefix}.storageKey`,
  737:         picture.storageKey,
  738:         PROFILE_FIELD_LIMITS.storageKey,
  739:         "Picture storage key",
  740:       );
  741: 
  742:       validateTextLength(
  743:         collector,
  744:         `${fieldPrefix}.fileName`,
  745:         picture.fileName,
  746:         PROFILE_FIELD_LIMITS.fileName,
  747:         "Picture filename",
  748:       );
  749: 
  750:       validateTextLength(
  751:         collector,
  752:         `${fieldPrefix}.fileType`,
  753:         picture.fileType,
  754:         PROFILE_FIELD_LIMITS.fileType,
  755:         "Picture file type",
  756:       );
  757: 
  758:       const fileType = getText(picture.fileType);
  759: 
  760:       if (
  761:         fileType &&
  762:         !PROFILE_PICTURE_UPLOAD_CONFIG.allowedFileTypes.includes(fileType)
  763:       ) {
  764:         collector.addError(
  765:           `${fieldPrefix}.fileType`,
  766:           "Upload a GIF, JPG, JPEG, PNG, WEBP, or AVIF image.",
  767:           "invalid_file_type",
  768:         );
  769:       }
  770: 
  771:       const fileSize = picture.fileSize;
  772: 
  773:       if (fileSize !== "" && fileSize !== null && fileSize !== undefined) {
  774:         const numericFileSize = Number(fileSize);
  775: 
  776:         if (!Number.isFinite(numericFileSize) || numericFileSize < 0) {
  777:           collector.addError(
  778:             `${fieldPrefix}.fileSize`,
  779:             "The picture file size is invalid.",
  780:             "invalid_file_size",
  781:           );
  782:         } else {
  783:           const maximumFileSize =
  784:             Number(PROFILE_PICTURE_UPLOAD_CONFIG.maxFileSize) || 0;
  785: 
  786:           if (maximumFileSize > 0 && numericFileSize > maximumFileSize) {
  787:             collector.addError(
  788:               `${fieldPrefix}.fileSize`,
  789:               `Pictures must be ${Math.round(
  790:                 maximumFileSize / 1024 / 1024,
  791:               )} MB or smaller.`,
  792:               "file_too_large",
  793:             );
  794:           }
  795:         }
  796:       }
  797: 
  798:       validatePictureDimension(
  799:         collector,
  800:         `${fieldPrefix}.width`,
  801:         picture.width,
  802:         "Picture width",
  803:       );
  804: 
  805:       validatePictureDimension(
  806:         collector,
  807:         `${fieldPrefix}.height`,
  808:         picture.height,
  809:         "Picture height",
  810:       );
  811:     }
  812: 
  813:     /*
  814:      * =========================================
  815:      * Default Avatar Metadata
  816:      * =========================================
  817:      *
  818:      * A normalized default avatar should not retain
  819:      * uploaded-file metadata.
  820:      */
  821: 
  822:     if (useDefaultAvatar) {
  823:       const hasUploadedFileMetadata = Boolean(
  824:         getText(picture.storageKey) ||
  825:         getText(picture.fileName) ||
  826:         getText(picture.fileType) ||
  827:         Number(picture.fileSize) > 0 ||
  828:         (picture.width !== null &&
  829:           picture.width !== undefined &&
  830:           picture.width !== "") ||
  831:         (picture.height !== null &&
  832:           picture.height !== undefined &&
  833:           picture.height !== ""),
  834:       );
  835: 
  836:       if (hasUploadedFileMetadata) {
  837:         collector.addError(
  838:           `${fieldPrefix}.useDefaultAvatar`,
  839:           "Remove uploaded-file metadata before using the default avatar.",
  840:           "default_avatar_has_file_metadata",
  841:         );
  842:       }
  843:     }
  844: 
  845:     /*
  846:      * =========================================
  847:      * Shared Picture Information
  848:      * =========================================
  849:      */
  850: 
  851:     validateTextLength(
  852:       collector,
  853:       `${fieldPrefix}.description`,
  854:       picture.description,
  855:       PROFILE_FIELD_LIMITS.description,
  856:       "Picture description",
  857:     );
  858: 
  859:     if (picture.status && !isValidProfileItemStatus(picture.status)) {
  860:       collector.addError(
  861:         `${fieldPrefix}.status`,
  862:         "Select a valid picture status.",
  863:         "invalid_option",
  864:       );
  865:     }
  866: 
  867:     if (!getText(picture.description)) {
  868:       collector.addWarning(
  869:         `${fieldPrefix}.description`,
  870:         useDefaultAvatar
  871:           ? "Consider adding a description for the default avatar."
  872:           : "Add a picture description for accessibility.",
  873:         "missing_alt_description",
  874:       );
  875:     }
  876:   });
  877: 
  878:   validateCollectionIds(collector, pictures, "profilePictures");
  879: }
  880: 
  881: /*
  882:  * =========================================
  883:  * Primary Preferences
  884:  * =========================================
  885:  */
  886: 
  887: const PRIMARY_PREFERENCE_CONFIG = [
  888:   {
  889:     preference: "primaryProfessionalTitleId",
  890:     collection: "professionalTitles",
  891:     label: "professional title",
  892:   },
  893:   {
  894:     preference: "primaryEmailId",
  895:     collection: "emails",
  896:     label: "email",
  897:   },
  898:   {
  899:     preference: "primaryPhoneId",
  900:     collection: "phones",
  901:     label: "phone",
  902:   },
  903:   {
  904:     preference: "primaryWebsiteId",
  905:     collection: "websites",
  906:     label: "website",
  907:   },
  908:   {
  909:     preference: "primaryLocationId",
  910:     collection: "locations",
  911:     label: "location",
  912:   },
  913:   {
  914:     preference: "primarySocialLinkId",
  915:     collection: "socialLinks",
  916:     label: "social link",
  917:   },
  918:   {
  919:     preference: "primaryProfilePictureId",
  920:     collection: "profilePictures",
  921:     label: "profile picture",
  922:   },
  923: ];
  924: 
  925: function validatePrimaryPreferences(collector, profile) {
  926:   const preferences = getObject(profile.preferences);
  927: 
  928:   PRIMARY_PREFERENCE_CONFIG.forEach(({ preference, collection, label }) => {
  929:     const collectionItems = getArray(profile[collection]);
  930: 
  931:     const activeItems = collectionItems.filter(
  932:       (item) => item?.status !== "archived",
  933:     );
  934: 
  935:     const primaryId = getText(preferences[preference]);
  936: 
  937:     if (!primaryId) {
  938:       if (activeItems.length > 0) {
  939:         collector.addWarning(
  940:           `preferences.${preference}`,
  941:           `No primary ${label} is selected. The first active item will be used.`,
  942:           "missing_primary_item",
  943:         );
  944:       }
  945: 
  946:       return;
  947:     }
  948: 
  949:     const matchingItem = collectionItems.find((item) => item?.id === primaryId);
  950: 
  951:     if (!matchingItem) {
  952:       collector.addError(
  953:         `preferences.${preference}`,
  954:         `The selected primary ${label} does not exist.`,
  955:         "invalid_primary_id",
  956:       );
  957: 
  958:       return;
  959:     }
  960: 
  961:     if (matchingItem.status === "archived") {
  962:       collector.addError(
  963:         `preferences.${preference}`,
  964:         `An archived ${label} cannot be the primary item.`,
  965:         "archived_primary_item",
  966:       );
  967:     }
  968:   });
  969: }
  970: 
  971: /*
  972:  * =========================================
  973:  * Profile Configuration
  974:  * =========================================
  975:  */
  976: 
  977: function validateProfileConfiguration(collector, profile) {
  978:   if (profile.status && !isValidProfileStatus(profile.status)) {
  979:     collector.addError(
  980:       "status",
  981:       "Select a valid profile status.",
  982:       "invalid_option",
  983:     );
  984:   }
  985: 
  986:   if (
  987:     profile.visibility !== undefined &&
  988:     (!profile.visibility ||
  989:       typeof profile.visibility !== "object" ||
  990:       Array.isArray(profile.visibility))
  991:   ) {
  992:     collector.addError(
  993:       "visibility",
  994:       "Profile visibility has an invalid format.",
  995:       "invalid_object",
  996:     );
  997:   }
  998: 
  999:   if (
 1000:     profile.visibility?.isPublic !== undefined &&
 1001:     typeof profile.visibility.isPublic !== "boolean"
 1002:   ) {
 1003:     collector.addError(
 1004:       "visibility.isPublic",
 1005:       "Profile visibility must be true or false.",
 1006:       "invalid_boolean",
 1007:     );
 1008:   }
 1009: }
 1010: 
 1011: /*
 1012:  * =========================================
 1013:  * Meaningful Information
 1014:  * =========================================
 1015:  */
 1016: 
 1017: function validateMeaningfulInformation(collector, profile) {
 1018:   const fullName = getProfileFullName(profile);
 1019: 
 1020:   if (!fullName) {
 1021:     collector.addError(
 1022:       "firstName",
 1023:       "Enter your name before saving the profile.",
 1024:       "missing_identity",
 1025:     );
 1026:   }
 1027: 
 1028:   const hasProfessionalTitle = getArray(profile.professionalTitles).some(
 1029:     (title) => getText(title?.name),
 1030:   );
 1031: 
 1032:   const hasContactInformation = [
 1033:     "emails",
 1034:     "phones",
 1035:     "websites",
 1036:     "locations",
 1037:     "socialLinks",
 1038:   ].some((category) =>
 1039:     getArray(profile[category]).some((item) => getText(item?.value)),
 1040:   );
 1041: 
 1042:   if (!hasProfessionalTitle) {
 1043:     collector.addWarning(
 1044:       "professionalTitles",
 1045:       "Consider adding a professional title for rÃ©sumÃ©s and portfolios.",
 1046:       "missing_professional_title",
 1047:     );
 1048:   }
 1049: 
 1050:   if (!hasContactInformation) {
 1051:     collector.addWarning(
 1052:       "emails",
 1053:       "Consider adding at least one contact method.",
 1054:       "missing_contact_information",
 1055:     );
 1056:   }
 1057: }

 1059: /*
 1060:  * =========================================
 1061:  * Field Error Map
 1062:  * =========================================
 1063:  */
 1064: 
 1065: export function createProfileFieldErrorMap(errors = []) {
 1066:   return errors.reduce((fieldErrors, error) => {
 1067:     if (!fieldErrors[error.field]) {
 1068:       fieldErrors[error.field] = error.message;
 1069:     }
 1070: 
 1071:     return fieldErrors;
 1072:   }, {});
 1073: }
 1074: 
 1075: /*
 1076:  * =========================================
 1077:  * Main Validation
 1078:  * =========================================
 1079:  */
 1080: 
 1081: export function validateProfile(profileValue) {
 1082:   const profile = getObject(profileValue);
 1083: 
 1084:   const collector = createValidationCollector();
 1085: 
 1086:   validateIdentity(collector, profile);
 1087: 
 1088:   validateCollectionLimits(collector, profile);
 1089: 
 1090:   validateProfessionalTitles(collector, profile);
 1091: 
 1092:   ["emails", "phones", "websites", "locations", "socialLinks"].forEach(
 1093:     (category) => {
 1094:       validateContactCollection(collector, profile, category);
 1095:     },
 1096:   );
 1097: 
 1098:   validateProfilePictures(collector, profile);
 1099: 
 1100:   validatePrimaryPreferences(collector, profile);
 1101: 
 1102:   validateProfileConfiguration(collector, profile);
 1103: 
 1104:   validateMeaningfulInformation(collector, profile);
 1105: 
 1106:   return {
 1107:     isValid: collector.errors.length === 0,
 1108: 
 1109:     errors: collector.errors,
 1110:     warnings: collector.warnings,
 1111:     conflicts: collector.conflicts,
 1112: 
 1113:     fieldErrors: createProfileFieldErrorMap(collector.errors),
 1114:   };
 1115: }
 1116: 
 1117: /*
 1118:  * =========================================
 1119:  * Assert Valid Profile
 1120:  * =========================================
 1121:  */
 1122: 
 1123: export function assertValidProfile(profile) {
 1124:   const validationResult = validateProfile(profile);
 1125: 
 1126:   if (validationResult.isValid) {
 1127:     return validationResult;
 1128:   }
 1129: 
 1130:   const error = new Error(
 1131:     "The profile contains invalid or incomplete information.",
 1132:   );
 1133: 
 1134:   error.name = "ProfileValidationError";
 1135:   error.code = "PROFILE_VALIDATION_FAILED";
 1136:   error.status = 400;
 1137: 
 1138:   error.publicMessage =
 1139:     "Correct the highlighted Profile information before saving.";
 1140: 
 1141:   error.validation = validationResult;
 1142:   error.errors = validationResult.errors;
 1143:   error.warnings = validationResult.warnings;
 1144:   error.conflicts = validationResult.conflicts;
 1145:   error.fieldErrors = validationResult.fieldErrors;
 1146: 
 1147:   throw error;
 1148: }

 1154:  */

 1158:

 1160:     return `${result.errors.length} ${
 1161:       result.errors.length === 1 ? "problem must" : "problems must"
 1162:     } be corrected before saving.`;
 1163:   }
 1164:

 1168:     } for improvement.`;
 1169:   }

   14: export function isBackendProjectAsset(asset) {
   15:   return ["backend", "azure-sql"].includes(
   16:     String(asset?.storageProvider || "").trim().toLowerCase(),
   17:   );
   18: }
   19: 
   20: export async function resolveProjectAssetUrl({
   21:   projectId,
   22:   asset,
   23:   kind,
   24:   signal,
   25: }) {
   26:   if (!asset) return "";
   27: 
   28:   if (isBackendProjectAsset(asset)) {
   29:     if (!projectId || !asset.backendAssetId) {
   30:       throw new Error("Project and asset IDs are required for backend files.");
   31:     }
   32: 
   33:     if (kind === "media") {
   34:       return createProjectMediaObjectUrl(projectId, asset.backendAssetId, { signal });
   35:     }
   36: 
   37:     if (kind === "document") {
   38:       return createProjectDocumentObjectUrl(projectId, asset.backendAssetId, { signal });
   39:     }
   40: 
   41:     throw new Error("Unsupported Project asset kind.");
   42:   }
   43: 
   44:   if (asset.storageKey) {
   45:     return createProjectAssetUrl(asset.storageKey);
   46:   }
   47: 
   48:   return asset.externalUrl || "";
   49: }

   52:   if (typeof url === "string" && url.startsWith("blob:")) {
   53:     revokeProjectAssetUrl(url);
   54:   }

   89: function getIndexedDb() {
   90:   if (typeof window === "undefined" || !window.indexedDB) {
   91:     throw createProjectAssetStorageError({
   92:       code: "PROJECT_ASSET_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE",
   93: 
   94:       message: "IndexedDB is unavailable.",
   95:

  104: /*

  106:  * Promise Helpers

  109: 
  110: function requestToPromise(request) {
  111:   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  112:     request.onsuccess = () => {
  113:       resolve(request.result);
  114:     };
  115: 
  116:     request.onerror = () => {
  117:       reject(request.error);
  118:     };
  119:   });
  120: }
  121: 
  122: function transactionToPromise(transaction) {
  123:   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  124:     transaction.oncomplete = () => {
  125:       resolve();
  126:     };
  127: 
  128:     transaction.onerror = () => {
  129:       reject(transaction.error);
  130:     };
  131: 
  132:     transaction.onabort = () => {
  133:       reject(
  134:         transaction.error ||
  135:           new Error("The IndexedDB transaction was aborted."),
  136:       );
  137:     };
  138:   });
  139: }

  141: /*
  142:  * =========================================
  143:  * Open Database
  144:  * =========================================
  145:  */
  146: 
  147: function openProjectAssetDatabase() {
  148:   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  149:     const request = getIndexedDb().open(
  150:       PROJECT_ASSET_DATABASE_NAME,
  151:       PROJECT_ASSET_DATABASE_VERSION,
  152:     );
  153: 
  154:     request.onupgradeneeded = () => {
  155:       const database = request.result;
  156: 
  157:       let store;
  158: 
  159:       if (!database.objectStoreNames.contains(PROJECT_ASSET_STORE_NAME)) {
  160:         store = database.createObjectStore(PROJECT_ASSET_STORE_NAME, {
  161:           keyPath: "storageKey",
  162:         });
  163:       } else {
  164:         store = request.transaction.objectStore(PROJECT_ASSET_STORE_NAME);
  165:       }
  166: 
  167:       if (!store.indexNames.contains(PROJECT_ID_INDEX_NAME)) {
  168:         store.createIndex(PROJECT_ID_INDEX_NAME, "projectId", {
  169:           unique: false,
  170:         });
  171:       }
  172: 
  173:       if (!store.indexNames.contains(ASSET_KIND_INDEX_NAME)) {
  174:         store.createIndex(ASSET_KIND_INDEX_NAME, "kind", {
  175:           unique: false,
  176:         });
  177:       }
  178:     };
  179: 
  180:     request.onsuccess = () => {
  181:       const database = request.result;
  182: 
  183:       /*
  184:        * A tab holding an old database connection
  185:        * must close it when another tab upgrades
  186:        * the database.
  187:        */
  188: 
  189:       database.onversionchange = () => {
  190:         database.close();
  191:       };
  192: 
  193:       resolve(database);
  194:     };
  195: 
  196:     request.onerror = () => {
  197:       reject(
  198:         createProjectAssetStorageError({
  199:           code: "PROJECT_ASSET_DATABASE_OPEN_FAILED",
  200: 
  201:           message: "Unable to open Project asset storage.",
  202: 
  203:           publicMessage: "Project file storage could not be opened.",
  204: 
  205:           cause: request.error,
  206:         }),
  207:       );
  208:     };
  209: 
  210:     request.onblocked = () => {
  211:       reject(
  212:         createProjectAssetStorageError({
  213:           code: "PROJECT_ASSET_DATABASE_BLOCKED",
  214: 
  215:           message: "The Project asset database operation was blocked.",
  216: 
  217:           publicMessage: "Close other tabs using this portfolio and try again.",
  218:         }),
  219:       );
  220:     };
  221:   });
  222: }

  240: function validateProjectAssetFile(file, kind) {

  242:     throw createProjectAssetStorageError({
  243:       code: "PROJECT_ASSET_FILE_REQUIRED",
  244: 
  245:       message: "A valid File or Blob-like object is required.",
  246: 
  247:       publicMessage: "Select a valid Project file before uploading.",
  248:     });
  249:   }
  250: 
  251:   const isSupported =
  252:     kind === "media"
  253:       ? isSupportedProjectMedia(file)
  254:       : isSupportedProjectDocument(file);
  255: 
  256:   if (!isSupported) {
  257:     throw createProjectAssetStorageError({
  258:       code: "PROJECT_ASSET_FILE_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED",
  259: 
  260:       message: "The selected Project asset type is unsupported.",
  261: 
  262:       publicMessage:
  263:         kind === "media"
  264:           ? "Upload a supported JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4, or WebM file."
  265:           : "Upload a supported Project document type.",
  266:     });
  267:   }
  268: 
  269:   const isWithinSizeLimit =
  270:     kind === "media"
  271:       ? isProjectMediaWithinSizeLimit(file)
  272:       : isProjectDocumentWithinSizeLimit(file);
  273: 
  274:   if (!isWithinSizeLimit) {
  275:     throw createProjectAssetStorageError({
  276:       code: "PROJECT_ASSET_FILE_SIZE_INVALID",
  277: 
  278:       message: "The selected Project asset exceeds its size limit or is empty.",
  279: 
  280:       publicMessage:
  281:         kind === "media"
  282:           ? "The selected image or video is empty or exceeds the permitted size."
  283:           : "The selected document is empty or exceeds the permitted size.",
  284:     });
  285:   }
  286: }

  320: /*
  321:  * =========================================
  322:  * Write Asset
  323:  * =========================================
  324:  */
  325: 
  326: export async function writeProjectAsset({
  327:   file,
  328:   projectId,
  329:   assetId = "",
  330:   storageKey = "",
  331:   kind = "media",
  332: } = {}) {
  333:   const normalizedKind = normalizeAssetKind(kind);
  334: 
  335:   const normalizedProjectId = getText(projectId);
  336: 
  337:   if (!normalizedProjectId) {
  338:     throw createProjectAssetStorageError({
  339:       code: "PROJECT_ASSET_PROJECT_ID_REQUIRED",
  340: 
  341:       message: "A Project identifier is required before storing an asset.",
  342: 
  343:       publicMessage:
  344:         "The Project file cannot be saved because the Project could not be identified.",
  345:     });
  346:   }
  347: 
  348:   validateProjectAssetFile(file, normalizedKind);
  349: 
  350:   const resolvedAssetId = getText(assetId) || createProjectId("project-asset");
  351: 
  352:   const resolvedStorageKey =
  353:     getText(storageKey) ||
  354:     `project:${normalizedProjectId}:${normalizedKind}:${resolvedAssetId}`;
  355: 
  356:   const database = await openProjectAssetDatabase();
  357: 
  358:   const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
  359: 
  360:   try {
  361:     const transaction = database.transaction(
  362:       PROJECT_ASSET_STORE_NAME,
  363:       "readwrite",
  364:     );
  365: 
  366:     const store = transaction.objectStore(PROJECT_ASSET_STORE_NAME);
  367: 
  368:     /*
  369:      * The read and write are handled within the
  370:      * same request callback so the transaction
  371:      * cannot become inactive between operations.
  372:      */
  373: 
  374:     const existingRequest = store.get(resolvedStorageKey);
  375: 
  376:     const preparedRecordPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  377:       existingRequest.onerror = () => {
  378:         reject(existingRequest.error);
  379:       };
  380: 
  381:       existingRequest.onsuccess = () => {
  382:         const existingRecord = existingRequest.result;
  383: 
  384:         /*
  385:          * Never allow a storage key belonging
  386:          * to another Project to be overwritten.
  387:          */
  388: 
  389:         if (
  390:           existingRecord &&
  391:           existingRecord.projectId !== normalizedProjectId
  392:         ) {
  393:           transaction.abort();
  394: 
  395:           reject(
  396:             createProjectAssetStorageError({
  397:               code: "PROJECT_ASSET_STORAGE_KEY_CONFLICT",
  398: 
  399:               message:
  400:                 "The requested asset storage key belongs to another Project.",
  401: 
  402:               publicMessage:
  403:                 "The Project file could not be saved because its storage identifier conflicts with another file.",
  404:             }),
  405:           );
  406: 
  407:           return;
  408:         }
  409: 
  410:         const blob = file.slice(
  411:           0,
  412:           file.size,
  413:           file.type || "application/octet-stream",
  414:         );
  415: 
  416:         const record = {
  417:           storageKey: resolvedStorageKey,
  418: 
  419:           projectId: normalizedProjectId,
  420: 
  421:           assetId: resolvedAssetId,
  422: 
  423:           kind: normalizedKind,
  424: 
  425:           fileName: getText(file.name),
  426: 
  427:           mimeType: getText(file.type) || "application/octet-stream",
  428: 
  429:           fileSize: Number(file.size) || 0,
  430: 
  431:           blob,
  432: 
  433:           createdAt: existingRecord?.createdAt || timestamp,
  434: 
  435:           updatedAt: timestamp,
  436:         };
  437: 
  438:         const putRequest = store.put(record);
  439: 
  440:         putRequest.onerror = () => {
  441:           reject(putRequest.error);
  442:         };
  443: 
  444:         putRequest.onsuccess = () => {
  445:           resolve(record);
  446:         };
  447:       };
  448:     });
  449: 
  450:     const [record] = await Promise.all([
  451:       preparedRecordPromise,
  452:       transactionToPromise(transaction),
  453:     ]);
  454: 
  455:     return createAssetMetadata(record);
  456:   } catch (error) {
  457:     if (error?.name === "ProjectAssetStorageError") {
  458:       throw error;
  459:     }
  460: 
  461:     const quotaExceeded = isStorageQuotaError(error);
  462: 
  463:     throw createProjectAssetStorageError({
  464:       code: quotaExceeded
  465:         ? "PROJECT_ASSET_QUOTA_EXCEEDED"
  466:         : "PROJECT_ASSET_WRITE_FAILED",
  467: 
  468:       message: quotaExceeded
  469:         ? "IndexedDB storage quota was exceeded."
  470:         : "Unable to save a Project asset.",
  471: 
  472:       publicMessage: quotaExceeded
  473:         ? "The browser does not have enough storage space for this Project file. Remove unused files or choose a smaller file."
  474:         : "The selected Project file could not be saved.",
  475: 
  476:       cause: error,
  477:     });
  478:   } finally {
  479:     database.close();
  480:   }
  481: }
  482: 
  483: /*
  484:  * =========================================
  485:  * Read Asset
  486:  * =========================================
  487:  */
  488: 
  489: export async function readProjectAsset(storageKey) {
  490:   const normalizedStorageKey = getText(storageKey);
  491: 
  492:   if (!normalizedStorageKey) {
  493:     return null;
  494:   }
  495: 
  496:   const database = await openProjectAssetDatabase();
  497: 
  498:   try {
  499:     const transaction = database.transaction(
  500:       PROJECT_ASSET_STORE_NAME,
  501:       "readonly",
  502:     );
  503: 
  504:     const store = transaction.objectStore(PROJECT_ASSET_STORE_NAME);
  505: 
  506:     const record = await requestToPromise(store.get(normalizedStorageKey));
  507: 
  508:     await transactionToPromise(transaction);
  509: 
  510:     return record || null;
  511:   } catch (error) {
  512:     throw createProjectAssetStorageError({
  513:       code: "PROJECT_ASSET_READ_FAILED",
  514: 
  515:       message: "Unable to read a Project asset.",
  516: 
  517:       publicMessage: "The Project file could not be loaded.",
  518: 
  519:       cause: error,
  520:     });
  521:   } finally {
  522:     database.close();
  523:   }
  524: }
  525: 
  526: /*
  527:  * =========================================
  528:  * Asset Existence
  529:  * =========================================
  530:  */
  531: 
  532: export async function hasProjectAsset(storageKey) {
  533:   const record = await readProjectAsset(storageKey);
  534: 
  535:   return Boolean(record?.blob);
  536: }
  537: 
  538: /*
  539:  * =========================================
  540:  * Create Object URL
  541:  * =========================================
  542:  */
  543: 
  544: export async function createProjectAssetUrl(storageKey) {
  545:   const normalizedStorageKey = getText(storageKey);
  546: 
  547:   if (!normalizedStorageKey) {
  548:     throw createProjectAssetStorageError({
  549:       code: "PROJECT_ASSET_STORAGE_KEY_REQUIRED",
  550: 
  551:       message: "An asset storage key is required.",
  552: 
  553:       publicMessage: "The Project file could not be identified.",
  554:     });
  555:   }
  556: 
  557:   const record = await readProjectAsset(normalizedStorageKey);
  558: 
  559:   if (!record?.blob) {
  560:     throw createProjectAssetStorageError({
  561:       code: "PROJECT_ASSET_NOT_FOUND",
  562: 
  563:       message: `Project asset not found: ${normalizedStorageKey}`,
  564: 
  565:       publicMessage:
  566:         "The Project file is no longer available in browser storage.",
  567:     });
  568:   }
  569: 
  570:   if (typeof URL === "undefined" || typeof URL.createObjectURL !== "function") {
  571:     throw createProjectAssetStorageError({
  572:       code: "PROJECT_ASSET_URL_UNAVAILABLE",
  573: 
  574:       message: "Object URLs are unavailable.",
  575: 
  576:       publicMessage:
  577:         "The Project file cannot be previewed in this environment.",
  578:     });
  579:   }
  580: 
  581:   return URL.createObjectURL(record.blob);
  582: }

  601: /*
  602:  * =========================================
  603:  * List Project Asset Metadata
  604:  * =========================================
  605:  *
  606:  * Blob data is removed from the returned
  607:  * records to avoid unnecessarily retaining
  608:  * large file data in application state.
  609:  */
  610: 
  611: export async function listProjectAssets(projectId, { kind = "all" } = {}) {
  612:   const normalizedProjectId = getText(projectId);
  613: 
  614:   if (!normalizedProjectId) {
  615:     return [];
  616:   }
  617: 
  618:   const normalizedKind = kind === "media" || kind === "document" ? kind : "all";
  619: 
  620:   const database = await openProjectAssetDatabase();
  621: 
  622:   try {
  623:     const transaction = database.transaction(
  624:       PROJECT_ASSET_STORE_NAME,
  625:       "readonly",
  626:     );
  627: 
  628:     const store = transaction.objectStore(PROJECT_ASSET_STORE_NAME);
  629: 
  630:     const index = store.index(PROJECT_ID_INDEX_NAME);
  631: 
  632:     const records = await requestToPromise(index.getAll(normalizedProjectId));
  633: 
  634:     await transactionToPromise(transaction);
  635: 
  636:     return getArray(records)
  637:       .filter(
  638:         (record) => normalizedKind === "all" || record.kind === normalizedKind,
  639:       )
  640:       .map(createAssetMetadata);
  641:   } catch (error) {
  642:     throw createProjectAssetStorageError({
  643:       code: "PROJECT_ASSET_LIST_FAILED",
  644: 
  645:       message: "Unable to list Project assets.",
  646: 
  647:       publicMessage: "The Project file list could not be loaded.",
  648: 
  649:       cause: error,
  650:     });
  651:   } finally {
  652:     database.close();
  653:   }
  654: }
  655: 
  656: /*
  657:  * =========================================
  658:  * Delete Assets by Storage Key
  659:  * =========================================
  660:  */
  661: 
  662: export async function deleteProjectAssets(storageKeys = []) {
  663:   const normalizedStorageKeys = [
  664:     ...new Set(getArray(storageKeys).map(getText).filter(Boolean)),
  665:   ];
  666: 
  667:   if (normalizedStorageKeys.length === 0) {
  668:     return 0;
  669:   }
  670: 
  671:   const database = await openProjectAssetDatabase();
  672: 
  673:   try {
  674:     const transaction = database.transaction(
  675:       PROJECT_ASSET_STORE_NAME,
  676:       "readwrite",
  677:     );
  678: 
  679:     const store = transaction.objectStore(PROJECT_ASSET_STORE_NAME);
  680: 
  681:     normalizedStorageKeys.forEach((normalizedStorageKey) => {
  682:       store.delete(normalizedStorageKey);
  683:     });
  684: 
  685:     await transactionToPromise(transaction);
  686: 
  687:     return normalizedStorageKeys.length;
  688:   } catch (error) {
  689:     throw createProjectAssetStorageError({
  690:       code: "PROJECT_ASSET_DELETE_FAILED",
  691: 
  692:       message: "Unable to delete Project assets.",
  693: 
  694:       publicMessage: "One or more Project files could not be removed.",
  695: 
  696:       cause: error,
  697:     });
  698:   } finally {
  699:     database.close();
  700:   }
  701: }
  702: 
  703: /*
  704:  * =========================================
  705:  * Delete All Assets for Project
  706:  * =========================================
  707:  *
  708:  * A cursor is used instead of getAll(). This
  709:  * prevents every large Blob from being loaded
  710:  * into application memory before deletion.
  711:  */
  712: 
  713: export async function deleteProjectAssetsForProject(projectId) {
  714:   const normalizedProjectId = getText(projectId);
  715: 
  716:   if (!normalizedProjectId) {
  717:     return 0;
  718:   }
  719: 
  720:   const database = await openProjectAssetDatabase();
  721: 
  722:   try {
  723:     const transaction = database.transaction(
  724:       PROJECT_ASSET_STORE_NAME,
  725:       "readwrite",
  726:     );
  727: 
  728:     const store = transaction.objectStore(PROJECT_ASSET_STORE_NAME);
  729: 
  730:     const index = store.index(PROJECT_ID_INDEX_NAME);
  731: 
  732:     if (typeof IDBKeyRange === "undefined") {
  733:       throw new Error("IDBKeyRange is unavailable.");
  734:     }
  735: 
  736:     const keyRange = IDBKeyRange.only(normalizedProjectId);
  737: 
  738:     /*
  739:      * This variable is updated while the cursor
  740:      * deletes each matching Project asset.
  741:      */
  742: 
  743:     let cursorDeletedCount = 0;
  744: 
  745:     const cursorPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  746:       const cursorRequest = index.openCursor(keyRange);
  747: 
  748:       cursorRequest.onerror = () => {
  749:         reject(
  750:           cursorRequest.error || new Error("The Project asset cursor failed."),
  751:         );
  752:       };
  753: 
  754:       cursorRequest.onsuccess = () => {
  755:         const cursor = cursorRequest.result;
  756: 
  757:         /*
  758:          * No cursor means every matching asset
  759:          * has been processed.
  760:          */
  761: 
  762:         if (!cursor) {
  763:           resolve(cursorDeletedCount);
  764: 
  765:           return;
  766:         }
  767: 
  768:         const deleteRequest = cursor.delete();
  769: 
  770:         deleteRequest.onerror = () => {
  771:           reject(
  772:             deleteRequest.error ||
  773:               new Error("A Project asset could not be deleted."),
  774:           );
  775:         };
  776: 
  777:         deleteRequest.onsuccess = () => {
  778:           cursorDeletedCount += 1;
  779: 
  780:           cursor.continue();
  781:         };
  782:       };
  783:     });
  784: 
  785:     /*
  786:      * Use a different variable name for the
  787:      * resolved count to avoid redeclaration.
  788:      */
  789: 
  790:     const [completedDeletedCount] = await Promise.all([
  791:       cursorPromise,
  792:       transactionToPromise(transaction),
  793:     ]);
  794: 
  795:     return completedDeletedCount;
  796:   } catch (error) {
  797:     throw createProjectAssetStorageError({
  798:       code: "PROJECT_ASSET_PROJECT_DELETE_FAILED",
  799: 
  800:       message: "Unable to delete Project assets.",
  801: 
  802:       publicMessage: "One or more Project files could not be removed.",
  803: 
  804:       cause: error,
  805:     });
  806:   } finally {
  807:     database.close();
  808:   }
  809: }

    1: import { API_BASE_URL, ApiError } from "../apiClient.js";
    2: 
    3: export async function fetchProjectBinary(endpoint, options = {}) {
    4:   if (
    5:     typeof endpoint !== "string" ||
    6:     !endpoint.startsWith("/projects/") ||
    7:     endpoint.startsWith("//")
    8:   ) {
    9:     throw new TypeError("A valid Project asset endpoint is required.");
   10:   }
   11: 
   12:   const controller = new AbortController();
   13:   const timeoutMs = options.timeoutMs ?? 180000;
   14:   let timedOut = false;
   15: 
   16:   const onAbort = () => controller.abort();
   17: 
   18:   if (options.signal?.aborted) {
   19:     controller.abort();
   20:   } else {
   21:     options.signal?.addEventListener("abort", onAbort, { once: true });
   22:   }
   23: 
   24:   const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
   25:     timedOut = true;
   26:     controller.abort();
   27:   }, timeoutMs);
   28: 
   29:   try {
   30:     const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}${endpoint}`, {
   31:       method: "GET",
   32:       credentials: "include",
   33:       headers: { Accept: "*/*" },
   34:       cache: "no-store",
   35:       signal: controller.signal,
   36:     });
   37: 
   38:     if (!response.ok) {
   39:       let errorData = null;
   40: 
   41:       try {
   42:         errorData = await response.json();
   43:       } catch {
   44:         // Non-JSON error responses are handled below.
   45:       }
   46: 
   47:       throw new ApiError({
   48:         message:
   49:           errorData?.message ||
   50:           `Project asset request failed (HTTP ${response.status}).`,
   51:         status: response.status,
   52:         code: errorData?.code || "PROJECT_ASSET_REQUEST_FAILED",
   53:         url: `${API_BASE_URL}${endpoint}`,
   54:         method: "GET",
   55:       });
   56:     }
   57: 
   58:     return response.blob();
   59:   } catch (error) {
   60:     if (error instanceof ApiError) throw error;
   61: 
   62:     if (error?.name === "AbortError") {
   63:       throw new ApiError({
   64:         message: timedOut
   65:           ? "The Project asset download timed out."
   66:           : "The Project asset download was canceled.",
   67:         code: timedOut
   68:           ? "PROJECT_ASSET_TIMEOUT"
   69:           : "PROJECT_ASSET_ABORTED",
   70:         cause: error,
   71:       });
   72:     }
   73: 
   74:     throw new ApiError({
   75:       message: "Unable to download the Project asset.",
   76:       code: "PROJECT_ASSET_NETWORK_ERROR",
   77:       cause: error,
   78:     });
   79:   } finally {
   80:     clearTimeout(timeout);
   81:     options.signal?.removeEventListener?.("abort", onAbort);
   82:   }
   83: }
   84: 
   85: export async function createProjectBinaryObjectUrl(endpoint, options = {}) {
   86:   const blob = await fetchProjectBinary(endpoint, options);
   87: 
   88:   return URL.createObjectURL(blob);
   89: }

    1: function isEligibleFeaturedMedia(mediaItem) {
    2:   return Boolean(
    3:     mediaItem &&
    4:       mediaItem.status !== "archived" &&
    5:       mediaItem.visibility !== "private" &&
    6:       (mediaItem.storageKey || mediaItem.externalUrl),
    7:   );
    8: }
    9: 
   10: export function prepareFeaturedProjectMedia(
   11:   existingMedia = [],
   12:   uploadedMedia = [],
   13:   requestedFeaturedMediaId = "",
   14: ) {
   15:   const uploadedFeaturedMedia = uploadedMedia.find(
   16:     (item) => item.isFeatured && isEligibleFeaturedMedia(item),
   17:   );
   18: 
   19:   const previousMedia = existingMedia.map((item) => ({
   20:     ...item,
   21:     isFeatured: uploadedFeaturedMedia ? false : item.isFeatured,
   22:   }));
   23: 
   24:   const completeMedia = [...previousMedia, ...uploadedMedia];
   25: 
   26:   const featuredMedia =
   27:     uploadedFeaturedMedia ||
   28:     completeMedia.find(
   29:       (item) =>
   30:         item.id === requestedFeaturedMediaId &&
   31:         isEligibleFeaturedMedia(item),
   32:     ) ||
   33:     completeMedia.find(
   34:       (item) => item.isFeatured && isEligibleFeaturedMedia(item),
   35:     ) ||
   36:     completeMedia.find(isEligibleFeaturedMedia) ||
   37:     null;
   38: 
   39:   return {
   40:     media: completeMedia.map((item) => ({
   41:       ...item,
   42:       isFeatured: item.id === featuredMedia?.id,
   43:     })),
   44:     featuredMediaId: featuredMedia?.id || "",
   45:   };
   46: }

  109: /*
  110:  * =========================================
  111:  * Duplicate Identity
  112:  * =========================================
  113:  *
  114:  * Projects may share a title when they belong
  115:  * to different organizations or clients.
  116:  */
  117: 
  118: function createProjectIdentity(project) {
  119:   const title = getText(project?.title).normalize("NFKC").toLocaleLowerCase();
  120: 
  121:   const organization = getText(
  122:     project?.organization?.name || project?.organization?.clientName,
  123:   )
  124:     .normalize("NFKC")
  125:     .toLocaleLowerCase();
  126: 
  127:   return {
  128:     title,
  129:     organization,
  130:   };
  131: }
  132: 
  133: function ensureUniqueProject(records, candidate, excludedProjectId = "") {
  134:   const candidateIdentity = createProjectIdentity(candidate);
  135: 
  136:   if (!candidateIdentity.title) {
  137:     return;
  138:   }
  139: 
  140:   const duplicate = records.find((project) => {
  141:     if (project.id === excludedProjectId) {
  142:       return false;
  143:     }
  144: 
  145:     const existingIdentity = createProjectIdentity(project);
  146: 
  147:     /*
  148:      * When neither record identifies an
  149:      * organization, the normalized title alone
  150:      * is used to prevent accidental duplicates.
  151:      */
  152: 
  153:     return (
  154:       existingIdentity.title === candidateIdentity.title &&
  155:       existingIdentity.organization === candidateIdentity.organization
  156:     );
  157:   });
  158: 
  159:   if (!duplicate) {
  160:     return;
  161:   }
  162: 
  163:   throw createProjectServiceError(
  164:     "PROJECT_DUPLICATE",
  165:     `A matching Project already exists: ${duplicate.id}`,
  166:     candidateIdentity.organization
  167:       ? "A Project with this title and organization already exists."
  168:       : "A Project with this title already exists.",
  169:     {
  170:       project: duplicate,
  171: 
  172:       fieldErrors: {
  173:         title: "A matching Project record already exists.",
  174:       },
  175:     },
  176:   );
  177: }

  184: 
  185: async function storeProjectUploads(projectId, uploads, kind) {
  186:   const uploadCollection = getArray(uploads);
  187: 
  188:   const metadata = [];
  189: 
  190:   const createdStorageKeys = [];
  191: 
  192:   try {
  193:     for (let index = 0; index < uploadCollection.length; index += 1) {
  194:       const upload = uploadCollection[index];
  195: 
  196:       if (!(upload?.file instanceof Blob)) {
  197:         throw createProjectServiceError(
  198:           "PROJECT_UPLOAD_FILE_INVALID",
  199:           `Project ${kind} upload does not contain a valid Blob.`,
  200:           `One of the selected Project ${
  201:             kind === "media" ? "media files" : "documents"
  202:           } is invalid.`,
  203:         );
  204:       }
  205: 
  206:       const storedAsset = await writeProjectAsset({
  207:         file: upload.file,
  208: 
  209:         projectId,
  210: 
  211:         assetId: upload.assetId || upload.id,
  212: 
  213:         storageKey: upload.storageKey,
  214: 
  215:         kind,
  216:       });
  217: 
  218:       createdStorageKeys.push(storedAsset.storageKey);
  219: 
  220:       const metadataValues = {
  221:         ...upload,
  222: 
  223:         /*
  224:          * File objects must never be included
  225:          * in localStorage metadata.
  226:          */
  227: 
  228:         file: undefined,
  229: 
  230:         id: storedAsset.assetId,
  231: 
  232:         fileName: storedAsset.fileName,
  233: 
  234:         mimeType: storedAsset.mimeType,
  235: 
  236:         fileSize: storedAsset.fileSize,
  237: 
  238:         storageProvider: "indexed-db",
  239: 
  240:         storageKey: storedAsset.storageKey,
  241: 
  242:         uploadedAt: storedAsset.updatedAt,
  243:       };
  244: 
  245:       metadata.push(
  246:         kind === "media"
  247:           ? createProjectMedia(metadataValues, index)
  248:           : createProjectDocument(metadataValues, index),
  249:       );
  250:     }
  251: 
  252:     return {
  253:       metadata,
  254:       createdStorageKeys,
  255:     };
  256:   } catch (error) {
  257:     /*
  258:      * If one upload fails, remove every asset
  259:      * already created during this collection.
  260:      */
  261: 
  262:     await deleteProjectAssets(createdStorageKeys).catch(() => {});
  263: 
  264:     throw error;
  265:   }
  266: }
  267: 
  268: /*
  269:  * =========================================
  270:  * Prepare Project Assets
  271:  * =========================================
  272:  */
  273: 
  274: async function prepareProjectAssets(
  275:   project,
  276:   { mediaUploads = [], documentUploads = [] } = {},
  277: ) {
  278:   const storedMedia = await storeProjectUploads(
  279:     project.id,
  280:     mediaUploads,
  281:     "media",
  282:   );
  283: 
  284:   try {
  285:     const storedDocuments = await storeProjectUploads(
  286:       project.id,
  287:       documentUploads,
  288:       "document",
  289:     );
  290: 
  291:     /*
  292:      * A staged upload selected in the Media
  293:      * Editor must take priority. Before upload,
  294:      * its ID cannot be resolved by normalizeProject
  295:      * because it is not yet part of project.media.
  296:      */
  297: 
  298:     const featuredMediaResult = prepareFeaturedProjectMedia(
  299:       getArray(project.media),
  300:       storedMedia.metadata,
  301:       getText(project.presentation?.featuredMediaId),
  302:     );
  303:     const preparedProject = normalizeProject({
  304:       ...project,
  305: 
  306:       media: featuredMediaResult.media,
  307: 
  308:       supportingDocuments: [
  309:         ...getArray(project.supportingDocuments),
  310: 
  311:         ...storedDocuments.metadata,
  312:       ],
  313: 
  314:       presentation: {
  315:         ...project.presentation,
  316: 
  317:         featuredMediaId: featuredMediaResult.featuredMediaId,
  318:       },
  319:     });
  320: 
  321:     return {
  322:       project: preparedProject,
  323: 
  324:       createdStorageKeys: [
  325:         ...storedMedia.createdStorageKeys,
  326:         ...storedDocuments.createdStorageKeys,
  327:       ],
  328:     };
  329:   } catch (error) {
  330:     /*
  331:      * Document storage failed after media was
  332:      * saved, so the new media must be rolled
  333:      * back as well.
  334:      */
  335: 
  336:     await deleteProjectAssets(storedMedia.createdStorageKeys).catch(() => {});
  337: 
  338:     throw error;
  339:   }
  340: }
  341: 
  342: /*
  343:  * =========================================
  344:  * Safe Removed-Asset Cleanup
  345:  * =========================================
  346:  */
  347: 
  348: async function removeUnreferencedAssets(project, requestedStorageKeys) {
  349:   const referencedStorageKeys = new Set([
  350:     ...getArray(project.media)
  351:       .map((mediaItem) => getText(mediaItem.storageKey))
  352:       .filter(Boolean),
  353: 
  354:     ...getArray(project.supportingDocuments)
  355:       .map((documentRecord) => getText(documentRecord.storageKey))
  356:       .filter(Boolean),
  357:   ]);
  358: 
  359:   const removableStorageKeys = [
  360:     ...new Set(getArray(requestedStorageKeys).map(getText).filter(Boolean)),
  361:   ].filter((storageKey) => !referencedStorageKeys.has(storageKey));
  362: 
  363:   if (removableStorageKeys.length === 0) {
  364:     return 0;
  365:   }
  366: 
  367:   return deleteProjectAssets(removableStorageKeys);
  368: }
