  430: /*
  431:  * =========================================
  432:  * Create Project
  433:  * =========================================
  434:  */
  435: 
  436: export async function createProject(
  437:   projectData,
  438:   {
  439:     collections = {},
  440:     mediaUploads = [],
  441:     documentUploads = [],
  442:     removedAssetStorageKeys = [],
  443:   } = {},
  444: ) {
  445:   const records = readStoredProjects();
  446: 
  447:   let project = createProjectModel(projectData);
  448: 
  449:   ensureUniqueProject(records, project);
  450: 
  451:   const preparedAssets = await prepareProjectAssets(project, {
  452:     mediaUploads,
  453:     documentUploads,
  454:   });
  455: 
  456:   project = preparedAssets.project;
  457: 
  458:   try {
  459:     const validation = validateForSave(project, collections);
  460: 
  461:     /*
  462:      * Store metadata only after every staged
  463:      * asset was written successfully.
  464:      */
  465: 
  466:     replaceStoredProjects([...records, project]);
  467: 
  468:     /*
  469:      * This collection is normally empty while
  470:      * creating, but accepting it keeps the
  471:      * service contract consistent.
  472:      */
  473: 
  474:     await removeUnreferencedAssets(project, removedAssetStorageKeys).catch(
  475:       () => {},
  476:     );
  477: 
  478:     return {
  479:       project,
  480:       warnings: validation.warnings,
  481:     };
  482:   } catch (error) {
  483:     /*
  484:      * Metadata was not saved, so every new
  485:      * IndexedDB asset must be removed.
  486:      */
  487: 
  488:     await deleteProjectAssets(preparedAssets.createdStorageKeys).catch(
  489:       () => {},
  490:     );
  491: 
  492:     throw error;
  493:   }
  494: }
  495: 
  496: /*
  497:  * =========================================
  498:  * Update Project
  499:  * =========================================
  500:  */
  501: 
  502: export async function updateProject(
  503:   projectId,
  504:   updates,
  505:   {
  506:     collections = {},
  507:     mediaUploads = [],
  508:     documentUploads = [],
  509:     removedAssetStorageKeys = [],
  510:   } = {},
  511: ) {
  512:   const normalizedProjectId = requireProjectId(projectId);
  513: 
  514:   const records = readStoredProjects();
  515: 
  516:   const projectIndex = findProjectIndex(records, normalizedProjectId);
  517: 
  518:   if (projectIndex < 0) {
  519:     throw createProjectServiceError(
  520:       "PROJECT_NOT_FOUND",
  521:       `Project not found: ${normalizedProjectId}`,
  522:       "The selected Project could not be found.",
  523:       {
  524:         projectId: normalizedProjectId,
  525:       },
  526:     );
  527:   }
  528: 
  529:   let project = updateProjectModel(records[projectIndex], updates);
  530: 
  531:   ensureUniqueProject(records, project, project.id);
  532: 
  533:   const preparedAssets = await prepareProjectAssets(project, {
  534:     mediaUploads,
  535:     documentUploads,
  536:   });
  537: 
  538:   project = preparedAssets.project;
  539: 
  540:   try {
  541:     const validation = validateForSave(project, collections);
  542: 
  543:     const nextRecords = [...records];
  544: 
  545:     nextRecords[projectIndex] = project;
  546: 
  547:     /*
  548:      * Save updated metadata before deleting
  549:      * old assets. If this write fails, existing
  550:      * files remain recoverable.
  551:      */
  552: 
  553:     replaceStoredProjects(nextRecords);
  554: 
  555:     /*
  556:      * Asset deletion occurs only after the new
  557:      * Project record has been saved.
  558:      */
  559: 
  560:     await removeUnreferencedAssets(project, removedAssetStorageKeys).catch(
  561:       () => {},
  562:     );
  563: 
  564:     return {
  565:       project,
  566:       warnings: validation.warnings,
  567:     };
  568:   } catch (error) {
  569:     /*
  570:      * Preserve all pre-existing files and remove
  571:      * only assets created during this attempt.
  572:      */
  573: 
  574:     await deleteProjectAssets(preparedAssets.createdStorageKeys).catch(
  575:       () => {},
  576:     );
  577: 
  578:     throw error;
  579:   }
  580: }
  581: 
  582: /*
  583:  * =========================================
  584:  * Archive Project
  585:  * =========================================
  586:  */
  587: 
  588: export async function archiveProject(projectId) {
  589:   const normalizedProjectId = requireProjectId(projectId);
  590: 
  591:   const records = readStoredProjects();
  592: 
  593:   const projectIndex = findProjectIndex(records, normalizedProjectId);
  594: 
  595:   if (projectIndex < 0) {
  596:     throw createProjectServiceError(
  597:       "PROJECT_NOT_FOUND",
  598:       `Project not found: ${normalizedProjectId}`,
  599:       "The selected Project could not be found.",
  600:       {
  601:         projectId: normalizedProjectId,
  602:       },
  603:     );
  604:   }
  605: 
  606:   const project = records[projectIndex];
  607: 
  608:   if (project.recordStatus === "archived") {
  609:     return project;
  610:   }
  611: 
  612:   const archivedProject = normalizeProject({
  613:     ...project,
  614: 
  615:     recordStatus: "archived",
  616: 
  617:     updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  618:   });
  619: 
  620:   const nextRecords = [...records];
  621: 
  622:   nextRecords[projectIndex] = archivedProject;
  623: 
  624:   replaceStoredProjects(nextRecords);
  625: 
  626:   return archivedProject;
  627: }

  629: /*
  630:  * =========================================
  631:  * Restore Project
  632:  * =========================================
  633:  */
  634: 
  635: export async function restoreProject(projectId) {
  636:   const normalizedProjectId = requireProjectId(projectId);
  637: 
  638:   const records = readStoredProjects();
  639: 
  640:   const projectIndex = findProjectIndex(records, normalizedProjectId);
  641: 
  642:   if (projectIndex < 0) {
  643:     throw createProjectServiceError(
  644:       "PROJECT_NOT_FOUND",
  645:       `Project not found: ${normalizedProjectId}`,
  646:       "The selected Project could not be found.",
  647:       {
  648:         projectId: normalizedProjectId,
  649:       },
  650:     );
  651:   }
  652: 
  653:   const project = records[projectIndex];
  654: 
  655:   if (project.recordStatus === "active") {
  656:     return project;
  657:   }
  658: 
  659:   const restoredProject = normalizeProject({
  660:     ...project,
  661: 
  662:     recordStatus: "active",
  663: 
  664:     updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  665:   });
  666: 
  667:   const nextRecords = [...records];
  668: 
  669:   nextRecords[projectIndex] = restoredProject;
  670: 
  671:   replaceStoredProjects(nextRecords);
  672: 
  673:   return restoredProject;
  674: }

  676: /*
  677:  * =========================================
  678:  * Delete Project Permanently
  679:  * =========================================
  680:  */
  681: 
  682: export async function deleteProject(projectId) {
  683:   const normalizedProjectId = requireProjectId(projectId);
  684: 
  685:   const records = readStoredProjects();
  686: 
  687:   const projectIndex = findProjectIndex(records, normalizedProjectId);
  688: 
  689:   if (projectIndex < 0) {
  690:     throw createProjectServiceError(
  691:       "PROJECT_NOT_FOUND",
  692:       `Project not found: ${normalizedProjectId}`,
  693:       "The selected Project could not be found.",
  694:       {
  695:         projectId: normalizedProjectId,
  696:       },
  697:     );
  698:   }
  699: 
  700:   const deletedProject = records[projectIndex];
  701: 
  702:   const nextRecords = records.filter(
  703:     (project) => project.id !== normalizedProjectId,
  704:   );
  705: 
  706:   /*
  707:    * Delete metadata first. If localStorage
  708:    * fails, the Project and all assets remain.
  709:    */
  710: 
  711:   replaceStoredProjects(nextRecords);
  712: 
  713:   /*
  714:    * Once metadata is removed, delete every
  715:    * IndexedDB asset owned by this Project.
  716:    *
  717:    * Cleanup is best effort because the Project
  718:    * metadata has already been deleted.
  719:    */
  720: 
  721:   let assetCleanupError = null;
  722: 
  723:   try {
  724:     await deleteProjectAssetsForProject(normalizedProjectId);
  725:   } catch (error) {
  726:     assetCleanupError = error;
  727:   }
  728: 
  729:   return {
  730:     ...deletedProject,
  731: 
  732:     assetCleanupWarning: assetCleanupError
  733:       ? "The Project was deleted, but one or more locally stored files could not be cleaned up."
  734:       : "",
  735:   };
  736: }

   22:  * Storage Error
   23:  * =========================================
   24:  */
   25: 
   26: function createProjectStorageError(
   27:   code,
   28:   message,
   29:   publicMessage,
   30:   cause = null,
   31: ) {
   32:   const error = new Error(message);
   33: 
   34:   error.name = "ProjectStorageError";
   35:   error.code = code;
   36:   error.publicMessage = publicMessage;
   37: 
   38:   if (cause) {
   39:     error.cause = cause;
   40:   }
   41: 
   42:   return error;

   47:  * Browser Storage
   48:  * =========================================
   49:  */
   50: 
   51: function getBrowserStorage() {
   52:   if (typeof window === "undefined") {
   53:     throw createProjectStorageError(
   54:       "PROJECT_STORAGE_ENVIRONMENT_UNAVAILABLE",
   55:       "Window is unavailable.",
   56:       "Project storage is not supported in this environment.",
   57:     );
   58:   }
   59: 
   60:   try {
   61:     if (!window.localStorage) {
   62:       throw new Error("localStorage is unavailable.");
   63:     }
   64: 
   65:     return window.localStorage;
   66:   } catch (cause) {
   67:     throw createProjectStorageError(
   68:       "PROJECT_STORAGE_ACCESS_DENIED",
   69:       "Browser localStorage could not be accessed.",
   70:       "Project storage is unavailable. Check your browser privacy and storage settings.",
   71:       cause,
   72:     );
   73:   }
   74: }

   77:  * =========================================
   78:  * Empty Storage Document
   79:  * =========================================
   80:  */
   81: 
   82: function createEmptyProjectStorageDocument() {
   83:   return {
   84:     storageVersion: PROJECT_STORAGE_VERSION,
   85: 
   86:     projectModelVersion: PROJECT_MODEL_VERSION,
   87: 
   88:     projectRecords: [],
   89: 
   90:     updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
   91:   };
   92: }

   94: /*
   95:  * =========================================
   96:  * Recovery Copy
   97:  * =========================================
   98:  *
   99:  * If stored JSON is corrupted, retain its raw
  100:  * value under a recovery key before reporting
  101:  * the error. This avoids silently discarding
  102:  * potentially recoverable Project metadata.
  103:  */
  104: 
  105: function preserveRecoveryCopy(
  106:   storage,
  107:   rawValue,
  108:   reason,
  109: ) {
  110:   if (!rawValue) {
  111:     return;
  112:   }
  113: 
  114:   try {
  115:     storage.setItem(
  116:       PROJECT_STORAGE_RECOVERY_KEY,
  117:       JSON.stringify({
  118:         originalStorageKey: PROJECT_STORAGE_KEY,
  119:         reason,
  120:         recoveredAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  121:         rawValue,
  122:       }),
  123:     );
  124:   } catch {
  125:     /*
  126:      * Recovery storage is best effort. Do not
  127:      * replace the original error if the browser
  128:      * cannot save the recovery copy.
  129:      */
  130:   }
  131: }

  133: /*
  134:  * =========================================
  135:  * Record Collection Resolution
  136:  * =========================================
  137:  */
  138: 
  139: function getStoredRecordCollection(document) {
  140:   if (Array.isArray(document.projectRecords)) {
  141:     return document.projectRecords;
  142:   }
  143: 
  144:   if (Array.isArray(document.projects)) {
  145:     return document.projects;
  146:   }
  147: 
  148:   if (Array.isArray(document.records)) {
  149:     return document.records;
  150:   }
  151: 
  152:   /*
  153:    * A completely absent collection represents
  154:    * an empty library. A present collection with
  155:    * the wrong type represents corruption.
  156:    */
  157: 
  158:   const hasCollectionProperty =
  159:     Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
  160:       document,
  161:       "projectRecords",
  162:     ) ||
  163:     Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
  164:       document,
  165:       "projects",
  166:     ) ||
  167:     Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
  168:       document,
  169:       "records",
  170:     );
  171: 
  172:   if (!hasCollectionProperty) {
  173:     return [];
  174:   }
  175: 
  176:   throw createProjectStorageError(
  177:     "PROJECT_STORAGE_RECORDS_INVALID",
  178:     "The stored Project collection is not an array.",
  179:     "The saved Project Library contains an invalid record collection.",
  180:   );
  181: }

  183: /*
  184:  * =========================================
  185:  * Storage Migration
  186:  * =========================================
  187:  */
  188: 
  189: function migrateProjectStorageDocument(
  190:   storedDocument,
  191: ) {
  192:   /*
  193:    * Original storage sometimes contained only
  194:    * the Project array.
  195:    */
  196: 
  197:   if (Array.isArray(storedDocument)) {
  198:     return {
  199:       document: {
  200:         ...createEmptyProjectStorageDocument(),
  201: 
  202:         projectRecords:
  203:           normalizeProjectCollection(
  204:             storedDocument,
  205:           ),
  206:       },
  207: 
  208:       wasMigrated: true,
  209:     };
  210:   }
  211: 
  212:   if (
  213:     !storedDocument ||
  214:     typeof storedDocument !== "object"
  215:   ) {
  216:     throw createProjectStorageError(
  217:       "PROJECT_STORAGE_DOCUMENT_INVALID",
  218:       "Stored Project data has an invalid structure.",
  219:       "The saved Project Library has an invalid format.",
  220:     );
  221:   }
  222: 
  223:   const storedVersion =
  224:     Number(storedDocument.storageVersion) || 1;
  225: 
  226:   if (storedVersion > PROJECT_STORAGE_VERSION) {
  227:     throw createProjectStorageError(
  228:       "PROJECT_STORAGE_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED",
  229:       `Stored Project version ${storedVersion} is newer than supported version ${PROJECT_STORAGE_VERSION}.`,
  230:       "This Project Library was created by a newer version of the application and cannot be opened safely.",
  231:     );
  232:   }
  233: 
  234:   const storedRecords =
  235:     getStoredRecordCollection(storedDocument);
  236: 
  237:   /*
  238:    * normalizeProjectCollection performs the
  239:    * model migration. It upgrades version-1
  240:    * Projects to the current model structure.
  241:    */
  242: 
  243:   const normalizedRecords =
  244:     normalizeProjectCollection(storedRecords);
  245: 
  246:   const wasMigrated =
  247:     storedVersion !== PROJECT_STORAGE_VERSION ||
  248:     Number(storedDocument.projectModelVersion) !==
  249:       PROJECT_MODEL_VERSION ||
  250:     !Array.isArray(storedDocument.projectRecords);
  251: 
  252:   return {
  253:     document: {
  254:       storageVersion: PROJECT_STORAGE_VERSION,
  255: 
  256:       projectModelVersion: PROJECT_MODEL_VERSION,
  257: 
  258:       projectRecords: normalizedRecords,
  259: 
  260:       updatedAt:
  261:         typeof storedDocument.updatedAt ===
  262:         "string"
  263:           ? storedDocument.updatedAt
  264:           : new Date().toISOString(),
  265:     },
  266: 
  267:     wasMigrated,
  268:   };
  269: }
  270: 
  271: /*
  272:  * =========================================
  273:  * Parse Storage Document
  274:  * =========================================
  275:  */
  276: 
  277: function parseProjectStorageDocument(rawValue) {
  278:   if (!rawValue) {
  279:     return {
  280:       document:
  281:         createEmptyProjectStorageDocument(),
  282: 
  283:       wasMigrated: false,
  284:     };
  285:   }
  286: 
  287:   let parsedValue;
  288: 
  289:   try {
  290:     parsedValue = JSON.parse(rawValue);
  291:   } catch (cause) {
  292:     throw createProjectStorageError(
  293:       "PROJECT_STORAGE_JSON_INVALID",
  294:       "Unable to parse stored Project data.",
  295:       "The saved Project Library could not be read because its data is damaged.",
  296:       cause,
  297:     );
  298:   }
  299: 
  300:   return migrateProjectStorageDocument(
  301:     parsedValue,
  302:   );
  303: }
  304: 
  305: /*
  306:  * =========================================
  307:  * Internal Document Write
  308:  * =========================================
  309:  */
  310: 
  311: function writeStorageDocument(
  312:   storage,
  313:   document,
  314: ) {
  315:   let serializedDocument;
  316: 
  317:   try {
  318:     serializedDocument = JSON.stringify(document);
  319:   } catch (cause) {
  320:     throw createProjectStorageError(
  321:       "PROJECT_STORAGE_SERIALIZATION_FAILED",
  322:       "Project storage could not be serialized.",
  323:       "Your Project records could not be prepared for storage.",
  324:       cause,
  325:     );
  326:   }
  327: 
  328:   try {
  329:     storage.setItem(
  330:       PROJECT_STORAGE_KEY,
  331:       serializedDocument,
  332:     );
  333:   } catch (cause) {
  334:     const isQuotaError =
  335:       cause?.name === "QuotaExceededError" ||
  336:       cause?.name === "NS_ERROR_DOM_QUOTA_REACHED" ||
  337:       cause?.code === 22 ||
  338:       cause?.code === 1014;
  339: 
  340:     throw createProjectStorageError(
  341:       isQuotaError
  342:         ? "PROJECT_STORAGE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED"
  343:         : "PROJECT_STORAGE_WRITE_FAILED",
  344: 
  345:       isQuotaError
  346:         ? "Project localStorage quota was exceeded."
  347:         : "Unable to write Project Library storage.",
  348: 
  349:       isQuotaError
  350:         ? "The browser does not have enough storage space for the Project Library metadata."
  351:         : "Your Project records could not be saved.",
  352: 
  353:       cause,
  354:     );
  355:   }
  356: 
  357:   return document;
  358: }
  359: 
  360: /*
  361:  * =========================================
  362:  * Read Project Storage
  363:  * =========================================
  364:  */
  365: 
  366: export function readProjectStorage({
  367:   persistMigration = true,
  368: } = {}) {
  369:   const storage = getBrowserStorage();
  370: 
  371:   let rawValue;
  372: 
  373:   try {
  374:     rawValue = storage.getItem(
  375:       PROJECT_STORAGE_KEY,
  376:     );
  377:   } catch (cause) {
  378:     throw createProjectStorageError(
  379:       "PROJECT_STORAGE_READ_FAILED",
  380:       "Unable to read Project Library storage.",
  381:       "Your saved Project records could not be loaded.",
  382:       cause,
  383:     );
  384:   }
  385: 
  386:   try {
  387:     const {
  388:       document,
  389:       wasMigrated,
  390:     } = parseProjectStorageDocument(rawValue);
  391: 
  392:     /*
  393:      * Persist successful migrations so every
  394:      * future read uses the current schema.
  395:      */
  396: 
  397:     if (
  398:       rawValue &&
  399:       wasMigrated &&
  400:       persistMigration
  401:     ) {
  402:       return writeStorageDocument(
  403:         storage,
  404:         {
  405:           ...document,
  406:           updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  407:         },
  408:       );
  409:     }
  410: 
  411:     return document;
  412:   } catch (error) {
  413:     preserveRecoveryCopy(
  414:       storage,
  415:       rawValue,
  416:       error?.code || "PROJECT_STORAGE_READ_FAILED",
  417:     );
  418: 
  419:     if (error?.name === "ProjectStorageError") {
  420:       throw error;
  421:     }
  422: 
  423:     throw createProjectStorageError(
  424:       "PROJECT_STORAGE_READ_FAILED",
  425:       "Unable to read Project Library storage.",
  426:       "Your saved Project records could not be loaded.",
  427:       error,
  428:     );
  429:   }
  430: }
  431: 
  432: /*
  433:  * =========================================
  434:  * Write Project Storage
  435:  * =========================================
  436:  */
  437: 
  438: export function writeProjectStorage(
  439:   projectRecords,
  440: ) {
  441:   if (!Array.isArray(projectRecords)) {
  442:     throw createProjectStorageError(
  443:       "PROJECT_STORAGE_WRITE_INPUT_INVALID",
  444:       "Project records must be supplied as an array.",
  445:       "The Project Library could not be saved because the record collection is invalid.",
  446:     );
  447:   }
  448: 
  449:   const storage = getBrowserStorage();
  450: 
  451:   const document = {
  452:     storageVersion: PROJECT_STORAGE_VERSION,
  453: 
  454:     projectModelVersion: PROJECT_MODEL_VERSION,
  455: 
  456:     projectRecords:
  457:       normalizeProjectCollection(
  458:         projectRecords,
  459:       ),
  460: 
  461:     updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  462:   };
  463: 
  464:   return writeStorageDocument(
  465:     storage,
  466:     document,
  467:   );
  468: }

  495:  * =========================================
  496:  * Update Stored Projects
  497:  * =========================================
  498:  */
  499: 
  500: export function updateStoredProjects(updater) {
  501:   if (typeof updater !== "function") {
  502:     throw createProjectStorageError(
  503:       "PROJECT_STORAGE_UPDATER_INVALID",
  504:       "The Project updater must be a function.",
  505:       "The Project Library could not be updated.",
  506:     );
  507:   }
  508: 
  509:   const currentRecords = readStoredProjects();
  510: 
  511:   /*
  512:    * Supply a new array so the updater cannot
  513:    * mutate the collection currently returned
  514:    * by the storage reader.
  515:    */
  516: 
  517:   const nextRecords = updater([
  518:     ...currentRecords,
  519:   ]);
  520: 
  521:   if (!Array.isArray(nextRecords)) {
  522:     throw createProjectStorageError(
  523:       "PROJECT_STORAGE_UPDATE_RESULT_INVALID",
  524:       "The Project updater did not return an array.",
  525:       "The Project Library could not be updated.",
  526:     );
  527:   }
  528: 
  529:   return replaceStoredProjects(nextRecords);
  530: }

   37:  * =========================================
   38:  * Date Parsing
   39:  * =========================================
   40:  */
   41: 
   42: export function parseProjectDate(value) {
   43:   const normalizedValue = getText(value);
   44: 
   45:   if (!normalizedValue) {
   46:     return null;
   47:   }
   48: 
   49:   const match = normalizedValue.match(
   50:     /^(\d{4})-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])(?:-(0[1-9]|[12]\d|3[01]))?$/,
   51:   );
   52: 
   53:   if (!match) {
   54:     return null;
   55:   }
   56: 
   57:   const year = Number(match[1]);
   58:   const month = Number(match[2]);
   59:   const day = match[3] ? Number(match[3]) : 1;
   60: 
   61:   const parsedDate = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day));
   62: 
   63:   if (
   64:     match[3] &&
   65:     (parsedDate.getUTCFullYear() !== year ||
   66:       parsedDate.getUTCMonth() !== month - 1 ||
   67:       parsedDate.getUTCDate() !== day)
   68:   ) {
   69:     return null;
   70:   }
   71: 
   72:   return {
   73:     value: normalizedValue,
   74:     date: parsedDate,
   75:     timestamp: parsedDate.getTime(),
   76:     year,
   77:     month,
   78:     day,
   79:     hasDay: Boolean(match[3]),
   80:   };
   81: }

  449:     getProjectOwnershipLabel(project?.ownership),

  451:     problem.statement,
  452:     problem.targetAudience,
  453:     problem.context,
  454:     problem.importance,
  455: 
  456:     solution.overview,
  457:     solution.approach,
  458:     solution.architecture,
  459: 
  460:     results.outcome,
  461:     results.problemsSolved,
  462:     results.impact,
  463:     results.beneficiariesAffected,
  464:     results.lessonsLearned,
  465:     results.futureImprovements,
  466: 
  467:     presentation.shortSummary,
  468:     presentation.caseStudy,
  469: 
  470:     ...objectives,
  471:     ...constraints,
  472:     ...features,
  473:     ...contributions,
  474:     ...metrics,
  475:     ...skills,
  476:     ...technologies,
  477:     ...relationships,
  478:     ...awards,
  479:     ...media,
  480:     ...documents,
  481:   ]
  482:     .map(getText)
  483:     .filter(Boolean)
  484:     .join(" ")
  485:     .normalize("NFKC")
  486:     .toLocaleLowerCase();
  487: }
  488: 
  489: /*
  490:  * =========================================
  491:  * Search Projects
  492:  * =========================================
  493:  */
  494: 
  495: export function searchProjects(projects, query) {
  496:   const normalizedQuery = getSearchableText(query);
  497: 
  498:   if (!normalizedQuery) {
  499:     return [...getArray(projects)];
  500:   }
  501: 
  502:   const queryTerms = normalizedQuery.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  503: 
  504:   return getArray(projects).filter((project) => {
  505:     const searchableText = createProjectSearchText(project);
  506: 
  507:     return queryTerms.every((term) => searchableText.includes(term));
  508:   });
  509: }

  511: /*

  516: 
  517: function hasRelationshipType(project, relationshipType) {

  519:     case "skill":
  520:       return getArray(project?.skillRelationships).length > 0;
  521: 
  522:     case "experience":
  523:       return (
  524:         getArray(project?.relatedRecords?.experienceRelationships).length > 0
  525:       );

  528:       return (

  530:       );
  531:

  533:       return (

  535:       );
  536:

  538:       return (
  539:         getArray(project?.relatedRecords?.certificationRelationships).length > 0
  540:       );
  541:

  547: /*
  548:  * =========================================
  549:  * Filter Projects
  550:  * =========================================
  551:  */
  552: 
  553: export function filterProjects(projects, filters = {}) {
  554:   const {
  555:     category = "all",
  556:     lifecycleStatus = "all",
  557:     ownership = "all",
  558:     featured = "all",
  559:     media = "all",
  560:     awarded = "all",
  561:     relationship = "all",
  562:   } = filters;
  563: 
  564:   return getArray(projects).filter((project) => {
  565:     if (category !== "all" && project.category !== category) {
  566:       return false;
  567:     }
  568: 
  569:     if (
  570:       lifecycleStatus !== "all" &&
  571:       project.lifecycleStatus !== lifecycleStatus
  572:     ) {
  573:       return false;
  574:     }
  575: 
  576:     if (ownership !== "all" && project.ownership !== ownership) {
  577:       return false;
  578:     }
  579: 
  580:     if (featured === "featured" && !project.presentation?.isFeatured) {
  581:       return false;
  582:     }
  583: 
  584:     if (featured === "not-featured" && project.presentation?.isFeatured) {
  585:       return false;
  586:     }
  587: 
  588:     const projectHasMedia = hasProjectMedia(project);
  589: 
  590:     if (media === "with-media" && !projectHasMedia) {
  591:       return false;
  592:     }
  593: 
  594:     if (media === "without-media" && projectHasMedia) {
  595:       return false;
  596:     }
  597: 
  598:     const projectHasAwards = hasProjectAwards(project);
  599: 
  600:     if (awarded === "awarded" && !projectHasAwards) {
  601:       return false;
  602:     }
  603: 
  604:     if (awarded === "not-awarded" && projectHasAwards) {
  605:       return false;
  606:     }
  607: 
  608:     if (relationship !== "all" && !hasRelationshipType(project, relationship)) {
  609:       return false;
  610:     }
  611: 
  612:     return true;
  613:   });
  614: }

  616: /*
  617:  * =========================================
  618:  * Title Comparison
  619:  * =========================================
  620:  */
  621: 
  622: function compareProjectTitles(firstProject, secondProject) {
  623:   return getText(firstProject?.title).localeCompare(
  624:     getText(secondProject?.title),
  625:     undefined,
  626:     {
  627:       sensitivity: "base",
  628:     },
  629:   );
  630: }
  631: 
  632: /*
  633:  * =========================================
  634:  * Updated-Date Comparison
  635:  * =========================================
  636:  */
  637: 
  638: function compareRecentlyUpdated(firstProject, secondProject) {
  639:   const difference =
  640:     getUpdatedSortValue(secondProject?.updatedAt) -
  641:     getUpdatedSortValue(firstProject?.updatedAt);
  642: 
  643:   if (difference !== 0) {
  644:     return difference;
  645:   }
  646: 
  647:   return compareProjectTitles(firstProject, secondProject);
  648: }
  649: 
  650: /*
  651:  * =========================================
  652:  * Newest Start-Date Comparison
  653:  * =========================================
  654:  *
  655:  * Projects without a start date are placed
  656:  * at the bottom of the collection.
  657:  */
  658: 
  659: function compareNewestStarted(firstProject, secondProject) {
  660:   const firstStartDate = getDateSortValue(firstProject?.dates?.startDate);
  661: 
  662:   const secondStartDate = getDateSortValue(secondProject?.dates?.startDate);
  663: 
  664:   if (firstStartDate && !secondStartDate) {
  665:     return -1;
  666:   }
  667: 
  668:   if (!firstStartDate && secondStartDate) {
  669:     return 1;
  670:   }
  671: 
  672:   if (firstStartDate !== secondStartDate) {
  673:     return secondStartDate - firstStartDate;
  674:   }
  675: 
  676:   return compareRecentlyUpdated(firstProject, secondProject);
  677: }
  678: 
  679: /*
  680:  * =========================================
  681:  * Oldest Start-Date Comparison
  682:  * =========================================
  683:  *
  684:  * Projects without a start date remain at
  685:  * the bottom even when sorting oldest-first.
  686:  */
  687: 
  688: function compareOldestStarted(firstProject, secondProject) {
  689:   const firstStartDate = getDateSortValue(firstProject?.dates?.startDate);
  690: 
  691:   const secondStartDate = getDateSortValue(secondProject?.dates?.startDate);
  692: 
  693:   if (firstStartDate && !secondStartDate) {
  694:     return -1;
  695:   }
  696: 
  697:   if (!firstStartDate && secondStartDate) {
  698:     return 1;
  699:   }
  700: 
  701:   if (firstStartDate !== secondStartDate) {
  702:     return firstStartDate - secondStartDate;
  703:   }
  704: 
  705:   return compareProjectTitles(firstProject, secondProject);
  706: }
  707: 
  708: /*
  709:  * =========================================
  710:  * Portfolio Priority
  711:  * =========================================
  712:  */
  713: 
  714: function getPortfolioPriority(project) {
  715:   if (project?.presentation?.isFeatured) {
  716:     return 1;
  717:   }
  718: 
  719:   if (isProjectCurrent(project)) {
  720:     return 2;
  721:   }
  722: 
  723:   if (
  724:     isProjectCompleted(project) &&
  725:     (project?.dates?.endDate || project?.dates?.startDate)
  726:   ) {
  727:     return 3;
  728:   }
  729: 
  730:   if (project?.dates?.endDate || project?.dates?.startDate) {
  731:     return 4;
  732:   }
  733: 
  734:   return 5;
  735: }
  736: 
  737: /*
  738:  * =========================================
  739:  * Portfolio Priority Comparison
  740:  * =========================================
  741:  */
  742: 
  743: function comparePortfolioPriority(firstProject, secondProject) {
  744:   const firstPriority = getPortfolioPriority(firstProject);
  745: 
  746:   const secondPriority = getPortfolioPriority(secondProject);
  747: 
  748:   if (firstPriority !== secondPriority) {
  749:     return firstPriority - secondPriority;
  750:   }
  751: 
  752:   const currentDifference =
  753:     Number(isProjectCurrent(secondProject)) -
  754:     Number(isProjectCurrent(firstProject));
  755: 
  756:   if (currentDifference !== 0) {
  757:     return currentDifference;
  758:   }
  759: 
  760:   const firstRelevantDate = getDateSortValue(
  761:     firstProject?.dates?.isCurrent
  762:       ? firstProject?.dates?.startDate
  763:       : firstProject?.dates?.endDate || firstProject?.dates?.startDate,
  764:   );
  765: 
  766:   const secondRelevantDate = getDateSortValue(
  767:     secondProject?.dates?.isCurrent
  768:       ? secondProject?.dates?.startDate
  769:       : secondProject?.dates?.endDate || secondProject?.dates?.startDate,
  770:   );
  771: 
  772:   if (firstRelevantDate !== secondRelevantDate) {
  773:     return secondRelevantDate - firstRelevantDate;
  774:   }
  775: 
  776:   return compareRecentlyUpdated(firstProject, secondProject);
  777: }
  778: 
  779: /*
  780:  * =========================================
  781:  * Newest Completed Comparison
  782:  * =========================================
  783:  */
  784: 
  785: function compareNewestCompleted(firstProject, secondProject) {
  786:   const firstCompleted = isProjectCompleted(firstProject);
  787: 
  788:   const secondCompleted = isProjectCompleted(secondProject);
  789: 
  790:   if (firstCompleted !== secondCompleted) {
  791:     return Number(secondCompleted) - Number(firstCompleted);
  792:   }
  793: 
  794:   const firstDate = getDateSortValue(
  795:     firstProject?.dates?.endDate || firstProject?.dates?.startDate,
  796:   );
  797: 
  798:   const secondDate = getDateSortValue(
  799:     secondProject?.dates?.endDate || secondProject?.dates?.startDate,
  800:   );
  801: 
  802:   if (firstDate && !secondDate) {
  803:     return -1;
  804:   }
  805: 
  806:   if (!firstDate && secondDate) {
  807:     return 1;
  808:   }
  809: 
  810:   if (firstDate !== secondDate) {
  811:     return secondDate - firstDate;
  812:   }
  813: 
  814:   return compareProjectTitles(firstProject, secondProject);
  815: }
  816: 
  817: /*
  818:  * =========================================
  819:  * Sort Projects
  820:  * =========================================
  821:  */
  822: 
  823: export function sortProjects(projects, sortOption = "newest-started") {
  824:   const sortedProjects = [...getArray(projects)];
  825: 
  826:   sortedProjects.sort((firstProject, secondProject) => {
  827:     switch (sortOption) {
  828:       case "newest-started":
  829:         return compareNewestStarted(firstProject, secondProject);
  830: 
  831:       case "oldest":
  832:         return compareOldestStarted(firstProject, secondProject);
  833: 
  834:       case "title-ascending":
  835:         return compareProjectTitles(firstProject, secondProject);
  836: 
  837:       case "title-descending":
  838:         return compareProjectTitles(secondProject, firstProject);
  839: 
  840:       case "recently-updated":
  841:         return compareRecentlyUpdated(firstProject, secondProject);
  842: 
  843:       case "newest-completed":
  844:         return compareNewestCompleted(firstProject, secondProject);
  845: 
  846:       case "impact":
  847:         return (
  848:           getProjectImpactScore(secondProject) -
  849:             getProjectImpactScore(firstProject) ||
  850:           compareNewestStarted(firstProject, secondProject)
  851:         );
  852: 
  853:       case "portfolio-default":
  854:         return comparePortfolioPriority(firstProject, secondProject);
  855: 
  856:       default:
  857:         return compareNewestStarted(firstProject, secondProject);
  858:     }
  859:   });
  860: 
  861:   return sortedProjects;
  862: }
  863: 
  864: /*
  865:  * =========================================
  866:  * Search, Filter, and Sort
  867:  * =========================================
  868:  */
  869: 
  870: export function prepareProjectCollection({
  871:   projects = [],
  872:   query = "",
  873:   filters = {},
  874:   sortOption = "newest-started",
  875: } = {}) {
  876:   const searchedProjects = searchProjects(projects, query);
  877: 
  878:   const filteredProjects = filterProjects(searchedProjects, filters);
  879: 
  880:   return sortProjects(filteredProjects, sortOption);
  881: }

  917: 
  918:     withPublicMedia: active.filter(hasPublicProjectMedia).length,
  919: 
  920:     withDocuments: active.filter(hasProjectDocuments).length,
  921: 
  922:     withRelationships: active.filter(
  923:       (project) => getProjectRelationshipCount(project) > 0,

   71:

   74:   }
   75:

   91: function parseProjectDate(value) {
   92:   const normalizedValue = getText(value);
   93: 
   94:   if (!normalizedValue) {
   95:     return null;
   96:   }
   97: 
   98:   const match = normalizedValue.match(
   99:     /^(\d{4})-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])(?:-(0[1-9]|[12]\d|3[01]))?$/,
  100:   );
  101: 
  102:   if (!match) {
  103:     return null;
  104:   }
  105: 
  106:   const year = Number(match[1]);
  107:   const month = Number(match[2]);
  108:   const day = match[3] ? Number(match[3]) : 1;
  109: 
  110:   const parsedDate = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day));
  111: 
  112:   if (
  113:     match[3] &&
  114:     (parsedDate.getUTCFullYear() !== year ||
  115:       parsedDate.getUTCMonth() !== month - 1 ||
  116:       parsedDate.getUTCDate() !== day)
  117:   ) {
  118:     return null;
  119:   }
  120: 
  121:   return parsedDate.getTime();
  122: }

  291:       fieldErrors,

  293:       "PROJECT_START_DATE_INVALID",
  294:       "Enter a valid project start date.",
  295:     );
  296:   }
  297: 
  298:   if (sourceDates.endDate && endDateValue === null) {
  299:     addError(
  300:       errors,
  301:       fieldErrors,
  302:       "dates.endDate",
  303:       "PROJECT_END_DATE_INVALID",
  304:       "Enter a valid project end date.",
  305:     );
  306:   }
  307: 
  308:   if (
  309:     !project.dates.isCurrent &&
  310:     ["completed", "cancelled"].includes(project.lifecycleStatus) &&
  311:     !project.dates.endDate
  312:   ) {
  313:     addError(
  314:       errors,
  315:       fieldErrors,
  316:       "dates.endDate",
  317:       "PROJECT_END_DATE_REQUIRED",
  318:       "Enter the project completion or cancellation date.",
  319:     );
  320:   }
  321: 
  322:   if (
  323:     startDateValue !== null &&
  324:     endDateValue !== null &&
  325:     endDateValue < startDateValue
  326:   ) {
  327:     addError(
  328:       errors,
  329:       fieldErrors,
  330:       "dates.endDate",
  331:       "PROJECT_DATE_ORDER_INVALID",
  332:       "The end date cannot be earlier than the start date.",
  333:     );
  334:   }
  335: 
  336:   if (project.dates.isCurrent && project.dates.endDate) {
  337:     addError(
  338:       errors,
  339:       fieldErrors,
  340:       "dates.endDate",
  341:       "PROJECT_CURRENT_END_DATE_CONFLICT",
  342:       "An ongoing project cannot have an end date.",
  343:     );
  344:   }
  345: 
  346:   if (
  347:     project.dates.isCurrent &&
  348:     !["in-progress", "maintained"].includes(project.lifecycleStatus)
  349:   ) {
  350:     addError(
  351:       errors,
  352:       fieldErrors,
  353:       "lifecycleStatus",
  354:       "PROJECT_CURRENT_LIFECYCLE_CONFLICT",
  355:       "An ongoing project must be In Progress or Maintained.",
  356:     );
  357:   }
  358: 
  359:   if (
  360:     ["in-progress", "maintained"].includes(project.lifecycleStatus) &&
  361:     !project.dates.isCurrent
  362:   ) {
  363:     addWarning(
  364:       warnings,
  365:       "dates.isCurrent",
  366:       "PROJECT_CURRENT_STATUS_RECOMMENDED",
  367:       "Consider marking an In Progress or Maintained project as ongoing.",
  368:     );
  369:   }
  370: 
  371:   /*
  372:    * =========================================
  373:    * URL Validation
  374:    * =========================================
  375:    */
  376: 
  377:   Object.entries(sourceLinks).forEach(([fieldName, urlValue]) => {
  378:     if (!isValidUrl(urlValue)) {
  379:       addError(
  380:         errors,
  381:         fieldErrors,
  382:         `links.${fieldName}`,
  383:         "PROJECT_URL_INVALID",
  384:         "Enter a complete HTTP or HTTPS address.",
  385:       );
  386:     }
  387:   });
  388: 
  389:   if (!isValidUrl(sourceOrganization.website)) {
  390:     addError(
  391:       errors,
  392:       fieldErrors,
  393:       "organization.website",
  394:       "PROJECT_ORGANIZATION_URL_INVALID",
  395:       "Enter a complete HTTP or HTTPS organization address.",
  396:     );
  397:   }
  398: 
  399:   /*
  400:    * =========================================
  401:    * Maximum Field Lengths
  402:    * =========================================
  403:    */
  404: 
  405:   [
  406:     [source.title, PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.title, "title", "Project title"],
  407:     [source.role, PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.role, "role", "Project role"],
  408:     [
  409:       sourceOrganization.name,
  410:       PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.organizationName,
  411:       "organization.name",
  412:       "Organization name",
  413:     ],
  414:     [
  415:       sourceOrganization.clientName,
  416:       PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.clientName,
  417:       "organization.clientName",
  418:       "Client name",
  419:     ],
  420:     [
  421:       sourceProblem.statement,
  422:       PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.problemStatement,
  423:       "problem.statement",
  424:       "Problem statement",
  425:     ],
  426:     [
  427:       sourceProblem.targetAudience,
  428:       PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.targetAudience,
  429:       "problem.targetAudience",
  430:       "Target audience",
  431:     ],
  432:     [
  433:       sourceProblem.context,
  434:       PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.context,
  435:       "problem.context",
  436:       "Project context",
  437:     ],
  438:     [
  439:       sourceProblem.importance,
  440:       PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.importance,
  441:       "problem.importance",
  442:       "Project importance",
  443:     ],
  444:     [
  445:       sourceSolution.overview,
  446:       PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.overview,
  447:       "solution.overview",
  448:       "Solution overview",
  449:     ],
  450:     [

  452:       PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.approach,
  453:       "solution.approach",
  454:       "Implementation approach",
  455:     ],
  456:     [
  457:       sourceSolution.architecture,
  458:       PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.architecture,
  459:       "solution.architecture",
  460:       "Architecture summary",
  461:     ],
  462:     [
  463:       sourceResults.outcome,
  464:       PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.outcome,
  465:       "results.outcome",
  466:       "Project outcome",
  467:     ],
  468:     [
  469:       sourceResults.problemsSolved,
  470:       PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.problemsSolved,
  471:       "results.problemsSolved",
  472:       "Problems solved",
  473:     ],
  474:     [
  475:       sourceResults.impact,
  476:       PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.impact,
  477:       "results.impact",
  478:       "Project impact",
  479:     ],
  480:     [
  481:       sourceResults.beneficiariesAffected,
  482:       PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.beneficiariesAffected,
  483:       "results.beneficiariesAffected",
  484:       "Affected beneficiaries",
  485:     ],
  486:     [
  487:       sourcePresentation.shortSummary,
  488:       PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.shortSummary,
  489:       "presentation.shortSummary",
  490:       "Portfolio summary",
  491:     ],
  492:     [
  493:       sourcePresentation.caseStudy,
  494:       PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.caseStudy,
  495:       "presentation.caseStudy",
  496:       "Detailed case study",
  497:     ],
  498:     [
  499:       sourcePrivateInformation.notes,
  500:       PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.privateNotes,
  501:       "privateInformation.notes",
  502:       "Private notes",
  503:     ],
  504:   ].forEach(([fieldValue, limit, field, label]) => {
  505:     validateMaximumLength({
  506:       value: fieldValue,
  507:       maximumLength: limit,
  508:       field,
  509:       label,
  510:       errors,
  511:       fieldErrors,
  512:     });
  513:   });
  514: 
  515:   /*
  516:    * =========================================
  517:    * Collection Limits
  518:    * =========================================
  519:    */
  520:

  522:     [
  523:       sourceProblem.objectives,
  524:       PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumObjectives,
  525:       "problem.objectives",
  526:       "objectives",
  527:     ],
  528:     [
  529:       sourceProblem.constraints,
  530:       PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumConstraints,

  532:       "constraints",
  533:     ],
  534:     [
  535:       sourceSolution.features,
  536:       PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumFeatures,
  537:       "solution.features",
  538:       "features",
  539:     ],
  540:     [
  541:       sourceSolution.contributions,
  542:       PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumContributions,
  543:       "solution.contributions",
  544:       "contributions",

  546:     [
  547:       sourceResults.metrics,
  548:       PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumMetrics,
  549:       "results.metrics",
  550:       "metrics",

  552:     [

  554:       PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumSkills,
  555:       "skillRelationships",

  562:       "technologies",

  565:     [source.media, PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumMedia, "media", "media items"],
  566:     [
  567:       source.supportingDocuments,
  568:       PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.maximumDocuments,
  569:       "supportingDocuments",
  570:       "documents",
  571:     ],
  572:   ];
  573: 
  574:   collectionLimits.forEach(([collection, maximum, field, label]) => {
  575:     if (Array.isArray(collection) && collection.length > maximum) {
  576:       addError(
  577:         errors,
  578:         fieldErrors,
  579:         field,
  580:         "PROJECT_COLLECTION_LIMIT_EXCEEDED",

  592:   const availableSkillIds = Array.isArray(collections.skills)
  593:     ? new Set(collections.skills.map((skill) => skill?.id).filter(Boolean))
  594:     : null;
  595: 
  596:   project.skillRelationships.forEach((relationship, index) => {
  597:     if (!relationship.skillId && !relationship.nameSnapshot) {
  598:       addError(

  600:         fieldErrors,
  601:         `skillRelationships.${index}`,
  602:         "PROJECT_SKILL_IDENTITY_REQUIRED",
  603:         "A related Skill must have an identifier or readable snapshot.",
  604:       );
  605:     }
  606: 
  607:     if (
  608:       relationship.demonstratedProficiency &&
  609:       !isValidProjectSkillProficiency(relationship.demonstratedProficiency)
  610:     ) {
  611:       addError(
  612:         errors,
  613:         fieldErrors,
  614:         `skillRelationships.${index}.demonstratedProficiency`,
  615:         "PROJECT_SKILL_PROFICIENCY_INVALID",
  616:         "Select a valid demonstrated proficiency.",
  617:       );
  618:     }
  619: 
  620:     /*
  621:      * A missing central record is a warning.
  622:      * The snapshot keeps the Project readable.
  623:      */
  624: 
  625:     if (
  626:       availableSkillIds &&
  627:       relationship.skillId &&
  628:       !availableSkillIds.has(relationship.skillId)
  629:     ) {
  630:       addWarning(
  631:         warnings,
  632:         `skillRelationships.${index}`,
  633:         "PROJECT_SKILL_NOT_FOUND",
  634:         `The Skill â€œ${
  635:           relationship.nameSnapshot || relationship.skillId
  636:         }â€ is no longer available in the Skill Library. Its snapshot will be preserved.`,
  637:       );
  638:     }
  639:   });
  640: 
  641:   /*
  642:    * =========================================
  643:    * Related Professional Records
  644:    * =========================================
  645:    */
  646: 
  647:   const relationshipCollections = [
  648:     {
  649:       relationshipName: "experienceRelationships",
  650:       idField: "experienceId",
  651:       records: collections.experiences,
  652:       label: "Experience",
  653:     },
  654:     {
  655:       relationshipName: "educationRelationships",
  656:       idField: "educationId",
  657:       records: collections.educationRecords,
  658:       label: "Education",
  659:     },
  660:     {
  661:       relationshipName: "trainingRelationships",
  662:       idField: "trainingId",
  663:       records: collections.trainingRecords,
  664:       label: "Training",
  665:     },
  666:     {
  667:       relationshipName: "certificationRelationships",
  668:       idField: "certificationId",
  669:       records: collections.certifications,
  670:       label: "Certification",
  671:     },
  672:   ];
  673: 
  674:   relationshipCollections.forEach(
  675:     ({ relationshipName, idField, records, label }) => {
  676:       if (!Array.isArray(records)) {
  677:         return;
  678:       }
  679: 
  680:       const availableIds = new Set(
  681:         records.map((record) => record?.id).filter(Boolean),
  682:       );
  683: 
  684:       project.relatedRecords[relationshipName].forEach(
  685:         (relationship, index) => {
  686:           if (!relationship[idField]) {
  687:             addError(
  688:               errors,
  689:               fieldErrors,
  690:               `relatedRecords.${relationshipName}.${index}`,
  691:               "PROJECT_RELATIONSHIP_ID_REQUIRED",
  692:               `A related ${label} record must have an identifier.`,
  693:             );
  694: 
  695:             return;
  696:           }
  697: 
  698:           if (!availableIds.has(relationship[idField])) {
  699:             addWarning(
  700:               warnings,
  701:               `relatedRecords.${relationshipName}.${index}`,
  702:               "PROJECT_RELATIONSHIP_NOT_FOUND",
  703:               `A related ${label} record is no longer available. Its readable snapshot will be preserved.`,
  704:             );
  705:           }
  706:         },
  707:       );
  708:     },
  709:   );
  710:

  712:    * =========================================
  713:    * Awards and Recognition
  714:    * =========================================
  715:    */
  716: 
  717:   const documentIds = new Set(
  718:     project.supportingDocuments.map((documentRecord) => documentRecord.id),
  719:   );
  720: 
  721:   project.awards.forEach((award, index) => {
  722:     if (
  723:       award.recognitionType &&
  724:       !isValidProjectRecognitionType(award.recognitionType)
  725:     ) {
  726:       addError(
  727:         errors,
  728:         fieldErrors,
  729:         `awards.${index}.recognitionType`,
  730:         "PROJECT_RECOGNITION_TYPE_INVALID",
  731:         "Select a valid recognition type.",
  732:       );
  733:     }
  734: 
  735:     if (award.placement && !isValidProjectAwardPlacement(award.placement)) {
  736:       addError(
  737:         errors,
  738:         fieldErrors,
  739:         `awards.${index}.placement`,
  740:         "PROJECT_AWARD_PLACEMENT_INVALID",
  741:         "Select a valid award placement.",
  742:       );
  743:     }
  744: 
  745:     if (!isValidUrl(award.url)) {
  746:       addError(
  747:         errors,
  748:         fieldErrors,
  749:         `awards.${index}.url`,
  750:         "PROJECT_AWARD_URL_INVALID",
  751:         "Enter a complete HTTP or HTTPS award address.",
  752:       );
  753:     }
  754: 
  755:     award.supportingDocumentIds.forEach((documentId) => {
  756:       if (!documentIds.has(documentId)) {
  757:         addError(
  758:           errors,
  759:           fieldErrors,
  760:           `awards.${index}.supportingDocumentIds`,
  761:           "PROJECT_AWARD_DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND",
  762:           "An award references a Project document that is no longer available.",
  763:         );
  764:       }
  765:     });
  766:   });
  767: 
  768:   /*
  769:    * =========================================
  770:    * Media
  771:    * =========================================
  772:    */
  773: 
  774:   project.media.forEach((mediaItem, index) => {
  775:     if (!isValidProjectMediaType(mediaItem.type)) {
  776:       addError(
  777:         errors,
  778:         fieldErrors,
  779:         `media.${index}.type`,
  780:         "PROJECT_MEDIA_TYPE_INVALID",
  781:         "Select a valid project media type.",
  782:       );
  783:     }
  784: 
  785:     if (!mediaItem.storageKey && !mediaItem.externalUrl) {
  786:       addError(
  787:         errors,
  788:         fieldErrors,
  789:         `media.${index}`,
  790:         "PROJECT_MEDIA_SOURCE_REQUIRED",
  791:         "Project media must have a stored file or external address.",
  792:       );
  793:     }
  794: 
  795:     if (!isValidUrl(mediaItem.externalUrl)) {
  796:       addError(
  797:         errors,
  798:         fieldErrors,
  799:         `media.${index}.externalUrl`,
  800:         "PROJECT_MEDIA_URL_INVALID",
  801:         "Enter a complete HTTP or HTTPS media address.",
  802:       );
  803:     }
  804: 
  805:     if (mediaItem.type !== "video" && !mediaItem.altText) {
  806:       addWarning(
  807:         warnings,
  808:         `media.${index}.altText`,
  809:         "PROJECT_MEDIA_ALT_TEXT_RECOMMENDED",
  810:         `Add alternative text for â€œ${
  811:           mediaItem.name || "this image"
  812:         }â€ to improve accessibility.`,
  813:       );
  814:     }
  815:   });
  816: 
  817:   const activeMedia = project.media.filter(
  818:     (mediaItem) => mediaItem.status !== "archived",
  819:   );
  820: 
  821:   const featuredMediaId = project.presentation.featuredMediaId;
  822: 
  823:   if (
  824:     featuredMediaId &&
  825:     !activeMedia.some((mediaItem) => mediaItem.id === featuredMediaId)
  826:   ) {
  827:     addError(
  828:       errors,
  829:       fieldErrors,
  830:       "presentation.featuredMediaId",
  831:       "PROJECT_FEATURED_MEDIA_NOT_FOUND",
  832:       "The selected featured media is no longer available.",
  833:     );
  834:   }
  835: 
  836:   /*
  837:    * =========================================
  838:    * Supporting Documents
  839:    * =========================================
  840:    */
  841: 
  842:   project.supportingDocuments.forEach((documentRecord, index) => {
  843:     if (!isValidProjectDocumentType(documentRecord.documentType)) {
  844:       addError(
  845:         errors,
  846:         fieldErrors,
  847:         `supportingDocuments.${index}.documentType`,
  848:         "PROJECT_DOCUMENT_TYPE_INVALID",
  849:         "Select a valid Project document type.",
  850:       );
  851:     }
  852: 
  853:     if (!documentRecord.storageKey && !documentRecord.externalUrl) {
  854:       addError(
  855:         errors,
  856:         fieldErrors,
  857:         `supportingDocuments.${index}`,
  858:         "PROJECT_DOCUMENT_SOURCE_REQUIRED",
  859:         "A Project document must have a stored file or external address.",
  860:       );
  861:     }
  862: 
  863:     if (!isValidUrl(documentRecord.externalUrl)) {
  864:       addError(
  865:         errors,
  866:         fieldErrors,
  867:         `supportingDocuments.${index}.externalUrl`,
  868:         "PROJECT_DOCUMENT_URL_INVALID",
  869:         "Enter a complete HTTP or HTTPS document address.",
  870:       );
  871:     }
  872:   });
  873: 
  874:   /*
  875:    * =========================================
  876:    * Professional Completeness Warnings
  877:    * =========================================
  878:    */
  879: 
  880:   if (!project.problem.statement) {
  881:     addWarning(
  882:       warnings,
  883:       "problem.statement",
  884:       "PROJECT_PROBLEM_RECOMMENDED",
  885:       "Add the problem or opportunity the project addressed.",
  886:     );
  887:   }
  888: 
  889:   if (!project.problem.importance) {
  890:     addWarning(
  891:       warnings,
  892:       "problem.importance",
  893:       "PROJECT_IMPORTANCE_RECOMMENDED",
  894:       "Explain why this project was professionally important.",
  895:     );
  896:   }
  897: 
  898:   if (!project.solution.overview) {
  899:     addWarning(
  900:       warnings,
  901:       "solution.overview",
  902:       "PROJECT_SOLUTION_RECOMMENDED",
  903:       "Add a concise explanation of the solution.",
  904:     );
  905:   }
  906: 
  907:   if (project.solution.contributions.length === 0) {
  908:     addWarning(
  909:       warnings,
  910:       "solution.contributions",
  911:       "PROJECT_CONTRIBUTIONS_RECOMMENDED",
  912:       "Describe your personal contributions to the project.",
  913:     );
  914:   }
  915: 
  916:   if (project.lifecycleStatus === "completed" && !project.results.outcome) {
  917:     addWarning(
  918:       warnings,
  919:       "results.outcome",
  920:       "PROJECT_OUTCOME_RECOMMENDED",
  921:       "Add the completed Projectâ€™s final outcome.",
  922:     );
  923:   }
  924: 
  925:   if (
  926:     project.lifecycleStatus === "completed" &&
  927:     !project.results.problemsSolved
  928:   ) {
  929:     addWarning(
  930:       warnings,
  931:       "results.problemsSolved",
  932:       "PROJECT_PROBLEMS_SOLVED_RECOMMENDED",
  933:       "Explain which problems the completed project solved.",
  934:     );
  935:   }
  936: 
  937:   if (
  938:     project.lifecycleStatus === "completed" &&
  939:     project.results.metrics.length === 0
  940:   ) {
  941:     addWarning(
  942:       warnings,
  943:       "results.metrics",
  944:       "PROJECT_METRICS_RECOMMENDED",
  945:       "Add measurable evidence of the projectâ€™s result when available.",
  946:     );
  947:   }
  948: 
  949:   if (!project.presentation.shortSummary) {
  950:     addWarning(
  951:       warnings,
  952:       "presentation.shortSummary",
  953:       "PROJECT_SUMMARY_RECOMMENDED",
  954:       `Add a portfolio summary of up to ${PROJECT_FIELD_LIMITS.shortSummary} characters.`,
  955:     );
  956:   }
  957: 
  958:   if (activeMedia.length === 0) {
  959:     addWarning(
  960:       warnings,
  961:       "media",
  962:       "PROJECT_MEDIA_RECOMMENDED",
  963:       "Add a featured image or video to strengthen the portfolio presentation.",
  964:     );
  965:   }
  966: 
  967:   if (project.presentation.isFeatured && activeMedia.length === 0) {
  968:     addWarning(
  969:       warnings,
  970:       "presentation.isFeatured",
  971:       "PROJECT_FEATURED_MEDIA_RECOMMENDED",
  972:       "A featured Project should have a strong public image or video.",
  973:     );
  974:   }
  975: 
  976:   return {
  977:     isValid: errors.length === 0,
  978: 
  979:     project,
  980: 
  981:     errors,
  982: 
  983:     warnings,
  984: 
  985:     fieldErrors,
  986:   };
  987: }
  988: 
  989: /*
  990:  * =========================================
  991:  * Validation Summary
  992:  * =========================================
  993:  */
  994: 
  995: export function getProjectValidationSummary(value) {
  996:   const project = normalizeProject(value);
  997: 
  998:   const activePublicMedia = project.media.filter(
  999:     (mediaItem) =>
 1000:       mediaItem.status !== "archived" && mediaItem.visibility === "public",
 1001:   );
 1002: 
 1003:   const checks = [
 1004:     {
 1005:       id: "identity",
 1006:       complete: Boolean(project.title && project.role),
 1007:     },
 1008:     {
 1009:       id: "timeline",
 1010:       complete: Boolean(
 1011:         project.dates.startDate &&
 1012:         (project.dates.isCurrent ||
 1013:           project.dates.endDate ||
 1014:           !["completed", "cancelled"].includes(project.lifecycleStatus)),
 1015:       ),
 1016:     },
 1017:     {
 1018:       id: "problem",
 1019:       complete: Boolean(project.problem.statement),
 1020:     },
 1021:     {
 1022:       id: "importance",
 1023:       complete: Boolean(project.problem.importance),

 1025:     {
 1026:       id: "solution",
 1027:       complete: Boolean(project.solution.overview),
 1028:     },
 1029:     {
 1030:       id: "contributions",
 1031:       complete: project.solution.contributions.length > 0,
 1032:     },
 1033:     {
 1034:       id: "results",

 1036:         project.results.outcome || project.lifecycleStatus !== "completed",
 1037:       ),
 1038:     },
 1039:     {
 1040:       id: "evidence",
 1041:       complete:
 1042:         project.results.metrics.length > 0 ||
 1043:         project.supportingDocuments.length > 0,
 1044:     },
 1045:     {
 1046:       id: "skills",
 1047:       complete: project.skillRelationships.length > 0,
 1048:     },

 1051:       complete: project.technologies.length > 0,
 1052:     },
 1053:     {
 1054:       id: "summary",
 1055:       complete: Boolean(project.presentation.shortSummary),
 1056:     },
 1057:     {
 1058:       id: "media",
 1059:       complete: activePublicMedia.length > 0,
 1060:     },
 1061:   ];
 1062: 
 1063:   const completedCount = checks.filter((check) => check.complete).length;
 1064: 
 1065:   const percentage = Math.round((completedCount / checks.length) * 100);
 1066: 
 1067:   let level = "Basic";
 1068: 
 1069:   if (percentage >= 90) {
 1070:     level = "Portfolio Ready";
 1071:   } else if (percentage >= 70) {
 1072:     level = "Strong";
 1073:   } else if (percentage >= 50) {
 1074:     level = "Developing";
 1075:   }
 1076: 
 1077:   return `${completedCount} of ${checks.length} professional elements completed Â· ${level}`;

    1: import {
    2:   apiDelete,
    3:   apiGet,
    4:   apiPatch,
    5:   apiPost,
    6: } from "../apiClient.js";
    7: 
    8: const SKILLS_ENDPOINT = "/skills";
    9: 
   10: function skillPath(skillId) {
   11:   if (
   12:     typeof skillId !== "string" ||
   13:     !skillId.trim() ||
   14:     skillId.trim().length > 200
   15:   ) {
   16:     throw new TypeError("A valid Skill ID is required.");
   17:   }
   18: 
   19:   return `${SKILLS_ENDPOINT}/${encodeURIComponent(skillId.trim())}`;
   20: }
   21: 
   22: function requireRowVersion(rowVersion) {
   23:   if (typeof rowVersion !== "string" || !rowVersion.trim()) {
   24:     throw new TypeError("A Skill rowVersion is required.");
   25:   }
   26: 
   27:   return rowVersion.trim();
   28: }
   29: 
   30: function requireSkillData(skillData) {
   31:   if (
   32:     !skillData ||
   33:     typeof skillData !== "object" ||
   34:     Array.isArray(skillData)
   35:   ) {
   36:     throw new TypeError("Skill data must be an object.");
   37:   }
   38: 
   39:   return skillData;
   40: }
   41: 
   42: function requireUpdates(updates) {
   43:   if (
   44:     !updates ||
   45:     typeof updates !== "object" ||
   46:     Array.isArray(updates)
   47:   ) {
   48:     throw new TypeError("Skill updates must be an object.");
   49:   }
   50: 
   51:   return updates;
   52: }
   53: 
   54: export async function fetchSkills(options = {}) {
   55:   const response = await apiGet(SKILLS_ENDPOINT, options);
   56:   return response.data.skills;
   57: }
   58: 
   59: export async function fetchSkillById(skillId, options = {}) {
   60:   const response = await apiGet(skillPath(skillId), options);
   61:   return response.data.skill;
   62: }
   63: 
   64: export async function createSkillApi(skillData, options = {}) {
   65:   const response = await apiPost(
   66:     SKILLS_ENDPOINT,
   67:     requireSkillData(skillData),
   68:     options,
   69:   );
   70: 
   71:   return response.data.skill;
   72: }
   73: 
   74: export async function updateSkillApi(
   75:   skillId,
   76:   updates,
   77:   rowVersion,
   78:   options = {},
   79: ) {
   80:   const response = await apiPatch(
   81:     skillPath(skillId),
   82:     {
   83:       updates: requireUpdates(updates),
   84:       rowVersion: requireRowVersion(rowVersion),
   85:     },
   86:     options,
   87:   );
   88: 
   89:   return response.data.skill;
   90: }
   91: 
   92: export async function setSkillArchivedApi(
   93:   skillId,
   94:   archived,
   95:   rowVersion,
   96:   options = {},
   97: ) {
   98:   if (typeof archived !== "boolean") {
   99:     throw new TypeError("archived must be a boolean.");
  100:   }
  101: 
  102:   const response = await apiPatch(
  103:     `${skillPath(skillId)}/archive`,
  104:     {
  105:       archived,
  106:       rowVersion: requireRowVersion(rowVersion),
  107:     },
  108:     options,
  109:   );
  110: 
  111:   return response.data.skill;
  112: }
  113: 
  114: export function archiveSkillApi(
  115:   skillId,
  116:   rowVersion,
  117:   options = {},
  118: ) {
  119:   return setSkillArchivedApi(
  120:     skillId,
  121:     true,
  122:     rowVersion,
  123:     options,
  124:   );
  125: }
  126: 
  127: export function restoreSkillApi(
  128:   skillId,
  129:   rowVersion,
  130:   options = {},
  131: ) {
  132:   return setSkillArchivedApi(
  133:     skillId,
  134:     false,
  135:     rowVersion,
  136:     options,
  137:   );
  138: }
  139: 
  140: export async function deleteSkillApi(
  141:   skillId,
  142:   rowVersion,
  143:   options = {},
  144: ) {
  145:   const response = await apiDelete(skillPath(skillId), {
  146:     ...options,
  147:     body: {
  148:       rowVersion: requireRowVersion(rowVersion),
  149:     },
  150:   });
  151: 
  152:   return response.data;
  153: }

   21: function makeError(message, code, status = 400) {
   22:   const error = new Error(message);
   23:   error.code = code;
   24:   error.status = status;
   25:   error.publicMessage = message;
   26:   return error;
   27: }
   28: 
   29: function requireVersion(skill) {
   30:   if (!skill?.rowVersion) {
   31:     throw makeError(
   32:       "The skill must be refreshed before it can be changed.",
   33:       "SKILL_ROW_VERSION_REQUIRED",
   34:       409,
   35:     );
   36:   }
   37: 
   38:   return skill.rowVersion;
   39: }
   40: 
   41: function assertSkillCollection(skills) {
   42:   if (!Array.isArray(skills)) {
   43:     throw makeError(
   44:       "The server returned an invalid Skill Library.",
   45:       "SKILL_RESPONSE_INVALID",
   46:       502,
   47:     );
   48:   }
   49: 
   50:   const ids = new Set();
   51: 
   52:   for (const skill of skills) {
   53:     if (
   54:       !skill ||
   55:       typeof skill.id !== "string" ||
   56:       typeof skill.name !== "string" ||
   57:       typeof skill.rowVersion !== "string" ||
   58:       !skill.rowVersion.trim() ||
   59:       ids.has(skill.id)
   60:     ) {
   61:       throw makeError(
   62:         "The server returned an invalid or duplicate Skill.",
   63:         "SKILL_RESPONSE_INVALID",
   64:         502,
   65:       );
   66:     }
   67: 
   68:     ids.add(skill.id);
   69:   }
   70: 
   71:   return skills;
   72: }

   74: export async function getSkills({
   75:   includeArchived = false,
   76:   category = "all",
   77:   type = "all",
   78:   query = "",
   79: } = {}) {
   80:   const skills = assertSkillCollection(
   81:     await fetchSkills({
   82:       query: { includeArchived: true },
   83:     }),
   84:   );
   85: 
   86:   const search = normalizeSkillNameForComparison(query);
   87: 
   88:   return skills.filter((skill) => {
   89:     if (!includeArchived && skill.status === "archived") return false;
   90:     if (category !== "all" && skill.category !== category) return false;
   91:     if (type !== "all" && skill.type !== type) return false;
   92: 
   93:     if (!search) return true;
   94: 
   95:     return [
   96:       skill.name,
   97:       skill.description,
   98:       skill.category,
   99:       skill.type,
  100:       ...(skill.aliases || []),
  101:     ].some((value) =>
  102:       normalizeSkillNameForComparison(value).includes(search),
  103:     );
  104:   });
  105: }

  131: export async function resolveSkillMatch(name) {
  132:   const skills = await getSkills({ includeArchived: true });
  133:   const matchingSkill = findMatchingSkill(skills, name);
  134: 
  135:   if (!matchingSkill) {
  136:     return {
  137:       matched: false,
  138:       matchedBy: "",
  139:       skill: null,
  140:     };
  141:   }
  142: 
  143:   const requested = normalizeSkillNameForComparison(name);
  144:   const primary = normalizeSkillNameForComparison(matchingSkill.name);
  145: 
  146:   return {
  147:     matched: true,
  148:     matchedBy: requested === primary ? "name" : "alias",
  149:     skill: matchingSkill,
  150:   };
  151: }

  153: export async function findOrCreateSkill(
  154:   skillData,
  155:   { restoreArchived = true } = {},
  156: ) {
  157:   const candidate =
  158:     typeof skillData === "string"
  159:       ? { name: skillData }
  160:       : skillData && typeof skillData === "object"
  161:         ? skillData
  162:         : {};
  163: 
  164:   const name = String(candidate.name || "").trim();
  165: 
  166:   if (!name) {
  167:     throw makeError("Enter a skill name.", "SKILL_NAME_REQUIRED");
  168:   }
  169: 
  170:   const match = await resolveSkillMatch(name);
  171: 
  172:   if (match.matched) {
  173:     const restored =
  174:       restoreArchived && match.skill.status === "archived";
  175: 
  176:     const skill = restored
  177:       ? await restoreSkill(match.skill.id, match.skill.rowVersion)
  178:       : match.skill;
  179: 
  180:     return {
  181:       skill,
  182:       created: false,
  183:       restored,
  184:       matched: true,
  185:       matchedBy: match.matchedBy,
  186:     };
  187:   }
  188: 
  189:   const skill = await createSkill({
  190:     ...candidate,
  191:     name,
  192:     source: candidate.source || "manual",
  193:     sourceContext: candidate.sourceContext || "experience",
  194:   });
  195: 
  196:   return {
  197:     skill,
  198:     created: true,
  199:     restored: false,
  200:     matched: false,
  201:     matchedBy: "",
  202:   };
  203: }

   56: 
   57: function createSkillNotFoundError(skillId) {
   58:   return createSkillServiceError({
   59:     message: `Skill "${skillId}" was not found.`,
   60: 
   61:     publicMessage: "The requested skill could not be found.",
   62:

   69: /*
   70:  * =========================================
   71:  * Skill Usage Conflict
   72:  * =========================================
   73:  */
   74: 
   75: function createSkillUsageConflict(skill, usage) {
   76:   const experienceCount = Number(usage?.experienceCount) || 0;
   77: 
   78:   const educationCount = Number(usage?.educationCount) || 0;
   79: 
   80:   const trainingCount = Number(usage?.trainingCount) || 0;
   81: 
   82:   const resumeCount = Number(usage?.resumeCount) || 0;
   83: 
   84:   const portfolioCount = Number(usage?.portfolioCount) || 0;
   85: 
   86:   const experienceSkillCount = Number(usage?.experienceSkillCount) || 0;
   87: 
   88:   const experienceTechnologyCount =
   89:     Number(usage?.experienceTechnologyCount) || 0;
   90: 
   91:   const educationSkillCount = Number(usage?.educationSkillCount) || 0;
   92: 
   93:   const trainingSkillCount = Number(usage?.trainingSkillCount) || 0;
   94: 
   95:   const relationshipCount =
   96:     experienceSkillCount +
   97:     experienceTechnologyCount +
   98:     educationSkillCount +
   99:     trainingSkillCount;
  100: 
  101:   const recordCount =
  102:     experienceCount +
  103:     educationCount +
  104:     trainingCount +
  105:     resumeCount +
  106:     portfolioCount;
  107: 
  108:   const publicMessage =
  109:     `"${skill.name}" cannot be permanently deleted because it is still ` +
  110:     `referenced by ${recordCount} ${
  111:       recordCount === 1 ? "saved record" : "saved records"
  112:     }. Archive it instead.`;
  113: 
  114:   const experienceConflicts = Array.isArray(usage?.experiences)
  115:     ? usage.experiences.map((experience) => ({
  116:         type: "experience",
  117: 
  118:         recordId: experience.id,
  119: 
  120:         recordName:
  121:           `${experience.positionTitle} at ` + experience.organizationName,
  122: 
  123:         positionTitle: experience.positionTitle,
  124: 
  125:         organizationName: experience.organizationName,
  126: 
  127:         usedAsSkill: experience.usedAsSkill === true,
  128: 
  129:         usedAsTechnology: experience.usedAsTechnology === true,
  130:       }))
  131:     : [];
  132: 
  133:   const educationConflicts = Array.isArray(usage?.educationRecords)
  134:     ? usage.educationRecords.map((education) => ({
  135:         type: "education",
  136: 
  137:         recordId: education.id,
  138: 
  139:         recordName:
  140:           `${education.credentialName} at ` + education.institutionName,
  141: 
  142:         credentialName: education.credentialName,
  143: 
  144:         institutionName: education.institutionName,
  145:       }))
  146:     : [];
  147: 
  148:   const trainingConflicts = Array.isArray(usage?.trainingRecords)
  149:     ? usage.trainingRecords.map((training) => ({
  150:         type: "training",
  151: 
  152:         recordId: training.id,
  153: 
  154:         recordName: `${training.title} from ` + training.providerName,
  155: 
  156:         title: training.title,
  157: 
  158:         providerName: training.providerName,
  159:       }))
  160:     : [];
  161: 
  162:   return createSkillServiceError({
  163:     message:
  164:       `Skill "${skill.id}" has stored relationships ` +
  165:       "and cannot be deleted.",
  166: 
  167:     publicMessage,
  168: 
  169:     code: "SKILL_IN_USE",
  170: 
  171:     status: 409,
  172: 
  173:     details: {
  174:       skillId: skill.id,
  175:       skillName: skill.name,
  176: 
  177:       recordCount,
  178:       relationshipCount,
  179: 
  180:       experienceCount,
  181:       educationCount,
  182:       trainingCount,
  183:       resumeCount,
  184:       portfolioCount,
  185: 
  186:       experienceSkillCount,
  187:       experienceTechnologyCount,
  188:       educationSkillCount,
  189:       trainingSkillCount,
  190:     },
  191: 
  192:     usage,
  193: 
  194:     conflicts: [
  195:       ...experienceConflicts,
  196:       ...educationConflicts,
  197:       ...trainingConflicts,
  198:     ],
  199:   });
  200: }

  229: /*
  230:  * =========================================
  231:  * Get All Skills
  232:  * =========================================
  233:  */
  234: 
  235: export async function getSkills({
  236:   includeArchived = false,
  237:   category = "all",
  238:   type = "all",
  239:   query = "",
  240: } = {}) {
  241:   const skills = readStoredSkills();
  242: 
  243:   const normalizedQuery = normalizeSkillNameForComparison(query);
  244: 
  245:   return skills
  246:     .filter((skill) => {
  247:       if (!includeArchived && skill.status === "archived") {
  248:         return false;
  249:       }
  250: 
  251:       if (category !== "all" && skill.category !== category) {
  252:         return false;
  253:       }
  254: 
  255:       if (type !== "all" && skill.type !== type) {
  256:         return false;
  257:       }
  258: 
  259:       if (!normalizedQuery) {
  260:         return true;
  261:       }
  262: 
  263:       const searchableValues = [
  264:         skill.name,
  265:         skill.description,
  266:         skill.category,
  267:         skill.type,
  268:         ...(skill.aliases || []),
  269:       ]
  270:         .map(normalizeSkillNameForComparison)
  271:         .filter(Boolean);
  272: 
  273:       return searchableValues.some((value) => value.includes(normalizedQuery));
  274:     })
  275:     .sort((firstSkill, secondSkill) =>
  276:       firstSkill.name.localeCompare(secondSkill.name, undefined, {
  277:         sensitivity: "base",
  278:       }),
  279:     );
  280: }

  365: /*
  366:  * =========================================
  367:  * Update Skill
  368:  * =========================================
  369:  */
  370: 
  371: export async function updateSkill(skillId, updates = {}) {
  372:   if (!skillId) {
  373:     throw createSkillServiceError({
  374:       message: "A skill ID is required to update a skill.",
  375: 
  376:       publicMessage: "The skill could not be identified.",
  377: 
  378:       code: "SKILL_ID_REQUIRED",
  379: 
  380:       status: 400,
  381:     });
  382:   }
  383: 
  384:   const skills = readStoredSkills();
  385: 
  386:   const skillIndex = skills.findIndex((skill) => skill.id === skillId);
  387: 
  388:   if (skillIndex === -1) {
  389:     throw createSkillNotFoundError(skillId);
  390:   }
  391: 
  392:   const currentSkill = skills[skillIndex];
  393: 
  394:   const safeUpdates = updates && typeof updates === "object" ? updates : {};
  395: 
  396:   const mergedSkill = {
  397:     ...currentSkill,
  398:     ...safeUpdates,
  399: 
  400:     proficiency: {
  401:       ...currentSkill.proficiency,
  402:       ...safeUpdates.proficiency,
  403:     },
  404: 
  405:     language: {
  406:       ...currentSkill.language,
  407:       ...safeUpdates.language,
  408:     },
  409: 
  410:     id: currentSkill.id,
  411: 
  412:     createdAt: currentSkill.createdAt,
  413:   };
  414: 
  415:   assertValidSkill(mergedSkill, {
  416:     existingSkills: skills,
  417:     excludeSkillId: skillId,
  418:   });
  419: 
  420:   const updatedSkill = updateSkillModel(currentSkill, safeUpdates);
  421: 
  422:   const nextSkills = [...skills];
  423: 
  424:   nextSkills[skillIndex] = updatedSkill;
  425: 
  426:   replaceStoredSkills(nextSkills);
  427: 
  428:   return updatedSkill;
  429: }

  464:  * =========================================
  465:  */
  466: 
  467: function resolveStoredSkillUsage(skillId) {
  468:   /*
  469:    * Active and archived parent records are checked.
  470:    * Archiving a parent record does not remove its
  471:    * central Skill Library relationships.
  472:    */
  473: 
  474:   const experiences = readStoredExperiences();
  475: 
  476:   const educationRecords = readStoredEducation();
  477: 
  478:   const trainingRecords = readStoredTraining();
  479: 
  480:   return getSkillUsage(skillId, {
  481:     experiences,
  482:     educationRecords,
  483:     trainingRecords,
  484:   });
  485: }
